=== \.github\workflows\firebase-hosting.yml ===
name: Deploy to Firebase Hosting

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Firebase CLI
        run: npm install -g firebase-tools

      - name: Deploy to Firebase Hosting
        run: firebase deploy --only hosting --project saybon-3e3c2
        env:
          FIREBASE_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.FIREBASE_TOKEN }}


=== \.github\workflows\health.yml ===
name: SayBon health check
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 6,18 * * *"   # 06:00 and 18:00 UTC = Ghana time
  workflow_dispatch: {}
jobs:
  audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - name: Run the audit
        id: audit
        run: node tools/audit.mjs .
      - name: Email me if something is wrong
        if: failure()
        uses: dawidd6/action-send-mail@v3
        with:
          server_address: smtp.gmail.com
          server_port: 465
          secure: true
          username: saybon.fr@gmail.com
          password: ${{ secrets.MAIL_PASSWORD }}
          subject: "SayBon health check: something needs attention"
          to: saybon.fr@gmail.com
          from: SayBon monitor <saybon.fr@gmail.com>
          body: file://audit-report.txt

let currentQuestion = 0;
let score = 0;
let wrongAnswers = 0;
let interventionShown = false;
let spokenAnswers = [];
let writtenAnswers = [];
let mediaRecorder = null;
let recordedChunks = [];
let currentAudioBlob = null;
let pausedQuestionIndex = null;

const app = document.getElementById("app");
const questionText = document.getElementById("questionText");
const mediaArea = document.getElementById("mediaArea");
const answers = document.getElementById("answers");
const progressBar = document.getElementById("progressBar");
const questionCategory = document.getElementById("questionCategory");
const questionCounter = document.getElementById("questionCounter");

const intervention = document.getElementById("intervention");
const interventionAudio = document.getElementById("interventionAudio");
const continueBtn = document.getElementById("continueBtn");
const revealBtn = document.getElementById("revealBtn");

function resetInterventionState() {
  if (intervention) {
    intervention.classList.add("hidden");
    intervention.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    intervention.style.display = "none";
    intervention.style.opacity = "0";
    intervention.style.pointerEvents = "none";
  }

  if (app) {
    app.classList.remove("hidden");
    app.style.display = "";
    app.style.opacity = "1";
    app.style.pointerEvents = "auto";
  }

  if (continueBtn) {
    continueBtn.style.opacity = "0";
    continueBtn.classList.remove("slide-in-left");
  }

  if (revealBtn) {
    revealBtn.style.opacity = "0";
    revealBtn.classList.remove("slide-in-right");
  }

  if (interventionAudio) {
    interventionAudio.pause();
    interventionAudio.currentTime = 0;
    interventionAudio.onended = null;
  }
}

function updateProgress() {
  const progress = (currentQuestion / questions.length) * 100;
  progressBar.style.width = `${progress}%`;
}

function clearUI() {
  mediaArea.innerHTML = "";
  answers.innerHTML = "";
  currentAudioBlob = null;
}

function makePillButton(text, onClick, extraClass = "") {
  const btn = document.createElement("button");
  btn.className = `answer-pill ${extraClass}`.trim();
  btn.textContent = text;
  btn.type = "button";
  btn.onclick = onClick;
  return btn;
}

function getEstimatedLevelByProgress() {
  if (score <= 1) return "A0";
  if (score <= 3) return "A1";
  if (score <= 5) return "A2";
  if (score <= 7) return "B1";
  return "B2";
}

function renderQuestion() {
  const q = questions[currentQuestion];

  if (!q) {
    finishPlacement();
    return;
  }

  resetInterventionState();
  updateProgress();
  clearUI();

  questionText.textContent = q.prompt;
  questionCategory.textContent = q.category || "Placement";
  questionCounter.textContent = `Question ${currentQuestion + 1} of ${questions.length}`;

  if (q.audio) {
    const audioWrap = document.createElement("div");
    audioWrap.className = "audio-wrap";

    const audio = document.createElement("audio");
    audio.controls = true;
    audio.src = q.audio;
    audio.preload = "auto";

    audioWrap.appendChild(audio);
    mediaArea.appendChild(audioWrap);
  }

  if (q.text) {
    const readingBlock = document.createElement("div");
    readingBlock.className = "reading-block";
    readingBlock.innerHTML = `
      <p class="reading-label">TEXT</p>
      <div class="reading-text">${q.text}</div>
    `;
    mediaArea.appendChild(readingBlock);
  }

  if (q.readingQuestion) {
    const rq = document.createElement("div");
    rq.className = "reading-question";
    rq.textContent = q.readingQuestion;
    mediaArea.appendChild(rq);
  }

  if (q.type === "mcq") {
    q.options.forEach((option, index) => {
      const btn = makePillButton(option, () => handleAnswer(index));
      answers.appendChild(btn);
    });
  }

  if (q.type === "speaking") {
    const card = document.createElement("div");
    card.className = "response-card speaking-card";
    card.innerHTML = `
      <p class="response-prompt speaking-prompt">${q.speakingPrompt}</p>

      <div class="speaking-recorder-shell">
        <div class="speaking-control-row">
          <button class="record-icon-btn record-icon-start" id="startRecordingBtn" type="button" aria-label="Start recording">

    `;

      });

      renderQuestion();
    };
  }

  if (q.type === "writing") { {
    const card = document.createElement("div");
    card.className = "response-card";

      const val = document.getElementById("writtenResponse").value.trim();
      writtenAnswers.push({
        id: q.id,
        level: q.level,
        prompt: q.writingPrompt,
        answer: val
      });
      currentQuestion++;
      renderQuestion();
    };
  }
}

async function startRecording(questionId) {
  try {
    if (mediaRecorder && mediaRecorder.state !== "inactive") return;

    const startBtn = document.getElementById("startRecordingBtn");
    const stopBtn = document.getElementById("stopRecordingBtn");
    const submitBtn = document.getElementById("submitSpeaking");
    const status = document.getElementById("recStatus");
    const previewWrap = document.getElementById("audioPreviewWrap");
    const reRecordBtn = document.getElementById("reRecordBtn");
    const waveCanvas = document.getElementById("waveCanvas");

    currentAudioBlob = null;
    recordedChunks = [];

    if (previewWrap) previewWrap.innerHTML = "";
    if (submitBtn) submitBtn.disabled = true;
    if (reRecordBtn) reRecordBtn.disabled = true;

    recordingStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
    mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(recordingStream);

    waveAudioContext = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    waveSource = waveAudioContext.createMediaStreamSource(recordingStream);
    waveAnalyser = waveAudioContext.createAnalyser();
    waveAnalyser.fftSize = 2048;
    waveSource.connect(waveAnalyser);

    if (waveCanvas) {
      startWaveDraw(waveCanvas, waveAnalyser);
    }

    mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = (event) => {
      if (event.data && event.data.size > 0) {
        recordedChunks.push(event.data);
      }
    };

    mediaRecorder.onstop = async () => {
      try {
        currentAudioBlob = new Blob(recordedChunks, { type: "audio/webm" });
        renderSavedAudioPreview(currentAudioBlob);

        if (status) status.textContent = "Recording saved. You can replay, re-record, or submit.";
        if (submitBtn) submitBtn.disabled = false;
        if (reRecordBtn) reRecordBtn.disabled = false;
      } catch (err) {
        console.error(err);
        if (status) status.textContent = "Recording failed. Please try again.";
      } finally {
        stopWaveDraw();
        cleanupWaveRecorder();
        if (startBtn) startBtn.disabled = false;
        if (stopBtn) stopBtn.disabled = true;
      }
    };

    mediaRecorder.start();

    if (startBtn) startBtn.disabled = true;
    if (stopBtn) stopBtn.disabled = false;
    if (status) status.textContent = "Recording… speak now.";
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(error);
    const status = document.getElementById("recStatus");
    if (status) status.textContent = "Microphone access is required to record your answer.";
    cleanupWaveRecorder();
  }
}

function stopRecording() {
  const status = document.getElementById("recStatus");

  if (mediaRecorder && mediaRecorder.state !== "inactive") {
    mediaRecorder.stop();
    if (status) status.textContent = "Finishing recording…";
  }
}

function handleAnswer(selectedIndex) {
  const q = questions[currentQuestion];

  if (selectedIndex === q.correct) {
    score++;
  } else {
    wrongAnswers++;
  }

  currentQuestion++;

  if (!interventionShown && wrongAnswers >= 3 && currentQuestion < questions.length) {
    pausedQuestionIndex = currentQuestion;
    showIntervention();
    return;
  }

  renderQuestion();
}

function showIntervention() {
  if (wrongAnswers < 3 || interventionShown === true) return;

  interventionShown = true;

  if (app) {
    app.classList.add("hidden");
    app.style.display = "none";
    app.style.pointerEvents = "none";
  }

  if (intervention) {
    intervention.classList.remove("hidden");
    intervention.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
    intervention.style.display = "flex";
    intervention.style.opacity = "1";
    intervention.style.pointerEvents = "all";
  }

  continueBtn.style.opacity = "0";
  revealBtn.style.opacity = "0";
  continueBtn.classList.remove("slide-in-left");
  revealBtn.classList.remove("slide-in-right");

  if (interventionAudio) {
    interventionAudio.currentTime = 0;
    interventionAudio.play().catch(() => {});
    interventionAudio.onended = () => {
      continueBtn.style.opacity = "1";
      revealBtn.style.opacity = "1";
      continueBtn.classList.add("slide-in-left");
      revealBtn.classList.add("slide-in-right");
    };
  }
}

continueBtn.onclick = () => {
  if (intervention) {
    intervention.classList.add("hidden");
    intervention.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    intervention.style.display = "none";
    intervention.style.opacity = "0";
    intervention.style.pointerEvents = "none";
  }

  if (app) {
    app.classList.remove("hidden");
    app.style.display = "";
    app.style.pointerEvents = "auto";
  }

  if (pausedQuestionIndex !== null) {
    currentQuestion = pausedQuestionIndex;
  }

  renderQuestion();
};

revealBtn.onclick = () => {
  finishPlacement(true);
};

function calculateLevel() {
  const percent = Math.round((score / 12) * 100);

  if (percent < 25) return "A0";
  if (percent < 45) return "A1";
  if (percent < 65) return "A2";
  if (percent < 80) return "B1";
  return "B2";
}

function finishPlacement(fromIntervention = false) {
  const level = fromIntervention ? getEstimatedLevelByProgress() : calculateLevel();

  sessionStorage.setItem("placement_score", String(score));
  sessionStorage.setItem("placement_total", "15");
  sessionStorage.setItem("placement_level", level);
  sessionStorage.setItem("placement_spoken_answers", JSON.stringify(spokenAnswers));
  sessionStorage.setItem("placement_written_answers", JSON.stringify(writtenAnswers));
  sessionStorage.setItem("placement_intervention_used", fromIntervention ? "yes" : "no");

  window.location.href = "/placement/result.html";
}

resetInterventionState();
renderQuestion();

/* ==========================================
   SPEAKING RECORDER UPGRADE HELPERS
========================================== */

let waveAnimation = null;
let recordingStream = null;
let waveAudioContext = null;
let waveAnalyser = null;
let waveSource = null;

function startWaveDraw(canvas, analyserNode) {
  if (!canvas || !analyserNode) return;

  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  const bufferLength = analyserNode.fftSize;
  const dataArray = new Uint8Array(bufferLength);

  function draw() {
    waveAnimation = requestAnimationFrame(draw);

    analyserNode.getByteTimeDomainData(dataArray);

    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, canvas.width, 0);
    grad.addColorStop(0, "rgba(110,224,255,0.85)");
    grad.addColorStop(1, "rgba(67,154,255,0.95)");

    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.strokeStyle = grad;
    ctx.beginPath();

    const sliceWidth = canvas.width / bufferLength;
    let x = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < bufferLength; i++) {
      const v = dataArray[i] / 128.0;
      const y = v * canvas.height / 2;

      if (i === 0) {
        ctx.moveTo(x, y);
      } else {
        ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      }

      x += sliceWidth;
    }

    ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, canvas.height / 2);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  draw();
}

function stopWaveDraw() {
  if (waveAnimation) {
    cancelAnimationFrame(waveAnimation);
    waveAnimation = null;
  }

  const canvas = document.getElementById("waveCanvas");
  if (canvas) {
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  }
}

function cleanupWaveRecorder() {
  try {
    if (recordingStream) {
      recordingStream.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());
    }
  } catch (e) {}

  try {
    if (waveAudioContext && waveAudioContext.state !== "closed") {
      waveAudioContext.close();
    }
  } catch (e) {}

  recordingStream = null;
  waveAudioContext = null;
  waveAnalyser = null;
  waveSource = null;
  mediaRecorder = null;
}

function renderSavedAudioPreview(blob) {
  const previewWrap = document.getElementById("audioPreviewWrap");
  if (!previewWrap || !blob) return;

  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

  previewWrap.innerHTML = `
    <div class="saved-audio-box">
      <audio id="savedAudioPlayer" controls src="${url}"></audio>
    </div>
  `;
}

function reRecordSpeaking() {
  currentAudioBlob = null;
  recordedChunks = [];

  const previewWrap = document.getElementById("audioPreviewWrap");
  const submitBtn = document.getElementById("submitSpeaking");
  const reRecordBtn = document.getElementById("reRecordBtn");
  const status = document.getElementById("recStatus");
  const startBtn = document.getElementById("startRecordingBtn");
  const stopBtn = document.getElementById("stopRecordingBtn");

  if (previewWrap) previewWrap.innerHTML = "";
  if (submitBtn) submitBtn.disabled = true;
  if (reRecordBtn) reRecordBtn.disabled = true;
  if (startBtn) startBtn.disabled = false;
  if (stopBtn) stopBtn.disabled = true;
  if (status) status.textContent = "Tap record and answer in French.";

  stopWaveDraw();
  cleanupWaveRecorder();
}

// SayBon activity tracking: streaks, daily goal minutes, achievements.
// Mounted once from server.js: require("./activity-routes")(app, { admin, db, express })
module.exports = function mountActivity(app, deps) {
  const { admin, db, express } = deps;
  const TYPES = ["lesson", "game", "music", "exam"];
  const EVENTS = { lesson_complete: "lesson", game_complete: "game", exam_complete: "exam" };
  const GOALS = [5, 10, 15, 20, 30];
  const DEFAULT_GOAL = 10;
  const DAY_RE = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;
  const MAX_SEC_PER_CALL = 180;
  const MAX_SEC_PER_DAY = 5 * 3600;

  function dayNum(s) { return Math.round(Date.parse(s + "T00:00:00Z") / 86400000); }
  function dayStr(n) { return new Date(n * 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10); }
  function validDay(s) {
    if (typeof s !== "string" || !DAY_RE.test(s) || isNaN(Date.parse(s + "T00:00:00Z"))) return false;
    return Math.abs(dayNum(s) - Math.floor(Date.now() / 86400000)) <= 2;
  }
  async function uidFrom(req, res) {
    const h = req.headers.authorization || "";
    const t = h.indexOf("Bearer ") === 0 ? h.slice(7) : null;
    if (!t) { res.status(401).json({ error: "authentication required" }); return null; }
    try { return (await admin.auth().verifyIdToken(t)).uid; }
    catch (e) { res.status(401).json({ error: "authentication failed" }); return null; }
  }
  const sumRef = (uid) => db.collection("userActivity").doc(uid);
  const dayRef = (uid, d) => db.collection("userActivity").doc(uid).collection("days").doc(d);

  function emptySec() { return { lesson: 0, game: 0, music: 0, exam: 0 }; }
  function totalSec(sec) { return TYPES.reduce((a, k) => a + (sec[k] || 0), 0); }

  // quick health check: open /api/activity/ping in a browser
  app.get("/api/activity/ping", (req, res) => res.json({ ok: true, activity: true }));

  // ---------- LOG ----------
  app.post("/api/activity/log", express.json({ limit: "20kb" }), async (req, res) => {
    const uid = await uidFrom(req, res); if (!uid) return;
    try {
      const { day, type } = req.body || {};
      let seconds = Math.floor(Number(req.body && req.body.seconds) || 0);
      const event = req.body && req.body.event;
      if (!validDay(day)) return res.status(400).json({ error: "bad day" });
      if (!TYPES.includes(type)) return res.status(400).json({ error: "bad type" });
      if (event && !EVENTS[event]) return res.status(400).json({ error: "bad event" });
      seconds = Math.max(0, Math.min(MAX_SEC_PER_CALL, seconds));

      const out = await db.runTransaction(async (tx) => {
        const sRef = sumRef(uid), dRef = dayRef(uid, day);
        const [sSnap, dSnap] = await Promise.all([tx.get(sRef), tx.get(dRef)]);
        const s = sSnap.exists ? sSnap.data() : {};
        const d = dSnap.exists ? dSnap.data() : {};
        const goal = GOALS.includes(s.goalMinutes) ? s.goalMinutes : DEFAULT_GOAL;
        const sec = Object.assign(emptySec(), d.sec || {});
        const room = Math.max(0, MAX_SEC_PER_DAY - totalSec(sec));
        const add = Math.min(seconds, room);
        sec[type] += add;
        const comp = Object.assign({ lesson: 0, game: 0, exam: 0 }, d.completions || {});
        const totals = Object.assign(emptySec(), s.totals || {});
        totals[type] += add;
        const counts = Object.assign({ lesson_complete: 0, game_complete: 0, exam_complete: 0 }, s.counts || {});
        if (event) { comp[EVENTS[event]] += 1; counts[event] += 1; }
        const total = totalSec(sec);
        const goalMet = total >= goal * 60;
        const counted = goalMet || comp.lesson + comp.game + comp.exam > 0;
        let streak = s.streak || 0, best = s.bestStreak || 0, last = s.lastCountedDay || null;
        let goalDays = s.goalDays || 0;
        if (goalMet && !d.goalCounted) goalDays += 1;
        let streakGrew = false;
        if (counted && last !== day) {
          if (last && dayNum(day) - dayNum(last) === 1) streak += 1;
          else if (!last || dayNum(day) > dayNum(last)) streak = 1;
          // if day is earlier than last (clock skew) leave streak alone
          if (!last || dayNum(day) >= dayNum(last)) { last = day; streakGrew = true; }
          best = Math.max(best, streak);
        }
        tx.set(dRef, { sec, completions: comp, total, goalMet, goalCounted: goalMet || !!d.goalCounted, counted, day }, { merge: true });
        tx.set(sRef, { goalMinutes: goal, streak, bestStreak: best, lastCountedDay: last, totals, counts, goalDays, updatedAt: admin.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp() }, { merge: true });
        return { streak, goalMinutes: goal, todaySeconds: total, goalMet, streakGrew };
      });
      res.json(out);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("ACTIVITY LOG ERROR:", err);
      res.status(500).json({ error: "could not log activity" });
    }
  });

  // ---------- SETTINGS ----------
  app.post("/api/activity/settings", express.json({ limit: "5kb" }), async (req, res) => {
    const uid = await uidFrom(req, res); if (!uid) return;
    try {
      const g = Number(req.body && req.body.goalMinutes);
      if (!GOALS.includes(g)) return res.status(400).json({ error: "goalMinutes must be one of " + GOALS.join(", ") });
      await sumRef(uid).set({ goalMinutes: g }, { merge: true });
      res.json({ success: true, goalMinutes: g });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("ACTIVITY SETTINGS ERROR:", err);
      res.status(500).json({ error: "could not save settings" });
    }
  });

  // ---------- SUMMARY ----------
  function achievements(stats) {
    const m = (sec) => Math.floor(sec / 60);
    const list = [
      ["first_lesson", "🎯", "First Steps", "Complete your first lesson", stats.lessons, 1],
      ["five_lessons", "📘", "Dedicated Learner", "Complete 5 lessons", stats.lessons, 5],
      ["twentyfive_lessons", "📚", "Bookworm", "Complete 25 lessons", stats.lessons, 25],
      ["first_game", "🧩", "Game On", "Finish your first Talkletics mission", stats.games, 1],
      ["first_exam", "📝", "Exam Ready", "Finish a DELF mock exam", stats.exams, 1],
      ["music_30", "🎧", "Music Lover", "Listen for 30 minutes", m(stats.musicSec), 30],
      ["goal_1", "🎉", "Goal Getter", "Hit your daily goal", stats.goalDays, 1],
      ["goal_7", "🏅", "Goal Crusher", "Hit your daily goal 7 times", stats.goalDays, 7],
      ["streak_3", "🔥", "Streak Keeper", "3-day streak", stats.bestStreak, 3],
      ["streak_7", "⚡", "On Fire", "7-day streak", stats.bestStreak, 7],
      ["streak_30", "🌟", "Unstoppable", "30-day streak", stats.bestStreak, 30],
      ["minutes_100", "⏱️", "Century", "Practise for 100 minutes in total", m(stats.totalSec), 100]
    ];
    return list.map(([id, icon, title, sub, value, target]) => ({
      id, icon, title, sub, earned: value >= target, value: Math.min(value, target), target
    }));
  }

  app.get("/api/activity/summary", async (req, res) => {
    const uid = await uidFrom(req, res); if (!uid) return;
    try {
      const day = req.query.day;
      if (!validDay(day)) return res.status(400).json({ error: "bad day" });
      const dn = dayNum(day);
      const weekDays = []; for (let i = 6; i >= 0; i--) weekDays.push(dayStr(dn - i));
      const refs = weekDays.map((d) => dayRef(uid, d));
      const [sSnap, lpSnap, ...dSnaps] = await Promise.all([
        sumRef(uid).get(), db.collection("levelProgress").doc(uid).get(), ...refs.map((r) => r.get())
      ]);
      const s = sSnap.exists ? sSnap.data() : {};
      const goal = GOALS.includes(s.goalMinutes) ? s.goalMinutes : DEFAULT_GOAL;
      const week = weekDays.map((d, i) => {
        const x = dSnaps[i].exists ? dSnaps[i].data() : {};
        return { day: d, minutes: Math.round(((x.total || 0) / 60) * 10) / 10, counted: !!x.counted };
      });
      const todayDoc = dSnaps[6].exists ? dSnaps[6].data() : {};
      const todaySec = Object.assign(emptySec(), todayDoc.sec || {});
      let streak = s.streak || 0;
      const last = s.lastCountedDay;
      const alive = last && dn - dayNum(last) <= 1;
      const countedToday = last === day;
      if (!alive) streak = 0;
      const levels = {}; let lessons = 0;
      if (lpSnap.exists) {
        const lp = lpSnap.data();
        Object.keys(lp).forEach((k) => { const n = ((lp[k] && lp[k].completedLessons) || []).length; levels[k] = n; lessons += n; });
      }
      const totals = Object.assign(emptySec(), s.totals || {});
      const counts = s.counts || {};
      const stats = {
        lessons: Math.max(lessons, counts.lesson_complete || 0), games: counts.game_complete || 0,
        exams: counts.exam_complete || 0, musicSec: totals.music, totalSec: totalSec(totals),
        goalDays: s.goalDays || 0, bestStreak: Math.max(s.bestStreak || 0, streak)
      };
      res.json({
        streak, bestStreak: stats.bestStreak, countedToday,
        goalMinutes: goal,
        today: { seconds: totalSec(todaySec), bySeconds: todaySec, goalMet: totalSec(todaySec) >= goal * 60 },
        week, totalsSeconds: totals, levels, lessonsCompleted: lessons,
        counts: { lessons: stats.lessons, games: stats.games, exams: stats.exams },
        achievements: achievements(stats)
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("ACTIVITY SUMMARY ERROR:", err);
      res.status(500).json({ error: "could not load summary" });
    }
  });
};

  if(!stream)$("state").textContent="Microphone off: say it out loud";

import dotenv from "dotenv";

/*
========================================
LOAD ENV FIRST (ABSOLUTE TOP)
========================================
*/
dotenv.config({ path: "./.env" });

/*
========================================
IMPORTS
========================================
*/
import express from "express";
import cors from "cors";

import requestRoutes from "./routes/requestRoutes.js";
import stripeRoutes from "./routes/stripeRoutes.js";
import paystackRoutes from "./routes/paystackRoutes.js";

/*
========================================
INIT
========================================
*/
const app = express();

/*
========================================
MIDDLEWARE
========================================
*/
app.use(cors());
app.use(express.json());
app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true }));

/*
========================================
HEALTH CHECK
========================================
*/
app.get("/", (req, res) => {
  res.send("SayBon Backend Running");
});

/*
========================================
ROUTES (CANONICAL API)
========================================
- Quote upload + word count:
  POST /api/quote   (multipart form-data "file")

- Stripe session:
  POST /api/stripe/create-stripe-session  (json {amount})

- Paystack init:
  POST /api/paystack/initialize           (json {amount, email})
========================================
*/
app.use("/api/quote", requestRoutes);
app.use("/api/stripe", stripeRoutes);
app.use("/api/paystack", paystackRoutes);

/*
========================================
LEGACY ALIASES (so old frontend links still work)
========================================
*/
app.use("/request", requestRoutes);
app.use("/stripe", stripeRoutes);
app.use("/paystack", paystackRoutes);

/*
========================================
404
========================================
*/
app.use((req, res) => {
  res.status(404).json({
    success: false,
    message: "Endpoint not found"
  });
});

/*
========================================
SERVER
========================================
*/
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3000;

app.listen(PORT, () => {
  console.log("SayBon backend running on port " + PORT);
});

=== \backend\functions\index.js ===
/**
 * SayBon Payments API (Firebase Functions v2)
 * Route:
 * POST /api/create-stripe-session
 */

// force redeploy

const { onRequest } = require("firebase-functions/v2/https");
const express = require("express");
const cors = require("cors");

try { require("dotenv").config(); } catch (e) {}

const Stripe = require("stripe");

const app = express();

app.use(cors({ origin: true }));
app.use(express.json({ limit: "1mb" }));

function mustEnv(name) {
  const v = process.env[name];
  if (!v) throw new Error(`Missing environment variable: ${name}`);
  return v;
}

function safeNumber(n, fallback = 0) {
  const x = Number(n);
  return Number.isFinite(x) ? x : fallback;
}

function clampInt(n, min, max) {
  const x = Math.round(safeNumber(n, min));
  return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, x));
}

function normalizeCurrency(cur) {
  const c = String(cur || "USD").trim().toUpperCase();
  if (["USD","GBP","EUR"].includes(c)) return c;
  return "USD";
}

function formatPlan(plan) {
  const p = String(plan || "").toLowerCase();
  return p === "express" ? "express" : "standard";
}

/* ===============================
   STRIPE CHECKOUT
================================ */

app.post("/create-stripe-session", async (req,res) => {

  try {

const stripe = new Stripe(process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY);
    const currency = normalizeCurrency(req.body.currency);
    const plan = formatPlan(req.body.plan);

    const words = clampInt(req.body.words,1,5000000);
    const amount = safeNumber(req.body.amount,0);

    const amountCents = clampInt(amount * 100,50,500000000);

    const origin = req.headers.origin || "https://saybonapp.com";

    const session = await stripe.checkout.sessions.create({

      mode:"payment",

      line_items:[{
        price_data:{
          currency:currency.toLowerCase(),
          product_data:{
            name: plan === "express" ? "Express Translation" : "Standard Translation",
            description:`${words} words`
          },
          unit_amount:amountCents
        },
        quantity:1
      }],

      success_url:`${origin}/translation/success.html?session_id={CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID}`,

      cancel_url:`${origin}/translation/request.html`

    });

    res.json({ url: session.url });

  }

  catch(err){

    console.error("Stripe error:",err);

    res.status(400).json({
      error:"stripe_error",
      message:err.message
    });

  }

});

/* ===============================
   HEALTH CHECK
================================ */

app.get("/health",(req,res)=>{
  res.json({ ok:true });
});

/* ===============================
   EXPORT API
================================ */

exports.api = onRequest({

  region:"us-central1",

  secrets:[
    "STRIPE_SECRET_KEY"
  ]

},app);

# SayBon Assistant File Ledger

## 2026-02-26 16:44:01 — Updated payment backend wiring (LIVE via Firebase Functions)

=== \backend\server.js ===
/* force redeploy 11 Mar */

import express from "express";
import cors from "cors";
import Stripe from "stripe";
import admin from "firebase-admin";

const app = express();

/* ==========================================
FIREBASE ADMIN
========================================== */

admin.initializeApp();
const db = admin.firestore();

/* ==========================================
STRIPE INITIALIZATION
========================================== */

const stripe = new Stripe(process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY,{
  apiVersion:"2023-10-16"
});

/* ==========================================
WEBHOOK (RAW BODY REQUIRED)
========================================== */

app.post("/webhook", express.raw({type:"application/json"}), async (req,res)=>{

  let event;

  try{

    event = stripe.webhooks.constructEvent(
      req.body,
      req.headers["stripe-signature"],
      process.env.STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
    );

  }catch(err){

    console.error("Webhook signature verification failed:",err.message);
    return res.status(400).send(`Webhook Error: ${err.message}`);

  }

  /* ==========================================
  PAYMENT COMPLETED
  ========================================== */

  if(event.type === "checkout.session.completed"){

    const session = event.data.object;
    const jobId = session.client_reference_id;

    console.log("Stripe payment received for job:",jobId);

    if(jobId){

      try{

        await db.collection("translationJobs")
        .doc(jobId)
        .update({
          status:"paid",
          paidAt:new Date()
        });

        console.log("Firestore updated for:",jobId);

      }catch(err){

        console.error("Firestore update failed:",err);

      }

    }

  }

  res.json({received:true});

});

/* ==========================================
MIDDLEWARE (AFTER WEBHOOK)
========================================== */

app.use(cors({
  origin:[
    "https://saybonapp.com",
    "http://localhost:5500"
  ],
  methods:["GET","POST"],
  allowedHeaders:["Content-Type"]
}));

app.use(express.json());

/* ==========================================
SERVER HEALTH CHECK
========================================== */

app.get("/", (req,res)=>{
  res.json({
    status:"SayBon server running"
  });
});

/* ==========================================
CREATE STRIPE CHECKOUT
========================================== */

app.post("/api/createCheckout", async (req,res)=>{

  try{

    const { words, plan, jobId } = req.body;

    if(!words || !plan || !jobId){
      return res.status(400).json({
        error:"Missing words, plan or jobId"
      });
    }

    let price = 0;

    if(plan==="express"){
      price = words * 0.05;
    }else{
      price = words * 0.025;
    }

    const session = await stripe.checkout.sessions.create({

      payment_method_types:["card"],

      mode:"payment",

      line_items:[{
        price_data:{
          currency:"usd",
          product_data:{
            name:"SayBon Translation Service"
          },
          unit_amount:Math.round(price * 100)
        },
        quantity:1
      }],

      client_reference_id: jobId,

      metadata:{
        words:String(words),
        plan:String(plan)
      },

      success_url:
      "https://saybonapp.com/translation/success.html?job="+jobId,

      cancel_url:
      "https://saybonapp.com/translation/request.html"

    });

    res.json({
      url:session.url
    });

  }catch(err){

    console.error("Stripe Checkout Error:",err);

    res.status(500).json({
      error:"Stripe checkout failed"
    });

  }

});

/* ==========================================
404 HANDLER
========================================== */

app.use((req,res)=>{
  res.status(404).json({
    error:"Route not found"
  });
});

/* ==========================================
START SERVER (RENDER)
========================================== */

const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3000;

app.listen(PORT, ()=>{
  console.log("SayBon payment server running on port", PORT);
});


=== \backend\src\controllers\quoteController.js ===
import fs from "fs";

export default async function(req,res){

try{

const file=req.file;

if(!file){

return res.status(400).json({

error:"No file"

});

}

const text=fs.readFileSync(file.path,"utf8");

const words=text.trim().split(/\s+/).length;

res.json({

wordCount:words,

standard:(words*0.025).toFixed(2),

express:(words*0.05).toFixed(2)

});

}catch(e){

res.status(500).json({

error:e.message

});

}

}

=== \delf-grading-routes.js ===
// DELF placement: real marking of the writing and speaking answers.
//   POST /api/delf/grade-writing   { attemptId, level, prompt }            (JSON)
//   POST /api/delf/grade-speaking?attemptId=..&level=..&prompt=..          (body: audio/wav, 16 kHz mono)
// Writing: an AI examiner (Claude if ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set, otherwise Azure OpenAI) scores it 0-100 for the level.
// Speaking: Azure Speech transcribes + rates pronunciation; the AI examiner scores the content; the two are blended.
module.exports = function (app, ctx) {
  var admin = ctx.admin, db = ctx.db, express = ctx.express;
  var LEVELS = ["a1","a2","b1","b2","c1","c2","prim","junior"];

  async function uidFrom(req, res) {
    var h = req.headers.authorization || "";
    var t = h.indexOf("Bearer ") === 0 ? h.slice(7) : null;
    if (!t) { res.status(401).json({ error: "authentication required" }); return null; }
    try { return (await admin.auth().verifyIdToken(t)).uid; }
    catch (e) { res.status(401).json({ error: "authentication failed" }); return null; }
  }
  function attemptRef(uid, id) { return db.collection("delfPlacements").doc(uid).collection("attempts").doc(String(id)); }
  var clamp = function (n) { n = Math.round(Number(n)); return isFinite(n) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, n)) : null; };

  function parseJson(text) {
    try { return JSON.parse(String(text).replace(/```json|```/g, "").trim()); } catch (e) {}
    var m = String(text).match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/);
    if (m) { try { return JSON.parse(m[0]); } catch (e) {} }
    return null;
  }

  async function llmJson(system, user) {
    if (process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) {
      try {
        var r = await fetch("https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "x-api-key": process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, "anthropic-version": "2023-06-01" },
          body: JSON.stringify({ model: "claude-sonnet-5", max_tokens: 400, system: system, messages: [{ role: "user", content: user }] })
        });
        var d = await r.json();
        if (r.ok && d.content && d.content[0]) { var p = parseJson(d.content[0].text); if (p) return p; }
        else console.error("grading: Anthropic error", r.status, JSON.stringify(d).slice(0, 200));
      } catch (e) { console.error("grading: Anthropic failed", e.message); }
    }
    var ep = process.env.AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT, key = process.env.AZURE_OPENAI_KEY, dep = process.env.AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT;
    if (ep && key && dep) {
      try {
        var r2 = await fetch(ep.replace(/\/$/, "") + "/openai/deployments/" + dep + "/chat/completions?api-version=2024-08-01-preview", {
          method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "api-key": key },
          body: JSON.stringify({ messages: [{ role: "system", content: system }, { role: "user", content: user }], temperature: 0.3, max_tokens: 400 })
        });
        var d2 = await r2.json();
        var txt = d2.choices && d2.choices[0] && d2.choices[0].message && d2.choices[0].message.content;
        if (r2.ok && txt) { var p2 = parseJson(txt); if (p2) return p2; }
        else console.error("grading: Azure OpenAI error", r2.status, JSON.stringify(d2).slice(0, 200));
      } catch (e) { console.error("grading: Azure OpenAI failed", e.message); }
    }
    return null;
  }

  var SYSTEM = function (level, skill) {
    return "You are a kind, fair DELF examiner marking a placement-test " + skill + " answer at CEFR level " + String(level).toUpperCase() + ". " +
      "Judge it against what is expected at THAT level, and be generous: reward communication and effort, do not nitpick small errors. " +
      "Score from 0 to 100 (about 50 means a pass at that level). " +
      "Reply with ONLY valid JSON, no markdown: {\"score\": <integer 0-100>, \"feedback\": \"<two or three short, encouraging sentences in English: one strength, one thing to improve, and one corrected example if useful>\"}";
  };

  app.post("/api/delf/grade-writing", express.json({ limit: "50kb" }), async function (req, res) {
    var uid = await uidFrom(req, res); if (!uid) return;
    try {
      var b = req.body || {}, level = String(b.level || "").toLowerCase();
      if (LEVELS.indexOf(level) < 0 || !b.attemptId) return res.status(400).json({ error: "bad request" });
      var ref = attemptRef(uid, b.attemptId), snap = await ref.get();
      if (!snap.exists) return res.status(404).json({ error: "attempt not found" });
      var text = String((snap.data() || {}).writingResponse || "").trim();
      if (!text) { await ref.update({ writingStatus: "skipped" }); return res.json({ ok: true, status: "skipped" }); }
      var g = await llmJson(SYSTEM(level, "writing"), "Task given to the candidate: " + String(b.prompt || "").slice(0, 600) + "\n\nCandidate's answer:\n" + text.slice(0, 4000));
      var score = g ? clamp(g.score) : null;
      if (score == null) { await ref.update({ writingStatus: "ungraded" }); return res.json({ ok: true, status: "ungraded" }); }
      var fb = String(g.feedback || "").slice(0, 700);
      await ref.update({ writingScore: score, writingFeedback: fb, writingStatus: "graded" });
      res.json({ ok: true, status: "graded", score: score });
    } catch (e) { console.error("grade-writing", e); res.status(500).json({ error: "could not grade writing" }); }
  });

  app.post("/api/delf/grade-speaking", express.raw({ type: ["audio/wav", "audio/x-wav", "application/octet-stream"], limit: "8mb" }), async function (req, res) {
    var uid = await uidFrom(req, res); if (!uid) return;
    try {
      var level = String(req.query.level || "").toLowerCase(), id = req.query.attemptId;
      if (LEVELS.indexOf(level) < 0 || !id) return res.status(400).json({ error: "bad request" });
      var audio = req.body;
      if (!Buffer.isBuffer(audio) || audio.length < 4000) return res.status(400).json({ error: "recording too short" });
      var ref = attemptRef(uid, id), snap = await ref.get();
      if (!snap.exists) return res.status(404).json({ error: "attempt not found" });
      var region = process.env.AZURE_SPEECH_REGION, key = process.env.AZURE_SPEECH_KEY;
      if (!region || !key) { await ref.update({ speakingStatus: "ungraded" }); return res.json({ ok: true, status: "ungraded" }); }
      var base = "https://" + region + ".stt.speech.microsoft.com/speech/recognition/conversation/cognitiveservices/v1?language=fr-FR&format=detailed";
      var hdr = { "Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key": key, "Content-Type": "audio/wav; codecs=audio/pcm; samplerate=16000", "Accept": "application/json" };

      // 1. what was said
      var r1 = await fetch(base, { method: "POST", headers: hdr, body: audio });
      var d1 = await r1.json().catch(function () { return {}; });
      if (!r1.ok) { console.error("grade-speaking STT", r1.status, JSON.stringify(d1).slice(0, 200)); await ref.update({ speakingStatus: "ungraded" }); return res.json({ ok: true, status: "ungraded" }); }
      var best = d1.NBest && d1.NBest[0];
      var transcript = String((best && (best.Display || best.Lexical)) || d1.DisplayText || "").trim();
      if (!transcript) {
        await ref.update({ speakingScore: 0, speakingTranscript: "", speakingStatus: "no_speech", speakingFeedback: "We could not hear any speech in this recording. Try again in a quiet place, close to the microphone." });
        return res.json({ ok: true, status: "no_speech" });
      }

      // 2. how clearly it was said (pronunciation / fluency), scored against what was recognised
      var pron = null;
      try {
        var cfg = { ReferenceText: transcript, GradingSystem: "HundredMark", Granularity: "Word", Dimension: "Comprehensive", EnableMiscue: false };
        var h2 = Object.assign({}, hdr, { "Pronunciation-Assessment": Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(cfg)).toString("base64") });
        var r2 = await fetch(base, { method: "POST", headers: h2, body: audio });
        var d2 = await r2.json().catch(function () { return {}; });
        var b2 = r2.ok && d2.NBest && d2.NBest[0];
        if (b2) {
          var raw = (b2.AccuracyScore || 0) * 0.5 + (b2.CompletenessScore || 0) * 0.3 + (b2.FluencyScore || 0) * 0.2;
          pron = raw <= 0 ? 0 : Math.min(100, Math.round(100 * Math.pow(raw / 100, 0.75)));
        }
      } catch (e) { console.error("grade-speaking PA", e.message); }

      // 3. what was said, judged by the examiner
      var g = await llmJson(SYSTEM(level, "speaking") + " The answer is a transcript of a spoken answer, so ignore punctuation and capital letters.",
        "Task given to the candidate: " + String(req.query.prompt || "").slice(0, 600) + "\n\nTranscript of the candidate's spoken answer:\n" + transcript.slice(0, 3000));
      var content = g ? clamp(g.score) : null;

      var final = (pron != null && content != null) ? Math.round(pron * 0.4 + content * 0.6) : (content != null ? content : pron);
      if (final == null) { await ref.update({ speakingStatus: "ungraded", speakingTranscript: transcript }); return res.json({ ok: true, status: "ungraded" }); }
      var fb = g && g.feedback ? String(g.feedback).slice(0, 700) : "Your pronunciation was scored. Detailed feedback is not available right now.";
      await ref.update({ speakingScore: final, speakingPronunciation: pron, speakingContent: content, speakingTranscript: transcript.slice(0, 2000), speakingFeedback: fb, speakingStatus: "graded" });
      res.json({ ok: true, status: "graded", score: final });
    } catch (e) { console.error("grade-speaking", e); res.status(500).json({ error: "could not grade speaking" }); }
  });
};


=== \delf-journey-routes.js ===
// DELF journey: strict step-by-step course per level, plus multi-voice listening audio.
//   GET  /api/delf/journey?level=a2                         (Bearer) -> steps with status, scores
//   POST /api/delf/journey/lesson      {level, step}        (Bearer) -> marks an OPEN lesson done
//   POST /api/delf/journey/skill-mock  {level, skill, mockId, score}   score is out of 25
//   POST /api/delf/journey/skip-remedial {level, skill}
//   POST /api/delf/narrate {text}   -> English teacher voice (mp3)
//   POST /api/delf/tts-lines {lines:[{v:"F"|"H"|"N", t}], level}   -> audio/mpeg (one file, several voices)
// Order per level: for each skill (co, ce, pe, po): lessons 1-4, skill mock, then (only if the mock is under 50%)
// two optional extra lessons, then the next skill. Finally full mock 1 and full mock 2. Only the next step is open.
module.exports = function (app, ctx) {
  var admin = ctx.admin, db = ctx.db, express = ctx.express;
  var LEVELS = ["a1", "a2", "b1", "b2", "c1"];
  var SKILLS = ["co", "ce", "pe", "po"];
  var PASS = 12.5;                                     // 50% of a 25-point paper
  var SKILL_MOCK_N = { co: 1, ce: 2, pe: 3, po: 4 };   // tp-<level>-01..04 give the single-paper mocks
  var FULL_N = [5, 6];                                 // tp-<level>-05 and -06 are the two full mocks
  var pad = function (n) { return (n < 10 ? "0" : "") + n; };
  var mockId = function (level, n) { return "tp-" + level + "-" + pad(n); };

  async function auth(req, res) {
    var h = req.headers.authorization || "";
    if (h.indexOf("Bearer ") !== 0) { res.status(401).json({ error: "authentication required" }); return null; }
    try { return await admin.auth().verifyIdToken(h.slice(7)); } catch (e) { res.status(401).json({ error: "authentication failed" }); return null; }
  }
  async function owns(uid, level) {
    try { var s = await db.collection("delfAccess").doc(uid).get(); var d = s.exists ? s.data() : {}; return !!(d[level] && d[level].granted); } catch (e) { return false; }
  }
  async function loadProgress(uid, level) {
    var s = await db.collection("delfJourney").doc(uid).get(); var all = s.exists ? s.data() : {};
    var p = all[level] || {}; return { done: p.done || {}, skillMocks: p.skillMocks || {}, skipped: p.skipped || {} };
  }
  async function saveProgress(uid, level, p) {
    var o = {}; o[level] = p; await db.collection("delfJourney").doc(uid).set(o, { merge: true });
  }
  async function fullResults(uid, level) {
    var ids = FULL_N.map(function (n) { return mockId(level, n); }), out = {};
    try {
      var snap = await db.collection("delfMockResults").doc(uid).collection("attempts").where("mockId", "in", ids).limit(40).get();
      snap.docs.forEach(function (d) { var x = d.data(); if (!out[x.mockId] || x.total > out[x.mockId].total) out[x.mockId] = { total: x.total, passed: !!x.passed }; });
    } catch (e) { console.error("journey fullResults", e.message); }
    return out;
  }

  // Build the ordered list with a status for every step.
  function build(level, p, full) {
    var steps = [], prevOk = true;                    // prevOk: everything before is done (and any extra-lesson choice resolved)
    SKILLS.forEach(function (sk) {
      var lessonDone = true;
      for (var n = 1; n <= 4; n++) {
        var id = level + "-" + sk + "-" + n, done = !!p.done[id];
        steps.push({ id: id, kind: "lesson", skill: sk, n: n, status: done ? "done" : (prevOk ? "open" : "locked") });
        if (done) { /* stays ok */ } else { prevOk = false; lessonDone = false; }
      }
      var mid = level + "-" + sk + "-mock", sm = p.skillMocks[sk], mdone = !!(sm && p.done[mid]);
      steps.push({ id: mid, kind: "skillmock", skill: sk, mockId: mockId(level, SKILL_MOCK_N[sk]), status: mdone ? "done" : (prevOk ? "open" : "locked"),
        score: sm ? sm.score : null, pct: sm ? Math.round(sm.score / 25 * 100) : null, passed: sm ? sm.score >= PASS : null });
      if (!mdone) prevOk = false;
      var need = !!(sm && sm.score < PASS);
      var r1 = level + "-" + sk + "-r1", r2 = level + "-" + sk + "-r2";
      var r1d = !!p.done[r1], r2d = !!p.done[r2], skipped = !!p.skipped[sk];
      steps.push({ id: r1, kind: "remedial", skill: sk, n: 1, hidden: !need, status: r1d ? "done" : (need && mdone ? "open" : "locked") });
      steps.push({ id: r2, kind: "remedial", skill: sk, n: 2, hidden: !need, status: r2d ? "done" : (need && mdone && r1d ? "open" : "locked") });
      var resolved = !need || (r1d && r2d) || skipped;
      if (need && !resolved) prevOk = false;           // the learner must choose: take the extra lessons or skip them
      steps[steps.length - 1].choice = need && mdone && !resolved ? true : undefined;
    });
    FULL_N.forEach(function (n, i) {
      var id = mockId(level, n), r = full[id], done = !!r;
      steps.push({ id: "full" + (i + 1), kind: "full", mockId: id, status: done ? "done" : (prevOk ? "open" : "locked"), score: r ? r.total : null, passed: r ? r.passed : null });
      if (!done) prevOk = false;
    });
    return steps;
  }
  function find(steps, id) { for (var i = 0; i < steps.length; i++) if (steps[i].id === id) return steps[i]; return null; }
  async function guard(req, res) {
    var who = await auth(req, res); if (!who) return null;
    var level = String((req.body && req.body.level) || req.query.level || "").toLowerCase();
    if (LEVELS.indexOf(level) < 0) { res.status(400).json({ error: "unknown level" }); return null; }
    if (!(await owns(who.uid, level))) { res.status(403).json({ error: "this level is not unlocked" }); return null; }
    return { uid: who.uid, level: level };
  }

  app.get("/api/delf/journey", async function (req, res) {
    try {
      var g = await guard(req, res); if (!g) return;
      var p = await loadProgress(g.uid, g.level), full = await fullResults(g.uid, g.level);
      res.json({ level: g.level, passPct: 50, steps: build(g.level, p, full) });
    } catch (e) { console.error("journey get", e); res.status(500).json({ error: "could not load your journey" }); }
  });

  app.post("/api/delf/journey/lesson", express.json({ limit: "2kb" }), async function (req, res) {
    try {
      var g = await guard(req, res); if (!g) return;
      var id = String(req.body.step || "");
      var p = await loadProgress(g.uid, g.level), steps = build(g.level, p, await fullResults(g.uid, g.level)), st = find(steps, id);
      if (!st || (st.kind !== "lesson" && st.kind !== "remedial")) return res.status(400).json({ error: "unknown lesson" });
      if (st.status === "locked") return res.status(409).json({ error: "finish the previous step first" });
      if (st.status !== "done") { p.done[id] = Date.now(); await saveProgress(g.uid, g.level, p); }
      res.json({ ok: true });
    } catch (e) { console.error("journey lesson", e); res.status(500).json({ error: "could not save" }); }
  });

  app.post("/api/delf/journey/skill-mock", express.json({ limit: "2kb" }), async function (req, res) {
    try {
      var g = await guard(req, res); if (!g) return;
      var sk = String(req.body.skill || ""), score = Number(req.body.score);
      if (SKILLS.indexOf(sk) < 0 || !isFinite(score)) return res.status(400).json({ error: "bad request" });
      score = Math.max(0, Math.min(25, Math.round(score * 10) / 10));
      var p = await loadProgress(g.uid, g.level), steps = build(g.level, p, await fullResults(g.uid, g.level)), st = find(steps, g.level + "-" + sk + "-mock");
      if (!st || st.status === "locked") return res.status(409).json({ error: "finish the lessons first" });
      var prev = p.skillMocks[sk];
      p.skillMocks[sk] = { score: score, mockId: String(req.body.mockId || "").slice(0, 20), at: Date.now() };
      p.done[g.level + "-" + sk + "-mock"] = Date.now();
      if (score >= PASS || (prev && prev.score < PASS && score >= PASS)) { delete p.skipped[sk]; }
      await saveProgress(g.uid, g.level, p);
      res.json({ ok: true, score: score, pct: Math.round(score / 25 * 100), passed: score >= PASS });
    } catch (e) { console.error("journey skill-mock", e); res.status(500).json({ error: "could not save" }); }
  });

  app.post("/api/delf/journey/skip-remedial", express.json({ limit: "2kb" }), async function (req, res) {
    try {
      var g = await guard(req, res); if (!g) return;
      var sk = String(req.body.skill || ""), p = await loadProgress(g.uid, g.level);
      if (SKILLS.indexOf(sk) < 0 || !p.skillMocks[sk] || p.skillMocks[sk].score >= PASS) return res.status(400).json({ error: "nothing to skip" });
      p.skipped[sk] = true; await saveProgress(g.uid, g.level, p); res.json({ ok: true });
    } catch (e) { console.error("journey skip", e); res.status(500).json({ error: "could not save" }); }
  });

  // ---- multi-voice listening audio ----
  var cache = new Map(), CACHE_MAX = 200;
  var RATE = { a1: "-18%", a2: "-12%", b1: "-6%", b2: "0%", c1: "0%" };
  var VOICE = { F: "fr-FR-DeniseNeural", H: "fr-FR-HenriNeural", N: "fr-FR-DeniseNeural" };
  function esc(s) { return String(s).replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;").replace(/"/g, "&quot;"); }
  function ssml(lines, level, plain) {
    var rate = RATE[level] || "-10%";
    // the pause sits INSIDE each voice element: that is the form Azure accepts
    var body = lines.map(function (l) {
      var inner = plain ? esc(l.t) : '<prosody rate="' + rate + '">' + esc(l.t) + "</prosody>";
      var br = plain ? "" : '<break time="' + (l.v === "N" ? "700ms" : "400ms") + '"/>';
      return '<voice name="' + (VOICE[l.v] || VOICE.F) + '">' + inner + br + "</voice>";
    }).join("");
    return '<speak version="1.0" xml:lang="fr-FR" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis">' + body + "</speak>";
  }
  app.post("/api/delf/tts-lines", express.json({ limit: "40kb" }), async function (req, res) {
    try {
      var who = await auth(req, res); if (!who) return;
      var lines = Array.isArray(req.body && req.body.lines) ? req.body.lines.slice(0, 40) : [];
      lines = lines.map(function (l) { return { v: String(l.v || "F").toUpperCase().charAt(0), t: String(l.t || "").trim() }; }).filter(function (l) { return l.t; });
      var total = lines.reduce(function (a, l) { return a + l.t.length; }, 0);
      if (!lines.length || total > 4000) return res.status(400).json({ error: "text missing or too long" });
      var level = String(req.body.level || "").toLowerCase();
      var key = process.env.AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, region = process.env.AZURE_SPEECH_REGION;
      if (!key || !region) return res.status(500).json({ error: "speech service is not configured" });
      var ck = level + "|" + JSON.stringify(lines), hit = cache.get(ck);
      if (!hit) {
        var r = null, variants = [ssml(lines, level, false), ssml(lines, level, true)];
        for (var i = 0; i < variants.length; i++) {
          r = await fetch("https://" + region + ".tts.speech.microsoft.com/cognitiveservices/v1", {
            method: "POST",
            headers: { "Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key": key, "Content-Type": "application/ssml+xml", "X-Microsoft-OutputFormat": "audio-24khz-48kbitrate-mono-mp3", "User-Agent": "saybon-delf-tts" },
            body: variants[i]
          });
          if (r.ok) break;
          var msg = ""; try { msg = (await r.text()).slice(0, 300); } catch (e) {}
          console.error("DELF tts-lines Azure error", r.status, "variant", i, msg);
          if (r.status !== 400) break;
        }
        if (!r.ok) return res.status(502).json({ error: "speech synthesis failed (" + r.status + ")" });
        hit = Buffer.from(await r.arrayBuffer());
        if (cache.size >= CACHE_MAX) cache.delete(cache.keys().next().value);
        cache.set(ck, hit);
      }
      res.set({ "Content-Type": "audio/mpeg", "Content-Length": hit.length, "Cache-Control": "private, max-age=86400" });
      res.send(hit);
    } catch (e) { console.error("DELF tts-lines", e); res.status(500).json({ error: "could not create audio" }); }
  });
  // ---- English teacher voice for the lessons (French words in «guillemets» are spoken in French) ----
  var ncache = new Map();
  function nSsml(text, mode) {
    var t = String(text).replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;");
    var voice = mode === 2 ? "en-GB-SoniaNeural" : "en-US-AvaMultilingualNeural";
    if (mode === 0) t = t.replace(/«\s*([^»]+?)\s*»/g, '<lang xml:lang="fr-FR">$1</lang>');
    else t = t.replace(/[«»]/g, "");
    return '<speak version="1.0" xml:lang="en-US" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis"><voice name="' + voice + '"><prosody rate="-8%">' + t + "</prosody></voice></speak>";
  }
  app.post("/api/delf/narrate", express.json({ limit: "8kb" }), async function (req, res) {
    try {
      var who = await auth(req, res); if (!who) return;
      var text = String((req.body && req.body.text) || "").trim();
      if (!text || text.length > 1200) return res.status(400).json({ error: "text missing or too long" });
      var key = process.env.AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, region = process.env.AZURE_SPEECH_REGION;
      if (!key || !region) return res.status(500).json({ error: "speech service is not configured" });
      var hit = ncache.get(text);
      if (!hit) {
        var r = null;
        for (var m = 0; m < 3; m++) {
          r = await fetch("https://" + region + ".tts.speech.microsoft.com/cognitiveservices/v1", {
            method: "POST",
            headers: { "Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key": key, "Content-Type": "application/ssml+xml", "X-Microsoft-OutputFormat": "audio-24khz-48kbitrate-mono-mp3", "User-Agent": "saybon-delf-narrate" },
            body: nSsml(text, m)
          });
          if (r.ok) break;
          var msg = ""; try { msg = (await r.text()).slice(0, 300); } catch (e) {}
          console.error("DELF narrate Azure error", r.status, "variant", m, msg);
          if (r.status !== 400) break;
        }
        if (!r.ok) return res.status(502).json({ error: "speech synthesis failed (" + r.status + ")" });
        hit = Buffer.from(await r.arrayBuffer());
        if (ncache.size >= 150) ncache.delete(ncache.keys().next().value);
        ncache.set(text, hit);
      }
      res.set({ "Content-Type": "audio/mpeg", "Content-Length": hit.length, "Cache-Control": "private, max-age=86400" });
      res.send(hit);
    } catch (e) { console.error("DELF narrate", e); res.status(500).json({ error: "could not create audio" }); }
  });
};


=== \delf-mock-routes.js ===
// DELF mock exam routes. Added alongside server.js; mounted with:
//   require("./delf-mock-routes")(app, { admin, db, express });
const RUBRICS = require("./delf-rubrics.js");

module.exports = function mountDelfMockRoutes(app, deps) {
  const admin = deps.admin, db = deps.db, express = deps.express;

  async function getUid(req) {
    const h = req.headers.authorization || "";
    const token = h.indexOf("Bearer ") === 0 ? h.slice(7) : null;
    if (!token) return null;
    try { const d = await admin.auth().verifyIdToken(token); return d.uid; } catch (e) { return null; }
  }

  // Plain speech-to-text for exam answers (no pronunciation reference text).
  app.post("/api/delfTranscribe", express.raw({ type: () => true, limit: "10mb" }), async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const audio = req.body;
      if (!audio || !audio.length) return res.status(400).json({ error: "Audio is required" });
      const region = process.env.AZURE_SPEECH_REGION, key = process.env.AZURE_SPEECH_KEY;
      if (!region || !key) return res.status(500).json({ error: "Azure Speech is not configured on the server yet" });
      const url = "https://" + region + ".stt.speech.microsoft.com/speech/recognition/conversation/cognitiveservices/v1?language=fr-FR&format=detailed";
      const r = await fetch(url, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key": key, "Content-Type": "audio/wav; codecs=audio/pcm; samplerate=16000", "Accept": "application/json" },
        body: audio
      });
      const data = await r.json();
      if (!r.ok) return res.status(500).json({ error: "Transcription failed" });
      const best = data.NBest && data.NBest[0];
      const text = (best && (best.Display || best.Lexical)) || data.DisplayText || "";
      const conf = best && best.Confidence != null ? best.Confidence : null;
      res.json({ text: text, confidence: conf, status: data.RecognitionStatus || null });
    } catch (e) { console.error("delfTranscribe", e); res.status(500).json({ error: "Could not transcribe" }); }
  });

  // Rubric grading of a written or spoken production.
  app.post("/api/gradeDelfMock", express.json({ limit: "400kb" }), async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const b = req.body || {};
      const rubric = RUBRICS[b.rubric];
      if (!rubric) return res.status(400).json({ error: "unknown rubric" });
      const responses = Array.isArray(b.responses) ? b.responses.slice(0, 8) : [];
      const text = responses.map(function (r, i) {
        return "TASK " + (i + 1) + ": " + String(r.task || "").slice(0, 7000) + "\nCANDIDATE " + (rubric.kind === "po" ? "(speech transcript)" : "") + ": " + String(r.response || "").slice(0, 9000);
      }).join("\n\n");
      if (!text.trim() || responses.every(function (r) { return !String(r.response || "").trim(); })) {
        return res.json(zero(rubric, "No answer was given."));
      }
      const ep = process.env.AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT, key = process.env.AZURE_OPENAI_KEY, dep = process.env.AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT;
      if (!ep || !key || !dep) return res.status(500).json({ error: "Azure OpenAI is not configured on the server yet" });

      const crit = rubric.criteria.map(function (c) { return '- "' + c.k + '" (0 to ' + c.max + "): " + c.l + ". " + c.d; }).join("\n");
      const sys = "You are an experienced DELF examiner marking a practice exam at CEFR level " + String(rubric.level).toUpperCase() + " (" + (rubric.kind === "po" ? "oral production, spoken transcript produced by speech recognition: do not penalise punctuation, capitalisation or minor recognition errors" : "written production") + "). " +
        "Mark strictly but fairly against the official DELF grid, for the level only. Answer in English except for French quotations. " +
        "Score each criterion with a whole number between 0 and its maximum. If the response is off-topic, far too short or mostly not French, score low. " +
        'Reply ONLY with JSON: {"scores":{<key>:<number>,...},"strengths":"2-3 sentences","improvements":"2-3 sentences","correction":"one short corrected phrase taken from the candidate or empty"}\nCriteria:\n' + crit;
      const url = ep.replace(/\/$/, "") + "/openai/deployments/" + dep + "/chat/completions?api-version=2024-08-01-preview";
      const r = await fetch(url, {
        method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "api-key": key },
        body: JSON.stringify({ messages: [{ role: "system", content: sys }, { role: "user", content: text }], temperature: 0.2, max_tokens: 600, response_format: { type: "json_object" } })
      });
      const data = await r.json();
      if (!r.ok) { console.error("gradeDelfMock azure", data); return res.status(500).json({ error: "Grading request failed" }); }
      const raw = data.choices && data.choices[0] && data.choices[0].message && data.choices[0].message.content;
      let p; try { p = JSON.parse(raw); } catch (e) { return res.status(500).json({ error: "Could not parse grading result" }); }
      const scores = {}; let total = 0;
      rubric.criteria.forEach(function (c) {
        let v = Number(p && p.scores && p.scores[c.k]); if (!isFinite(v)) v = 0;
        v = Math.max(0, Math.min(c.max, Math.round(v))); scores[c.k] = v; total += v;
      });
      const max = rubric.criteria.reduce(function (a, c) { return a + c.max; }, 0);
      res.json({ rubric: b.rubric, scores: scores, total: total, max: max, strengths: String(p.strengths || ""), improvements: String(p.improvements || ""), correction: String(p.correction || ""), criteria: rubric.criteria.map(function (c) { return { k: c.k, l: c.l, max: c.max }; }) });
    } catch (e) { console.error("gradeDelfMock", e); res.status(500).json({ error: "Could not grade" }); }
  });

  function zero(rubric, msg) {
    const scores = {}; rubric.criteria.forEach(function (c) { scores[c.k] = 0; });
    return { rubric: null, scores: scores, total: 0, max: rubric.criteria.reduce(function (a, c) { return a + c.max; }, 0), strengths: "", improvements: msg, correction: "", criteria: rubric.criteria.map(function (c) { return { k: c.k, l: c.l, max: c.max }; }) };
  }

  // Save one finished attempt for the signed-in candidate.
  app.post("/api/delfMockSave", express.json({ limit: "400kb" }), async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const uid = await getUid(req);
      if (!uid) return res.status(401).json({ error: "authentication required" });
      const b = req.body || {};
      if (!/^(tp|jr|pr)-(a11|a1|a2|b1|b2|c1|c2)-\d{2}$/.test(String(b.mockId || ""))) return res.status(400).json({ error: "bad mock id" });
      const num = function (x) { x = Number(x); return isFinite(x) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(25, Math.round(x * 10) / 10)) : 0; };
      const sc = { co: num(b.scores && b.scores.co), ce: num(b.scores && b.scores.ce), pe: num(b.scores && b.scores.pe), po: num(b.scores && b.scores.po) };
      const total = Math.round((sc.co + sc.ce + sc.pe + sc.po) * 10) / 10;
      const passed = total >= 50 && sc.co >= 5 && sc.ce >= 5 && sc.pe >= 5 && sc.po >= 5;
      const doc = {
        mockId: b.mockId, scores: sc, total: total, passed: passed,
        feedback: { pe: b.feedback && b.feedback.pe || null, po: b.feedback && b.feedback.po || null },
        answers: String(JSON.stringify(b.answers || {})).slice(0, 60000),
        createdAt: admin.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
      };
      const ref = await db.collection("delfMockResults").doc(uid).collection("attempts").add(doc);
      res.json({ ok: true, id: ref.id, total: total, passed: passed });
    } catch (e) { console.error("delfMockSave", e); res.status(500).json({ error: "Could not save" }); }
  });

  app.get("/api/delfMockHistory", async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const uid = await getUid(req);
      if (!uid) return res.status(401).json({ error: "authentication required" });
      const snap = await db.collection("delfMockResults").doc(uid).collection("attempts").orderBy("createdAt", "desc").limit(100).get();
      const items = snap.docs.map(function (d) {
        const x = d.data(); return { id: d.id, mockId: x.mockId, scores: x.scores, total: x.total, passed: x.passed, at: x.createdAt && x.createdAt.toMillis ? x.createdAt.toMillis() : null };
      });
      res.json({ items: items });
    } catch (e) { console.error("delfMockHistory", e); res.status(500).json({ error: "Could not load" }); }
  });
};


=== \delf-payment-routes.js ===
// DELF preparation payments: price list, checkout (Stripe in USD or Paystack in GHS) and verification.
//   GET  /api/delf/prices                  (optional Bearer token -> marks the levels you already own)
//   POST /api/delf/checkout  { exam, provider: "stripe" | "paystack" }   (Bearer token)
//   GET  /api/delf/verify?session_id=..  or  ?reference=..                (Bearer token)
// Access is recorded in Firestore delfAccess/{uid}.{exam}.granted, which the DELF dashboard already reads.
module.exports = function (app, ctx) {
  var admin = ctx.admin, db = ctx.db, express = ctx.express, logIncome = ctx.logIncome || null;
  var SITE = "https://saybonapp.com";
  var ADMINS = ["saybon.fr@gmail.com", "adlaideduah@gmail.com"];
  var isAdmin = function (who) { return !!(who && who.email && ADMINS.indexOf(String(who.email).toLowerCase()) >= 0); };
  // USD prices, as published on the DELF page
  var PRICES_USD = { a1: 12, a2: 17, b1: 25, b2: 29, c1: 34, prim: 12, junior: 12 };
  var LABELS = { a1: "DELF A1", a2: "DELF A2", b1: "DELF B1", b2: "DELF B2", c1: "DELF C1", prim: "DELF Prim", junior: "DELF Junior" };
  var ORDER = ["a1", "a2", "b1", "b2", "c1", "prim", "junior"];

  async function uidFrom(req, res, optional) {
    var h = req.headers.authorization || "";
    var t = h.indexOf("Bearer ") === 0 ? h.slice(7) : null;
    if (!t) { if (optional) return { uid: null }; res.status(401).json({ error: "authentication required" }); return null; }
    try { var d = await admin.auth().verifyIdToken(t); return { uid: d.uid, email: d.email || null }; }
    catch (e) { if (optional) return { uid: null }; res.status(401).json({ error: "authentication failed" }); return null; }
  }

  var rateCache = { rate: null, at: 0 };
  async function ghsRate() {
    if (rateCache.rate && Date.now() - rateCache.at < 3600 * 1000) return rateCache.rate;
    try {
      var r = await fetch("https://open.er-api.com/v6/latest/USD");
      var d = await r.json();
      if (d && d.rates && d.rates.GHS) { rateCache = { rate: d.rates.GHS, at: Date.now() }; return rateCache.rate; }
    } catch (e) { console.error("delf prices: rate lookup failed", e.message); }
    return rateCache.rate;     // last known rate, or null
  }
  var ghsFor = function (usd, rate) { return rate ? Math.round(usd * rate) : null; };

  async function owned(uid) {
    if (!uid) return {};
    try { var s = await db.collection("delfAccess").doc(uid).get(); return s.exists ? s.data() : {}; } catch (e) { return {}; }
  }

  app.get("/api/delf/prices", async function (req, res) {
    try {
      var who = await uidFrom(req, res, true);
      var rate = await ghsRate(), acc = await owned(who.uid);
      res.json({
        rate: rate || null,
        admin: isAdmin(who),
        items: ORDER.map(function (k) { return { exam: k, label: LABELS[k], usd: PRICES_USD[k], ghs: ghsFor(PRICES_USD[k], rate), owned: !!(acc[k] && acc[k].granted) }; })
      });
    } catch (e) { console.error("delf prices", e); res.status(500).json({ error: "could not load prices" }); }
  });

  // Admin-only switch: unlock (or lock again) a level for yourself without paying, to test the mocks.
  app.post("/api/delf/admin-grant", express.json({ limit: "2kb" }), async function (req, res) {
    var who = await uidFrom(req, res); if (!who) return;
    if (!isAdmin(who)) return res.status(403).json({ error: "not allowed" });
    try {
      var exam = String((req.body && req.body.exam) || "").toLowerCase(), lock = !!(req.body && req.body.lock);
      if (!PRICES_USD[exam]) return res.status(400).json({ error: "unknown level" });
      var o = {};
      o[exam] = lock ? { granted: false, revokedAt: admin.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp() } : { granted: true, provider: "admin", sessionId: "admin", purchasedAt: admin.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp() };
      await db.collection("delfAccess").doc(who.uid).set(o, { merge: true });
      res.json({ ok: true, exam: exam, granted: !lock });
    } catch (e) { console.error("delf admin-grant", e); res.status(500).json({ error: "could not update access" }); }
  });

  app.post("/api/delf/checkout", express.json({ limit: "5kb" }), async function (req, res) {
    var who = await uidFrom(req, res); if (!who) return;
    try {
      var exam = String((req.body && req.body.exam) || "").toLowerCase(), provider = String((req.body && req.body.provider) || "");
      if (!PRICES_USD[exam]) return res.status(400).json({ error: "unknown exam" });
      var acc = await owned(who.uid);
      if (acc[exam] && acc[exam].granted) return res.status(409).json({ error: "you already have access to this level" });
      var usd = PRICES_USD[exam];

      if (provider === "stripe") {
        if (!process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY) return res.status(500).json({ error: "card payments are not configured" });
        var stripe = require("stripe")(process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY);
        var session = await stripe.checkout.sessions.create({
          mode: "payment", payment_method_types: ["card"],
          customer_email: who.email || undefined,
          line_items: [{ price_data: { currency: "usd", product_data: { name: LABELS[exam] + " preparation" }, unit_amount: usd * 100 }, quantity: 1 }],
          metadata: { uid: who.uid, exam: exam },
          success_url: SITE + "/delf/payment-success.html?session_id={CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID}",
          cancel_url: SITE + "/delf/payment.html?exam=" + encodeURIComponent(exam)
        });
        return res.json({ url: session.url });
      }

      if (provider === "paystack") {
        var key = process.env.PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY;
        if (!key) return res.status(500).json({ error: "cedi payments are not configured" });
        if (!who.email) return res.status(400).json({ error: "your account has no email address" });
        var rate = await ghsRate(), ghs = ghsFor(usd, rate);
        if (!ghs) return res.status(503).json({ error: "the cedi price is unavailable right now, please try again" });
        var ref = "delf_" + who.uid.slice(0, 8) + "_" + Date.now();
        var r = await fetch("https://api.paystack.co/transaction/initialize", {
          method: "POST", headers: { Authorization: "Bearer " + key, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({ email: who.email, amount: ghs * 100, currency: "GHS", reference: ref, callback_url: SITE + "/delf/payment-success.html", metadata: { uid: who.uid, exam: exam } })
        });
        var d = await r.json();
        if (!r.ok || !d.status || !d.data || !d.data.authorization_url) { console.error("delf paystack init", r.status, JSON.stringify(d).slice(0, 200)); return res.status(502).json({ error: "could not start the cedi payment" }); }
        await db.collection("delfPayments").doc(ref).set({ uid: who.uid, exam: exam, currency: "GHS", amount: ghs, provider: "paystack", status: "pending", createdAt: admin.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp() });
        return res.json({ url: d.data.authorization_url });
      }
      res.status(400).json({ error: "choose card or cedis" });
    } catch (e) { console.error("delf checkout", e); res.status(500).json({ error: "could not start payment" }); }
  });

  async function grant(uid, exam, ref, provider, amount, currency) {
    await db.collection("delfAccess").doc(uid).set(
      (function () { var o = {}; o[exam] = { granted: true, sessionId: ref, provider: provider, purchasedAt: admin.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp() }; return o; })(),
      { merge: true });
    if (logIncome) { try { await logIncome("delf_" + provider + "_" + ref, amount, currency, "DELF Exam Prep", "Auto-logged DELF payment for " + LABELS[exam]); } catch (e) { console.error("delf income log", e.message); } }
  }

  app.get("/api/delf/verify", async function (req, res) {
    var who = await uidFrom(req, res); if (!who) return;
    try {
      if (req.query.session_id) {
        if (!process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY) return res.status(500).json({ error: "card payments are not configured" });
        var stripe = require("stripe")(process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY);
        var s = await stripe.checkout.sessions.retrieve(String(req.query.session_id));
        var md = s.metadata || {};
        if (s.payment_status !== "paid" || md.uid !== who.uid || !PRICES_USD[md.exam]) return res.json({ verified: false });
        await grant(who.uid, md.exam, s.id, "stripe", (s.amount_total || 0) / 100, (s.currency || "usd").toUpperCase());
        return res.json({ verified: true, exam: md.exam, examLabel: LABELS[md.exam] });
      }
      var ref = String(req.query.reference || req.query.trxref || "");
      if (ref) {
        var key = process.env.PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY;
        if (!key) return res.status(500).json({ error: "cedi payments are not configured" });
        var doc = await db.collection("delfPayments").doc(ref).get();
        if (!doc.exists || doc.data().uid !== who.uid) return res.json({ verified: false });
        var pd = doc.data();
        var r = await fetch("https://api.paystack.co/transaction/verify/" + encodeURIComponent(ref), { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer " + key } });
        var d = await r.json();
        var ok = d && d.status && d.data && d.data.status === "success" && d.data.amount >= pd.amount * 100;
        if (!ok) return res.json({ verified: false });
        await db.collection("delfPayments").doc(ref).update({ status: "paid" });
        await grant(who.uid, pd.exam, "paystack_" + ref, "paystack", d.data.amount / 100, d.data.currency || "GHS");
        return res.json({ verified: true, exam: pd.exam, examLabel: LABELS[pd.exam] });
      }
      res.status(400).json({ error: "no payment reference" });
    } catch (e) { console.error("delf verify", e); res.status(500).json({ error: "could not verify payment" }); }
  });
};
