// DELF placement results + returning-learner state, via firebase-admin (client Firestore access is denied by rules).
// Mounted from server.js: require("./delf-placement-routes")(app, { admin, db, express })
module.exports = function mountDelfPlacement(app, deps) {
  const { admin, db, express } = deps;
  const LEVELS = ["a1", "a2", "b1", "b2", "c1", "c2", "prim", "junior"];
  const ORDER = ["a1", "a2", "b1", "b2", "c1", "c2"];
  const PASS = 0.7;
  async function uidFrom(req, res) {
    const h = req.headers.authorization || "";
    const t = h.indexOf("Bearer ") === 0 ? h.slice(7) : null;
    if (!t) { res.status(401).json({ error: "authentication required" }); return null; }
    try { return (await admin.auth().verifyIdToken(t)).uid; }
    catch (e) { res.status(401).json({ error: "authentication failed" }); return null; }
  }
  const int = (v, max) => Math.max(0, Math.min(max, Math.floor(Number(v) || 0)));

  app.get("/api/delf/ping", (req, res) => res.json({ ok: true, delf: true }));

  app.post("/api/delf/placement", express.json({ limit: "100kb" }), async (req, res) => {
    const uid = await uidFrom(req, res); if (!uid) return;
    try {
      const b = req.body || {};
      if (LEVELS.indexOf(b.level) < 0) return res.status(400).json({ error: "bad level" });
      const lc = int(b.listening && b.listening.correct, 200), lt = int(b.listening && b.listening.total, 200);
      const rc = int(b.reading && b.reading.correct, 200), rt = int(b.reading && b.reading.total, 200);
      const total = lt + rt, correct = Math.min(lc, lt) + Math.min(rc, rt);
      if (total < 1) return res.status(400).json({ error: "no questions scored" });
      const pct = correct / total;
      const doc = {
        level: b.level, correct, total, pct, passed: pct >= PASS,
        listening: { correct: Math.min(lc, lt), total: lt }, reading: { correct: Math.min(rc, rt), total: rt },
        writingResponse: typeof b.writingResponse === "string" && b.writingResponse ? b.writingResponse.slice(0, 8000) : null,
        writingStatus: "pending_ai_grading",
        speakingStatus: b.speakingRecorded ? "recorded_pending_ai_grading" : "not_recorded",
        timestamp: admin.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
      };
      const ref = await db.collection("delfPlacements").doc(uid).collection("attempts").add(doc);
      res.json({ ok: true, id: ref.id, pct, passed: doc.passed });
    } catch (e) { console.error("delfPlacement save", e); res.status(500).json({ error: "could not save" }); }
  });

  app.get("/api/delf/state", async (req, res) => {
    const uid = await uidFrom(req, res); if (!uid) return;
    try {
      const [aSnap, accSnap, mSnap] = await Promise.all([
        db.collection("delfPlacements").doc(uid).collection("attempts").orderBy("timestamp", "desc").limit(50).get(),
        db.collection("delfAccess").doc(uid).get(),
        db.collection("delfMockResults").doc(uid).collection("attempts").orderBy("createdAt", "desc").limit(20).get().catch(() => null)
      ]);
      const attempts = aSnap.docs.map((d) => {
        const x = d.data();
        return {
          id: d.id, level: x.level, pct: x.pct || 0, correct: x.correct || 0, total: x.total || 0, passed: !!x.passed,
          listening: x.listening || null, reading: x.reading || null,
          writing: x.writingStatus === "graded" ? "graded" : x.writingResponse ? (x.writingStatus === "ungraded" ? "ungraded" : "pending") : "skipped",
          writingScore: typeof x.writingScore === "number" ? x.writingScore : null, writingFeedback: x.writingFeedback || null,
          speaking: x.speakingStatus === "graded" ? "graded" : x.speakingStatus === "no_speech" ? "no_speech" : x.speakingStatus === "ungraded" ? "ungraded" : x.speakingStatus === "not_recorded" ? "skipped" : "pending",
          speakingScore: typeof x.speakingScore === "number" ? x.speakingScore : null, speakingFeedback: x.speakingFeedback || null,
          at: x.timestamp && x.timestamp.toMillis ? x.timestamp.toMillis() : null
        };
      });
      const acc = accSnap.exists ? accSnap.data() : {};
      const granted = Object.keys(acc).filter((k) => acc[k] && acc[k].granted);
      const mocks = mSnap ? mSnap.docs.map((d) => {
        const x = d.data();
        return { id: d.id, mockId: x.mockId, scores: x.scores || null, total: x.total, passed: x.passed, at: x.createdAt && x.createdAt.toMillis ? x.createdAt.toMillis() : null };
      }) : [];
      let top = null;
      attempts.forEach((a) => { if (a.passed && ORDER.indexOf(a.level) >= 0 && (top === null || ORDER.indexOf(a.level) > ORDER.indexOf(top))) top = a.level; });
      const target = top ? ORDER[Math.min(ORDER.indexOf(top) + 1, ORDER.length - 1)] : "a1";
      const state = granted.length ? "enrolled" : attempts.length ? "tested" : "new";
      res.json({ state, attempts, highestCleared: top, targetExam: target, granted, mocks });
    } catch (e) { console.error("delfState", e); res.status(500).json({ error: "could not load" }); }
  });
};

=== \delf-tts-routes.js ===
// DELF listening audio: French neural text-to-speech through Azure Speech.
// POST /api/delf/tts  { text, level }  ->  audio/mpeg   (needs a signed-in Firebase user)
module.exports = function (app, ctx) {
  var admin = ctx.admin, express = ctx.express;
  var cache = new Map();            // text+voice settings -> Buffer (kept in memory)
  var CACHE_MAX = 300;
  var RATE = { a1: "-18%", a2: "-12%", b1: "-6%", b2: "0%", c1: "0%", c2: "0%" };

  function esc(s){ return String(s).replace(/&/g,"&amp;").replace(/</g,"&lt;").replace(/>/g,"&gt;").replace(/"/g,"&quot;"); }

  function buildSsml(text, level, voice, noProsody, oneVoice){
    var rate = RATE[level] || "-10%";
    var F = "fr-FR-DeniseNeural", M = "fr-FR-HenriNeural";
    var voices = (voice === "m") ? [M, F] : [F, M];
    var turns = text.split(/(?:^|\s)[–—]\s+/).map(function(t){ return t.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    var wrap = function(t){ return noProsody ? esc(t) : '<prosody rate="' + rate + '">' + esc(t) + '</prosody>'; };
    var body;
    if (/(?:^|\s)[–—]\s/.test(text) && turns.length > 1) {
      body = turns.map(function(t, i){ return '<voice name="' + voices[oneVoice ? 0 : i % 2] + '">' + wrap(t) + '</voice>'; }).join(noProsody ? "" : '<break time="500ms"/>');
    } else {
      body = '<voice name="' + voices[0] + '">' + wrap(text) + '</voice>';
    }
    return '<speak version="1.0" xml:lang="fr-FR" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis">' + body + '</speak>';
  }

  app.post("/api/delf/tts", express.json({ limit: "20kb" }), async function (req, res) {
    try {
      var h = req.headers.authorization || "";
      if (h.indexOf("Bearer ") !== 0) return res.status(401).json({ error: "authentication required" });
      try { await admin.auth().verifyIdToken(h.slice(7)); }
      catch (e) { return res.status(401).json({ error: "authentication required" }); }

      var text = String((req.body && req.body.text) || "").trim();
      var level = String((req.body && req.body.level) || "").toLowerCase();
      var voice = String((req.body && req.body.voice) || "f").toLowerCase() === "m" ? "m" : "f";
      if (!text || text.length > 1500) return res.status(400).json({ error: "text missing or too long" });

      var key = process.env.AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, region = process.env.AZURE_SPEECH_REGION;
      if (!key || !region) return res.status(500).json({ error: "speech service is not configured" });

      var ck = level + "|" + voice + "|" + text;
      var hit = cache.get(ck);
      if (!hit) {
        // try the full request; if Azure rejects it (400), retry with simpler speech markup. Log Azure's real message.
        var variants = [buildSsml(text, level, voice), buildSsml(text, level, voice, true), buildSsml(text, level, voice, true, true),
          "<speak version='1.0' xml:lang='fr-FR'><voice xml:lang='fr-FR' xml:gender='" + (voice === 'm' ? 'Male' : 'Female') + "' name='" + (voice === 'm' ? 'fr-FR-HenriNeural' : 'fr-FR-DeniseNeural') + "'>" + esc(text.replace(/(^|\s)[–—]\s+/g, '$1')) + "</voice></speak>"];
        var r = null;
        for (var vi = 0; vi < variants.length; vi++) {
          r = await fetch("https://" + region + ".tts.speech.microsoft.com/cognitiveservices/v1", {
            method: "POST",
            headers: {
              "Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key": key,
              "Content-Type": "application/ssml+xml",
              "X-Microsoft-OutputFormat": "audio-24khz-48kbitrate-mono-mp3",
              "User-Agent": "saybon-delf-tts"
            },
            body: variants[vi]
          });
          if (r.ok) break;
          var msg = ""; try { msg = (await r.text()).slice(0, 300); } catch (e) {}
          console.error("DELF TTS Azure error", r.status, "variant", vi, "region", region, msg);
          if (r.status !== 400) break;
        }
        if (!r.ok) return res.status(502).json({ error: "speech synthesis failed (" + r.status + ")" });
        hit = Buffer.from(await r.arrayBuffer());
        if (cache.size >= CACHE_MAX) cache.delete(cache.keys().next().value);
        cache.set(ck, hit);
      }
      res.set({ "Content-Type": "audio/mpeg", "Content-Length": hit.length, "Cache-Control": "private, max-age=86400" });
      res.send(hit);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("DELF TTS error", err);
      res.status(500).json({ error: "could not create audio" });
    }
  });
};

=== \docs\talkletics\CURRICULUM.md ===
# Talkletics curriculum (A0 to C2)

Speaking only. The learner speaks, the platform grades, and they advance at the pass mark. 7 levels, 49 games, 7 graduation challenges.

## Pre-A1 (A0) - Ma Maison (My House)
The learner uses isolated words, familiar names and very short set phrases, with lots of repetition and visual support.

**Pass mark:** games 55%, graduation 60% · **Answer length:** 1-8 s · **Focus:** Greetings, name, how are you, home vocabulary, family (ma/mon), oui/non, j'ai / je m'appelle

**The learner can:**
- Greet people and say goodbye politely
- Say their name and ask someone's name
- Name everyday objects and rooms in the home
- Name close family members and answer a yes/no question about them

**Games**

| # | Game | Type | Items |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Salutations (Greetings) | Repeat after me | 8 |
| 2 | Je me présente (Introducing myself) | Repeat after me | 6 |
| 3 | Dans la maison (In the house) | Say what you see | 7 |
| 4 | Ma famille (My family) | Say what you see | 7 |
| 🎓 | Bienvenue chez moi (Welcome to my home) | Role-play | 5 |

**Graduating from Pre-A1 (A0) means:** You can greet a neighbour, say who you are, say where you live and whether you have children, and say goodbye, using short phrases, even if you need slow speech and repetition.

## A1 - La Pêche d'Or (The Golden Peach (café and grocery))
The learner interacts in a simple way with slow, clear speech, using familiar everyday expressions and basic sentences about needs, likes and daily routine.

**Pass mark:** games 60%, graduation 65% · **Answer length:** 2-12 s · **Focus:** Numbers and prices, food and drink, je voudrais / je prends, j'aime / je n'aime pas, present tense of everyday verbs, telling the time

**The learner can:**
- Count and say prices
- Name common food and drinks
- Order something politely and pay
- Say what they like and don't like
- Describe a simple daily routine with times

**Games**

| 🎓 | Le client du jour (Customer of the day) | Role-play | 6 |

**Graduating from A1 means:** You can walk into a café, get a table, order food and drink, say what you like, and pay, using simple sentences. The other person may need to speak slowly.

## A2 - Le Restaurant (The Restaurant)
The learner handles simple, routine exchanges and describes things and past events in a series of short sentences.

**The learner can:**
- Book a table by phone and give the details

**Graduating from A2 means:** You can book, order, solve a small problem and pay in a restaurant, and tell someone what you ate last night, using short connected sentences with only occasional hesitation.

## B1 - La Gare et l'Hôtel (The Station and the Hotel)
The learner copes with most travel situations, enters conversations on familiar topics without preparation, and links sentences to describe experiences, plans and opinions.

**Graduating from B1 means:** You can deal with a travel disaster in French: explain what happened, propose and justify a solution, tell a related story and give advice, speaking for 30 to 40 seconds at a time with some hesitation but clear organisation.

## B2 - Le Bureau (The Office)
The learner interacts with fluency and spontaneity, gives clear detailed descriptions, and argues a viewpoint by weighing advantages and disadvantages.

**Pass mark:** games 70%, graduation 75% · **Answer length:** 20-55 s · **Focus:** Argument structure, concession, hypothesis (si + conditionnel), passive and nominalisation, trend vocabulary, professional register (vous), diplomatic phrasing

**The learner can:**

- Take part in a meeting: agree, disagree and propose, with nuance

- Build a structured argument with concession and conclusion

**Graduating from B2 means:** You can present a topic from a short document, defend your viewpoint against objections and conclude convincingly, speaking fluently for up to a minute at a time with good organisation and few errors that do not block meaning.

The learner expresses ideas fluently and spontaneously, structures long discourse on complex subjects and adapts register to the audience.

The learner expresses themselves spontaneously, very fluently and precisely, differentiating fine shades of meaning, even in the most complex situations.

- Use idioms and figurative language accurately

=== \dump-app.ps1 ===
$root = 'C:\SayBon'
$out  = Join-Path $root 'SayBon_dump.txt'
$skipDirs = '\node_modules\','\.git\','\.firebase\','\dumps\'
$exts = '.html','.htm','.css','.js','.mjs','.cjs','.json','.md','.txt','.yml','.yaml','.xml','.svg','.rules','.ps1','.bat','.sh'
$incNames = '.gitignore','.firebaserc'
$skipNames = 'package-lock.json','SayBon_dump.txt'
$maxBytes = 1MB

$files = @(Get-ChildItem -Path $root -Recurse -File -Force | Where-Object {
  $p = $_.FullName.Substring($root.Length).ToLower()
  $ok = $true
  foreach ($d in $skipDirs) { if ($p.Contains($d)) { $ok = $false } }
  $ok -and (($exts -contains $_.Extension.ToLower()) -or ($incNames -contains $_.Name)) `
      -and ($skipNames -notcontains $_.Name) `
      -and ($_.Name -notmatch '^\.env|serviceaccount|secret|private')
} | Sort-Object FullName)

$enc = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
$sw  = New-Object System.IO.StreamWriter($out, $false, $enc)
$sw.WriteLine("SayBon app dump | " + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') + " | " + $files.Count + " files")
$git = git -C $root log -1 --format='%h %s' 2>$null
if ($git) { $sw.WriteLine("git: $git") }
$sw.WriteLine()
$sw.WriteLine("FILE LIST")
foreach ($f in $files) { $sw.WriteLine("  " + $f.FullName.Substring($root.Length)) }
$sw.WriteLine()

foreach ($f in $files) {
  $sw.WriteLine("=== " + $f.FullName.Substring($root.Length) + " ===")
  if ($f.Length -gt $maxBytes) { $sw.WriteLine("[skipped: " + [math]::Round($f.Length/1KB) + " KB]") }
  else { $sw.WriteLine([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($f.FullName)) }
  $sw.WriteLine()
}
$sw.Close()
Write-Host ("Done: " + $files.Count + " files -> " + $out) -ForegroundColor Green

export async function deliverTranslation(db,jobId,translation){

const jobRef=db.collection("translationJobs").doc(jobId);

const jobDoc=await jobRef.get();

if(!jobDoc.exists){
throw new Error("Job not found");
}

await jobRef.update({

status:"completed",
finalTranslation:translation,
deliveredAt:new Date()

});

return{
delivered:true
};

}


=== \engine\job-allocation.js ===
export async function acceptJob(db,jobId,translatorId){

const jobRef=db.collection("translationJobs").doc(jobId);

const jobDoc=await jobRef.get();

if(!jobDoc.exists){
throw new Error("Job not found");
}

let job=jobDoc.data();

if(job.acceptedCount>=3){
throw new Error("Job already closed");
}

const acceptRef=db.collection("jobAcceptances");

const existing=await acceptRef
.where("jobId","==",jobId)
.where("translatorId","==",translatorId)
.get();

if(!existing.empty){
throw new Error("Translator already accepted job");
}

await acceptRef.add({

jobId:jobId,
translatorId:translatorId,
acceptedAt:new Date()

});

await jobRef.update({

acceptedCount:job.acceptedCount+1

});

return{
accepted:true
};

}


=== \engine\job-engine.js ===
export async function acceptJob(db,jobId,translatorId){

const jobRef=db.collection("translationJobs").doc(jobId);
const doc=await jobRef.get();

let job=doc.data();

let accepted=job.acceptedTranslators||[];

if(accepted.includes(translatorId))
return {message:"already accepted"};

if(accepted.length>=3)
return {message:"job closed"};

accepted.push(translatorId);

await jobRef.update({
acceptedTranslators:accepted,
status:"in_progress"
});

return {success:true};

}

=== \engine\reputation-engine.js ===
export async function updateReputation(db,translatorId,score,onTime){

const ref=db.collection("translatorProfiles").doc(translatorId);

const doc=await ref.get();

if(!doc.exists) return;

let data=doc.data();

let jobsSubmitted=data.jobsSubmitted+1;

let jobsPassed=data.jobsPassed;
let jobsRejected=data.jobsRejected;

if(score>=85){
jobsPassed++;
}else{
jobsRejected++;
}

let averageScore=((data.averageScore*(jobsSubmitted-1))+score)/jobsSubmitted;

let completionRate=jobsPassed/jobsSubmitted;

let onTimeRate=((data.onTimeRate*(jobsSubmitted-1))+(onTime?1:0))/jobsSubmitted;

let reputation=

(averageScore*0.6)+
(completionRate*100*0.3)+
(onTimeRate*100*0.1);

await ref.update({

jobsSubmitted,
jobsPassed,
jobsRejected,
averageScore,
onTimeRate,
reputationScore:reputation

});

}


=== \engine\segmenter.js ===
export function segmentText(text){

const maxWords=900;

const words=text.split(" ");

let segments=[];
let current=[];

for(let word of words){

current.push(word);

if(current.length>=maxWords){

segments.push(current.join(" "));
current=[];

}

}

if(current.length>0){

segments.push(current.join(" "));

}

return segments;

}


=== \engine\segment-translate.js ===
import { segmentText } from "./segmenter.js";
import { translateText } from "./ai-translation.js";

export async function translateLargeDocument(text,sourceLang,targetLang){

const segments=segmentText(text);

let translatedSegments=[];

for(const segment of segments){

const translated=await translateText(segment,sourceLang,targetLang);

translatedSegments.push(translated);

}

return translatedSegments.join("\n\n");

}

=== \engine\translation-memory.js ===
export async function saveTranslationMemory(db,source,target,sourceLang,targetLang){

if(!source || !target) return;

await db.collection("translationMemory").add({

source:source.trim(),
target:target.trim(),
sourceLang:sourceLang,
targetLang:targetLang,
createdAt:new Date()

});

}



export async function applyTranslationMemory(db,text){

const snapshot = await db.collection("translationMemory").get();

let output=text;

snapshot.forEach(doc=>{

const memory=doc.data();

if(memory.source && memory.target){

const regex=new RegExp(memory.source,"gi");

output=output.replace(regex,memory.target);

}

});

return output;

}

=== \firestore.rules ===
rules_version = '2';
service cloud.firestore {
  match /databases/{database}/documents {

    function signedIn() { return request.auth != null; }
    function isAdmin() { return signedIn() && request.auth.token.email in ['adlaideduah@gmail.com', 'saybon.fr@gmail.com']; }
    // A user the server has blocked for chat violations cannot post, even by writing to Firestore directly.
    function notBlocked() {
      return !exists(/databases/$(database)/documents/chatUserStatus/$(request.auth.uid))
          || get(/databases/$(database)/documents/chatUserStatus/$(request.auth.uid)).data.get('blocked', false) != true;
    }

    // Default deny - nothing is accessible unless explicitly allowed below.
    match /{document=**} {
      allow read, write: if false;
    }

    // Translation jobs - signed-in users can read (job board); only admins can change them.
    match /translationJobs/{jobId} {
      allow read: if signedIn();
      allow update: if isAdmin();
    }

    // Job submissions - read for signed-in users (My Jobs / Under Review tabs).
    match /jobSubmissions/{submissionId} {
      allow read: if signedIn();
    }

    // Translator applications - public register + test flow, but only the fields
    // those pages write. Scores, status and anything else can only be set by the server.
    match /translatorApplications/{appId} {
      allow create: if request.resource.data.keys().hasOnly(['name','email','languages','createdAt','testCompleted'])
                    && request.resource.data.testCompleted == false;
      allow update: if request.resource.data.diff(resource.data).affectedKeys()
                    .hasOnly(['englishTranslation','frenchTranslation','testCompleted','submittedAt']);
    }

    // Community chat rooms - signed-in users can read, create their own custom room,
    // and update only the last-message fields. Deleting a room is server-side only.
    match /chatRooms/{roomId} {
      allow read: if signedIn();
      allow create: if signedIn() && (
                      request.resource.data.createdBy == request.auth.uid
                      || request.resource.data.keys().hasOnly(['lastMessage','lastMessageAt','lastSenderName']));
      allow update: if signedIn() && request.resource.data.diff(resource.data).affectedKeys()
                      .hasOnly(['lastMessage','lastMessageAt','lastSenderName']);
      allow delete: if false;
    }

    match /chatRooms/{roomId}/messages/{messageId} {
      allow read: if signedIn();
      allow create: if signedIn()
                    && request.resource.data.uid == request.auth.uid
                    && notBlocked();
    }

  
    // SayBon Library: anyone can read published books; only admins can add, edit or delete.
    match /libraryBooks/{bookId} {
      allow read: if resource.data.published == true || isAdmin();
      allow write: if isAdmin();
    }
    match /libraryTexts/{bookId} {
      allow read: if isAdmin() || get(/databases/$(database)/documents/libraryBooks/$(bookId)).data.published == true;
      allow write: if isAdmin();
    }  
    // SayBon Library illustrations: anyone can read, only admins can write.
    match /libraryImages/{imgId} {
      allow read: if true;
      allow write: if isAdmin();
    }  }
}

=== \functions\index.js ===
const functions = require("firebase-functions");
const admin = require("firebase-admin");
const OpenAI = require("openai");

admin.initializeApp();

const db = admin.firestore();

const openai = new OpenAI({
  apiKey: functions.config().openai.key
});


exports.evaluateTranslator = functions.firestore
.document("translatorApplications/{applicantId}")
.onCreate(async (snap, context) => {

const data = snap.data();

const english = data.englishTranslation || "";
const french = data.frenchTranslation || "";

try{

const prompt = `
You are evaluating a professional translator application.

Evaluate the following translations and return a score from 0 to 100.

English translation:
${english}

French translation:
${french}

Return JSON only:

{
 "accuracy": number,
 "grammar": number,
 "terminology": number,
 "fluency": number
}
`;

const response = await openai.chat.completions.create({

model:"gpt-4o-mini",

messages:[
{role:"system",content:"You are a professional translation evaluator."},
{role:"user",content:prompt}
]

});

const result = JSON.parse(response.choices[0].message.content);

const finalScore = Math.round(
(result.accuracy * 0.4) +
(result.grammar * 0.25) +
(result.terminology * 0.2) +
(result.fluency * 0.15)
);

let status = "rejected";

if(finalScore >= 80){
status = "approved";
}

await snap.ref.update({

accuracyScore: result.accuracy,
grammarScore: result.grammar,
terminologyScore: result.terminology,
fluencyScore: result.fluency,

finalScore: finalScore,
status: status,

evaluatedAt: Date.now()

});

}catch(err){

console.error("Evaluation error:",err);

await snap.ref.update({

status:"evaluation_failed"

});

}

});

=== \index.js ===
const functions = require("firebase-functions/v2/https");
const admin = require("firebase-admin");

admin.initializeApp();

exports.api = functions.onRequest(async (req, res) => {

  try {

    // Health test
    if (req.method === "GET") {
      res.json({ status: "SayBon API running" });
      return;
    }

    // Order creation
    if (req.body.type === "order") {

      const order = {

        email: req.body.email,
        amount: req.body.amount,
        currency: req.body.currency,
        status: "paid",
        created: Date.now()

      };

      await admin.firestore()
        .collection("translationOrders")
        .add(order);

      res.json({
        ok: true
      });

      return;

    }

    res.status(400).json({
      error: "Invalid request"
    });

  }

  catch (error) {

    res.status(500).json({
      error: error.message
    });

  }

});

=== \level-routes.js ===
// Saves the learner's placement level on their account, so it survives new tabs, devices and logins.
//   GET  /api/level            (Bearer) -> { level }
//   POST /api/level {level}    (Bearer) -> { ok, level }
module.exports = function (app, ctx) {
  var admin = ctx.admin, db = ctx.db, express = ctx.express;
  var VALID = ["A0", "A1", "A2", "B1", "B2", "C1", "C2"];
  async function uid(req, res) {
    var h = req.headers.authorization || "", t = h.indexOf("Bearer ") === 0 ? h.slice(7) : null;
    if (!t) { res.status(401).json({ error: "authentication required" }); return null; }
    try { return (await admin.auth().verifyIdToken(t)).uid; } catch (e) { res.status(401).json({ error: "authentication failed" }); return null; }
  }
  app.get("/api/level", async function (req, res) {
    var u = await uid(req, res); if (!u) return;
    try { var s = await db.collection("learnerLevels").doc(u).get(); res.json({ level: s.exists ? (s.data().level || null) : null }); }
    catch (e) { console.error("level get", e); res.status(500).json({ error: "could not load level" }); }
  });
  app.post("/api/level", express.json({ limit: "2kb" }), async function (req, res) {
    var u = await uid(req, res); if (!u) return;
    var lv = String((req.body && req.body.level) || "").toUpperCase();
    if (VALID.indexOf(lv) < 0) return res.status(400).json({ error: "unknown level" });
    try { await db.collection("learnerLevels").doc(u).set({ level: lv, updatedAt: admin.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp() }, { merge: true }); res.json({ ok: true, level: lv }); }
    catch (e) { console.error("level set", e); res.status(500).json({ error: "could not save level" }); }
  });
};

=== \placement-clip-routes.js ===
// Entry placement test listening clips: French neural voices (Azure Speech), fixed set of clips.
// GET /api/placement/clip/:id  ->  audio/mpeg   (no login needed; only the clips below can be requested)
module.exports = function (app, ctx) {
  var RATE = { a0: "-22%", a1: "-18%", a2: "-12%", b1: "-6%", b2: "0%", c1: "0%" };
  var F = "fr-FR-DeniseNeural", M = "fr-FR-HenriNeural";
  // voice = first speaker; dialogues (lines starting with a dash) alternate between the two voices
  var CLIPS = {
    "a0-1": { voice: "f", text: "Bonjour ! Je m'appelle Marie. J'ai dix ans." },
    "a1-1": { voice: "m", text: "Bonjour, je m'appelle Paul. J'habite à Lyon, avec ma femme et mes deux enfants. Je travaille dans un hôpital." },
    "a1-2": { voice: "m", text: "– Je voudrais un café et un croissant, s'il vous plaît. – Voilà. Ça fait trois euros cinquante." },
    "a2-1": { voice: "f", text: "Demain, je vais à Bordeaux pour voir ma sœur. Mon train part à sept heures quarante et arrive à dix heures. Je prends un taxi, parce qu'elle habite loin de la gare." },
    "a2-2": { voice: "m", text: "– Allô, bonjour, je voudrais changer mon rendez-vous de mardi. – Mardi à quatorze heures ? Je peux vous proposer mercredi à seize heures. – Mercredi, c'est impossible, je travaille. – Alors jeudi matin, à neuf heures ? – Parfait, merci." },
    "a2-3": { voice: "f", text: "Ce week-end, il va pleuvoir dans le nord, mais dans le sud, il fera beau, avec vingt-cinq degrés. N'oubliez pas votre parapluie si vous restez à Lille !" },
    "b1-1": { voice: "m", text: "Depuis que j'habite en ville, je n'utilise plus ma voiture. Le métro est rapide et je gagne du temps. Le seul inconvénient, c'est le bruit, surtout le matin." },
    "b1-2": { voice: "m", text: "– Tu as vu l'offre d'emploi à Toulouse ? – Oui, mais je n'ai pas envie de déménager. – Pourtant, le salaire est bien meilleur. – C'est vrai, mais ma famille et mes amis sont ici. Je préfère rester." },
    "b1-3": { voice: "f", text: "Le musée sera exceptionnellement fermé lundi à cause de travaux. Les visiteurs qui ont déjà un billet pourront le garder et venir un autre jour avant la fin du mois." },
    "b2-1": { voice: "m", text: "Le télétravail a progressé, mais il divise. Certains salariés apprécient l'autonomie, alors que d'autres se plaignent d'isolement. Selon une enquête récente, la majorité souhaiterait un système mixte, avec deux ou trois jours au bureau." },
    "b2-2": { voice: "m", text: "– Pourquoi avoir quitté la grande entreprise ? – J'avais l'impression de ne plus apprendre. Même si la sécurité de l'emploi me rassurait, j'ai préféré créer ma propre société, quitte à gagner moins les premières années." },
    "b2-3": { voice: "f", text: "Le projet de nouvelle ligne de tramway suscite des réactions contrastées. Si les commerçants espèrent une hausse de la fréquentation, les riverains craignent des nuisances pendant les deux ans de travaux." },
    "c1-1": { voice: "m", text: "Loin de constituer une simple mode passagère, la sobriété numérique répond à une prise de conscience : chaque courriel, chaque vidéo en continu consomme de l'énergie. Reste à savoir si les usagers accepteront de modifier durablement leurs habitudes." },
    "c1-2": { voice: "f", text: "Bien que les résultats de l'étude soient encourageants, ses auteurs appellent à la prudence : l'échantillon était restreint et les effets observés pourraient disparaître à long terme. Une réplication à plus grande échelle s'impose." },
    "c1-3": { voice: "m", text: "– Certains jugent la réforme inéquitable. – Elle l'est, dans la mesure où elle pénalise d'abord les plus modestes, alors même qu'elle prétend les protéger. – Vous ne dites pas qu'elle est inutile, pourtant. – Non : le principe est juste, c'est son calendrier qui est précipité." }
  };
  var cache = new Map();

  function esc(s){ return String(s).replace(/&/g,"&amp;").replace(/</g,"&lt;").replace(/>/g,"&gt;").replace(/"/g,"&quot;"); }
  function ssml(clip, level, noProsody, oneVoice){
    var rate = RATE[level] || "-10%";
    var voices = clip.voice === "m" ? [M, F] : [F, M];
    var turns = clip.text.split(/(?:^|\s)[–—]\s+/).map(function(t){ return t.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    var wrap = function(t){ return noProsody ? esc(t) : '<prosody rate="' + rate + '">' + esc(t) + '</prosody>'; };
    var body;
    if (/(?:^|\s)[–—]\s/.test(clip.text) && turns.length > 1) {
      body = turns.map(function(t, i){ return '<voice name="' + voices[oneVoice ? 0 : i % 2] + '">' + wrap(t) + '</voice>'; }).join(noProsody ? "" : '<break time="500ms"/>');
    } else {
      body = '<voice name="' + voices[0] + '">' + wrap(clip.text) + '</voice>';
    }
    return '<speak version="1.0" xml:lang="fr-FR" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis">' + body + '</speak>';
  }

  app.get("/api/placement/clip/:id", async function (req, res) {
    try {
      var id = String(req.params.id || "").toLowerCase();
      var clip = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(CLIPS, id) ? CLIPS[id] : null;
      if (!clip) return res.status(404).json({ error: "unknown clip" });
      var key = process.env.AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, region = process.env.AZURE_SPEECH_REGION;
      if (!key || !region) return res.status(500).json({ error: "speech service is not configured" });
      var buf = cache.get(id);
      if (!buf) {
        var lvl = id.split("-")[0], r = null;
        var variants = [ssml(clip, lvl), ssml(clip, lvl, true), ssml(clip, lvl, true, true),
          "<speak version='1.0' xml:lang='fr-FR'><voice xml:lang='fr-FR' xml:gender='" + (clip.voice === 'm' ? 'Male' : 'Female') + "' name='" + (clip.voice === 'm' ? 'fr-FR-HenriNeural' : 'fr-FR-DeniseNeural') + "'>" + esc(clip.text.replace(/(^|\s)[–—]\s+/g, '$1')) + "</voice></speak>"];
        for (var vi = 0; vi < variants.length; vi++) {
          r = await fetch("https://" + region + ".tts.speech.microsoft.com/cognitiveservices/v1", {
            method: "POST",
            headers: { "Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key": key, "Content-Type": "application/ssml+xml", "X-Microsoft-OutputFormat": "audio-24khz-48kbitrate-mono-mp3", "User-Agent": "saybon-placement-clips" },
            body: variants[vi]
          });
          if (r.ok) break;
          var msg = ""; try { msg = (await r.text()).slice(0, 300); } catch (e) {}
          console.error("Placement clip Azure error", r.status, "variant", vi, "region", region, msg);
          if (r.status !== 400) break;
        }
        if (!r.ok) return res.status(502).json({ error: "speech synthesis failed (" + r.status + ")" });
        buf = Buffer.from(await r.arrayBuffer());
        cache.set(id, buf);
      }
      res.set({ "Content-Type": "audio/mpeg", "Content-Length": buf.length, "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=86400" });
      res.send(buf);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Placement clip error", err);
      res.status(500).json({ error: "could not create audio" });
    }
  });
};

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<script type='module' src='/js/auth-guard.js'></script>
<title>SayBon Admin</title>
</head>

<body>

<h2>Translation Jobs</h2>

<div id="jobs"></div>

<script src="https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/9.23.0/firebase-app-compat.js"></script>
<script src="https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/9.23.0/firebase-firestore-compat.js"></script>

<script>

const firebaseConfig={
apiKey:"YOUR_API_KEY",
authDomain:"YOUR_PROJECT.firebaseapp.com",

=== \public\admin\passkey\passkey.js ===
(function () {
  const input = document.getElementById("passkeyInput");
  const status = document.getElementById("status");

  const MASTER_PASSKEY = "0110041181";
  const STORAGE_KEY = "saybon_admin_generated_passkeys";
  const ROLE_KEY = "saybon_admin_role";
  const ACTIVE_PASSKEY_KEY = "saybon_admin_active_passkey";
  const ACTIVE_PASSKEY_RECORD_KEY = "saybon_admin_active_passkey_record";

  let handled = false;
  let denyTimer = null;

  function getGeneratedPasskeys() {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      const parsed = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
      return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  function saveActiveSession(role, record) {
    localStorage.setItem(ROLE_KEY, role);
    localStorage.setItem(ACTIVE_PASSKEY_KEY, record.passkey || "");
    localStorage.setItem(ACTIVE_PASSKEY_RECORD_KEY, JSON.stringify(record));
  }

  function grant(record) {
    if (handled) return;
    handled = true;
    saveActiveSession(record.role || "employee_admin", record);
    window.location.href = "/admin/access-granted/";
  }

  function deny() {
    if (handled) return;
    handled = true;
    window.location.href = "/admin/access-denied/";
  }

  function resetTimer() {
    if (denyTimer) {
      clearTimeout(denyTimer);
      denyTimer = null;
    }
  }

  function buildAllowedRecords() {
    const generated = getGeneratedPasskeys()
      .filter(item => item && item.enabled === true)
      .map(item => ({
        name: item.name || "Employee",
        passkey: String(item.passkey || "").trim(),
        role: item.role || "employee_admin",
        employeeId: item.employeeId || ""
      }));

    return [
      {
        name: "Master Admin",
        passkey: MASTER_PASSKEY,
        role: "master_admin",
        employeeId: "MASTER"
      },
      ...generated
    ];
  }

  function validateNow() {
    if (handled) return;

    const key = String(input.value || "").trim();
    if (!key) return;

    const records = buildAllowedRecords();
    const matched = records.find(r => String(r.passkey).trim() === key);

    if (matched) {
      grant(matched);
      return;
    }

    const hasPrefixMatch = records.some(r => String(r.passkey).startsWith(key));
    if (!hasPrefixMatch) {
      deny();
    }
  }

  input.addEventListener("input", () => {
    if (handled) return;
    resetTimer();

    const key = String(input.value || "").trim();
    if (!key) return;

    const records = buildAllowedRecords();
    const matched = records.find(r => String(r.passkey).trim() === key);

    if (matched) {
      grant(matched);
      return;
    }

    denyTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      validateNow();
    }, 700);
  });

  input.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (e.key === "Enter") {
      resetTimer();
      validateNow();
    }
  });

  input.addEventListener("blur", () => {
    resetTimer();
    validateNow();
  });

  if (status) {
    status.textContent = "";
  }
})();

=== \public\auth\login.js ===
import { initializeApp } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.7.1/firebase-app.js";
import {
  getAuth,
  GoogleAuthProvider,
  signInWithPopup,
  signInWithEmailAndPassword,
  createUserWithEmailAndPassword
} from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.7.1/firebase-auth.js";

const firebaseConfig = {
  apiKey: "AIzaSyB2aKUdE1NSt0kN332BwTYSX52D0lxj1g0",
  authDomain: "saybon-3e3c2.firebaseapp.com",
  projectId: "saybon-3e3c2",
  appId: "1:75085012344:web:0b18581cb0a30c3df47c8d"
};

const app = initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
const auth = getAuth(app);
const provider = new GoogleAuthProvider();

document.getElementById("backBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {
  if(window.stopAppBgMusic){ window.stopAppBgMusic(); } window.location.href = "/";
});

document.getElementById("loginBtn").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  try {
    await signInWithPopup(auth, provider);

    // LOCKED BEHAVIOR:
    // Always goes directly to dashboard
    window.location.href = "/dashboard/";

  } catch (err) {
    alert("Login cancelled or failed.");
  }
});





let isSignUpMode = false;

document.getElementById("toggleModeBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {
  isSignUpMode = !isSignUpMode;
  document.getElementById("emailAuthBtn").textContent = isSignUpMode ? "Create Account" : "Sign In";
  document.getElementById("toggleModeText").textContent = isSignUpMode ? "Already have an account?" : "New here?";
  document.getElementById("toggleModeBtn").textContent = isSignUpMode ? "Sign In" : "Create Account";
  document.getElementById("emailAuthError").textContent = "";
});

document.getElementById("emailAuthForm").addEventListener("submit", async (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const email = document.getElementById("emailInput").value.trim();
  const password = document.getElementById("passwordInput").value;
  const errorEl = document.getElementById("emailAuthError");
  errorEl.textContent = "";

  try {
    if (isSignUpMode) {
      await createUserWithEmailAndPassword(auth, email, password);
    } else {
      await signInWithEmailAndPassword(auth, email, password);
    }
    window.location.href = "/dashboard/";
  } catch (err) {
    if (err.code === "auth/email-already-in-use") {
      errorEl.textContent = "That email is already registered. Try signing in instead.";
    } else if (err.code === "auth/weak-password") {
      errorEl.textContent = "Password should be at least 6 characters.";
    } else if (err.code === "auth/invalid-email") {
      errorEl.textContent = "Please enter a valid email address.";
    } else if (err.code === "auth/wrong-password" || err.code === "auth/invalid-credential") {
      errorEl.textContent = "Incorrect email or password.";
    } else if (err.code === "auth/user-not-found") {
      errorEl.textContent = "No account found with that email.";
    } else {
      errorEl.textContent = "Something went wrong. Please try again.";
    }
  }
});

document.getElementById("emailIconBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {
  const form = document.getElementById("emailAuthForm");
  const divider = document.querySelector(".email-divider");
  const isOpen = form.style.display === "flex";
  form.style.display = isOpen ? "none" : "flex";
  divider.style.display = isOpen ? "none" : "flex";
});

const API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";

function unlock(){
  if(false){
    sessionStorage.setItem("chatAdminVerified","true");
    document.getElementById("login").style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById("panel").style.display = "block";
    loadAll();
  }else{
    alert("Incorrect passcode");
  }
}
window.unlock = unlock; window.addEventListener("adminAuthorized", function(){ document.getElementById("login").style.display = "none"; document.getElementById("panel").style.display = "block"; loadAll(); });

if(sessionStorage.getItem("chatAdminVerified") === "true"){
  document.getElementById("login").style.display = "none";
  document.getElementById("panel").style.display = "block";
  loadAll();
}

document.querySelectorAll(".tab-btn").forEach(btn=>{
  btn.addEventListener("click", ()=>{
    document.querySelectorAll(".tab-btn").forEach(b=>b.classList.remove("active"));
    document.querySelectorAll(".tab-panel").forEach(p=>p.classList.remove("active"));
    btn.classList.add("active");
    document.getElementById("panel-"+btn.dataset.tab).classList.add("active");
  });
});

function loadAll(){
  loadUsers();
  loadViolations();
  loadRooms();
}

let cachedUsers = [];
let cachedViolations = [];
let cachedRooms = [];

function renderOverview(){
  const grid = document.getElementById("statGrid");
  const blockedCount = cachedUsers.filter(u=>u.blocked).length;
  const flaggedCount = cachedUsers.filter(u=>u.flagged).length;
  const cards = [
    {label:"Total Users Tracked", value:cachedUsers.length},
    {label:"Blocked Users", value:blockedCount},
    {label:"Flagged Users", value:flaggedCount},
    {label:"Total Violations", value:cachedViolations.length},
    {label:"Custom Rooms", value:cachedRooms.length}
  ];
  grid.innerHTML = cards.map(c=>"<div class='stat-card'><div class='stat-label'>"+c.label+"</div><div class='stat-value'>"+c.value+"</div></div>").join("");
}

async function loadUsers(){

  const table = document.getElementById("usersTable");
  const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminChatUsers");
  cachedUsers = await res.json();

  if(!cachedUsers.length){
    table.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='4' class='empty-note'>No user activity tracked yet.</td></tr>";
    renderOverview();
    return;
  }

  table.innerHTML = "";

  cachedUsers.forEach(u=>{
    const row = document.createElement("tr");
    const statusBadge = u.blocked ? "<span class='badge badge-blocked'>Blocked</span>" : u.flagged ? "<span class='badge badge-flagged'>Flagged</span>" : "<span class='badge badge-clean'>Clean</span>";
    row.innerHTML =
      "<td>"+escapeHtml(u.displayName)+"</td>"+
      "<td>"+u.violationCount+"</td>"+
      "<td>"+statusBadge+"</td>"+
      "<td>"+
        (u.blocked
          ? "<button class='action-btn btn-unblock' onclick=\"unblockUser('"+u.uid+"')\">Unblock</button>"
          : "<button class='action-btn btn-block' onclick=\"blockUser('"+u.uid+"','"+escapeHtml(u.displayName).replace(/'/g,"\\'")+"')\">Block</button>")+
        "<button class='action-btn btn-flag' onclick=\"toggleFlag('"+u.uid+"','"+escapeHtml(u.displayName).replace(/'/g,"\\'")+"',"+(!u.flagged)+")\">"+(u.flagged?"Unflag":"Flag")+"</button>"+
      "</td>";
    table.appendChild(row);
  });

  renderOverview();

}

window.blockUser = async function(uid, displayName){
  await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminBlockUser", {method:"POST", headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"}, body:JSON.stringify({uid, displayName})});
  loadUsers();
}

window.unblockUser = async function(uid){
  await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminUnblockUser", {method:"POST", headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"}, body:JSON.stringify({uid})});
  loadUsers();
}

window.toggleFlag = async function(uid, displayName, flagged){
  await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminFlagUser", {method:"POST", headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"}, body:JSON.stringify({uid, displayName, flagged})});
  loadUsers();
}

async function loadViolations(){

  const table = document.getElementById("violationsTable");
  const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminChatViolations");
  cachedViolations = await res.json();

  if(!cachedViolations.length){
    table.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='4' class='empty-note'>No violations logged yet.</td></tr>";
    renderOverview();
    return;
  }

  table.innerHTML = "";

  cachedViolations.forEach(v=>{
    const row = document.createElement("tr");
    row.innerHTML =
      "<td>"+escapeHtml(v.displayName)+"</td>"+
      "<td>"+escapeHtml(v.roomId)+"</td>"+
      "<td>"+escapeHtml(v.matchedTerm)+"</td>"+
      "<td>"+escapeHtml(v.messageText)+"</td>";
    table.appendChild(row);
  });

  renderOverview();

}

async function loadRooms(){

  const table = document.getElementById("roomsTable");
  const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminChatCustomRooms");
  cachedRooms = await res.json();

  if(!cachedRooms.length){
    table.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='3' class='empty-note'>No custom rooms created yet.</td></tr>";
    renderOverview();
    return;
  }

  table.innerHTML = "";

  cachedRooms.forEach(r=>{
    const row = document.createElement("tr");
    row.innerHTML =
      "<td>"+escapeHtml(r.name)+"</td>"+
      "<td>"+escapeHtml(r.lastMessage||"")+"</td>"+
      "<td><button class='action-btn btn-delete' onclick=\"deleteRoom('"+r.id+"')\">Delete</button></td>";
    table.appendChild(row);
  });

  renderOverview();

}

window.deleteRoom = async function(roomId){
  if(!confirm("Delete this custom room? This cannot be undone.")) return;
  await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminDeleteChatRoom", {method:"POST", headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"}, body:JSON.stringify({roomId})});
  loadRooms();
}

function escapeHtml(str){
  const div = document.createElement("div");
  div.textContent = str == null ? "" : String(str);
  return div.innerHTML;
}

function formatPreviewTime(ts) {
  if (!ts || !ts.toDate) return "";
  const date = ts.toDate();
  const now = new Date();
  if (date.toDateString() === now.toDateString()) {
    return date.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit" });
  }
  const diffDays = Math.floor((now - date) / 86400000);
  if (diffDays === 1) return "Yesterday";
  if (diffDays < 7) return diffDays + "d ago";
  return date.toLocaleDateString([], { month: "short", day: "numeric" });
}

function openRoom(roomId, roomName) {
  document.querySelectorAll(".conversation-item, .new-chat-btn").forEach(b => b.classList.remove("active"));
  const btn = document.querySelector('.room-btn[data-room-id="' + roomId + '"]');
  if (btn) btn.classList.add("active");

  welcomeWorkspace.classList.add("hidden");
  chatWorkspace.classList.remove("hidden");

  document.querySelector(".chatroom-shell").classList.add("mobile-chat-open");

  roomTitle.innerHTML = roomName;
  if (btn) {
    const srcAvatar = btn.querySelector(".conversation-avatar");
    roomAvatar.innerHTML = srcAvatar ? srcAvatar.innerHTML : "";
  }
  currentRoomId = roomId;

  subscribeToRoom(roomId);
}

function wireRoomButton(btn){
  btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    openRoom(btn.dataset.roomId, btn.dataset.room);
  });
}

roomButtons.forEach(wireRoomButton);

function slugify(name){
  return name.toLowerCase().trim().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-").replace(/(^-|-$)/g, "").slice(0, 30);
}

function buildCustomRoomButton(roomId, name){
  const btn = document.createElement("button");
  btn.className = "room-btn conversation-item";
  btn.dataset.room = name;
  btn.dataset.roomId = roomId;
  btn.innerHTML =
    "<span class='conversation-avatar'><svg viewBox='0 0 24 24' width='22' height='22' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='1.8'><circle cx='12' cy='12' r='10'/><path d='M12 8v8M8 12h8'/></svg></span>" +
    "<span class='conversation-body'>" +
      "<span class='conversation-top-row'><span class='conversation-name'>" + escapeHtml(name) + "</span><span class='conversation-time' id='time-" + roomId + "'></span></span>" +
      "<span class='conversation-preview' id='preview-" + roomId + "'>No messages yet</span>" +
    "</span>";
  wireRoomButton(btn);
  return btn;
}

confirmCreateRoomBtn.addEventListener("click", async () => {

  if (!currentUser) {
    alert("Please sign in to create a room.");
    return;
  }

  const name = newRoomNameInput.value.trim();
  if (!name) return;

  const roomId = "custom-" + slugify(name) + "-" + Date.now().toString(36).slice(-4);

  confirmCreateRoomBtn.disabled = true;

  try{

    await setDoc(doc(db, "chatRooms", roomId), {
      name,
      isCustom: true,
      createdBy: currentUser.uid,
      createdAt: serverTimestamp()
    });

    customRoomsLabel.style.display = "block";
    const btn = buildCustomRoomButton(roomId, name);
    customRoomsList.appendChild(btn);

    createRoomModal.classList.add("hidden");
    openRoom(roomId, name);

  }catch(err){
    alert("Could not create the room. Please try again.");
  }finally{
    confirmCreateRoomBtn.disabled = false;
  }

});

async function loadCustomRooms(){
  try{
    const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, "chatRooms"), where("isCustom","==",true)));
    if (snap.empty) return;

    const rooms = [];
    snap.forEach(d => rooms.push({ id: d.id, ...d.data() }));
    rooms.sort((a,b) => {
      const aT = a.createdAt && a.createdAt.seconds ? a.createdAt.seconds : 0;
      const bT = b.createdAt && b.createdAt.seconds ? b.createdAt.seconds : 0;
      return aT - bT;
    });

    customRoomsLabel.style.display = "block";
    rooms.forEach(r => {
      customRoomsList.appendChild(buildCustomRoomButton(r.id, r.name));
    });

  }catch(err){
    console.error("Could not load custom rooms:", err);
  }
}

loadCustomRooms();

  saveProfileEdit.textContent = "Saving...";

  try {

    let photoURL = currentUser.photoURL || "";

    if (pendingPhotoFile) {

      await uploadBytesResumable(fileRef, pendingPhotoFile);
      photoURL = await getDownloadURL(fileRef);

    sidebarProfileName.textContent = newName;
    if (photoURL) sidebarProfileAvatar.src = photoURL;

    profileModal.classList.add("hidden");

  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Profile update failed:", err);
    alert("Could not update your profile. Please try again.");
  } finally {
    saveProfileEdit.disabled = false;
    saveProfileEdit.textContent = "Save";
  }

});

const chatStorage = getStorage();

mediaBtn.addEventListener("click", () => { mediaInput.click(); });

mediaInput.addEventListener("change", async (e) => {

  const files = [...e.target.files];
  mediaInput.value = "";
  if (!files.length || !currentRoomId || !currentUser) return;

  const displayName = currentUser.displayName || currentUser.email || "Learner";
  mediaPreview.classList.remove("hidden");

  for (const file of files) {

    const card = document.createElement("div");
    card.className = "media-card";
    card.textContent = "Uploading " + file.name + "...";
    mediaPreview.appendChild(card);

    try {

      const fileRef = storageRef(chatStorage, "chatMedia/" + currentRoomId + "/" + Date.now() + "_" + file.name);
      await uploadBytesResumable(fileRef, file);
      const fileUrl = await getDownloadURL(fileRef);

      await addDoc(collection(db, "chatRooms", currentRoomId, "messages"), {
        uid: currentUser.uid,
        displayName,
        type: "file",
        fileUrl,
        fileName: file.name,
        fileType: file.type,
        createdAt: serverTimestamp()
      });

      await setDoc(doc(db, "chatRooms", currentRoomId), {
        lastMessage: "Sent: " + file.name,
        lastMessageAt: serverTimestamp(),
        lastSenderName: displayName
      }, { merge: true });

      card.remove();

    } catch (err) {
      console.error("File upload failed:", err);
      card.textContent = "Failed to upload " + file.name;
    }

  }

  setTimeout(() => {
    mediaPreview.classList.add("hidden");
    mediaPreview.innerHTML = "";
  }, 1200);

});

// =========================================================
// VOICE NOTE SYSTEM (real recording, upload, and send)
// =========================================================

let mediaRecorder = null;
let recordedChunks = [];
let micStream = null;

function stopMicStream(){
  if (micStream) {
    micStream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());
    micStream = null;
  }
}

voiceBtn.addEventListener("click", async () => {

  try {
    micStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
  } catch (err) {
    alert("Could not access your microphone. Please allow microphone permission and try again.");
    return;
  }

  composer.classList.add("hidden");
  recordingPanel.classList.remove("hidden");
  recordingSeconds = 0;
  recordingTimer.innerHTML = "0:00";

  recordedChunks = [];
  mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(micStream);
  mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = (e) => { if (e.data.size > 0) recordedChunks.push(e.data); };
  if(window.pauseAppBgMusicForRecording){ window.pauseAppBgMusicForRecording(); } mediaRecorder.start();

  recordingInterval = setInterval(() => {
    recordingSeconds++;
    const mins = Math.floor(recordingSeconds / 60);
    const secs = recordingSeconds % 60;
    recordingTimer.innerHTML = mins + ":" + secs.toString().padStart(2, "0");
  }, 1000);

});

cancelRecording.addEventListener("click", () => {
  clearInterval(recordingInterval);
  if (mediaRecorder && mediaRecorder.state !== "inactive") {
    mediaRecorder.onstop = null;
    mediaRecorder.stop(); if(window.resumeAppBgMusicAfterRecording){ window.resumeAppBgMusicAfterRecording(); }
  }
  stopMicStream();
  recordingPanel.classList.add("hidden");
  composer.classList.remove("hidden");
});

document.getElementById("sendRecording").addEventListener("click", () => {

  clearInterval(recordingInterval);
  recordingPanel.classList.add("hidden");
  composer.classList.remove("hidden");

  if (!mediaRecorder || mediaRecorder.state === "inactive" || !currentRoomId || !currentUser) {
    stopMicStream();
    return;
  }

  mediaRecorder.onstop = async () => {

    stopMicStream();

    const blob = new Blob(recordedChunks, { type: "audio/webm" });
    const displayName = currentUser.displayName || currentUser.email || "Learner";

    try {

      const fileRef = storageRef(chatStorage, "chatVoiceNotes/" + currentRoomId + "/" + Date.now() + ".webm");
      await uploadBytesResumable(fileRef, blob);
      const fileUrl = await getDownloadURL(fileRef);

      await addDoc(collection(db, "chatRooms", currentRoomId, "messages"), {
        uid: currentUser.uid,
        displayName,
        type: "voice",
        fileUrl,
        createdAt: serverTimestamp()
      });

      await setDoc(doc(db, "chatRooms", currentRoomId), {
        lastMessage: "Voice note",
        lastMessageAt: serverTimestamp(),
        lastSenderName: displayName
      }, { merge: true });

    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Voice note upload failed:", err);
      alert("Could not send voice note. Please try again.");
    }

  };

  mediaRecorder.stop(); if(window.resumeAppBgMusicAfterRecording){ window.resumeAppBgMusicAfterRecording(); }

});

// REAL MESSAGE SENDING

const chatWarningBanner = document.getElementById("chatWarningBanner");

function showChatWarning(msg){
  chatWarningBanner.textContent = msg;
  chatWarningBanner.classList.remove("hidden");
  setTimeout(() => chatWarningBanner.classList.add("hidden"), 6000);
}

async function sendMessage() {
  const text = composerInput.value.trim();
  if (!text || !currentRoomId || !currentUser) return;

  const displayName = currentUser.displayName || currentUser.email || "Learner";

  try {

    const statusRes = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/chatUserStatus?uid=" + encodeURIComponent(currentUser.uid));
    const status = await statusRes.json();

    if (status.blocked) {
      showChatWarning("Your account has been blocked from sending messages due to repeated violations. Contact support if you believe this is a mistake.");
      return;
    }

    const checkRes = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/chatCheckContent", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ text })
    });
    const check = await checkRes.json();

    if (!check.allowed) {

      const violationRes = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/chatRecordViolation", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": "Bearer " + await currentUser.getIdToken() },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          uid: currentUser.uid,
          displayName,
          roomId: currentRoomId,
          messageText: text,
          matchedTerm: check.matchedTerm
        })
      });
      const violation = await violationRes.json();

      if (violation.blocked) {
        showChatWarning("This message was not sent, and your account has now been blocked after repeated violations of our content guidelines.");
      } else {
        showChatWarning("This message was not sent - it contains content that is not allowed here. Warning " + violation.violationCount + " of 3. Continued violations will result in a block.");
      }

      return;

    }

  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Content check failed:", err);
  }

  composerInput.value = "";

  try {
    await addDoc(collection(db, "chatRooms", currentRoomId, "messages"), {
      uid: currentUser.uid,
      displayName: displayName,
      text: text,
      createdAt: serverTimestamp()
    });

    const preview = text.length > 60 ? text.slice(0, 60) + "..." : text;

    await setDoc(doc(db, "chatRooms", currentRoomId), {
      lastMessage: preview,
      lastMessageAt: serverTimestamp(),
      lastSenderName: displayName
    }, { merge: true });

  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Send failed:", err);
    showChatWarning("Could not send message. Please try again.");
  }
}
sendBtn.addEventListener("click", sendMessage);
composerInput.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey) {
    e.preventDefault();
    sendMessage();
  }
});

// =========================================================
// REAL-TIME MESSAGE LISTENER
// =========================================================

function subscribeToRoom(roomId) {
  if (unsubscribeMessages) {
    unsubscribeMessages();
    unsubscribeMessages = null;
  }

  messagesContainer.innerHTML = "";

  const q = query(collection(db, "chatRooms", roomId, "messages"), orderBy("createdAt"));

  unsubscribeMessages = onSnapshot(q, (snapshot) => {
    messagesContainer.innerHTML = "";

    snapshot.forEach(docSnap => {
      const msg = docSnap.data();
      const isOwn = currentUser && msg.uid === currentUser.uid;

      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.className = "message-row" + (isOwn ? " outgoing" : "");

      const name = escapeHtml(msg.displayName || "Learner");
      const initial = escapeHtml((msg.displayName || "?").charAt(0).toUpperCase());
      const text = escapeHtml(msg.text || "");

      let inner = "";
      if (!isOwn) inner += "<div class=\"message-avatar\">" + initial + "</div>";
      inner += "<div class=\"message-bubble " + (isOwn ? "outgoing-bubble" : "incoming-bubble") + "\">";
      if (!isOwn) inner += "<div class=\"message-user\">" + name + "</div>";

      if (msg.type === "file") {

        const isImage = msg.fileType && msg.fileType.indexOf("image/") === 0;

        if (isImage) {
          inner += "<img class=\"message-image\" src=\"" + msg.fileUrl + "\" onclick=\"window.open('" + msg.fileUrl + "','_blank')\">";
        } else {
          inner += "<div class=\"message-file-card\" onclick=\"window.open('" + msg.fileUrl + "','_blank')\">" +
            "<svg viewBox='0 0 24 24' width='20' height='20' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='1.8'><path d='M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z'/><path d='M14 2v6h6'/></svg>" +
            "<span>" + escapeHtml(msg.fileName || "File") + "</span>" +
            "</div>";
        }

      } else if (msg.type === "voice") {

        inner += "<audio controls src=\"" + msg.fileUrl + "\" style=\"max-width:220px;\"></audio>";

      } else {

        inner += "<div>" + text + "</div>";

      }

      inner += "</div>";

      row.innerHTML = inner;
      messagesContainer.appendChild(row);
    });

    messagesContainer.scrollTop = messagesContainer.scrollHeight;
  });
}

<script>
function showJsError(msg){
  var el = document.getElementById("errorBanner");
  el.style.display = "block";
  el.textContent += msg + "\n\n";
}
window.addEventListener("error", function(e){
  showJsError("ERROR: " + e.message + " (line " + e.lineno + ", col " + e.colno + ")\nFile: " + e.filename);
});
window.addEventListener("unhandledrejection", function(e){
  showJsError("UNHANDLED PROMISE REJECTION: " + (e.reason && e.reason.message ? e.reason.message : e.reason));
});
</script>

=== \public\css\dashboard-bg-pan.css ===
/* Keeps the page's current background photo panning slowly.
   snow.js adds the class "sb-pan" only when the page paints its own photo (e.g. the Christmas stylesheet) over the panning layer,
   and passes that same photo in --sb-photo. No image is named here, so the photo never changes.
   Remove this file's <link> (and snow.js) to undo. */
html.sb-pan{ background:var(--sb-color,#0a1822) !important; }
html.sb-pan body{ background:transparent !important; }
html.sb-pan body::before{ background-image:var(--sb-photo) !important; }
@media (max-width:800px){ html.sb-pan body{ background-attachment:scroll !important; } }

#sbSnow{ position:fixed; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; pointer-events:none; z-index:0; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){ #sbSnow{ display:none; } }

=== \public\css\page-reveal.css ===
/* =========================================================
   SAYBON GLOBAL PAGE REVEAL
   One shared reveal system for every page EXCEPT the
   homepage, which keeps its own bespoke system in
   home.css / home.js. Do not touch that system.

   USAGE PER PAGE (added one page at a time):
     1. Add class="pr-preload" to <body>
     2. Add <script src="/js/page-reveal.js" defer></script>
        anywhere in <head> or before </body>
   No other markup or per-page code needed.
========================================================= */

body.pr-preload{
  opacity:0;
  filter:blur(6px);
}

body.pr-in{
  opacity:1;
  filter:blur(0);
  transition:
    opacity .7s ease,
    filter .8s ease;
}

<script type="module">
const API = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";
import { auth } from "/js/firebase-init.js";
import { onAuthStateChanged } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-auth.js";
const grid = document.getElementById("grid");
// Always-visible catalogue; server progress is layered on top when it loads.
const CATALOG = [
  ["first_lesson","🎯","First Steps","Complete your first lesson",1,"Finish one lesson to unlock"],
  ["five_lessons","📘","Dedicated Learner","Complete 5 lessons",5,"Five lessons and it is yours"],
  ["twentyfive_lessons","📚","Bookworm","Complete 25 lessons",25,"A full level of lessons"],
  ["first_game","🧩","Game On","Finish your first Talkletics mission",1,"Play one Talkletics mission"],
  ["first_exam","📝","Exam Ready","Finish a DELF mock exam",1,"Try a DELF mock exam"],
  ["music_30","🎧","Music Lover","Listen for 30 minutes",30,"Press play on some French music"],
  ["goal_1","🎉","Goal Getter","Hit your daily goal",1,"Reach your daily goal once"],
  ["goal_7","🏅","Goal Crusher","Hit your daily goal 7 times",7,"Hit your goal on 7 days"],
  ["streak_3","🔥","Streak Keeper","3-day streak",3,"Practise 3 days in a row"],
  ["streak_7","⚡","On Fire","7-day streak",7,"Seven days in a row"],
  ["streak_30","🌟","Unstoppable","30-day streak",30,"A whole month. You can do it"],
  ["minutes_100","⏱️","Century","Practise for 100 minutes in total",100,"100 minutes of French"]
];
function ld(){ const d=new Date(); return d.getFullYear()+"-"+("0"+(d.getMonth()+1)).slice(-2)+"-"+("0"+d.getDate()).slice(-2); }
function sparkle(el){
  if(matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) return;
  const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();
  for(let i=0;i<8;i++){ const s=document.createElement("span"); s.className="fx-sparkle"; s.textContent=["✨","⭐","💛"][i%3];
    s.style.left=(r.left+r.width/2)+"px"; s.style.top=(r.top+r.height/2)+"px";
    s.style.setProperty("--dx",(Math.random()*120-60)+"px"); s.style.setProperty("--dy",(Math.random()*-110-10)+"px");
    document.body.appendChild(s); setTimeout(()=>s.remove(),1000); }
}
function draw(progress){
  let n=0;
  grid.innerHTML=CATALOG.map(function(c,i){
    const p=progress && progress[c[0]];
    const value=p?p.value:0, target=p?p.target:c[4], earned=p?p.earned:false;
    if(earned) n++;
    const pct=Math.min(100,Math.round(value/target*100));
    return '<div class="fx-badge '+(earned?'earned':'locked')+'" style="animation-delay:'+(i*0.05)+'s"><div class="ic">'+c[1]+'</div><div class="tx"><div class="bt">'+c[2]+'</div><div class="bs">'+c[3]+'</div>'+
      (earned?'<div class="hint">Unlocked! 🎉</div>':'<div class="bar"><div style="width:'+pct+'%"></div></div><div class="hint">'+(progress?value+' / '+target+' &middot; ':'')+c[5]+'</div>')+'</div></div>';
  }).join("");
  document.getElementById("countTxt").textContent=n+" of "+CATALOG.length+" unlocked";
  document.getElementById("countBar").style.width=Math.round(n/CATALOG.length*100)+"%";
  document.getElementById("sub").textContent = n===0 ? "Your first badge is one lesson away. Go get it!" : "Collect them all, one small win at a time.";
  grid.querySelectorAll(".fx-badge.earned").forEach(el=>el.addEventListener("click",()=>sparkle(el)));
}
draw(null);
onAuthStateChanged(auth, async function(user){
  if(!user) return;
  try{
    const tok=await user.getIdToken();
    const r=await fetch(API+"/api/activity/summary?day="+ld(),{headers:{Authorization:"Bearer "+tok}});
    if(!r.ok) throw 0;
    const map={}; (await r.json()).achievements.forEach(a=>map[a.id]=a);
    draw(map);
  }catch(e){ /* keep the full locked catalogue, nothing to look broken */ }
});
</script>

const level = sessionStorage.getItem("saybon_level");
document.querySelectorAll(".js-profile-level").forEach(el => el.textContent = level || "");

const streak = Number(localStorage.getItem("saybon_streak")) || 0;
document.querySelectorAll(".js-streak-num").forEach(el => el.textContent = streak);

const dailyMinutes = Number(localStorage.getItem("saybon_daily_minutes")) || 0;
const goalTarget = 10;
document.querySelectorAll(".js-goal-minutes").forEach(el => el.textContent = dailyMinutes);

const circumference = 2 * Math.PI * 42;
const pct = Math.min(dailyMinutes / goalTarget, 1);
document.querySelectorAll(".js-goal-ring-fill").forEach(ringFill => {
  ringFill.style.strokeDasharray = circumference;
  ringFill.style.strokeDashoffset = circumference * (1 - pct);

import { auth } from "/js/firebase-init.js";
const API = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";
const RM = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
const $$ = (s) => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(s));
const C = 2 * Math.PI * 42;
const MILESTONES = [3, 7, 14, 30, 50, 100, 200, 365];

// wake the (sleepy) server early so Progress and Achievements load fast
try { fetch(API + "/api/activity/ping", { mode: "no-cors" }).catch(() => {}); } catch (e) {}

function localDay() { const d = new Date(); return d.getFullYear() + "-" + ("0" + (d.getMonth() + 1)).slice(-2) + "-" + ("0" + d.getDate()).slice(-2); }
function safe(f, d) { try { return f(); } catch (e) { return d; } }

function roll(el, from, to, ms) {
  if (RM || from === to) { el.textContent = to; return; }
  const t0 = performance.now();
  (function step(t) {
    const p = Math.min((t - t0) / ms, 1);
    el.textContent = Math.round(from + (to - from) * (1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 3)));
    if (p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
  })(t0);
}

function confetti() {
  if (RM) return;
  const box = document.createElement("div"); box.className = "sb-confetti";
  const bits = ["🔥", "⭐", "🎉", "✨", "💛"];
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
    const s = document.createElement("span");
    s.textContent = bits[i % bits.length];
    s.style.left = Math.random() * 100 + "vw";
    s.style.animationDuration = 1.8 + Math.random() * 1.6 + "s";
    s.style.animationDelay = Math.random() * 0.6 + "s";
    box.appendChild(s);
  }
  document.body.appendChild(box); setTimeout(() => box.remove(), 4500);
}
function toast(msg) {
  const t = document.createElement("div"); t.className = "sb-toast"; t.textContent = msg;
  document.body.appendChild(t);
  requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => t.classList.add("show")));
  setTimeout(() => { t.classList.remove("show"); setTimeout(() => t.remove(), 600); }, 3200);
}

function animateStreak(streak) {
  const seen = Number(safe(() => localStorage.getItem("sb_seen_streak"), 0)) || 0;
  const flames = $$(".dash-streak-flame");
  const nums = $$(".js-streak-num");
  nums.forEach((n) => roll(n, Math.min(seen, streak), streak, 900));
  if (streak > 0) {
    flames.forEach((f) => {
      if (!RM && streak !== seen) { f.classList.add("fly"); setTimeout(() => { f.classList.remove("fly"); f.classList.add("lit"); }, 950); }
      else f.classList.add("lit");
    });
    if (streak > seen && !RM) nums.forEach((n) => setTimeout(() => n.classList.add("bump"), 900));
    if (streak > seen && MILESTONES.indexOf(streak) >= 0) {
      setTimeout(() => { confetti(); toast("🔥 " + streak + "-day streak!"); }, 900);
    }
  } else flames.forEach((f) => (f.style.opacity = ".55"));
  safe(() => localStorage.setItem("sb_seen_streak", String(streak)));
}

function setRing(minutes, goal) {
  const pct = Math.min(minutes / goal, 1);
  $$(".js-goal-ring-fill").forEach((r) => {
    r.style.strokeDasharray = C;
    r.style.strokeDashoffset = C;
    r.getBoundingClientRect();
    requestAnimationFrame(() => { r.style.strokeDashoffset = C * (1 - pct); });
    r.classList.toggle("is-done", pct >= 1);
  });
  $$(".dash-goal-ring-wrap").forEach((w) => w.classList.toggle("is-done", pct >= 1));
  $$(".js-goal-minutes").forEach((n) => roll(n, 0, Math.floor(minutes), 900));
  $$(".dash-goal-ring-text small").forEach((s) => (s.textContent = "/" + goal + " min"));
}

function lines(st) {
  const m = Math.floor(st.today.seconds / 60), g = st.goalMinutes, left = Math.max(g - m, 0);
  const next = [
    ["Try a lesson", "Pick up where you left off"],
    ["Play a mission", "Talkletics is waiting"],
    ["Put some music on", "Listening counts too"]
  ];
  let L = [];
  if (st.today.goalMet) {
    L.push(["Goal done", "Keep the flame going"]);
    L.push(["Bonus time", "Extra practice sticks"]);
    L.push(next[0], next[1], next[2]);
  } else if (m === 0) {
    L.push(["Ready when you are", g + " minutes to go"]);
    if (st.streak > 0 && !st.countedToday) L.push(["Keep the flame", "Day " + (st.streak + 1) + " awaits"]);
    L.push(["Start small", "One lesson counts"]);
    L.push(next[0], next[1], next[2]);
  } else {
    L.push([m + (m === 1 ? " minute in" : " minutes in"), left + " to go"]);
    L.push(["Nice rhythm", left + (left === 1 ? " minute left" : " minutes left")]);
    L.push(next[1], next[2], next[0]);
  }
  return L;
}

let tickTimer = null;
function ticker(st) {
  const L = lines(st);
  $$(".js-goal-caption").forEach((cap) => {
    cap.classList.add("sb-ticker"); cap.textContent = "";
    const mk = (l) => { const d = document.createElement("div"); d.className = "tk"; const h = document.createElement("span"); h.className = "tk-h"; h.textContent = l[0]; const s = document.createElement("span"); s.className = "tk-s"; s.textContent = l[1]; d.append(h, s); cap.appendChild(d); return d; };
    let i = 0, cur = mk(L[0]); requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => cur.classList.add("in")));
    cap._tk = setInterval(() => {
      const old = cur; i = (i + 1) % L.length; cur = mk(L[i]);
      requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => cur.classList.add("in")));
      old.classList.remove("in"); old.classList.add("out"); setTimeout(() => old.remove(), 600);
    }, 3800);
  });
}

function fallbackTicker() { /* API unreachable: keep the original static caption */ }

async function load(user) {
  const token = await user.getIdToken();
  const r = await fetch(API + "/api/activity/summary?day=" + localDay(), { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer " + token } });
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error("summary " + r.status);
  return r.json();
}

let started = false;
function render(st) {
  $$(".js-goal-caption").forEach((c) => c._tk && clearInterval(c._tk));
  const minutes = st.today.seconds / 60;
  setRing(minutes, st.goalMinutes);
  animateStreak(st.streak);
  ticker(st);
}

function applyProfile(user) {
  const name = user.displayName || "";
  if (name) $$(".dash-profile-name").forEach((n) => (n.textContent = name));
  $$(".dash-avatar").forEach((a) => {
    if (user.photoURL) { a.textContent = ""; const i = document.createElement("img"); i.alt = ""; i.src = user.photoURL; a.appendChild(i); }
    else if (name) a.textContent = name.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
  });
}

auth.onAuthStateChanged(async (user) => {
  if (user) applyProfile(user);
  if (!user || started) return; started = true;
  try { render(await load(user)); } catch (e) { console.warn("dashboard-live:", e); fallbackTicker(); }
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", async () => {
    if (document.visibilityState === "visible") { try { render(await load(user)); } catch (e) {} }
  });
});

=== \public\dashboard\level-sync.js ===
import { auth } from "/js/firebase-init.js";
import { onAuthStateChanged } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-auth.js";
const API = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";
const show = (lv) => document.querySelectorAll(".js-profile-level").forEach((el) => { el.textContent = lv; });
function local() { try { return sessionStorage.getItem("saybon_level"); } catch (e) { return null; } }
async function call(user, method, body, tries) {
  for (let i = 0; i < tries; i++) {
    try {
      const t = await user.getIdToken();
      const r = await fetch(API + "/api/level", { method, headers: Object.assign({ Authorization: "Bearer " + t }, body ? { "Content-Type": "application/json" } : {}), body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined });
      if (r.ok) return await r.json();
    } catch (e) { }
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 4000));
  }
  return null;
}
onAuthStateChanged(auth, async (user) => {
  if (!user || (user.isAnonymous && !user.email)) return;
  const lv = local();
  if (lv && /^[A-C][0-2]$/i.test(lv)) {
    show(lv.toUpperCase());
    call(user, "POST", { level: lv }, 5);          // save it to the account
    return;
  }
  const d = await call(user, "GET", null, 6);      // nothing in this browser: ask the account
  if (d && d.level) {
    try { sessionStorage.setItem("saybon_level", d.level); localStorage.removeItem("saybon_start_scratch"); } catch (e) { }
    show(d.level);
    return;
  }
  // No level anywhere (a new learner, or "Start from scratch"): the starting level is A0
  if (d) {
    try { sessionStorage.setItem("saybon_level", "A0"); localStorage.removeItem("saybon_start_scratch"); } catch (e) { }
    show("A0");
    call(user, "POST", { level: "A0" }, 5);
  }
});

const API = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";
const FALLBACK = "/levels/";
// highest level first: the most advanced level with completed lessons wins
const HUBS = [
  ["c2", "/levels/C2/"], ["c1", "/levels/C1/"], ["b2", "/levels/B2/"], ["b1", "/levels/B1/"],
  ["a2", "/levels/A2/"], ["a1", "/levels/A1/"],
  ["a0-tout-public", "/levels/A0/tout-public/"], ["a0-les-petits", "/levels/A0/les-petits/"]
];
const links = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a[data-my-lessons]'));
let target = FALLBACK;

function setTarget(href){ target = href; links.forEach((a) => { a.setAttribute("href", href); }); }

function placement(){
  let lv = null;
  try { lv = sessionStorage.getItem("saybon_level"); } catch (e) {}
  if (!lv || !/^[A-C][0-2]$/i.test(lv)) return null;
  lv = lv.toUpperCase();
  return lv === "A0" ? "/levels/A0/tout-public/" : "/levels/" + lv + "/";
}

function timeout(ms){ return new Promise((r) => setTimeout(() => r(null), ms)); }

async function progressHub(uid){
  const res = await Promise.all(HUBS.map(([key]) =>
    Promise.race([
      fetch(API + "/api/levelProgress?uid=" + encodeURIComponent(uid) + "&level=" + key).then((r) => r.json()).catch(() => null),
      timeout(7000)
    ])
  ));
  for (let i = 0; i < HUBS.length; i++) {
    const d = res[i];
    if (d && Array.isArray(d.completedLessons) && d.completedLessons.length) return HUBS[i][1];
  }
  return null;
}

// show something sensible straight away (placement level), then refine with real progress
setTarget(placement() || FALLBACK);

onAuthStateChanged(auth, async (user) => {
  if (!user) return;
  try {
    const hub = await progressHub(user.uid);
    if (hub) setTarget(hub);
    else if (!placement()) {
      // placement not cached in this browser yet: level-sync.js stores it shortly after load
      setTimeout(() => { const p = placement(); if (p && target === FALLBACK) setTarget(p); }, 2500);
    }
  } catch (e) {}
});

// if the learner taps before the lookup is back, use the best answer we have right now
links.forEach((a) => a.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
  const p = placement();
  if (target === FALLBACK && p) { e.preventDefault(); window.location.href = p; }
}));

// "C'est bon for Schools" card: locked for everyone except the SayBon admin.
import { auth } from "/js/firebase-init.js";
import { onAuthStateChanged } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-auth.js";

const card = document.getElementById("schoolsCard");
const pill = card && card.querySelector(".sch-pill");
const icon = card && card.querySelector(".card-go svg");
const LOCK = '<path d="M7 11V8a5 5 0 0 1 10 0v3"/><rect x="5" y="11" width="14" height="10" rx="2"/>';
const ARROW = '<path d="M9 6l6 6-6 6"/>';

let open = false;

function toast(msg){
  const t = document.createElement("div");
  t.className = "sb-toast"; t.textContent = msg;
  document.body.appendChild(t);
  requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => t.classList.add("show")));
  setTimeout(() => { t.classList.remove("show"); setTimeout(() => t.remove(), 600); }, 3400);
}

window.goSchools = function(){
  if (open) { window.location.href = "/schools/"; return; }
  toast("C'est bon for Schools is offered strictly by invitation to partner schools.");
};

if (card) {
  card.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => { if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") { e.preventDefault(); window.goSchools(); } });
  onAuthStateChanged(auth, (user) => {
    open = isSchoolsAdmin(user);
    card.classList.toggle("is-open", open);
    card.classList.toggle("is-locked", !open);
    card.setAttribute("aria-disabled", open ? "false" : "true");
    if (pill) pill.textContent = open ? "ADMIN ACCESS" : "BY INVITATION";
    if (icon) icon.innerHTML = open ? ARROW : LOCK;
  });
}
