}

function startWave(streamOrElement, isElement){
  var canvas = document.getElementById("lsWaveCanvas");
  var ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  canvas.style.display = "block";
  if(!lsAudioCtx){
    lsAudioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
  }
  var analyser = lsAudioCtx.createAnalyser();
  analyser.fftSize = 64;

  if(isElement){
    if(!streamOrElement._lsWaveSource){
      streamOrElement._lsWaveSource = lsAudioCtx.createMediaElementSource(streamOrElement);
      streamOrElement._lsWaveSource.connect(lsAudioCtx.destination);
    }
    streamOrElement._lsWaveSource.connect(analyser);
  } else {
    var source = lsAudioCtx.createMediaStreamSource(streamOrElement);
    source.connect(analyser);
  }

  var bufferLength = analyser.frequencyBinCount;
  var dataArray = new Uint8Array(bufferLength);

  function draw(){
    lsWaveAnimId = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    var barWidth = (canvas.width / bufferLength) * 1.8;
    var x = 0;
    for(var i = 0; i < bufferLength; i++){
      var barHeight = (dataArray[i] / 255) * canvas.height;
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd93d";
      ctx.fillRect(x, canvas.height - barHeight, barWidth, barHeight);
      x += barWidth + 2;
    }
  }
  draw();
}

function stopWave(){
  if(lsWaveAnimId){
    cancelAnimationFrame(lsWaveAnimId);
    lsWaveAnimId = null;
  }
  var canvas = document.getElementById("lsWaveCanvas");
  if(canvas){
    canvas.getContext("2d").clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    canvas.style.display = "none";
  }
}

function toggleRecording(){
  var btn = document.getElementById("lsRecordBtn");
  var status = document.getElementById("lsRecordStatus");

  if(!mediaRecorder || mediaRecorder.state === "inactive"){
    navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true }).then(function(stream){
      currentStream = stream;
      recordedChunks = [];
      mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream);
      mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = function(e){ recordedChunks.push(e.data); };
      mediaRecorder.onstop = function(){ if(window.resumeAppBgMusicAfterRecording){ window.resumeAppBgMusicAfterRecording(); }
        recordedBlob = new Blob(recordedChunks, { type: "audio/webm" });
        stopWave();
        document.getElementById("lsRecordBtn").style.display = "none";
        document.getElementById("lsPlaybackRow").style.display = "flex";
        document.getElementById("lsSubmitBtn").disabled = false;
        currentStream.getTracks().forEach(function(t){ t.stop(); });
      };
      if(window.pauseAppBgMusicForRecording){ window.pauseAppBgMusicForRecording(); } mediaRecorder.start();
      startWave(stream, false);
      btn.textContent = "■ Stop";
      btn.classList.add("ls-recording");
      status.textContent = "Recording...";
    }).catch(function(err){
      status.textContent = "Microphone access denied";
      console.error(err);
    });
  } else {
    mediaRecorder.stop();
  }
}

function playRecording(){
  var playBtn = document.getElementById("lsPlayBtn");
  var audioEl = document.getElementById("lsPlaybackAudio");
  var originalLabel = playBtn.innerHTML;
  playBtn.innerHTML = '<span class="ls-loading-pulse"></span>Loading...';
  playBtn.disabled = true;

  audioEl.src = URL.createObjectURL(recordedBlob);

  var onReady = function(){
    playBtn.innerHTML = originalLabel;
    playBtn.disabled = false;
    startWave(audioEl, true);
    audioEl.currentTime = 0;
    audioEl.play();
  };

  audioEl.addEventListener("canplay", onReady, { once: true });
  audioEl.addEventListener("ended", stopWave, { once: true });
}

function reRecord(){
  recordedBlob = null;
  document.getElementById("lsPlaybackRow").style.display = "none";
  var btn = document.getElementById("lsRecordBtn");
  btn.style.display = "inline-block";
  btn.textContent = "● Record";
  btn.classList.remove("ls-recording");
  document.getElementById("lsRecordStatus").textContent = "Not recorded yet";
  document.getElementById("lsSubmitBtn").disabled = true;
  document.getElementById("lsScoreDisplay").innerHTML = "";
}

function submitRecording(expectedText, partNum){
  var scoreDisplay = document.getElementById("lsScoreDisplay");
  scoreDisplay.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);">Scoring...</p>';

  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/assessPronunciation?referenceText=" + encodeURIComponent(expectedText || ""), {
    method: "POST",
    body: recordedBlob
  }).then(function(res){ return res.json(); }).then(function(data){
    var score = data.finalScore ?? data.score ?? data.AccuracyScore ?? data.accuracyScore ?? 0;
    score = Math.round(score);
    scoreDisplay.innerHTML =
      '<div class="ls-score">' + score + '%</div>' +
      '<div class="ls-btn-row">' +
      '<button class="ls-btn ls-btn-secondary" onclick="window.lsRetryRecording()">Try Again</button>' +
      '<button class="ls-btn ls-btn-primary" onclick="window.lsGoNext()">Continue</button>' +
      '</div>';
  }).catch(function(err){
    console.error(err);
    scoreDisplay.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#ff8a8a;">Could not score - please try again.</p>' +
      '<div class="ls-btn-row"><button class="ls-btn ls-btn-secondary" onclick="window.lsRetryRecording()">Try Again</button></div>';
  });
}

  }
};

function markLessonComplete(){
  try{ if(window.SayBonActivity) window.SayBonActivity.complete("lesson_complete"); }catch(e){}
  var uid = window.lsCurrentUid;
  if(!uid) return;
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/levelProgressComplete", {
    method: "POST",

function pcmToWav(d) { var n = d.length, pk = 0, i; for (i = 0; i < n; i++) { var a = Math.abs(d[i]); if (a > pk) pk = a; } var gain = (pk > 0.005 && pk < 0.7) ? 0.85 / pk : 1; var bf = new ArrayBuffer(44 + n * 2), v = new DataView(bf); function w(o, t) { for (var k = 0; k < t.length; k++) v.setUint8(o + k, t.charCodeAt(k)); } w(0, "RIFF"); v.setUint32(4, 36 + n * 2, true); w(8, "WAVE"); w(12, "fmt "); v.setUint32(16, 16, true); v.setUint16(20, 1, true); v.setUint16(22, 1, true); v.setUint32(24, 16000, true); v.setUint32(28, 32000, true); v.setUint16(32, 2, true); v.setUint16(34, 16, true); w(36, "data"); v.setUint32(40, n * 2, true); for (i = 0; i < n; i++) { var x = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, d[i] * gain)); v.setInt16(44 + i * 2, x < 0 ? x * 0x8000 : x * 0x7FFF, true); } var wb = new Blob([bf], { type: "audio/wav" }); wb.pk = pk; return wb; }
function acc(x) { return typeof x.AccuracyScore === "number" ? x.AccuracyScore : (x.PronunciationAssessment && typeof x.PronunciationAssessment.AccuracyScore === "number" ? x.PronunciationAssessment.AccuracyScore : (typeof x.accuracyScore === "number" ? x.accuracyScore : 0)); }

function grade(blob, ref) {

    if (wb.pk < 0.012) return { quiet: true };
    return fetch(API + "/api/assessPronunciation?referenceText=" + encodeURIComponent(ref), { method: "POST", body: wb }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (j) {
      var rw = ref.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean), raw = j && (j.detail || (j._debugRawAzureResponse && j._debugRawAzureResponse.NBest && j._debugRawAzureResponse.NBest[0] && j._debugRawAzureResponse.NBest[0].Words)),
        items = (raw || j.wordFeedback || j.words || []).filter(function (x) { return x && errOf(x) !== "Insertion"; }), words = null, mean;
      if (items.length && items.length === rw.length) { words = items.map(function (x) { return errOf(x) === "Omission" ? 0 : acc(x); }); mean = words.reduce(function (a, b) { return a + b; }, 0) / words.length; }
      else { mean = pickScore(j); if (mean === null) mean = items.length ? items.reduce(function (a, x) { return a + acc(x); }, 0) / items.length : 0; }
      if (mean < 8) return { quiet: true };
      return { mean: mean, words: words };
    });
  }).catch(function () { return { err: true }; });
}

}

  content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;
  background:linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(20,50,60,.55), rgba(8,20,26,.85));

  z-index:-1;
}

const API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";
import { app, auth } from "/js/firebase-init.js";
import { signInAnonymously } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-auth.js";
import { getStorage, ref, uploadBytes as _uploadBytes, getDownloadURL } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-storage.js";

const storage = getStorage(app, "gs://saybon-3e3c2.firebasestorage.app");
function uploadBytes(r, f, meta){ return window.compressImageFile(f).then(function(c){ if(c === f) return _uploadBytes(r, f, meta); return _uploadBytes(ref(r.storage, r.fullPath.replace(/\.[A-Za-z0-9]+$/, ".webp")), c, Object.assign({}, meta, {contentType:"image/webp"})); }); }
const ADMIN_PASSCODE = "963281";



document.getElementById("adGateBtn").addEventListener("click", checkPasscode); window.addEventListener("adminAuthorized", function(){ document.getElementById("adGate").style.display = "none"; document.getElementById("adPanel").style.display = "block"; updatePreviewAndList(); });
function checkPasscode(){
  var input = document.getElementById("adPasscodeInput").value;
  if(false){
    document.getElementById("adGate").style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById("adPanel").style.display = "block";
    updatePreviewAndList();
  } else {
    document.getElementById("adGateError").textContent = "Incorrect passcode";
  }
}

var levelEl = document.getElementById("adLevel");
var lessonEl = document.getElementById("adLesson");
var partEl = document.getElementById("adPart");
var typeEl = document.getElementById("adType");
var fileField = document.getElementById("adFileField");
var textField = document.getElementById("adTextField");
var recordPromptField = document.getElementById("adRecordPromptField");
var previewName = document.getElementById("adPreviewName");

[levelEl, lessonEl, partEl, typeEl].forEach(function(el){
  el.addEventListener("change", updatePreviewAndList);
});

function toggleFields(){
  typeEl.value === "text" ? (textField.style.display = "block", fileField.style.display = "none") : (textField.style.display = "none", fileField.style.display = "block");
  recordPromptField.style.display = (partEl.value !== "1") ? "block" : "none";
  document.getElementById("adSizeField").style.display = (typeEl.value === "image" || typeEl.value === "video") ? "block" : "none";
  document.getElementById("adTeacherImageField").style.display = (typeEl.value === "teacher-audio") ? "block" : "none";
}
typeEl.addEventListener("change", toggleFields);
partEl.addEventListener("change", toggleFields);
toggleFields();

var currentAssets = [];

function updatePreviewAndList(){
  toggleFields();
  loadAssetsForLesson().then(function(assets){
    currentAssets = assets;
    var sameTypeCount = assets.filter(function(a){ return a.type === typeEl.value && a.part == partEl.value; }).length;
    var nextIndex = sameTypeCount + 1;
    previewName.textContent = "Name: l" + lessonEl.value + "-" + typeEl.value + nextIndex;
    renderAssetList(assets);
  });
}

function loadAssetsForLesson(){
  return fetch(API_BASE + "/api/levelAssets?level=" + levelEl.value + "&lesson=" + lessonEl.value)
    .then(function(res){ return res.json(); })
    .catch(function(){ return []; });
}

function renderAssetList(assets){
  var list = document.getElementById("adAssetList");
  if(!assets || assets.length === 0){
    list.innerHTML = '<p class="ad-empty">No content added yet for this lesson</p>';
    return;
  }
  list.innerHTML = assets.map(function(a){
    return '<div class="ad-row">' +
      '<div><div class="ad-row-name">' + a.name + '</div><div class="ad-row-type">Part ' + a.part + ' - ' + a.type + '</div></div>' +
      '<div class="ad-row-actions"><button class="ad-edit-btn" data-id="' + a.id + '">Edit</button><button class="ad-delete-btn" data-id="' + a.id + '">Delete</button></div>' +
      '</div>';
  }).join("");
  document.querySelectorAll(".ad-delete-btn").forEach(function(btn){
    btn.addEventListener("click", function(){ deleteAsset(btn.getAttribute("data-id")); });
  });
  document.querySelectorAll(".ad-edit-btn").forEach(function(btn){
    btn.addEventListener("click", function(){ startEditAsset(btn.getAttribute("data-id")); });
  });
}

var editingAssetId = null;

function startEditAsset(id){
  var asset = currentAssets.find(function(a){ return a.id === id; });
  if(!asset) return;

  editingAssetId = id;
  partEl.value = asset.part;
  document.getElementById("adPartTitle").value = asset.partTitle || "Part " + asset.part;
  document.getElementById("adTransitionMode").value = asset.transitionMode || "button";
  typeEl.value = asset.type;
  toggleFields();

  var fileLabel = document.querySelector("#adFileField label");
  fileLabel.textContent = asset.url ? "File (already attached - choose a new one only to replace it)" : "File";
  var imgLabel = document.querySelector("#adTeacherImageField label");
  if(imgLabel){
    imgLabel.textContent = asset.imageUrl ? "Teacher Image (already attached - choose a new one only to replace it)" : "Teacher Image (the file above should be the audio)";
  }

  if(asset.type === "text"){
    document.getElementById("adTextInput").value = asset.content || "";
  }
  if(asset.type === "image" || asset.type === "video"){
    document.getElementById("adSize").value = asset.size || "medium";
  }
  if(asset.recordPrompt){
    document.getElementById("adRecordPrompt").value = asset.recordPrompt || "";
    document.getElementById("adExpectedText").value = asset.expectedText || "";
  }

  document.getElementById("adUploadBtn").textContent = "Save Changes";
  previewName.textContent = "Editing: " + asset.name + " (file optional - only upload to replace)";

  var status = document.getElementById("adUploadStatus");
  status.innerHTML = '<span id="adCancelEdit" style="cursor:pointer;text-decoration:underline;color:#d4af6a;">Cancel edit</span>';
  document.getElementById("adCancelEdit").addEventListener("click", cancelEdit);

  document.getElementById("adPanel").scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
}

function cancelEdit(){
  editingAssetId = null;
  document.getElementById("adUploadBtn").textContent = "Add to Lesson";
  document.getElementById("adUploadStatus").textContent = "";
  document.getElementById("adTextInput").value = "";
  document.getElementById("adFileInput").value = "";
  updatePreviewAndList();
}

document.getElementById("adUploadBtn").addEventListener("click", uploadAsset);

function uploadAsset(){
  var status = document.getElementById("adUploadStatus");

  if(editingAssetId){
    saveEditedAsset(status);
    return;
  }

  var sameTypeCount = currentAssets.filter(function(a){ return a.type === typeEl.value && a.part == partEl.value; }).length;
  var name = "l" + lessonEl.value + "-" + typeEl.value + (sameTypeCount + 1);

  var basePayload = {
    level: levelEl.value,
    lesson: parseInt(lessonEl.value),
    part: parseInt(partEl.value),
    partTitle: document.getElementById("adPartTitle").value || "Part " + partEl.value,
    transitionMode: document.getElementById("adTransitionMode").value,
    type: typeEl.value,
    name: name,
    recordPrompt: recordPromptField.style.display !== "none" ? document.getElementById("adRecordPrompt").value : null,
    expectedText: recordPromptField.style.display !== "none" ? document.getElementById("adExpectedText").value : null,
    size: (typeEl.value === "image" || typeEl.value === "video") ? document.getElementById("adSize").value : null
  };

  status.textContent = "Saving...";
  status.className = "ad-status";

  if(typeEl.value === "text"){
    basePayload.content = document.getElementById("adTextInput").value;
    saveAssetRecord(basePayload, status);
    return;
  }

  var fileInput = document.getElementById("adFileInput");
  if(!fileInput.files[0]){
    status.textContent = "Please choose a file";
    status.className = "ad-status ad-error";
    return;
  }

  var file = fileInput.files[0];
  var storageRef = ref(storage, "levelAssets/" + levelEl.value + "/" + name + "-" + Date.now() + "-" + file.name);

  uploadBytes(storageRef, file).then(function(snapshot){
    return getDownloadURL(snapshot.ref);
  }).then(function(url){
    basePayload.url = url;
    status.textContent = "File uploaded successfully.";
    status.className = "ad-status ad-success";
    if(typeEl.value === "teacher-audio"){
      var imgInput = document.getElementById("adTeacherImageInput");
      if(!imgInput.files[0]){
        status.textContent = "Please choose a teacher image";
        status.className = "ad-status ad-error";
        return;
      }
      status.textContent = "File uploaded. Uploading teacher image...";
      var imgFile = imgInput.files[0];
      var imgRef = ref(storage, "levelAssets/" + levelEl.value + "/" + name + "-img-" + Date.now() + "-" + imgFile.name);
      uploadBytes(imgRef, imgFile).then(function(snap2){
        return getDownloadURL(snap2.ref);
      }).then(function(imgUrl){
        basePayload.imageUrl = imgUrl;
        status.textContent = "Teacher image uploaded successfully. Saving...";
        saveAssetRecord(basePayload, status);
      }).catch(function(err){
        console.error(err);
        status.textContent = "Teacher image upload failed: " + (err.message || "check console");
        status.className = "ad-status ad-error";
      });
    } else {
      saveAssetRecord(basePayload, status);
    }
  }).catch(function(err){
    console.error(err);
    status.textContent = "Upload failed: " + (err.message || "check console");
    status.className = "ad-status ad-error";
  });
}

function saveEditedAsset(status){
  status.textContent = "Saving changes...";
  status.className = "ad-status";

  var updatePayload = {
    assetId: editingAssetId,
    part: parseInt(partEl.value),
    partTitle: document.getElementById("adPartTitle").value || "Part " + partEl.value,
    transitionMode: document.getElementById("adTransitionMode").value,
    recordPrompt: recordPromptField.style.display !== "none" ? document.getElementById("adRecordPrompt").value : null,
    expectedText: recordPromptField.style.display !== "none" ? document.getElementById("adExpectedText").value : null,
    size: (typeEl.value === "image" || typeEl.value === "video") ? document.getElementById("adSize").value : null
  };

  if(typeEl.value === "text"){
    updatePayload.content = document.getElementById("adTextInput").value;
    finishEditSave(updatePayload, status);
    return;
  }

  var fileInput = document.getElementById("adFileInput");
  var imgInput2 = document.getElementById("adTeacherImageInput");

  function maybeUploadTeacherImage(){
    if(typeEl.value === "teacher-audio" && imgInput2.files[0]){
      var imgFile = imgInput2.files[0];
      var imgRef = ref(storage, "levelAssets/" + levelEl.value + "/edit-img-" + Date.now() + "-" + imgFile.name);
      return uploadBytes(imgRef, imgFile).then(function(snap){ return getDownloadURL(snap.ref); }).then(function(imgUrl){ updatePayload.imageUrl = imgUrl; });
    }
    return Promise.resolve();
  }

  if(fileInput.files[0]){
    var file = fileInput.files[0];
    var storageRef = ref(storage, "levelAssets/" + levelEl.value + "/edit-" + Date.now() + "-" + file.name);
    uploadBytes(storageRef, file).then(function(snapshot){
      return getDownloadURL(snapshot.ref);
    }).then(function(url){
      updatePayload.url = url;
      return maybeUploadTeacherImage();
    }).then(function(){
      finishEditSave(updatePayload, status);
    }).catch(function(err){
      console.error(err);
      status.textContent = "Upload failed: " + (err.message || "check console");
      status.className = "ad-status ad-error";
    });
  } else {
    maybeUploadTeacherImage().then(function(){
      finishEditSave(updatePayload, status);
    }).catch(function(err){
      console.error(err);
      status.textContent = "Upload failed: " + (err.message || "check console");
      status.className = "ad-status ad-error";
    });
  }
}

function finishEditSave(payload, status){
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/levelAdminUpdateAsset", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify(payload)
  }).then(function(res){ return res.json(); }).then(function(){
    status.textContent = "Changes saved";
    status.className = "ad-status ad-success";
    editingAssetId = null;
    document.getElementById("adUploadBtn").textContent = "Add to Lesson";
    document.getElementById("adFileInput").value = "";
    document.getElementById("adTextInput").value = "";
    updatePreviewAndList();
  }).catch(function(err){
    console.error(err);
    status.textContent = "Save failed - check console";
    status.className = "ad-status ad-error";
  });
}

function saveAssetRecord(payload, status){
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/levelAdminAddAsset", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify(payload)
  }).then(function(res){ return res.json(); }).then(function(){
    status.textContent = "Added successfully";
    status.className = "ad-status ad-success";
    document.getElementById("adFileInput").value = "";
    document.getElementById("adTextInput").value = "";
    updatePreviewAndList();
  }).catch(function(err){
    console.error(err);
    status.textContent = "Save failed - check console";
    status.className = "ad-status ad-error";
  });
}

function deleteAsset(id){
  if(!confirm("Delete this content block?")) return;
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/levelAdminDeleteAsset", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ assetId: id })
  }).then(function(){ updatePreviewAndList(); });
}

=== \public\levels\C1\theme.css ===
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;}
html,body{min-height:100%;}
body{
  color:#fff;
  font-family:"Manrope",-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif;
  overflow-x:hidden;
}

body::before{
  content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;
  background-image:url('/assets/levels/c1.webp');
  background-size:cover;background-position:center;background-repeat:no-repeat;
  z-index:-2;
}
body::after{
  content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;
  background:linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(20,50,60,.55), rgba(8,20,26,.85));
  backdrop-filter:blur(7px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(7px);
  z-index:-1;

const API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";

var pathParts = location.pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean);
var LEVEL;
if(pathParts.indexOf("tout-public") !== -1){ LEVEL = "a0-tout-public"; }
else { LEVEL = pathParts[1].toLowerCase(); }

import { auth } from "/js/firebase-init.js";
import { onAuthStateChanged } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-auth.js";

function applyUnlocks(maxUnlocked){
  var buttons = document.querySelectorAll(".lesson");
  buttons.forEach(function(btn){
    var numSpan = btn.querySelector(".tp-num");
    if(!numSpan) return;
    var num = parseInt(numSpan.textContent);
    if(num <= maxUnlocked){
      btn.classList.remove("locked");
      btn.classList.add("unlocked");
      var lockIcon = btn.querySelector(".tp-lock");
      if(lockIcon) lockIcon.style.display = "none";
      btn.onclick = function(){ window.location.href = "lesson" + num + ".html"; };
    }
  });
}

var isAdmin = sessionStorage.getItem("saybon_admin_unlocked") === "true";
if(isAdmin){
  applyUnlocks(25);
} else {
  onAuthStateChanged(auth, function(user){
    if(!user){ applyUnlocks(1); return; }
    if(String(user.email||'').toLowerCase()==='saybon.fr@gmail.com'){ applyUnlocks(100); return; }
    fetch(API_BASE + "/api/levelProgress?uid=" + user.uid + "&level=" + LEVEL)
      .then(function(res){ return res.json(); })
      .then(function(data){
        var completed = data.completedLessons || [];
        var maxCompleted = completed.length ? Math.max.apply(null, completed) : 0;
        applyUnlocks(maxCompleted + 1);
      })
      .catch(function(){ applyUnlocks(1); });
  });
}

<script type="module">
import { auth } from "/js/firebase-init.js";
import { onAuthStateChanged } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-auth.js";
const API = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";
const log = m => { const l = document.getElementById("log"); l.textContent += "\n" + m; l.scrollTop = l.scrollHeight; };
let user = null, plan = null;
onAuthStateChanged(auth, u => { user = u; document.getElementById("log").textContent = u ? "Signed in as " + u.email + ". Press the first button." : "Not signed in. Sign in to SayBon as admin, then reload this page."; });
async function tok() { return user ? await user.getIdToken() : null; }
async function api(path, body) {
  const r = await fetch(API + path, { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", Authorization: "Bearer " + await tok() }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(path + " " + r.status);
  return r.json();
}
document.getElementById("prev").onclick = async () => {
  if (!user) { log("Please sign in as admin first."); return; }
  const level = document.getElementById("lvl").value;
  const blocks = await (await fetch("import-data/" + level + ".json")).json();
  const byLesson = {}; blocks.forEach(b => (byLesson[b.lesson] = byLesson[b.lesson] || []).push(b));
  plan = { level, byLesson, existing: {} };
  log("Checking existing content for " + Object.keys(byLesson).length + " lessons...");
  let withContent = 0;
  for (const n of Object.keys(byLesson)) {
    const ex = await (await fetch(API + "/api/levelAssets?level=" + level + "&lesson=" + n)).json();
    plan.existing[n] = ex; if (ex.length) withContent++;
  }
  log("New blocks to add: " + blocks.length + "\nLessons that already have content: " + withContent +
    (document.getElementById("rep").checked ? " (they will be REPLACED)" : " (they will be SKIPPED)"));
  document.getElementById("go").disabled = false;
};
document.getElementById("go").onclick = async () => {
  document.getElementById("go").disabled = true; document.getElementById("prev").disabled = true;
  const replace = document.getElementById("rep").checked;
  const jobs = []; let skipped = 0, deleted = 0, added = 0, failed = 0;
  for (const n of Object.keys(plan.byLesson)) {
    const ex = plan.existing[n];
    if (ex.length && !replace) { skipped++; continue; }
    ex.forEach(a => jobs.push({ kind: "del", id: a.id }));
    plan.byLesson[n].forEach(b => jobs.push({ kind: "add", b }));
  }
  const dels = jobs.filter(j => j.kind === "del"), adds = jobs.filter(j => j.kind === "add");
  let done = 0; const total = jobs.length;
  async function run(list, fn) {
    let i = 0;
    await Promise.all([1, 2, 3, 4].map(async () => {
      while (i < list.length) { const j = list[i++]; let ok = false;
        for (let t = 0; t < 3 && !ok; t++) { try { await fn(j); ok = true; } catch (e) { await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800)); } }
        if (!ok) failed++; done++; document.getElementById("fill").style.width = (done / total * 100) + "%"; }
    }));
  }
  await run(dels, async j => { await api("/api/levelAdminDeleteAsset", { assetId: j.id }); deleted++; });
  log("Old blocks removed: " + deleted);
  await run(adds, async j => { await api("/api/levelAdminAddAsset", j.b); added++; });
  log("DONE. Added " + added + " blocks, removed " + deleted + ", skipped " + skipped + " lessons, failed " + failed + ".");
  if (failed) log("Some blocks failed. Run the import again with 'Replace' ticked.");
};
</script>

  var img = document.getElementById(imgId);
  var audioEl = document.getElementById(audioId);
  var playBtn = btnId ? document.getElementById(btnId) : null;
  if(!img || !audioEl) return;
  img.style.opacity = "0";
  img.style.transition = "opacity .5s ease-in";
  if(img.complete){
    img.style.opacity = "1";
  } else {
    img.addEventListener("load", function(){ img.style.opacity = "1"; });
  }
  function showPlayButton(){
    if(playBtn){ playBtn.style.display = "inline-block"; }
  }
  if(playBtn){
    playBtn.addEventListener("click", function(){
      audioEl.play().then(function(){
        playBtn.style.display = "none";
      }).catch(function(err){
        console.error("TEACHER AUDIO MANUAL PLAY FAILED:", err);
      });
    });
  }
  try{
    var audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    if(audioCtx.state === "suspended"){
      await audioCtx.resume();
    }
    var source = audioCtx.createMediaElementSource(audioEl);
    var analyser = audioCtx.createAnalyser();
    analyser.fftSize = 256;
    source.connect(analyser);
    analyser.connect(audioCtx.destination);
    try{
      await audioEl.play();
      setTimeout(function(){
        if(audioEl.paused){ showPlayButton(); }
      }, 400);
    }catch(playErr){
      console.error("TEACHER AUDIO PLAY BLOCKED:", playErr);
      showPlayButton();
    }
    var dataArray = new Uint8Array(analyser.frequencyBinCount);
    function animate(){
      if(!img.isConnected || !audioEl.isConnected){ return; }
      if(audioEl.paused || audioEl.ended){
        img.style.transform = "scale(1)";
        img.style.filter = "none";
        return;
      }
      analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);
      var avg = dataArray.reduce(function(a,b){ return a+b; }, 0) / dataArray.length;
      var intensity = Math.min(avg / 80, 1);
      var scale = 1 + (intensity * 0.06);
      var bounce = intensity * 8;
      var glow = 10 + (intensity * 30);
      img.style.transform = "scale(" + scale.toFixed(3) + ") translateY(-" + bounce.toFixed(2) + "px)";
      img.style.filter = "drop-shadow(0 0 " + glow.toFixed(0) + "px rgba(212,175,106," + (0.3 + intensity * 0.5).toFixed(2) + "))";
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }
    audioEl.addEventListener("play", function(){ requestAnimationFrame(animate); });
    audioEl.addEventListener("playing", function(){ requestAnimationFrame(animate); });
    animate();
  }catch(err){
    console.error("TEACHER AUDIO ANIMATION ERROR:", err);
  }
}
function renderBlock(block){
  var sizeClass = block.size ? "ls-size-" + block.size : "ls-size-large";
  if(block.type === "text") return '<div class="ls-block ls-block-text">' + block.content + '</div>';
  if(block.type === "image") return '<div class="ls-block ' + sizeClass + '"><img src="' + block.url + '"></div>';
  if(block.type === "audio") return '<div class="ls-block"><audio controls controlsList="nodownload" oncontextmenu="return false;" src="' + block.url + '"></audio></div>';
  if(block.type === "video") return '<div class="ls-block ' + sizeClass + '"><video controls controlsList="nodownload" oncontextmenu="return false;" src="' + block.url + '"></video></div>';
  if(block.type === "teacher-audio"){
    injectTeacherAudioStyles();
    return '<div class="ls-block" style="text-align:center;">' +
      '<div style="position:relative;display:inline-block;min-width:220px;min-height:280px;">' +
      '<img class="ls-teacher-audio-img" src="' + block.imageUrl + '">' +
      '<div class="ls-teacher-tap-overlay ls-teacher-tap-hidden">Tap to hear the teacher</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<audio class="ls-teacher-audio-el" controlsList="nodownload" oncontextmenu="return false;" style="display:none;" autoplay src="' + block.url + '"></audio>' +
      '</div>';
  }
  return "";
}

function getPartAssets(partNum){
  return allAssets.filter(function(a){ return a.part === partNum; });
}
function getMaxPart(){ var max = 1; allAssets.forEach(function(a){ if(a.part > max) max = a.part; }); return max; }
function getPartLabel(partNum){ var match = allAssets.find(function(a){ return a.part === partNum; }); return (match && match.partTitle) ? ("Part " + partNum + " - " + match.partTitle) : ("Part " + partNum); }
function getPartTransitionMode(partNum){ var match = allAssets.find(function(a){ return a.part === partNum; }); return (match && match.transitionMode) ? match.transitionMode : "button"; }
window.lsGoToPart1 = function(){ recordedBlob = null; currentPart = 1; renderPart(1, getPartLabel(1)); };

function renderPart(partNum, label){if(window.psRender&&window.psRender(partNum,getPartAssets(partNum),{root:root,api:API_BASE})){return;}
  var blocks = getPartAssets(partNum);
  var promptBlock = blocks.find(function(b){ return b.recordPrompt; });
  var needsRecording = !!promptBlock;
  var transitionMode = getPartTransitionMode(partNum);

  var blocksHtml = blocks.map(renderBlock).join("");

  var recordSection = "";
  if(needsRecording){
    var promptText = promptBlock ? promptBlock.recordPrompt : "Record your answer";
    recordSection =
      '<div class="ls-prompt-bubble">' + promptText + '</div>' +
      '<canvas id="lsWaveCanvas" class="ls-wave-canvas" width="280" height="56" style="display:none;"></canvas>' +
      '<div class="ls-record-row">' +
      '<button class="ls-record-btn" id="lsRecordBtn">● Record</button>' +
      '<span class="ls-record-status" id="lsRecordStatus">' + (recordedBlob ? "Recorded" : "Not recorded yet") + '</span>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="ls-playback-row" id="lsPlaybackRow" style="display:none;">' +
      '<button class="ls-btn ls-btn-secondary" id="lsPlayBtn">&#9658; Play My Recording</button>' +
      '<button class="ls-btn ls-btn-secondary" id="lsRerecordBtn">&#8635; Re-record</button>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<audio id="lsPlaybackAudio" controlsList="nodownload" style="display:none;"></audio>' +
      '<div id="lsScoreDisplay"></div>' +
      '<div class="ls-btn-row"><button class="ls-btn ls-btn-primary" id="lsSubmitBtn" disabled>Submit</button></div>';
  }

  var continueBtn = (needsRecording || transitionMode === "auto") ? "" :
    '<div class="ls-btn-row"><button class="ls-btn ls-btn-primary" onclick="window.lsGoNext()">Continue</button></div>';

  var back1Btn = partNum > 1 ?
    '<div style="text-align:center;margin-top:10px;"><button class="ls-btn ls-btn-secondary" onclick="window.lsGoToPart1()">&#8634; Back to Part 1</button></div>' : '';

  render(
    '<p class="ls-part-label">' + label + '</p>' +
    '<div class="ls-card">' + blocksHtml + recordSection + '</div>' +
    continueBtn + back1Btn
  );

  root.querySelectorAll(".ls-teacher-audio-el").forEach(function(audioEl){
    setTimeout(function(){
      if(audioEl.paused){
        var wrapper = audioEl.previousElementSibling;
        var overlay = wrapper ? wrapper.querySelector(".ls-teacher-tap-overlay") : null;
        if(overlay){ overlay.classList.remove("ls-teacher-tap-hidden"); }
      }
    }, 500);
  });

  if(!needsRecording && transitionMode === "auto"){
    var autoMedia = root.querySelector("video, audio");
    if(autoMedia){
      autoMedia.addEventListener("ended", function(){ window.lsGoNext(); });
    } else {
      setTimeout(function(){ window.lsGoNext(); }, 2500);
    }
  }

  if(needsRecording){
    document.getElementById("lsRecordBtn").addEventListener("click", toggleRecording);
    document.getElementById("lsPlayBtn").addEventListener("click", playRecording);
    document.getElementById("lsRerecordBtn").addEventListener("click", reRecord);
    var expectedText = promptBlock ? promptBlock.expectedText : "";
    document.getElementById("lsSubmitBtn").addEventListener("click", function(){ submitRecording(expectedText, partNum); });
  }
}

function startWave(streamOrElement, isElement){
  var canvas = document.getElementById("lsWaveCanvas");
  var ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  canvas.style.display = "block";
  if(!lsAudioCtx){
    lsAudioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
  }
  var analyser = lsAudioCtx.createAnalyser();
  analyser.fftSize = 64;

  if(isElement){
    if(!streamOrElement._lsWaveSource){
      streamOrElement._lsWaveSource = lsAudioCtx.createMediaElementSource(streamOrElement);
      streamOrElement._lsWaveSource.connect(lsAudioCtx.destination);
    }
    streamOrElement._lsWaveSource.connect(analyser);
  } else {
    var source = lsAudioCtx.createMediaStreamSource(streamOrElement);
    source.connect(analyser);
  }

  var bufferLength = analyser.frequencyBinCount;
  var dataArray = new Uint8Array(bufferLength);

  function draw(){
    lsWaveAnimId = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    var barWidth = (canvas.width / bufferLength) * 1.8;
    var x = 0;
    for(var i = 0; i < bufferLength; i++){
      var barHeight = (dataArray[i] / 255) * canvas.height;
      ctx.fillStyle = "#d4af6a";
      ctx.fillRect(x, canvas.height - barHeight, barWidth, barHeight);
      x += barWidth + 2;
    }
  }
  draw();
}

function stopWave(){
  if(lsWaveAnimId){
    cancelAnimationFrame(lsWaveAnimId);
    lsWaveAnimId = null;
  }
  var canvas = document.getElementById("lsWaveCanvas");
  if(canvas){
    canvas.getContext("2d").clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    canvas.style.display = "none";
  }
}

function toggleRecording(){
  var btn = document.getElementById("lsRecordBtn");
  var status = document.getElementById("lsRecordStatus");

  if(!mediaRecorder || mediaRecorder.state === "inactive"){
    navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true }).then(function(stream){
      currentStream = stream;
      recordedChunks = [];
      mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream);
      mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = function(e){ recordedChunks.push(e.data); };
      mediaRecorder.onstop = function(){ if(window.resumeAppBgMusicAfterRecording){ window.resumeAppBgMusicAfterRecording(); }
        recordedBlob = new Blob(recordedChunks, { type: "audio/webm" });
        stopWave();
        document.getElementById("lsRecordBtn").style.display = "none";
        document.getElementById("lsPlaybackRow").style.display = "flex";
        document.getElementById("lsSubmitBtn").disabled = false;
        currentStream.getTracks().forEach(function(t){ t.stop(); });
      };
      if(window.pauseAppBgMusicForRecording){ window.pauseAppBgMusicForRecording(); } mediaRecorder.start();
      startWave(stream, false);
      btn.textContent = "■ Stop";
      btn.classList.add("ls-recording");
      status.textContent = "Recording...";
    }).catch(function(err){
      status.textContent = "Microphone access denied";
      console.error(err);
    });
  } else {
    mediaRecorder.stop();
  }
}

function playRecording(){
  var playBtn = document.getElementById("lsPlayBtn");
  var audioEl = document.getElementById("lsPlaybackAudio");
  var originalLabel = playBtn.innerHTML;
  playBtn.innerHTML = '<span class="ls-loading-pulse"></span>Loading...';
  playBtn.disabled = true;

  audioEl.src = URL.createObjectURL(recordedBlob);

  var onReady = function(){
    playBtn.innerHTML = originalLabel;
    playBtn.disabled = false;
    startWave(audioEl, true);
    audioEl.currentTime = 0;
    audioEl.play();
  };

  audioEl.addEventListener("canplay", onReady, { once: true });
  audioEl.addEventListener("ended", stopWave, { once: true });
}

function reRecord(){
  recordedBlob = null;
  document.getElementById("lsPlaybackRow").style.display = "none";
  var btn = document.getElementById("lsRecordBtn");
  btn.style.display = "inline-block";
  btn.textContent = "● Record";
  btn.classList.remove("ls-recording");
  document.getElementById("lsRecordStatus").textContent = "Not recorded yet";
  document.getElementById("lsSubmitBtn").disabled = true;
  document.getElementById("lsScoreDisplay").innerHTML = "";
}

function submitRecording(expectedText, partNum){
  var scoreDisplay = document.getElementById("lsScoreDisplay");
  scoreDisplay.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);">Scoring...</p>';

  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/assessPronunciation?referenceText=" + encodeURIComponent(expectedText || ""), {
    method: "POST",
    body: recordedBlob
  }).then(function(res){ return res.json(); }).then(function(data){
    var score = data.finalScore ?? data.score ?? data.AccuracyScore ?? data.accuracyScore ?? 0;
    score = Math.round(score);
    scoreDisplay.innerHTML =
      '<div class="ls-score">' + score + '%</div>' +
      '<div class="ls-btn-row">' +
      '<button class="ls-btn ls-btn-secondary" onclick="window.lsRetryRecording()">Try Again</button>' +
      '<button class="ls-btn ls-btn-primary" onclick="window.lsGoNext()">Continue</button>' +
      '</div>';
  }).catch(function(err){
    console.error(err);
    scoreDisplay.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#ff8a8a;">Could not score - please try again.</p>' +
      '<div class="ls-btn-row"><button class="ls-btn ls-btn-secondary" onclick="window.lsRetryRecording()">Try Again</button></div>';
  });
}

window.lsRetryRecording = function(){
  recordedBlob = null;
  renderPart(currentPart, getPartLabel(currentPart));
};

window.lsGoNext = function(){
  recordedBlob = null;
  var nextPart = currentPart + 1;
  if(getPartAssets(nextPart).length > 0){
    currentPart = nextPart;
    renderPart(nextPart, getPartLabel(nextPart));
  }
  else {
    try{Object.keys(localStorage).forEach(function(k){if(k.indexOf('psResume:')===0)localStorage.removeItem(k);});}catch(e){}markLessonComplete();
    render(
      '<div class="ls-card" style="text-align:center;padding:36px 22px;">' +
      '<div style="width:76px;height:76px;margin:0 auto 18px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid #ffd68c;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:2.2rem;color:#ffd68c;box-shadow:0 0 0 8px rgba(255,214,140,.12);">\u2713</div>' +
      '<p class="ls-part-label" style="letter-spacing:.14em;">LESSON COMPLETE</p>' +
      '<p style="color:#fff;font:600 1.7rem Cormorant Garamond,Georgia,serif;margin:6px 0 24px;">Bravo ! Well done.</p>' +
      '<button class="ls-btn ls-btn-primary" id="lsBackBtn" style="display:block;width:100%;max-width:300px;margin:10px auto 0;padding:14px 20px;border-radius:999px;font:600 1rem Poppins,system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;border:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffd68c,#f0a94a);color:#2b1a05;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(240,169,74,.35);">Back to lessons</button>' +
      '<button class="ls-btn" id="lsRedoBtn" style="display:block;width:100%;max-width:300px;margin:10px auto 0;padding:14px 20px;border-radius:999px;font:600 1rem Poppins,system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,214,140,.7);background:transparent;color:#ffd68c;">Redo lesson</button>' +
      '</div>'
    );
    setTimeout(function(){var b=document.getElementById('lsBackBtn'),r=document.getElementById('lsRedoBtn');if(b)b.onclick=function(){location.href='./';};if(r)r.onclick=function(){try{Object.keys(localStorage).forEach(function(k){if(k.indexOf('psL1:')===0||k.indexOf('psResume:')===0)localStorage.removeItem(k);});}catch(e){}location.reload();};},0);
  }
};

function markLessonComplete(){
  var uid = window.lsCurrentUid;
  if(!uid) return;
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/levelProgressComplete", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ uid: uid, level: LEVEL, lesson: LESSON })
  }).catch(function(err){ console.error("Could not save progress:", err); });
}

fetch(API_BASE + "/api/levelAssets?level=" + LEVEL + "&lesson=" + LESSON)
  .then(function(res){ return res.json(); })
  .then(function(assets){
    allAssets = assets || [];if(LEVEL==="a0-les-petits"&&LESSON>=2&&LESSON<=12){allAssets=[1,2,3,4,5].map(function(p){return {part:p,type:"text",content:" "};});} /*UL*/ if(allAssets.length === 0 && LESSON <= 25 && /^(a1|a2|b1|b2|c1|c2)$/.test(LEVEL)){ allAssets = [{part:1,type:"text",content:" "}]; }
    if(allAssets.length === 0 && (LESSON === 1 || LESSON === 2) && /^(a1|a2|b1|b2|c1|c2)$/.test(LEVEL)){ allAssets = [{part:1,type:"text",content:" "},{part:2,type:"text",content:" "}]; }
    if(allAssets.length === 0){
      render('<div class="ls-card" style="text-align:center;"><p style="color:#fff;">This lesson\'s content hasn\'t been added yet.</p></div>');
      return;
    }
    renderPart(1, getPartLabel(1));
  })
  .catch(function(err){
    console.error(err);
    render('<div class="ls-card" style="text-align:center;"><p style="color:#ff8a8a;">Could not load this lesson.</p></div>');
  });

function decode16(blob) { return blob.arrayBuffer().then(function(ab) { var AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext, ac = new AC(); return new Promise(function(res, rej) { ac.decodeAudioData(ab, res, rej); }).then(function(buf) { try { ac.close(); } catch (e) {} var len = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(buf.duration * 16000)), oc = new OfflineAudioContext(1, len, 16000), src = oc.createBufferSource(); src.buffer = buf; src.connect(oc.destination); src.start(); return oc.startRendering(); }); }).then(function(o) { return o.getChannelData(0); }); }
function pcmToWav(d) { var n = d.length, pk = 0, i; for (i = 0; i < n; i++) { var a = Math.abs(d[i]); if (a > pk) pk = a; } var gain = (pk > 0.005 && pk < 0.7) ? 0.85 / pk : 1; var bf = new ArrayBuffer(44 + n * 2), v = new DataView(bf); function w(o, t) { for (var k = 0; k < t.length; k++) v.setUint8(o + k, t.charCodeAt(k)); } w(0, "RIFF"); v.setUint32(4, 36 + n * 2, true); w(8, "WAVE"); w(12, "fmt "); v.setUint32(16, 16, true); v.setUint16(20, 1, true); v.setUint16(22, 1, true); v.setUint32(24, 16000, true); v.setUint32(28, 32000, true); v.setUint16(32, 2, true); v.setUint16(34, 16, true); w(36, "data"); v.setUint32(40, n * 2, true); for (i = 0; i < n; i++) { var x = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, d[i] * gain)); v.setInt16(44 + i * 2, x < 0 ? x * 0x8000 : x * 0x7FFF, true); } var wb = new Blob([bf], { type: "audio/wav" }); wb.pk = pk; return wb; }
function pickScore(d) { var keys = ["finalScore", "score", "AccuracyScore", "accuracyScore", "pronunciationScore", "PronScore", "pronScore", "overallScore", "OverallScore", "overall", "total"]; function num(v) { return typeof v === "number" && isFinite(v) ? v : (typeof v === "string" && v.trim() !== "" && isFinite(+v) ? +v : null); } function look(o, dep) { if (!o || typeof o !== "object" || dep > 4) return null; for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) { var n = num(o[keys[i]]); if (n !== null) return n; } for (var k in o) { if (o[k] && typeof o[k] === "object") { var r = look(o[k], dep + 1); if (r !== null) return r; } } return null; } return look(d, 0); }

/* records automatically: starts at once, ends after a pause once the learner has spoken. Resolves a Blob, "quiet" (nobody spoke), or null (skipped). */
function autoRecord(ui, o) {
  return new Promise(function(resolve) {
    var done = false, mr = null, chunks = [], ac = null, raf = 0, spoke = false, lastVoice = 0, t0 = Date.now(), floor = 0, nf = 0;
    ui.orb.classList.remove("idle"); ui.stt.textContent = T.listening;
    ui.btns.innerHTML = '<button class="lnk" id="rdSk">' + T.skip + "</button>";
    function fin(v) { if (done) return; done = true; cancelAnimationFrame(raf); try { ac && ac.close(); } catch (e) {} ui.orb.classList.add("idle"); ui.orb.style.transform = ""; ui.btns.innerHTML = ""; resolve(v); }
    ui.btns.querySelector("#rdSk").onclick = function() { try { if (mr && mr.state === "recording") { mr.onstop = null; mr.stop(); } } catch (e) {} fin(null); };
    getStream().then(function(s) {
      var AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext; ac = new AC(); var an = ac.createAnalyser(); an.fftSize = 1024; ac.createMediaStreamSource(s).connect(an);
      var buf = new Float32Array(an.fftSize);
      mr = new MediaRecorder(s); mr.ondataavailable = function(e) { if (e.data && e.data.size) chunks.push(e.data); };
      mr.onstop = function() { fin(spoke ? new Blob(chunks, { type: mr.mimeType || "audio/webm" }) : "quiet"); };
      mr.start(); t0 = Date.now();
      (function tick() {
        if (done) return; an.getFloatTimeDomainData(buf); var sum = 0, i; for (i = 0; i < buf.length; i++) sum += buf[i] * buf[i]; var rms = Math.sqrt(sum / buf.length), now = Date.now(), el = now - t0;
        if (el < 600) { floor = nf ? Math.min(floor, rms) : rms; nf++; } else { var th = Math.min(0.045, Math.max(0.015, floor * 3));
          if (rms > th) { spoke = true; lastVoice = now; }
          ui.orb.style.transform = "scale(" + (1 + Math.min(1.6, rms * 14)).toFixed(2) + ")";
          if (spoke && now - lastVoice > o.sil && el > 1200) { try { mr.stop(); } catch (e) {} return; }
          if (!spoke && el > o.wait) { try { mr.stop(); } catch (e) {} return; }
          if (el > o.cap) { try { mr.stop(); } catch (e) {} return; } }
        raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      })();
    }).catch(function() { ui.stt.textContent = T.mic; });
  });
}
/* grade -> {v, det:[per reference word {w,s,e,ph,st,en}] or null, ws (compat), quiet, err} */
function azWords(j) {
  var raw = j && (j.detail || (j._debugRawAzureResponse && j._debugRawAzureResponse.NBest && j._debugRawAzureResponse.NBest[0] && j._debugRawAzureResponse.NBest[0].Words));
  return (raw && raw.length) ? raw : null;
}
/* what the recogniser heard, lined up with the text: matched words, replaced words ("heard X"), and words never said */
function diffDet(rw, heardText) {
  function nz(t) { return String(t || "").toLowerCase().replace(/[’']/g, "'").replace(/[^\p{L}']/gu, ""); }
  var H = heardText.split(/\s+/).map(function(w) { return { raw: w.replace(/^[^\p{L}]+|[^\p{L}]+$/gu, ""), n: nz(w) }; }).filter(function(x) { return x.n; }), R = rw.map(nz), n = R.length, m = H.length, i, j, D = [];
  if (!m) return null;
  for (i = 0; i <= n; i++) { D.push([]); for (j = 0; j <= m; j++) D[i].push(i === 0 ? j : (j === 0 ? i : 0)); }
  function sim(a, b) { return a === b ? 0 : 1; }
  for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) for (j = 1; j <= m; j++) D[i][j] = Math.min(D[i - 1][j] + 1, D[i][j - 1] + 1, D[i - 1][j - 1] + sim(R[i - 1], H[j - 1].n));
  var out = new Array(n), a = n, b = m;
  while (a > 0 || b > 0) {
    if (a > 0 && b > 0 && D[a][b] === D[a - 1][b - 1] + sim(R[a - 1], H[b - 1].n)) { out[a - 1] = R[a - 1] === H[b - 1].n ? { s: 92, e: "" } : { s: 35, e: "m", heard: H[b - 1].raw }; a--; b--; }
    else if (a > 0 && D[a][b] === D[a - 1][b] + 1) { out[a - 1] = { s: 0, e: "o" }; a--; }
    else b--;
  }
  return out.map(function(o, k) { return { w: rw[k], s: o.s, e: o.e, heard: o.heard || "", st: null, en: null, ph: [] }; });
}
function gradeWav(wb, ref) {
  return Promise.resolve(wb).then(function(wb) {
    if (wb.pk < 0.012) return { quiet: true };
    return fetch(API + "/api/assessPronunciation?referenceText=" + encodeURIComponent(ref), { method: "POST", body: wb }).then(function(r) { return r.json(); }).then(function(j) {
      var rw = ref.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean), raw, ws = null, det = null, az = azWords(j), items, src = "none", nAz = 0;
      function acc(x) { return typeof x.AccuracyScore === "number" ? x.AccuracyScore : (x.PronunciationAssessment && typeof x.PronunciationAssessment.AccuracyScore === "number" ? x.PronunciationAssessment.AccuracyScore : (typeof x.accuracyScore === "number" ? x.accuracyScore : 0)); }
      function err(x) { return x.ErrorType || (x.PronunciationAssessment && x.PronunciationAssessment.ErrorType) || x.errorType || ""; }
      function nz(t) { return String(t || "").toLowerCase().replace(/[^\p{L}]/gu, ""); }
      items = (az || (j && (j.wordFeedback || j.words)) || []).filter(function(x) { return x && err(x) !== "Insertion"; }); nAz = items.length; if (az) src = "azure";
      /* line the measured words up with the reference words (Azure may split or join some of them) */
      var groups = null;
      if (items.length === rw.length) groups = items.map(function(x) { return [x]; });
      else if (items.length) { groups = []; var p = 0, okAl = true;
        for (var ri = 0; ri < rw.length && okAl; ri++) { var want = nz(rw[ri]), got = "", gr = [];
          while (p < items.length && got.length < want.length) { gr.push(items[p]); got += nz(items[p].Word || items[p].word || items[p].text || ""); p++; }
          if (!gr.length || got !== want) okAl = false; else groups.push(gr); }
        if (!okAl || p !== items.length) groups = null; }
      if (groups) {
        det = groups.map(function(gr, i) { var om = gr.every(function(x) { return err(x) === "Omission"; }), mis = gr.some(function(x) { return err(x) === "Mispronunciation"; }), first = gr[0], lastW = gr[gr.length - 1],
            t0 = typeof first.Offset === "number" ? first.Offset / 10000 : null, d = typeof lastW.Offset === "number" && typeof lastW.Duration === "number" ? (lastW.Offset + lastW.Duration) / 10000 : null,
            ph = [].concat.apply([], gr.map(function(x) { return (x.Phonemes || []).map(function(q) { return { p: q.Phoneme || q.phoneme || "", s: acc(q) }; }); })),
            s0 = om ? 0 : gr.reduce(function(a, x) { return a + acc(x); }, 0) / gr.length;
          if (!om) { var pm = ph.length ? Math.min.apply(null, ph.map(function(q) { return q.s; })) : 100; s0 = Math.min(s0, 40 + pm * 0.6); if (mis) s0 = Math.min(s0, 55); }
          return { w: rw[i], s: Math.round(s0), e: om ? "o" : (mis ? "m" : ""), st: om ? null : t0, en: (om || t0 === null || d === null) ? null : d, ph: ph }; });
        ws = det.map(function(d) { return { s: d.s, e: d.e === "o" ? "o" : "" }; });
        raw = ws.reduce(function(a, b) { return a + b.s; }, 0) / ws.length;
      } else { raw = pickScore(j); if (raw === null) raw = 0; raw = Math.min(raw, 60); }
      if (!det) { var ht = j && (j.recognizedText || j.recognized || j.text || j.DisplayText || j.displayText || j.transcript); if (typeof ht === "string" && ht.trim()) { var dd = diffDet(rw, ht); if (dd) { det = dd; src = "heard"; ws = det.map(function(d) { return { s: d.s, e: d.e === "o" ? "o" : "" }; }); raw = ws.reduce(function(a, b) { return a + b.s; }, 0) / ws.length; } } }
      try { window.__rdLast = { src: src, nRef: rw.length, nAz: nAz, det: !!det, raw: Math.round(raw), keys: j ? Object.keys(j) : [], words: det ? det.map(function(d) { return d.w + ":" + d.s + (d.e ? d.e : ""); }) : (items || []).map(function(x) { return (x.Word || x.word || "?") + ":" + acc(x) + err(x); }) }; } catch (e) {}
      if (raw < 8) return { quiet: true };
      var v = Math.round(raw); if (LEN) v = Math.max(Math.round(100 * Math.pow(Math.min(100, raw) / 100, LEN.g)), LEN.f);
      return { v: Math.min(100, v), raw: raw, ws: ws, det: det, derived: src === "heard" };
    });
  }).catch(function() { return { err: true }; });
}
/* The speech service can stop listening at a long pause and ignore the rest of a multi-line reading. When the words at the end come back "not heard"
   but the recording goes on, grade the remaining audio against the remaining words and join the results. */
function grade(blob, ref) {
  return decode16(blob).then(function(pcm) {
    var rw = ref.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean), SR = 16000, pk = 0, i;
    for (i = 0; i < pcm.length; i += 7) { var a = Math.abs(pcm[i]); if (a > pk) pk = a; }
    function voiced(from) { var w = SR * 0.12, hits = 0; for (var o = from; o + w < pcm.length; o += w) { var sm = 0; for (var q = 0; q < w; q += 4) sm += pcm[o + q] * pcm[o + q]; if (Math.sqrt(sm / (w / 4)) > Math.max(0.012, pk * 0.1)) { hits++; if (hits >= 4) return true; } else hits = Math.max(0, hits - 1); } return false; }
    var parts = [], start = 0, from = 0, segs = 0, first = null;
    function loop() {
      var seg = pcm.subarray(from), wb = pcmToWav(seg), sub = rw.slice(start).join(" ");
      return gradeWav(wb, sub).then(function(g) {
        segs++; if (!first) first = g;
        if (g.quiet || g.err || !g.det) { if (!parts.length) return g; return parts; }
        var offMs = from / SR * 1000, det = g.det.map(function(d) { return { w: d.w, s: d.s, e: d.e, heard: d.heard, ph: d.ph, st: d.st === null ? null : d.st + offMs, en: d.en === null ? null : d.en + offMs }; });
        var L = -1; for (var k = det.length - 1; k >= 0; k--) { if (det[k].e !== "o") { L = k; break; } }
        var tail = det.length - 1 - L;
        if (!g.derived && L >= 0 && tail >= 1 && segs < 5 && det[L].en !== null) { var nf = Math.max(from, Math.round((det[L].en - 120) / 1000 * SR));
          if (voiced(nf)) { parts = parts.concat(det.slice(0, L + 1)); start += L + 1; from = nf; return loop(); } }
        parts = parts.concat(det); return parts;
      });
    }
    return loop().then(function(r) {
      if (!Array.isArray(r)) return r;
      var det = r; if (det.length !== rw.length) return first;
      var ws = det.map(function(d) { return { s: d.s, e: d.e === "o" ? "o" : "" }; }), raw = ws.reduce(function(a, b) { return a + b.s; }, 0) / ws.length, v = Math.round(raw);
      if (LEN) v = Math.max(Math.round(100 * Math.pow(Math.min(100, raw) / 100, LEN.g)), LEN.f);
      try { if (window.__rdLast) window.__rdLast.segments = segs; } catch (e) {}
      return { v: Math.min(100, v), raw: raw, ws: ws, det: det, derived: false };
    });
  }).catch(function() { return { err: true }; });
}
/* one automatic attempt, retried up to `tries` times when nothing was heard; resolves a grade or null */
async function attempt(ui, ref, o, tries) {
  for (var k = 0; k < tries; k++) {
    var b = await autoRecord(ui, o);
    if (b === null) return null;
    if (b === "quiet") { ui.stt.textContent = T.hear; await wait(1300); continue; }
    ui.stt.textContent = T.scoring;
    var g = await grade(b, ref);
    if (g.quiet) { ui.stt.textContent = T.hear; await wait(1300); continue; }
    if (g.err) { ui.stt.textContent = T.err; await wait(1300); continue; }
    ui.stt.textContent = ""; return g;
  }
  ui.stt.textContent = ""; return null;
}

var LIA1 = "les des mes tes ses ces nos vos leurs aux un mon ton son aucun quels quelles deux trois six dix petit grand bon mauvais gros nous vous ils elles on en est sont ont suis sommes êtes es avez avons était étaient dans chez sans sous très bien moins comment".split(" ");
var HMUET = "heure homme hôtel histoire hôpital habite habiter habitude hiver huile humain honneur herbe hier".split(" ");
function cleanTok(w) { return w.toLowerCase().replace(/^[^\p{L}']+|[^\p{L}']+$/gu, ""); }
function liaisonOf(w1, w2) {
  var a = cleanTok(w1), b = cleanTok(w2); if (!a || !b || LIA1.indexOf(a) < 0) return null;
  if (!/^[aeiouyàâéèêëîïôûù]/.test(b) && HMUET.indexOf(b) < 0) return null; if (b === "oui" || b === "onze" || b === "et") return null;
  var l = a.slice(-1), m = { s: "z", x: "z", z: "z", t: "t", d: "t", n: "n", p: "p", g: "k" }[l]; if (!m) return null;
  return { cons: m, was: l };
}
function coach(det, S) {
  if (!det) return null; var flat = [], end = [];
  S.forEach(function(s) { var ts = s.t.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean); ts.forEach(function(w, i) { flat.push(w); end.push(i === ts.length - 1); }); });
  var words = [], links = [], pauses = [], i, sid = [], lines = {};
  S.forEach(function(s, si) { s.t.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).forEach(function() { sid.push(si); }); });
  for (i = 0; i < det.length; i++) { var d = det[i]; if (d.e === "o") { words.push({ w: d.w, kind: "miss", s: 0, sounds: [], heard: "" }); lines[sid[i]] = 1; continue; }
    var snd = d.ph.filter(function(q) { return q.s < 60 && q.p; }).sort(function(a, b) { return a.s - b.s; }).slice(0, 2).map(function(q) { return { p: q.p, tip: TIPS[q.p] || "" }; });
    if (d.s < 60) { words.push({ w: d.w, kind: d.s < 45 ? "weak" : "close", s: d.s, sounds: snd, heard: d.heard || "" }); lines[sid[i]] = 1; } }
  for (i = 0; i + 1 < det.length; i++) { var x = det[i], y = det[i + 1]; if (end[i] || x.en === null || y.st === null || x.e === "o" || y.e === "o") continue;
    var gap = Math.round(y.st - x.en), lia = liaisonOf(flat[i], flat[i + 1]), punct = /[,;:.!?…]$/.test(flat[i]);
    if (lia && gap > 260 && !punct) { links.push({ a: cleanTok(flat[i]), b: cleanTok(flat[i + 1]), gap: gap, cons: lia.cons, was: lia.was }); lines[sid[i]] = 1; }
    else if (!punct && gap > 900) { pauses.push({ a: cleanTok(flat[i]), b: cleanTok(flat[i + 1]), gap: gap }); lines[sid[i]] = 1; } }
  words.sort(function(a, b) { return a.s - b.s; });
  return { words: words, links: links, pauses: pauses, lines: Object.keys(lines).map(Number) };
}
function secs(ms) { return (ms / 1000).toFixed(1) + " s"; }
function coachCount(c) { return c.words.length + c.links.length + c.pauses.length; }
function coachHtml(c) {
  var h = "";
  if (c.words.length) { h += '<div class="pg"><div class="pl">' + T.sec1 + "</div>"; c.words.forEach(function(w) {
    var nm = esc(w.w.replace(/^[^\p{L}\p{N}]+|[^\p{L}\p{N}]+$/gu, ""));
    h += '<div class="pw"><b>' + nm + "</b></div>";
    if (w.heard) h += '<div class="pn">' + T.heard.replace("{h}", esc(w.heard)).replace("{w}", nm) + "</div>"; else if (w.kind === "miss") h += '<div class="pn">' + T.notheard + "</div>";
    w.sounds.forEach(function(q) { h += '<div class="pn"><em>/' + esc(q.p) + "/</em> " + esc(q.tip || T.sound) + "</div>"; }); }); h += "</div>"; }
  if (c.links.length) { h += '<div class="pg"><div class="pl">' + T.sec2 + "</div>"; c.links.forEach(function(l) {
    h += '<div class="pw"><b>' + esc(l.a) + " \u203f " + esc(l.b) + '</b></div><div class="pn">' + T.linkTip.replace("{c}", l.cons).replace("{g}", secs(l.gap)) + "</div>"; }); h += "</div>"; }
  if (c.pauses.length) { h += '<div class="pg"><div class="pl">' + T.sec3 + '</div><div class="pn">' + T.pauseNote + "</div>"; c.pauses.forEach(function(l) {
    h += '<div class="pw"><b>' + esc(l.a) + " | " + esc(l.b) + '</b><i>' + secs(l.gap) + "</i></div>"; }); h += "</div>"; }
  return h;
}

function weakList(ws, S) {
  if (!ws) return []; var flat = [], k = 0; S.forEach(function(s) { s.t.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).forEach(function(w) { flat.push(w.replace(/^[^\p{L}\p{N}]+|[^\p{L}\p{N}]+$/gu, "")); }); });

function isPerfect(res, c) { return !!(res && res.det && !res.derived && c && !c.words.length && !c.links.length && !c.pauses.length && res.raw >= 78); }
async function showPoints(res, S) {

  var h = '<div class="pc">' + (has ? "" : "<h3>" + (good ? T.perfectGo : T.points) + "</h3>");
  if (has) h += sumHtml(c, T.points); else if (!good) h += '<p class="sc" style="margin:4px 0 0">' + (res.derived ? T.okderived : (res.det ? T.okish : T.nodet)) + "</p>";
  if (DEBUG && window.__rdLast) h += '<pre style="text-align:left;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:.7rem;opacity:.8;margin-top:10px">' + JSON.stringify(window.__rdLast) + "</pre>";
  ui.pt.innerHTML = h + "</div>"; bindDet(ui.pt); ui.pt.classList.add("on"); await wait(900); try { ui.pt.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" }); } catch (e) {}
}
function hidePoints() { ui.pt.classList.remove("on"); }
async function unit(U, idx, total) {
  var S = U.sents, whole = S.map(function(s) { return s.t; }).join(" "), last = idx === total - 1;
  var capWhole = Math.max(30000, whole.split(/\s+/).length * 1900 + 9000);
  hidePoints(); ui.btns.innerHTML = ""; ui.stt.textContent = "";
  if (idx > 0) { await rollUp(); }
  if (total > 1) { var lvEl = root.querySelector(".lv"); if (lvEl) lvEl.textContent = LEVEL.toUpperCase() + " · " + (EN ? "Lesson" : "Leçon") + " " + LESSON + " · " + T.text + " " + (idx + 1) + "/" + total; }
  await setDir(T.dir0);
  await rollDown(S);
  /* 1. the teacher reads once */
  ui.stt.textContent = T.teacher; await play(PFX + "listen");
  if (U.audio) await play(U.audio, SLOWREAD); else { for (var i = 0; i < S.length; i++) { cur(i); await play(S[i].a, SLOWREAD); await wait(450); } cur(-1); }
  ui.stt.textContent = "";
  /* 2. the learner reads, recorded automatically */
  clearSeen(); await setDir(T.dirNow); await play(PFX + "now");
  var r1 = await attempt(ui, whole, { sil: 2300, wait: 11000, cap: capWhole }, 2);
  if (r1) { drawBoard(S, r1.ws, -1, null); await showPoints(r1, S); }
  /* 3. slowly, line by line: only the lines that need it (none if the first reading was clean) */
  clearSeen(); var need = [], rc1 = r1 ? coach(r1.det, S) : null, clean = isPerfect(r1, rc1);
  if (!clean) { if (r1 && r1.det && rc1) need = rc1.lines.slice().sort(function(x, y) { return x - y; }); else need = S.map(function(_, k) { return k; }); if (!need.length) need = S.map(function(_, k) { return k; }); }
  if (need.length) await setDir(need.length < S.length ? T.dirFew : T.dirSlow), await play(PFX + "slow");
  var oks = [], off = 0;
  for (var jj = 0; jj < need.length; jj++) {
    var j = need[jj];
    cur(j); ui.stt.textContent = T.teacher; await play(S[j].a, SLOW); ui.stt.textContent = "";
    await play(OLD + "again");
    var g = await attempt(ui, S[j].t, { sil: 1500, wait: 9000, cap: Math.max(14000, S[j].t.split(/\s+/).length * 2200 + 6000) }, 2);
    if (g && g.v >= THR) { oks[j] = true; var l = ui.txt.querySelector('.ln[data-i="' + j + '"]'); if (l) l.classList.add("ok"); }
  }
  cur(-1);
  /* 4. the whole text again, graded */
  var r2 = null;
  for (;;) {
    await setDir(T.dirWhole); await play(PFX + "whole");
    r2 = await attempt(ui, whole, { sil: 2300, wait: 11000, cap: capWhole }, 2);
    if (r2) { drawBoard(S, r2.ws, -1, null); }
    hidePoints(); await wait(500);
    var rc = r2 ? coach(r2.det, S) : null, rem = rc && (rc.words.length || rc.links.length) ? '<div style="margin-top:16px">' + sumHtml({ words: rc.words, links: rc.links, pauses: [] }, T.finalPts) + "</div>" : "";
    var cmp = '<div class="pc" style="text-align:center">' + (r2 ? '<div class="big">' + r2.v + '%</div>' : "") + '<div class="cmp">' + (r1 ? "<div>" + T.first + " · " + r1.v + "%</div>" : "") + (r2 ? "<div>" + T.last + " · " + r2.v + "%</div>" : "") + "</div>" + rem + "</div>";
    ui.pt.innerHTML = cmp; bindDet(ui.pt); ui.pt.classList.add("on"); try { ui.btns.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" }); } catch (e) {}
    ui.btns.innerHTML = '<button id="rdAg">' + T.again + '</button><button class="pri" id="rdNx">' + (last ? T.fin : T.next) + "</button>";
    var act = await new Promise(function(r) { ui.btns.querySelector("#rdAg").onclick = function() { r("again"); }; ui.btns.querySelector("#rdNx").onclick = function() { r("next"); }; });
    ui.btns.innerHTML = ""; if (act === "next") break; hidePoints();
  }

function introCard() {
  return new Promise(function(resolve) {
    root.innerHTML = '<div class="pc"><div class="pc-h"><div class="pc-lv">' + LEVEL.toUpperCase() + " &middot; " + (EN ? "Lesson" : "Le\u00e7on") + " " + LESSON + '</div><h2 class="pc-t">' + T.intro + '</h2><i class="pc-ln"></i></div><div class="pc-b"></div><button type="button" class="pc-skip" aria-label="Skip"><span>' + T.skip + '</span><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M6 6l6 6-6 6M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></button></div>';
    var card = root.firstChild, b = card.querySelector(".pc-b"), p = document.createElement("div"); p.className = "pc-pn first";
    p.innerHTML = '<button type="button" class="pc-teach" aria-label="Teacher">' + MIC + '</button><div class="pc-st"></div>'; b.appendChild(p); void p.offsetWidth; p.classList.remove("first");
    var btn = p.querySelector(".pc-teach"), media = new Audio(), done = false;
    function end() { if (done) return; done = true; try { media.pause(); } catch (e) {} btn.classList.remove("on"); sceneDo("calm"); musicOn(); card.style.transition = "opacity .7s"; card.style.opacity = 0; setTimeout(resolve, 750); }
    card.querySelector(".pc-skip").onclick = end;
    media.preload = "auto"; media.src = AU + C.intro + ".mp3?v=2";
    media.addEventListener("play", function() { var h = p.querySelector(".pc-hint"); if (h) h.remove(); btn.classList.add("on"); sceneDo("listen"); musicOff(); });
    media.addEventListener("pause", function() { if (!media.ended) btn.classList.remove("on"); });
    media.addEventListener("ended", end); media.addEventListener("error", end);
    var pp = media.play();
    if (pp && pp.catch) pp.catch(function() {
      var hint = document.createElement("div"); hint.className = "pc-hint"; hint.textContent = EN ? "tap to listen" : "touchez pour \u00e9couter"; p.appendChild(hint);
      var kick = function() { document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", kick, true); document.removeEventListener("keydown", kick, true); if (!done && media.paused && !media.ended) { var q = media.play(); if (q && q.catch) q.catch(function() {}); } };
      document.addEventListener("pointerdown", kick, true); document.addEventListener("keydown", kick, true);
    });
    btn.onclick = function() { if (media.paused) { var q = media.play(); if (q && q.catch) q.catch(function() {}); } else media.pause(); };
  });
}

 },delay);
}

/* ---------- a scene ---------- */
function runScene(i){
 var sc=SCENES[i];G.idx=i;
 G.panel.innerHTML='';
 sc.dotBase=SCENES.slice(0,i).reduce(function(t,s){return t+s.answers.length;},0);
 G.dChunks=[];G.dT0=0;G.dT1=0;G.playing=false;G.ended=false;G.S0=sc.S;
 G.prompt.classList.remove('on','ans');
 var wait=document.createElement('div');wait.className='rv-hint';wait.innerHTML='<span>Getting your microphone ready…</span>';G.root.appendChild(wait);G.wait=wait;
 navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({audio:{echoCancellation:true,noiseSuppression:true}}).then(function(s){
  if(!G||G.dead){s.getTracks().forEach(function(t){t.stop();});return;}
  G.stream=s;
  var rec=new MediaRecorder(s);G.rec=rec;
  rec.ondataavailable=function(e){if(e.data&&e.data.size)G.dChunks.push(e.data);};
  rec.onstart=function(){G.dT0=performance.now();};
  rec.onstop=function(){
   try{s.getTracks().forEach(function(t){t.stop();});}catch(e){}
   if(!G||G.dead||!G.ended)return;
   score(new Blob(G.dChunks,{type:rec.mimeType||'audio/webm'}),sc);
  };
  musicOff();rec.start();
  playSeg(sc);
 }).catch(function(){
  if(!G||G.dead)return;
  if(G.wait){G.wait.remove();G.wait=null;}
  G.panel.innerHTML='<div class="rv-card rv-res"><div class="rv-msg">Microphone blocked<small>Allow the microphone in your browser, then try again.</small></div><div class="rv-acts"><button type="button" class="rv-go">Try again</button></div></div>';
  G.panel.querySelector('.rv-go').onclick=function(){runScene(i);};
 });
}
function playSeg(sc){
 var m=G.media;
 if(!m){m=G.media=new Audio();m.preload='auto';m.src=AUD;}
 function go(){
  try{m.currentTime=sc.S;}catch(e){}
  var onPlaying=function(){m.removeEventListener('playing',onPlaying);G.playing=true;G.dT1=performance.now();G.S0=m.currentTime||sc.S;if(G.wait){G.wait.remove();G.wait=null;}loop(sc);};
  m.addEventListener('playing',onPlaying);
  var p=m.play();
  if(p&&p.catch)p.catch(function(){
   if(G.wait){G.wait.remove();G.wait=null;}
   var h=document.createElement('div');h.className='rv-hint';h.innerHTML='<span>Tap to begin</span>';G.root.appendChild(h);
   h.onclick=function(){h.remove();var q=m.play();if(q&&q.catch)q.catch(function(){});};
  });
 }
 if(m.readyState>=1)go();else{m.addEventListener('loadedmetadata',function f(){m.removeEventListener('loadedmetadata',f);go();});try{m.load();}catch(e){}}
}
function loop(sc){
 var m=G.media,flags={};
 function frame(){

function pcmToWav(d){
  var n=d.length,pk=0,i;
  for(i=0;i<n;i++){var a=Math.abs(d[i]);if(a>pk)pk=a;}
  var gain=(pk>0.005&&pk<0.7)?0.85/pk:1;
  var bf=new ArrayBuffer(44+n*2),v=new DataView(bf);
  function w(o,t){for(var k=0;k<t.length;k++)v.setUint8(o+k,t.charCodeAt(k));}
  w(0,'RIFF');v.setUint32(4,36+n*2,true);w(8,'WAVE');w(12,'fmt ');v.setUint32(16,16,true);v.setUint16(20,1,true);v.setUint16(22,1,true);v.setUint32(24,16000,true);v.setUint32(28,32000,true);v.setUint16(32,2,true);v.setUint16(34,16,true);w(36,'data');v.setUint32(40,n*2,true);
  for(i=0;i<n;i++){var x=Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,d[i]*gain));v.setInt16(44+i*2,x<0?x*0x8000:x*0x7FFF,true);}
  var wb=new Blob([bf],{type:'audio/wav'});wb.pk=pk;return wb;
}

 /* Very forgiving marking for children: any real try earns stars. Only a silent try is asked again (twice at most). */
 function kidsResult(d){
  var quiet=!!(d&&d.quiet),raw=quiet?0:pickScoreL(d||{}),heard=!quiet&&(raw===null||raw>=3);
  p.classList.add('scored');st.textContent='';
  if(!heard){
   tries++;
   if(tries<2){
    res.innerHTML='<div class="pc-fb"><div class="pc-msg">Encore une fois !<small>Say it a little louder \u2014 I\u2019m listening</small></div></div>';
    blob=null;autoGo=true;T(function(){autoGo=false;p.classList.remove('scored');res.innerHTML='';st.innerHTML='<span class="pc-yt">Your turn!</span>';startRec();},1900);
    return;
   }
   res.innerHTML='<div class="pc-fb"><div class="pc-stars"><span>\u2605</span><span class="off">\u2605</span><span class="off">\u2605</span></div><div class="pc-msg">Bon effort !<small>Let\u2019s keep going \u2014 you\u2019ll get it</small></div></div>';
   T(kidsNext,2600);return;
  }
  var n=(raw===null||raw>=20)?3:2,h='';
  for(var q=0;q<3;q++)h+='<span'+(q<n?'':' class="off"')+' style="animation-delay:'+(q*.18)+'s">\u2605</span>';
  res.innerHTML='<div class="pc-fb"><div class="pc-stars">'+h+'</div><div class="pc-msg">'+(n===3?'Bravo !<small>Super \u2014 you said it!</small>':'Tr\u00e8s bien !<small>Very good \u2014 well done!</small>')+'</div></div><div class="pc-acts"><button type="button" class="pc-go pc-next">Next '+I.next+'</button></div>';
  res.querySelector('.pc-next').onclick=kidsNext;
  if(sc())sc().cheer();
  T(kidsNext,2800);
 }

/* SayBon - Les Petits scene. Drop-in for ParisScene: PetitsScene.mount({lesson}) returns {cheer, calm, listen, micState, destroy}.
   One of nine paintings per lesson (rotating). The picture travels slowly and smoothly (zoom + pan + gentle sway), with a far blurred
   layer moving the other way for depth, sweeping light, soft rays, glints that twinkle on the bright spots of the painting, and
   drifting particles that suit each scene (pollen, petals, snow, leaves, dust). */
(function(){
var BASE="/levels/scene-petits/img/p";
/* Order across lessons, scenery first: beach, waterfall hike, lakeside village, winter rink, blossom park, then park, playground, and the two libraries last. */
var SEQ=[3,5,8,4,7,2,9,1,6];

 far.style.backgroundImage="url("+url+")";

 /* camera: zoom s and offset in px; "focus" adds a small push-in while the teacher speaks */
 var cam={x:0,y:0,s:1.18},from={x:0,y:0,s:1.18},to={x:0,y:0,s:1.3},t0=0,dur=12000,focus=0,focusT=0,alive=true,raf=0,tStart=performance.now();
 function size(){
  vw=window.innerWidth;vh=window.innerHeight;
  var c=Math.max(vw/iw,vh/ih);pw=iw*c;ph=ih*c;
  pan.style.width=pw+"px";pan.style.height=ph+"px";pan.style.marginLeft=(-pw/2)+"px";pan.style.marginTop=(-ph/2)+"px";
  cv.width=Math.round(vw*dpr);cv.height=Math.round(vh*dpr);
 }
 function bounds(s){return {x:Math.max(0,(pw*s-vw)/2),y:Math.max(0,(ph*s-vh)/2)};}
 function pick(){
  from={x:cam.x,y:cam.y,s:cam.s};
  var s=rnd(1.16,1.52);while(Math.abs(s-from.s)<.12)s=rnd(1.16,1.52);
  var b=bounds(s),k=.88;
  var x=rnd(-b.x,b.x)*k,y=rnd(-b.y,b.y)*k;
  /* keep real travel: avoid picking a spot too close to where we already are */
  var tries=0;while(tries++<6&&Math.hypot(x-from.x,(y-from.y)*1.4)<Math.min(vw,vh)*.35){x=rnd(-b.x,b.x)*k;y=rnd(-b.y,b.y)*k;}
  to={x:x,y:y,s:s};t0=performance.now();dur=rnd(11000,17000);
 }
 function apply(now){
  var t=Math.min(1,(now-t0)/dur);if(t>=1)pick();
  var e=ease(Math.min(1,(now-t0)/dur));
  cam.x=from.x+(to.x-from.x)*e;cam.y=from.y+(to.y-from.y)*e;cam.s=from.s+(to.s-from.s)*e;

  var b=bounds(s),x=Math.max(-b.x,Math.min(b.x,cam.x+swx)),y=Math.max(-b.y,Math.min(b.y,cam.y+swy));
  pan.style.transform="translate3d("+x.toFixed(1)+"px,"+y.toFixed(1)+"px,0) rotate("+(sway*57.3*.5).toFixed(3)+"deg) scale("+s.toFixed(4)+")";
  far.style.transform="translate3d("+(-x*.35).toFixed(1)+"px,"+(-y*.35).toFixed(1)+"px,0) scale("+(1.25+(s-1)*.2).toFixed(3)+")";
 }
 /* glints: found on the brightest spots of the painting, so they sit on water, snow, lamps, windows */
 function makeGlints(){

   var c=document.createElement("canvas"),W=96,H=48;c.width=W;c.height=H;var g=c.getContext("2d");g.drawImage(img,0,0,W,H);

const API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";

async function convertToWav(blob){

  const arrayBuffer = await blob.arrayBuffer();
  const audioContext = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();

  let audioBuffer;
  try{
    audioBuffer = await audioContext.decodeAudioData(arrayBuffer);
  } finally {
    // Always release this AudioContext, whether decoding
    // succeeded or failed. Leaving these open across repeated
    // recordings in the same session can degrade or silently
    // break later attempts once the browser's context limit
    // is approached.
    audioContext.close();
  }

  const targetSampleRate = 16000;
  const offlineContext = new OfflineAudioContext(1, Math.ceil(audioBuffer.duration * targetSampleRate), targetSampleRate);
  const source = offlineContext.createBufferSource();
  source.buffer = audioBuffer;
  source.connect(offlineContext.destination);
  source.start();
  const renderedBuffer = await offlineContext.startRendering();

  const pcmData = renderedBuffer.getChannelData(0);

  return encodeWav(pcmData, targetSampleRate);

}

function encodeWav(samples, sampleRate){

  const buffer = new ArrayBuffer(44 + samples.length * 2);
  const view = new DataView(buffer);

  function writeString(offset, string){
    for(let i = 0; i < string.length; i++){
      view.setUint8(offset + i, string.charCodeAt(i));
    }
  }

  writeString(0, "RIFF");
  view.setUint32(4, 36 + samples.length * 2, true);
  writeString(8, "WAVE");
  writeString(12, "fmt ");
  view.setUint32(16, 16, true);
  view.setUint16(20, 1, true);
  view.setUint16(22, 1, true);
  view.setUint32(24, sampleRate, true);
  view.setUint32(28, sampleRate * 2, true);
  view.setUint16(32, 2, true);
  view.setUint16(34, 16, true);
  writeString(36, "data");
  view.setUint32(40, samples.length * 2, true);

  let offset = 44;
  for(let i = 0; i < samples.length; i++, offset += 2){
    const s = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, samples[i]));
    view.setInt16(offset, s < 0 ? s * 0x8000 : s * 0x7FFF, true);
  }

  return new Blob([view], { type: "audio/wav" });

}

const activities = [
  { prompt: "Bonjour, comment allez-vous ?", displayPrompt: "« Bonjour, comment allez-vous ? »" },

function loadActivity(i){
  const a = activities[i];
  document.getElementById("stepLabel").innerText = "Activity " + (i + 1) + " of " + activities.length;
  document.getElementById("promptText").innerText = a.displayPrompt;
  feedbackBox.style.display = "none";

  micBtn.style.display = "inline-flex";
