async function loadOverview(){

  const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminMusicOverview");
  const data = await res.json();

  const grid = document.getElementById("statGrid");
  grid.innerHTML = "";

  const cards = [
    { label: "Total Videos", value: data.totalVideos },
    { label: "Total Views", value: data.totalViews },
    { label: "Total Likes", value: data.totalLikes },
    { label: "Total Comments", value: data.totalComments },
    { label: "Playlists Created", value: data.totalPlaylists }
  ];

  cards.forEach((c,i)=>{
    const card = document.createElement("div");
    card.className = "stat-card cascade-card";
    card.style.animationDelay = (i * 0.08) + "s";
    card.innerHTML = "<div class='stat-label'>" + c.label + "</div><div class='stat-value'>" + c.value + "</div>";
    grid.appendChild(card);
  });

}

function extractYoutubeId(input){
  input = input.trim();
  if(/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11}$/.test(input)) return input;
  const patterns = [
    /(?:youtube\.com\/watch\?v=)([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11})/,
    /(?:youtu\.be\/)([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11})/,
    /(?:youtube\.com\/embed\/)([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11})/
  ];
  for(const p of patterns){
    const m = input.match(p);
    if(m) return m[1];
  }
  return null;
}

async function loadVideos(){

  const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/musicVideos");
  const videos = await res.json();

  const table = document.getElementById("videosTable");

  if(!videos.length){
    table.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='6' class='empty-note'>No videos yet. Add one above.</td></tr>";
    return;
  }

  table.innerHTML = "";

  videos.forEach(v=>{
    const row = document.createElement("tr");
    row.innerHTML =
      "<td>" + (v.thumbnailUrl ? "<img class='thumb-sm' src='" + v.thumbnailUrl + "'>" : v.youtubeId ? "<img class='thumb-sm' src='https://img.youtube.com/vi/" + v.youtubeId + "/hqdefault.jpg'>" : "<div class='thumb-sm' style='display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(183,110,121,.15);color:#C9A0A5;font-size:10px;'>File</div>") + "</td>" +
      "<td>" + v.title + "<br><span style='color:#786367;font-size:10.5px;'>" + (v.artist||"") + "</span></td>" +
      "<td>" + v.genre + "</td>" +
      "<td>" + v.views + "</td>" +
      "<td>" + v.likeCount + "</td>" +
      "<td>" +
      "<button onclick=\"triggerThumbnailEdit('" + v.id + "', '" + v.genre + "')\">Edit Thumbnail</button> " +
      "<button class='btn-delete' onclick=\"deleteVideo('" + v.id + "')\">Delete</button>" +
      "<input type='file' accept='image/*' style='display:none;' id='thumbEdit-" + v.id + "' onchange=\"handleThumbnailEdit('" + v.id + "', '" + v.genre + "')\" />" +
      "</td>";
    table.appendChild(row);
  });

}

window.addVideo = async function(){

  const title = document.getElementById("addTitle").value.trim();
  const artist = document.getElementById("addArtist").value.trim();
  const genre = document.getElementById("addGenre").value;
  const description = document.getElementById("addDescription").value.trim();
  const btn = document.getElementById("addVideoBtn");
  const progressEl = document.getElementById("uploadProgress");
  const thumbnailFile = document.getElementById("addThumbnail").files[0];

  if(!title){
    alert("Please provide a title.");
    return;
  }

  let youtubeId = null;
  let fileUrl = null;
  let thumbnailUrl = null;

  if(thumbnailFile){

    if(!auth.currentUser){
      await signInAnonymously(auth);
    }

    try{
      const thumbSrc = await window.compressImageFile(thumbnailFile);
      const thumbRef = ref(storage, "musicThumbnails/" + genre + "/" + Date.now() + "_" + thumbSrc.name);
      await uploadBytesResumable(thumbRef, thumbSrc);
      thumbnailUrl = await getDownloadURL(thumbRef);
    }catch(err){
      alert("Thumbnail upload failed. Continuing without a custom thumbnail.");
    }

  }

  if(uploadMode === "youtube"){

    const youtubeInput = document.getElementById("addYoutube").value.trim();
    youtubeId = extractYoutubeId(youtubeInput);

    if(!youtubeId){
      alert("Please provide a valid YouTube URL or 11-character video ID.");
      return;
    }

  }else{

    const fileInput = document.getElementById("addVideoFile");
    const file = fileInput.files[0];

    if(!file){
      alert("Please choose a video file to upload.");
      return;
    }

    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.innerText = "Uploading...";

    try{

      if(!auth.currentUser){
        await signInAnonymously(auth);
      }

      const fileRef = ref(storage, "musicVideos/" + genre + "/" + Date.now() + "_" + file.name);
      const uploadTask = uploadBytesResumable(fileRef, file);

      fileUrl = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        uploadTask.on("state_changed",
          (snapshot) => {
            const pct = Math.round((snapshot.bytesTransferred / snapshot.totalBytes) * 100);
            progressEl.innerText = "Uploading: " + pct + "%";
          },
          (err) => reject(err),
          async () => resolve(await getDownloadURL(uploadTask.snapshot.ref))
        );
      });

      progressEl.innerText = "Upload complete.";

    }catch(err){
      alert("Video upload failed. Please try again.");
      btn.disabled = false;
      btn.innerText = "Add Video";
      return;
    }

  }

  const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminAddMusicVideo", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ title, artist, genre, youtubeId, fileUrl, thumbnailUrl, description })
  });

  btn.disabled = false;
  btn.innerText = "Add Video";

  if(res.ok){
    document.getElementById("addTitle").value = "";
    document.getElementById("addArtist").value = "";
    document.getElementById("addYoutube").value = "";
    document.getElementById("addDescription").value = "";
    document.getElementById("addVideoFile").value = "";
    document.getElementById("addThumbnail").value = "";
    progressEl.innerText = "";
    loadVideos();
    loadOverview();
  }else{
    alert("Could not add video.");
  }

}

window.deleteVideo = async function(videoId){

  if(!confirm("Delete this video? This cannot be undone.")) return;

  await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminDeleteMusicVideo", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ videoId })
  });

  loadVideos();
  loadOverview();

}

window.triggerThumbnailEdit = function(videoId, genre){
  document.getElementById("thumbEdit-" + videoId).click();
}

window.handleThumbnailEdit = async function(videoId, genre){

  const input = document.getElementById("thumbEdit-" + videoId);
  const file = input.files[0];

  if(!file) return;

  if(!auth.currentUser){
    await signInAnonymously(auth);
  }

  try{

    const thumbSrc = await window.compressImageFile(file);
    const thumbRef = ref(storage, "musicThumbnails/" + genre + "/" + Date.now() + "_" + thumbSrc.name);
    await uploadBytesResumable(thumbRef, thumbSrc);
    const thumbnailUrl = await getDownloadURL(thumbRef);

    const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminUpdateMusicThumbnail", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ videoId, thumbnailUrl })
    });

    if(res.ok){
      loadVideos();
    }else{
      alert("Could not update thumbnail.");
    }

  }catch(err){
    alert("Thumbnail upload failed. Please try again.");
  }

}

async function loadCommentsTab(){

  const videosRes = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/musicVideos");
  const videos = await videosRes.json();

  const table = document.getElementById("commentsTable");
  table.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='4' class='empty-note'>Loading…</td></tr>";

  let allComments = [];

  for(const v of videos){
    const cRes = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/musicComments?videoId=" + v.id);
    const comments = await cRes.json();
    comments.forEach(c => allComments.push({ ...c, videoTitle: v.title }));
  }

  if(!allComments.length){
    table.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='4' class='empty-note'>No comments yet.</td></tr>";
    return;
  }

  table.innerHTML = "";

  allComments.forEach(c=>{
    const row = document.createElement("tr");
    row.innerHTML =
      "<td>" + c.videoTitle + "</td>" +
      "<td>" + c.userName + "</td>" +
      "<td>" + c.text.replace(/</g,"&lt;") + "</td>" +
      "<td><button class='btn-delete' onclick=\"deleteComment('" + c.id + "')\">Delete</button></td>";
    table.appendChild(row);
  });

}

window.deleteComment = async function(commentId){

  if(!confirm("Delete this comment?")) return;

  await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/musicDeleteComment", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ commentId })
  });

  loadCommentsTab();
  loadOverview();

}

const API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";
const genres = ["Afro","Latin","Soul","Pop","Jazz","Country","Reggae","Classical","Gospel"];

let currentGenre = "All";
let allVideos = [];
let heroVideos = [];
let heroIndex = 0;
let heroTimer = null;

const genreItemsEl = document.getElementById("genreItems");

genres.forEach(g => {
  const item = document.createElement("div");
  item.className = "sb-item";
  item.id = "sb-genre-" + g;
  item.innerHTML =
    "<svg viewBox='0 0 24 24' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='2'><path d='M9 18V5l12-2v13'/><circle cx='6' cy='18' r='3'/><circle cx='18' cy='16' r='3'/></svg>" + g;
  item.onclick = () => selectGenre(g);
  genreItemsEl.appendChild(item);
});

function thumbHtml(v){
  if(v.thumbnailUrl){
    return "<img class='thumb' src='" + v.thumbnailUrl + "' loading='lazy'>";
  }
  if(v.youtubeId){
    return "<img class='thumb' src='https://img.youtube.com/vi/" + v.youtubeId + "/hqdefault.jpg' loading='lazy'>";
  }
  return "<div class='thumb-fallback'><svg width='30' height='30' viewBox='0 0 24 24' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='1.6'><path d='M3 18v-6a9 9 0 0 1 18 0v6'/><path d='M21 19a2 2 0 0 1-2 2h-1a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-3a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h3zM3 19a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h1a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-3a2 2 0 0 0-2-2H3z'/></svg></div>";
}

function cardHtml(v, wide, i){
  const delay = "style='animation-delay:" + ((i||0) * 0.06) + "s'";
  return "<div class='" + (wide ? "video-card" : "shelf-card") + " cascade-card' " + delay + " onclick=\"location.href='/music/watch.html?v=" + v.id + "'\">" +
    thumbHtml(v) +
    "<div class='card-info'>" +
      "<div class='channel-avatar'><svg viewBox='0 0 24 24' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='2'><path d='M9 18V5l12-2v13'/><circle cx='6' cy='18' r='3'/><circle cx='18' cy='16' r='3'/></svg></div>" +
      "<div>" +
        "<div class='card-title'>" + v.title + "</div>" +
        "<div class='card-channel'>" + (v.artist || "SayBon Music") + "</div>" +
        "<div class='card-meta'>" + v.views + " views" + (wide ? " · " + v.genre : "") + "</div>" +
      "</div>" +
    "</div>" +
  "</div>";
}

function renderHeroSlide(v, i){

  const bgClass = (v.thumbnailUrl || v.youtubeId) ? "hero-bg" : "hero-bg fallback";
  const bgStyle = v.thumbnailUrl
    ? "background-image:url('" + v.thumbnailUrl + "')"
    : v.youtubeId
      ? "background-image:url('https://img.youtube.com/vi/" + v.youtubeId + "/maxresdefault.jpg')"
      : "";

  return "<div class='hero-slide" + (i === 0 ? " active" : "") + "' data-index='" + i + "'>" +
    "<div class='" + bgClass + "' style=\"" + bgStyle + "\"></div>" +
    "<div class='hero-overlay'></div>" +
    "<div class='hero-content'>" +
      "<span class='hero-badge'>" + (i === 0 ? "Featured" : "Trending") + "</span>" +
      "<h1 class='hero-title'>" + v.title + "</h1>" +
      "<p class='hero-sub'>" + (v.artist || "SayBon Music") + " · " + v.views + " views</p>" +
      "<button class='hero-play-btn' onclick=\"location.href='/music/watch.html?v=" + v.id + "'\"><svg viewBox='0 0 24 24' fill='currentColor'><path d='M8 5v14l11-7z'/></svg>Play Now</button>" +
    "</div>" +
  "</div>";

}

function buildHero(){

  const heroEl = document.getElementById("heroSection");

  if(!heroVideos.length){
    heroEl.style.display = "none";
    return;
  }

  heroEl.style.display = "block";
  heroEl.innerHTML = heroVideos.map((v,i) => renderHeroSlide(v,i)).join("");

  if(heroVideos.length > 1){
    const dots = document.createElement("div");
    dots.className = "hero-dots";
    heroVideos.forEach((v, i) => {
      const dot = document.createElement("div");
      dot.className = "hero-dot" + (i === 0 ? " active" : "");
      dot.onclick = (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); goToHeroSlide(i); };
      dots.appendChild(dot);
    });
    heroEl.appendChild(dots);
  }

  heroIndex = 0;
  startHeroTimer();

}

function goToHeroSlide(i){
  heroIndex = i;
  document.querySelectorAll(".hero-slide").forEach((s, idx) => s.classList.toggle("active", idx === i));
  document.querySelectorAll(".hero-dot").forEach((d, idx) => d.classList.toggle("active", idx === i));
  startHeroTimer();
}

function startHeroTimer(){
  clearInterval(heroTimer);
  if(heroVideos.length <= 1) return;
  heroTimer = setInterval(() => {
    goToHeroSlide((heroIndex + 1) % heroVideos.length);
  }, 6000);
}

function selectGenre(genre){
  currentGenre = genre;
  sbmCurrentView = null;
  document.querySelectorAll(".sb-item").forEach(i => i.classList.remove("active"));
  if(genre === "All"){
    document.getElementById("sb-home").classList.add("active");
  }else{
    document.getElementById("sb-genre-" + genre).classList.add("active");
  }
  renderContent();
}
window.selectGenre = selectGenre;

function renderPillRow(){

  const wrap = document.getElementById("pillRowWrap");
  const row = document.getElementById("pillRow");

  const counts = {};
  allVideos.forEach(v => { counts[v.genre] = (counts[v.genre]||0) + 1; });

  const present = genres.filter(g => counts[g]);

  if(!present.length){
    wrap.style.display = "none";
    return;
  }

  wrap.style.display = "block";
  row.innerHTML = "";

  present.forEach(g => {
    const pill = document.createElement("div");
    pill.className = "genre-pill-card";
    pill.onclick = () => selectGenre(g);
    pill.innerHTML =
      "<div class='pill-icon'><svg viewBox='0 0 24 24' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='2'><path d='M9 18V5l12-2v13'/><circle cx='6' cy='18' r='3'/><circle cx='18' cy='16' r='3'/></svg></div>" +
      "<div><div class='pill-name'>" + g + "</div><div class='pill-count'>" + counts[g] + " video" + (counts[g]===1?"":"s") + "</div></div>";
    row.appendChild(pill);
  });

}

function sbmShelfHtml(pl, wide){
  return "<div class='section-header'><div><div class='section-title'>" + pl.title + "</div><div class='card-meta'>" + pl.sub + "</div></div>" +
    "<div class='section-viewall' onclick=\"sbmPlay('" + pl.id + "')\">&#9654; Play all</div></div>" +
    "<div class='shelf-row'>" + pl.videos.map((v,i) => cardHtml(v, false, i)).join("") + "</div>";
}

window.sbmPlay = function(id){
  const pl = SBM.autoPlaylists(allVideos).find(p => p.id === id);
  if(pl) SBM.playList(pl.videos, pl.title);
};

function sbmPersonal(area){
  if(!SBM.history().length) return;
  const pls = SBM.autoPlaylists(allVideos).filter(p => p.id === "foryou" || p.id === "recent");
  pls.forEach(pl => {
    const shelf = document.createElement("div");
    shelf.className = "shelf";
    shelf.innerHTML = sbmShelfHtml(pl);
    area.appendChild(shelf);
  });
}

let sbmCurrentView = null;

window.sbmView = function(view){
  sbmCurrentView = view;
  currentGenre = "All";
  document.querySelectorAll(".sb-item").forEach(i => i.classList.remove("active"));
  const el = document.getElementById("sb-" + view);
  if(el) el.classList.add("active");
  clearInterval(heroTimer);
  document.getElementById("heroSection").style.display = "none";
  const area = document.getElementById("contentArea");
  if(view === "history"){
    const list = SBM.recentUnique(allVideos);
    area.innerHTML = "<div class='section-header'><div class='section-title'>History</div></div>" +
      (list.length ? "<div class='grid' id='flatGrid'></div>" : "<div class='empty-state'>Nothing here yet. Play something and it will show up.</div>");
    if(list.length){
      document.getElementById("flatGrid").innerHTML = list.map((v,i) => cardHtml(v, true, i)).join("");
    }
  }else if(view === "liked"){
    const list = allVideos.filter(v => SBM.isLiked(v.id));
    area.innerHTML = "<div class='section-header'><div class='section-title'>Liked videos</div>" +
      (list.length ? "<div class='section-viewall' onclick=\"sbmPlay('liked')\">&#9654; Play all</div>" : "") + "</div>" +
      (list.length ? "<div class='grid' id='flatGrid'></div>" : "<div class='empty-state'>You have not liked anything yet. Tap the heart on a video.</div>");
    if(list.length) document.getElementById("flatGrid").innerHTML = list.map((v,i) => cardHtml(v, true, i)).join("");
  }else{
    area.innerHTML = "";
    const pls = SBM.autoPlaylists(allVideos);
    if(!SBM.history().length){
      const n = document.createElement("div");
      n.className = "empty-state";
      n.style.padding = "10px 0 26px";
      n.textContent = "Play a few videos and your own mixes will appear here. Meanwhile, here is what is popular.";
      area.appendChild(n);
    }
    pls.forEach(pl => {
      const shelf = document.createElement("div");
      shelf.className = "shelf";
      shelf.innerHTML = sbmShelfHtml(pl);
      area.appendChild(shelf);
    });
  }
};

window.sbmRefresh = function(){
  if(!allVideos.length) return;
  if(sbmCurrentView) window.sbmView(sbmCurrentView);
  else if(currentGenre === "All" && !document.getElementById("searchInput").value.trim()) renderContent();
};

function renderContent(){
  sbmCurrentView = null;

  const area = document.getElementById("contentArea");

  if(!allVideos.length){
    area.innerHTML = "<div class='empty-state'>No videos yet - check back soon.</div>";
    heroVideos = [];
    buildHero();
    return;
  }

  const sorted = [...allVideos].sort((a,b) => b.views - a.views);

  if(currentGenre === "All"){
    heroVideos = sorted.slice(0, 3);
  }else{
    heroVideos = sorted.filter(v => v.genre === currentGenre).slice(0, 1);
  }
  buildHero();

  if(currentGenre !== "All"){

    const genreVideos = sorted.filter(v => v.genre === currentGenre);
    const heroIds = heroVideos.map(v => v.id);
    const rest = genreVideos.filter(v => !heroIds.includes(v.id));

    area.innerHTML = "<div class='section-header'><div class='section-title'>" + currentGenre + "</div></div><div class='grid' id='flatGrid'></div>";
    const grid = document.getElementById("flatGrid");

    if(!rest.length){
      grid.innerHTML = "<div class='empty-state'>That is the only video in this genre so far.</div>";
      return;
    }

    grid.innerHTML = rest.map((v,i) => cardHtml(v, true, i)).join("");
    return;

  }

  area.innerHTML = "";
  sbmPersonal(area);

  const heroIds = heroVideos.map(v => v.id);
  const trending = sorted.filter(v => !heroIds.includes(v.id)).slice(0, 8);

  if(trending.length){
    const trendingShelf = document.createElement("div");
    trendingShelf.className = "shelf";
    trendingShelf.innerHTML =
      "<div class='section-header'><div class='section-title'>Trending</div></div>" +
      "<div class='shelf-row'>" + trending.map((v,i) => cardHtml(v, false, i)).join("") + "</div>";
    area.appendChild(trendingShelf);
  }

  const byGenre = {};
  allVideos.forEach(v => {
    if(!byGenre[v.genre]) byGenre[v.genre] = [];
    byGenre[v.genre].push(v);
  });

  genres.forEach(g => {
    if(!byGenre[g] || !byGenre[g].length) return;
    const shelf = document.createElement("div");
    shelf.className = "shelf";
    shelf.innerHTML =
      "<div class='section-header'><div class='section-title'>" + g + "</div><div class='section-viewall' onclick=\"selectGenre('" + g + "')\">View All</div></div>" +
      "<div class='shelf-row'>" + byGenre[g].map((v,i) => cardHtml(v, false, i)).join("") + "</div>";
    area.appendChild(shelf);
  });

}

async function loadVideos(){

  document.getElementById("contentArea").innerHTML = "<div class='empty-state'>Loading...</div>";

  try{
    const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/musicVideos");
    allVideos = await res.json();
    renderPillRow();
    const qp = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
    if(qp.get("view")) window.sbmView(qp.get("view"));
    else if(qp.get("genre") && genres.includes(qp.get("genre"))) selectGenre(qp.get("genre"));
    else renderContent();
  }catch(err){
    document.getElementById("contentArea").innerHTML = "<div class='empty-state'>Could not load videos.</div>";
  }

}

window.searchVideos = function(){

  const q = document.getElementById("searchInput").value.trim().toLowerCase();

  if(!q){
    renderContent();
    return;
  }

  document.getElementById("heroSection").style.display = "none";
  clearInterval(heroTimer);

  const area = document.getElementById("contentArea");
  const filtered = allVideos.filter(v => v.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) || (v.artist||"").toLowerCase().includes(q));

  if(!filtered.length){
    area.innerHTML = "<div class='empty-state'>No results for that search.</div>";
    return;
  }

  area.innerHTML = "<div class='section-header'><div class='section-title'>Search results</div></div><div class='grid' id='flatGrid'></div>";
  document.getElementById("flatGrid").innerHTML = filtered.map((v,i) => cardHtml(v, true, i)).join("");

}

document.getElementById("searchInput").addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if(e.key === "Enter") searchVideos();
});

loadVideos();

const sidebarToggleBtn = document.getElementById("sidebarToggleBtn");
const sidebarEl = document.getElementById("sidebar");
const sidebarOverlay = document.getElementById("sidebarOverlay");

function closeSidebar(){
  sidebarEl.classList.remove("open");
  sidebarOverlay.classList.remove("open");
}

sidebarToggleBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
  sidebarEl.classList.toggle("open");
  sidebarOverlay.classList.toggle("open");
});
sidebarOverlay.addEventListener("click", closeSidebar);

=== \public\music\music-auth.js ===
import { auth } from "/js/firebase-init.js";
var API = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";
var nativeFetch = window.fetch.bind(window);
function ready() {
  var p = auth.authStateReady ? auth.authStateReady() : Promise.resolve();
  return Promise.race([p, new Promise(function (r) { setTimeout(r, 3000); })]);
}
window.fetch = async function (input, init) {
  try {
    var url = typeof input === "string" ? input : (input && input.url) || "";
    if (url.indexOf(API + "/api/music") === 0) {
      await ready();
      var u = auth.currentUser;
      if (u) {
        var t = await u.getIdToken();
        init = Object.assign({}, init);
        var h = new Headers(init.headers || (typeof input !== "string" && input && input.headers) || {});
        if (!h.has("Authorization")) h.set("Authorization", "Bearer " + t);
        init.headers = h;
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {}
  return nativeFetch(input, init);
};

=== \public\music\music-core.js ===
/* SayBon Music core - listening history, taste profile, recommendations, automatic playlists, shared sidebar.
   Loaded by /music/index.html, watch.html and playlists.html. Works signed-in (history also saved on the server)
   and degrades to this-device-only if the server is unreachable. */
(function(){
var API="https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";
var S={uid:null,hist:[],liked:{},all:null,allP:null};
var GENRES=["Afro","Latin","Soul","Pop","Jazz","Country","Reggae","Classical","Gospel"];

function lsGet(k,d){try{var v=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(k));return v==null?d:v;}catch(e){return d;}}
function lsSet(k,v){try{localStorage.setItem(k,JSON.stringify(v));}catch(e){}}
function ssGet(k,d){try{var v=JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem(k));return v==null?d:v;}catch(e){return d;}}
function ssSet(k,v){try{sessionStorage.setItem(k,JSON.stringify(v));}catch(e){}}
function esc(s){return String(s==null?"":s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,function(c){return {"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;","'":"&#39;"}[c];});}
function hkey(){return "sbm_hist_"+(S.uid||"guest");}
function post(path,body){return fetch(API+path,{method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify(body)}).then(function(r){return r.json().catch(function(){return {};});});}

/* ---------- videos ---------- */
function getAll(){
  if(S.all)return Promise.resolve(S.all);
  if(S.allP)return S.allP;
  S.allP=fetch(API+"/api/musicVideos").then(function(r){return r.json();}).then(function(a){S.all=Array.isArray(a)?a:[];return S.all;}).catch(function(){S.allP=null;return [];});
  return S.allP;
}
function byId(all){var m={};all.forEach(function(v){m[v.id]=v;});return m;}

/* ---------- user + history ---------- */
function setUser(uid){
  S.uid=uid||null;
  S.hist=lsGet(hkey(),[]);
  if(!uid)return Promise.resolve();
  var a=fetch(API+"/api/musicHistory?userId="+encodeURIComponent(uid)).then(function(r){return r.json();}).then(function(rows){
    if(!Array.isArray(rows))return;
    var seen={};S.hist.forEach(function(e){seen[e.videoId+"|"+e.at]=e;});
    rows.forEach(function(e){var k=e.videoId+"|"+e.at;if(seen[k]){seen[k].pct=Math.max(seen[k].pct||0,e.pct||0);}else{S.hist.push(e);seen[k]=e;}});
    S.hist.sort(function(x,y){return x.at-y.at;});
    S.hist=S.hist.slice(-400);lsSet(hkey(),S.hist);
  }).catch(function(){});
  var b=fetch(API+"/api/musicLiked?userId="+encodeURIComponent(uid)).then(function(r){return r.json();}).then(function(ids){
    S.liked={};if(Array.isArray(ids))ids.forEach(function(i){S.liked[i]=1;});
  }).catch(function(){});
  return Promise.all([a,b]);
}
function setLiked(id,on){if(on)S.liked[id]=1;else delete S.liked[id];}
var cur=null;
function track(v,pct){
  if(!v||!v.id)return;
  if(!pct){cur={videoId:v.id,genre:v.genre||"",artist:v.artist||"",at:Date.now(),pct:0};S.hist.push(cur);}
  else if(cur&&cur.videoId===v.id){cur.pct=Math.max(cur.pct,pct);}
  else return;
  S.hist=S.hist.slice(-400);lsSet(hkey(),S.hist);
  if(S.uid)post("/api/musicHistoryAdd",{userId:S.uid,videoId:cur.videoId,genre:cur.genre,artist:cur.artist,at:cur.at,pct:cur.pct}).catch(function(){});
}

/* ---------- taste profile ---------- */
function decay(at){return Math.pow(.5,(Date.now()-at)/(14*864e5));}
function profile(all){
  var G={},A={},plays={},last={},lk={};
  S.hist.forEach(function(e){
    var w=decay(e.at)*(e.pct>=80?1.6:(e.pct>0?1:.7));
    if(e.genre)G[e.genre]=(G[e.genre]||0)+w;
    if(e.artist)A[e.artist]=(A[e.artist]||0)+w;
    plays[e.videoId]=(plays[e.videoId]||0)+1;
    last[e.videoId]=Math.max(last[e.videoId]||0,e.at);
  });
  (all||[]).forEach(function(v){if(S.liked[v.id]){if(v.genre)G[v.genre]=(G[v.genre]||0)+2;if(v.artist)A[v.artist]=(A[v.artist]||0)+2;}});
  function norm(o){var m=0,k;for(k in o)m=Math.max(m,o[k]);if(m)for(k in o)o[k]/=m;return o;}
  return {G:norm(G),A:norm(A),plays:plays,last:last,hasHistory:S.hist.length>0};
}
function popNorm(v,max){return max?Math.log(1+(v.views||0))/Math.log(1+max):0;}
function maxViews(all){var m=0;all.forEach(function(v){m=Math.max(m,v.views||0);});return m;}
function score(v,P,mv){
  var s=4*(P.G[v.genre]||0)+3*(P.A[v.artist]||0)+(S.liked[v.id]?1.2:0)+.6*popNorm(v,mv);
  var n=P.plays[v.id]||0;
  s+=n?-.35*Math.min(n,3):.7;
  if(P.last[v.id]&&Date.now()-P.last[v.id]<36e5)s-=3;
  return s;
}
function words(t){return String(t||"").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9À-ſ ]/g," ").split(/\s+/).filter(function(w){return w.length>3;});}
function similar(curV,all,n){
  var P=profile(all),mv=maxViews(all),cw=words(curV.title);
  return all.filter(function(v){return v.id!==curV.id;}).map(function(v){
    var sim=(v.artist&&v.artist===curV.artist?3:0)+(v.genre===curV.genre?2:0);
    var vw=words(v.title),ov=0;cw.forEach(function(w){if(vw.indexOf(w)>-1)ov++;});
    sim+=Math.min(ov,2)*.75;
    return {v:v,s:sim+.5*score(v,P,mv)};
  }).sort(function(a,b){return b.s-a.s;}).slice(0,n||12).map(function(x){return x.v;});
}
function ts(v){var c=v.createdAt;if(!c)return 0;if(c._seconds)return c._seconds*1000;var d=new Date(c).getTime();return isNaN(d)?0:d;}

/* ---------- automatic playlists ---------- */
function recentUnique(all){
  var m=byId(all),seen={},out=[];
  for(var i=S.hist.length-1;i>=0;i--){var id=S.hist[i].videoId;if(!seen[id]&&m[id]){seen[id]=1;out.push(m[id]);}}
  return out;
}
function autoPlaylists(all){
  var P=profile(all),mv=maxViews(all),m=byId(all),out=[],now=Date.now();
  function add(id,title,sub,videos){if(videos&&videos.length)out.push({id:id,title:title,sub:sub,videos:videos});}
  if(P.hasHistory){
    var ranked=all.slice().sort(function(a,b){return score(b,P,mv)-score(a,P,mv);});
    add("foryou","Made for you","Picked from what you play and like",ranked.slice(0,20));
    add("recent","Recently played","Pick up where you left off",recentUnique(all).slice(0,20));
    var most=Object.keys(P.plays).filter(function(i){return m[i];}).sort(function(a,b){return P.plays[b]-P.plays[a];}).slice(0,20).map(function(i){return m[i];});
    if(most.length&&P.plays[most[0].id]>1)add("most","Your most played","The ones you keep coming back to",most);
    var tg=Object.keys(P.G).sort(function(a,b){return P.G[b]-P.G[a];})[0];
    if(tg)add("genre","Your "+tg+" mix","Because "+tg+" is what you play most",all.filter(function(v){return v.genre===tg;}).sort(function(a,b){return score(b,P,mv)-score(a,P,mv);}).slice(0,25));
    var ta=Object.keys(P.A).sort(function(a,b){return P.A[b]-P.A[a];})[0];
    if(ta){var av=all.filter(function(v){return v.artist===ta;});if(av.length>1)add("artist","More from "+ta,"You have been listening to "+ta,av.sort(function(a,b){return score(b,P,mv)-score(a,P,mv);}));}
    var re=all.filter(function(v){return (S.liked[v.id]||P.plays[v.id])&&(!P.last[v.id]||now-P.last[v.id]>14*864e5);}).sort(function(a,b){return (P.last[a.id]||0)-(P.last[b.id]||0);}).slice(0,20);
    add("rediscover","Rediscover","Songs you have not played in a while",re);
  }
  var liked=all.filter(function(v){return S.liked[v.id];});
  add("liked","Liked videos","Everything you have liked",liked);
  add("popular","Popular right now","Most played on SayBon Music",all.slice().sort(function(a,b){return (b.views||0)-(a.views||0);}).slice(0,20));
  add("fresh","Fresh uploads","The newest additions",all.slice().sort(function(a,b){return ts(b)-ts(a);}).slice(0,20));
  return out;
}

  setQueue(videos.map(function(v){return v.id;}),title);
  location.href="/music/watch.html?v="+encodeURIComponent(videos[0].id)+"&q=1";
}

function ago(at){
  var m=Math.round((Date.now()-at)/6e4);if(m<1)return "just now";if(m<60)return m+" min ago";
  var h=Math.round(m/60);if(h<24)return h+" h ago";var d=Math.round(h/24);return d+(d===1?" day ago":" days ago");
}

/* First visit to Music: Eryn explains the "language bath" once, then the page carries on. Played only until it has actually started. */
(function(){
  var KEY="sb_music_intro_seen",U="/assets/audio/music/intro-eryn.mp3";
  try{if(localStorage.getItem(KEY))return}catch(e){}
  fetch(U,{method:"HEAD"}).then(function(r){
    var ct=(r.headers.get("content-type")||"").toLowerCase();
    if(!(r.ok&&ct.indexOf("audio")===0))return;
    var a=new Audio(U);a.preload="auto";
    a.addEventListener("playing",function(){try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,"1")}catch(e){}});
    var p=a.play();
    if(p&&p.catch)p.catch(function(){
      /* the browser wants a tap first: play on the first tap, and ignore it if the learner already started a song */
      var go=function(){document.removeEventListener("pointerdown",go,true);a.play().catch(function(){})};
      document.addEventListener("pointerdown",go,true);
    });
  }).catch(function(){});
})();

import { auth } from "/js/firebase-init.js";
import { onAuthStateChanged } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-auth.js";

const API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";

function showToast(message){
  const toast = document.getElementById("toast");
  toast.innerText = message;
  toast.classList.add("show");
  clearTimeout(toastTimer);
  toastTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    toast.classList.remove("show");
  }, 2600);
}
window.showToast = showToast;

onAuthStateChanged(auth, (user) => {
  currentUser = user;
  loadPlaylists();
  renderAuto();
  SBM.setUser(user ? user.uid : null).then(() => renderAuto());
});

function pvThumb(v){
  if(v.thumbnailUrl) return "<img class='pv-thumb' src='" + v.thumbnailUrl + "'>";
  if(v.youtubeId) return "<img class='pv-thumb' src='https://img.youtube.com/vi/" + v.youtubeId + "/hqdefault.jpg'>";
  return "<div class='pv-thumb-fallback'></div>";
}

const esc = SBM.esc;

function renderRows(container, videos, opts){
  container.innerHTML = "";
  videos.forEach(v => {
    const row = document.createElement("div");
    row.className = "pv-row";
    row.onclick = () => {
      SBM.setQueue(videos.map(x => x.id), opts.title);
      location.href = "/music/watch.html?v=" + encodeURIComponent(v.id) + "&q=1";
    };
    row.innerHTML =
      pvThumb(v) +
      "<div style='flex:1;min-width:0;'><div class='pv-title'>" + esc(v.title) + "</div><div class='pv-sub'>" + esc(v.artist || "SayBon Music") + " · " + (v.views || 0) + " views</div></div>" +
      (opts.onRemove ? "<button class='pv-x' title='Remove from playlist' aria-label='Remove'>&times;</button>" : "");
    if(opts.onRemove){
      row.querySelector(".pv-x").onclick = (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); opts.onRemove(v, row); };
    }
    container.appendChild(row);
  });
}

async function renderAuto(){
  const box = document.getElementById("autoSection");
  const all = await SBM.getAll();
  const pls = SBM.autoPlaylists(all);
  const hasHist = SBM.history().length > 0;
  box.innerHTML =
    "<div class='sec-label'>Made for you</div>" +
    "<div class='sec-sub'>" + (hasHist ? "Built from what you play and like. It updates as you listen." : "Play a few videos and your own mixes appear here. Meanwhile, here is what is popular.") + "</div>";
  pls.forEach((pl, i) => {
    const card = document.createElement("div");
    card.className = "playlist-card cascade-card";
    card.style.animationDelay = (i * 0.05) + "s";
    const header = document.createElement("div");
    header.className = "playlist-header";
    header.innerHTML =
      "<div class='pl-meta'><span class='playlist-name'>" + esc(pl.title) + "</span><span class='pl-sub'>" + esc(pl.sub) + " · " + pl.videos.length + " video" + (pl.videos.length === 1 ? "" : "s") + "</span></div>" +
      "<div class='pl-actions'><button class='pl-btn' data-a='play'>&#9654; Play all</button><button class='pl-btn ghost' data-a='save'>Save</button></div>";
    const vids = document.createElement("div");
    vids.className = "playlist-videos";
    renderRows(vids, pl.videos, { title: pl.title });
    header.onclick = () => vids.classList.toggle("open");
    header.querySelector("[data-a=play]").onclick = (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); SBM.playList(pl.videos, pl.title); };
    header.querySelector("[data-a=save]").onclick = async (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      const uid = (auth.currentUser || currentUser || {}).uid;
      if(!uid){ showToast("Please sign in to save playlists."); return; }
      try{
        const r = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/musicCreatePlaylist", { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ userId: uid, name: pl.title }) });
        const d = await r.json();
        if(!r.ok) throw new Error();
        for(const v of pl.videos.slice(0, 40)){
          await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/musicAddToPlaylist", { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ playlistId: d.id, videoId: v.id }) });
        }
        showToast("Saved to your playlists.");
        loadPlaylists();
      }catch(err){ showToast("Could not save that playlist. Please try again."); }
    };
    card.appendChild(header);
    card.appendChild(vids);
    box.appendChild(card);
  });
}

async function loadPlaylists(){

  const container = document.getElementById("playlistContainer");
  const realUser = auth.currentUser || currentUser;

  if(!realUser){
    container.innerHTML = "<div class='empty-note'>Please sign in to see your playlists.</div>";
    return;
  }

  try{

    const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/musicPlaylists?userId=" + encodeURIComponent(realUser.uid));
    const playlists = await res.json();

    if(!res.ok || !Array.isArray(playlists)){
      container.innerHTML = "<div class='empty-note'>Could not load your playlists. Please try again.</div>";
      return;
    }

    if(!playlists.length){
      container.innerHTML = "<div class='empty-note'>You haven't made any playlists yet. Create one above.</div>";
      return;
    }

    container.innerHTML = "";

    playlists.forEach((p,i) => {

      let name = p.name;
      let count = p.videoIds.length;
      let detail = null;

      const card = document.createElement("div");
      card.className = "playlist-card cascade-card";
      card.style.animationDelay = (i * 0.07) + "s";

      const header = document.createElement("div");
      header.className = "playlist-header";

      const videosDiv = document.createElement("div");
      videosDiv.className = "playlist-videos";
      videosDiv.innerHTML = "<div class='empty-note' style='padding:16px 0;'>Loading…</div>";

      function paintHeader(){
        header.innerHTML =
          "<div class='pl-meta'><span class='playlist-name'>" + esc(name) + "</span><span class='playlist-count'>" + count + " video" + (count === 1 ? "" : "s") + "</span></div>" +
          "<div class='pl-actions'><button class='pl-btn' data-a='play'>&#9654; Play all</button><button class='pl-btn ghost' data-a='rename'>Rename</button><button class='pl-btn ghost' data-a='delete'>Delete</button></div>";
        header.querySelector("[data-a=play]").onclick = async (e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          const d = await ensureDetail();
          if(!d.videos.length){ showToast("Add a video to this playlist first."); return; }
          SBM.playList(d.videos, name);
        };
        header.querySelector("[data-a=rename]").onclick = async (e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          const n = (prompt("Rename playlist", name) || "").trim();
          if(!n || n === name) return;
          const r = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/musicRenamePlaylist", { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ playlistId: p.id, userId: realUser.uid, name: n }) });
          if(r.ok){ name = n; paintHeader(); showToast("Renamed."); }else{ showToast("Could not rename. Please try again."); }
        };
        header.querySelector("[data-a=delete]").onclick = async (e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if(!confirm("Delete the playlist \"" + name + "\"? The videos themselves are not deleted.")) return;
          const r = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/musicDeletePlaylist", { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ playlistId: p.id, userId: realUser.uid }) });
          if(r.ok){ card.remove(); showToast("Playlist deleted."); if(!container.children.length) loadPlaylists(); }else{ showToast("Could not delete. Please try again."); }
        };
      }

      async function ensureDetail(){
        if(detail) return detail;
        const detailRes = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/musicPlaylistDetail?id=" + p.id);
        detail = await detailRes.json();
        if(!detail.videos) detail.videos = [];
        return detail;
      }

      function paintVideos(){
        if(!detail.videos.length){
          videosDiv.innerHTML = "<div class='empty-note' style='padding:16px 0;'>No videos in this playlist yet. Open a video and tap Save.</div>";
          return;
        }
        renderRows(videosDiv, detail.videos, {
          title: name,
          onRemove: async (v, row) => {
            const r = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/musicRemoveFromPlaylist", { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ playlistId: p.id, videoId: v.id, userId: realUser.uid }) });
            if(r.ok){
              detail.videos = detail.videos.filter(x => x.id !== v.id);
              count = detail.videos.length;
              paintHeader();
              paintVideos();
            }else{ showToast("Could not remove. Please try again."); }
          }
        });
      }

      header.onclick = async () => {
        const isOpen = videosDiv.classList.toggle("open");
        if(isOpen && !detail){
          await ensureDetail();
          paintVideos();
        }
      };

      paintHeader();
      card.appendChild(header);
      card.appendChild(videosDiv);
      container.appendChild(card);

    });

  }catch(err){
    container.innerHTML = "<div class='empty-note'>Could not load your playlists. Please try again.</div>";
  }

}

window.createPlaylist = async function(){

  const realUser = auth.currentUser || currentUser;

  if(!realUser){
    showToast("Please sign in to create a playlist.");
    return;
  }

  const name = document.getElementById("newPlaylistName").value.trim();
  if(!name) return;

  const btn = document.getElementById("createPlaylistBtn");
  btn.disabled = true;

  try{

    const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/musicCreatePlaylist", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ userId: realUser.uid, name })
    });

    if(res.ok){
      document.getElementById("newPlaylistName").value = "";
      showToast("Playlist created.");
      loadPlaylists();
    }else{
      showToast("Could not create playlist. Please try again.");
    }

  }catch(err){
    showToast("Could not reach the server. Please try again.");
  }finally{
    btn.disabled = false;
  }

}

<div class="sbm-overlay" id="sbmOverlay" hidden><iframe id="sbmFrame" title="SayBon" allow="microphone; camera; autoplay; fullscreen; clipboard-write"></iframe></div>
<script type="module" src="/music/music-auth.js?v=1"></script>
<script src="/music/music-core.js?v=2"></script>
<script src="https://www.youtube.com/iframe_api"></script>

<script type="module">

import { auth } from "/js/firebase-init.js";
import { onAuthStateChanged } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-auth.js";

const API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";
const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
let videoId = params.get("v");

let currentUser = null;
let currentVideo = null;
let ytPlayer = null;
let htmlVideoEl = null;
let repeatMode = "off";
let upNextQueue = [];
let ytApiReady = false;

const queueFlag = params.get("q") === "1";
let queueMode = queueFlag;
if(!queueFlag) SBM.clearQueue();

onAuthStateChanged(auth, (user) => {
  currentUser = user;
  SBM.setUser(user ? user.uid : null).then(() => { if(currentVideo) loadSide(currentVideo); });
  loadVideo();
  loadComments();
});

window.onYouTubeIframeAPIReady = function(){
  ytApiReady = true;
};

window.cycleRepeatMode = function(){
  if(repeatMode === "off") repeatMode = "current";
  else if(repeatMode === "current") repeatMode = "all";
  else repeatMode = "off";

  const label = repeatMode === "off" ? "Repeat: Off" : repeatMode === "current" ? "Repeat: Current" : "Repeat: All";
  document.getElementById("repeatLabel").innerText = label;
  document.getElementById("repeatBtn").classList.toggle("active", repeatMode !== "off");
}

function handleVideoEnded(){
  SBM.track(currentVideo, 100);
  if(repeatMode === "current"){
    if(htmlVideoEl){
      htmlVideoEl.currentTime = 0;
      htmlVideoEl.play();
    }else if(ytPlayer && ytPlayer.seekTo){
      ytPlayer.seekTo(0);
      ytPlayer.playVideo();
    }
    return;
  }

  // Default behavior (repeatMode "off" or "all"): auto-advance within the queue,
  // matching real YouTube - autoplay-next happens regardless of the repeat toggle.
  playNextInQueue();
}

function playNextInQueue(){
  if(!upNextQueue.length){
    if(repeatMode !== "current") showUpNextSuggestion();
    return;
  }

  const currentIdx = upNextQueue.findIndex(v => v.id === videoId);
  const isLastTrack = currentIdx === -1 || currentIdx === upNextQueue.length - 1;

  if(isLastTrack){
    if(repeatMode === "all"){
      loadVideoById(upNextQueue[0].id);
      return;
    }
    showUpNextSuggestion();
    return;
  }

  loadVideoById(upNextQueue[currentIdx + 1].id);
}

let upNextTimer = null;
let upNextCancelled = false;

async function showUpNextSuggestion(){
  upNextCancelled = false;

  try{
    const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/musicVideos");
    const allVideos = await res.json();
    const candidates = allVideos.filter(v => v.id !== videoId);
    if(!candidates.length) return;

    const suggestion = SBM.similar(currentVideo, allVideos, 1)[0] || candidates[0];

    const overlay = document.createElement("div");
    overlay.id = "upNextOverlay";
    overlay.style.cssText = "position:fixed;bottom:24px;right:24px;width:280px;background:#1a1b20;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:14px;padding:14px;z-index:9999;box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.5);color:#fff;font-family:inherit;";

    overlay.innerHTML =
      '<div style="font-size:11px;color:#9a9da5;margin-bottom:8px;">Up next in <span id="upNextCountdown">5</span>s</div>' +
      '<div style="display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:12px;">' +
      '<img src="' + (suggestion.thumbnailUrl || "") + '" style="width:64px;height:36px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:6px;background:#333;">' +
      '<div style="flex:1;min-width:0;">' +
      '<div style="font-size:13px;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;">' + suggestion.title + '</div>' +
      '<div style="font-size:11px;color:#9a9da5;">' + (suggestion.artist || "SayBon Music") + '</div>' +
      '</div></div>' +
      '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;">' +
      '<button id="upNextPlayNowBtn" style="flex:1;background:#fff;color:#000;border:none;border-radius:8px;padding:8px;font-weight:600;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;">Play now</button>' +
      '<button id="upNextCancelBtn" style="flex:1;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:8px;padding:8px;font-weight:600;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;">Cancel</button>' +
      '</div>';

    document.body.appendChild(overlay);

    document.getElementById("upNextCancelBtn").onclick = function(){
      upNextCancelled = true;
      clearInterval(upNextTimer);
      overlay.remove();
    };
    document.getElementById("upNextPlayNowBtn").onclick = function(){
      clearInterval(upNextTimer);
      overlay.remove();
      loadVideoById(suggestion.id);
    };

    let secondsLeft = 5;
    upNextTimer = setInterval(function(){
      secondsLeft--;
      var el = document.getElementById("upNextCountdown");
      if(el) el.innerText = secondsLeft;
      if(secondsLeft <= 0){
        clearInterval(upNextTimer);
        if(!upNextCancelled){
          overlay.remove();
          loadVideoById(suggestion.id);
        }
      }
    }, 1000);

  }catch(err){
    console.error("Could not load Up Next suggestion:", err);
  }
}

function buildPlayer(data){

  htmlVideoEl = null;
  ytPlayer = null;

  if(data.fileUrl){

    document.getElementById("playerWrap").innerHTML =
      "<video id='mainVideoEl' autoplay controls controlsList='nodownload' disablePictureInPicture oncontextmenu='return false;' style='width:100%;height:100%;background:#0A0B0E;'><source src='" + data.fileUrl + "' type='video/mp4'></video>";

    htmlVideoEl = document.getElementById("mainVideoEl");
    htmlVideoEl.addEventListener("ended", handleVideoEnded);
    htmlVideoEl.play().catch(function(err){ console.warn("Autoplay blocked:", err); });

  }else if(data.youtubeId){

    document.getElementById("playerWrap").innerHTML = "<div id='ytPlayerTarget' style='width:100%;height:100%;'></div>";

    const createPlayer = () => {
      ytPlayer = new YT.Player('ytPlayerTarget', {
        videoId: data.youtubeId,
        playerVars: { modestbranding: 1, rel: 0, autoplay: 1 },
        events: {
          onStateChange: (event) => {
            if(event.data === YT.PlayerState.ENDED){
              handleVideoEnded();
            }
          }
        }
      });
    };

    if(ytApiReady){
      createPlayer();
    }else{
      const waitForApi = setInterval(() => {
        if(ytApiReady){
          clearInterval(waitForApi);
          createPlayer();
        }
      }, 200);
    }

  }else{
    document.getElementById("playerWrap").innerHTML =
      "<div style='display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:100%;color:#5F6270;font-size:13px;'>Video unavailable</div>";
  }

}

async function loadVideoById(id, pushHistory){

  try{

    const url = API_BASE + "/api/musicVideo?id=" + encodeURIComponent(id) + (currentUser ? "&userId=" + encodeURIComponent(currentUser.uid) : "");
    const res = await fetch(url);
    const data = await res.json();

    if(!res.ok){
      document.getElementById("videoTitle").innerText = "Video not found.";
      return;
    }

    currentVideo = data;
    videoId = id;
    if(pushHistory){
      window.history.replaceState({}, "", "/music/watch.html?v=" + id + (queueMode ? "&q=1" : ""));
    }
    SBM.track(data);

    buildPlayer(data);
    sbMiniReset(data);

    document.getElementById("videoTitle").innerText = data.title;
    document.getElementById("videoArtist").innerText = data.artist || "SayBon Music";
    document.getElementById("videoGenre").innerText = data.genre;
    document.getElementById("viewsCount").innerText = data.views + " views";
    document.getElementById("likeCount").innerText = data.likeCount;

    document.getElementById("likeBtn").classList.toggle("liked", !!data.userHasLiked);

    if(data.description){
      document.getElementById("videoDescription").style.display = "block";
      document.getElementById("videoDescription").innerText = data.description;
    }else{
      document.getElementById("videoDescription").style.display = "none";
    }

    fetch(API_BASE + "/api/musicIncrementView", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ videoId: id })
    });

    loadSide(data);
    loadComments(id);

  }catch(err){
    document.getElementById("videoTitle").innerText = "Could not load this video.";
  }

}

/* ---- keep playing while you browse: mini player + in-page layer for other pages ---- */
var miniDismissed = false, overlayOpen = false;
function sbMiniReset(d){
  miniDismissed = false;
  var mt = document.getElementById("miniT"); if(mt) mt.textContent = (d && d.title) || "Now playing";
  try{
    if(d && "mediaSession" in navigator){
      var img = d.thumbnailUrl || (d.youtubeId ? "https://img.youtube.com/vi/" + d.youtubeId + "/hqdefault.jpg" : "");
      navigator.mediaSession.metadata = new MediaMetadata({ title: d.title || "", artist: d.artist || "SayBon Music", album: d.genre || "SayBon Music", artwork: img ? [{ src: img, sizes: "480x360" }] : [] });
    }
  }catch(e){}
}
function sbPlaying(){
  try{
    if(htmlVideoEl) return !htmlVideoEl.paused && !htmlVideoEl.ended;
    if(ytPlayer && ytPlayer.getPlayerState) return ytPlayer.getPlayerState() === 1;
  }catch(e){}
  return false;
}
function sbActive(){
  try{
    if(htmlVideoEl) return !htmlVideoEl.ended && (htmlVideoEl.currentTime > 0 || !htmlVideoEl.paused);
    if(ytPlayer && ytPlayer.getPlayerState){ var s = ytPlayer.getPlayerState(); return s === 1 || s === 2 || s === 3; }
  }catch(e){}
  return false;
}
(function(){
  var slot = document.getElementById("playerSlot"), wrap = document.getElementById("playerWrap");
  var ov = document.getElementById("sbmOverlay"), fr = document.getElementById("sbmFrame");
  if(!slot || !wrap || !ov || !fr) return;
  var visible = true;
  function setMini(on){ wrap.classList.toggle("mini", on); slot.classList.toggle("is-mini", on); }
  function updateMini(){
    var want = overlayOpen ? (sbActive() && !miniDismissed) : (!visible && !miniDismissed && sbPlaying());
    if(want !== wrap.classList.contains("mini")) setMini(want);
  }
  if("IntersectionObserver" in window){
    new IntersectionObserver(function(es){ visible = es[0].intersectionRatio > 0.3; updateMini(); }, { threshold: [0, 0.3, 0.6] }).observe(slot);
  }
  setInterval(updateMini, 700);
  function stopPlayback(){ try{ if(htmlVideoEl) htmlVideoEl.pause(); else if(ytPlayer && ytPlayer.pauseVideo) ytPlayer.pauseVideo(); }catch(e){} }
  function closeOverlay(){
    if(!overlayOpen) return;
    overlayOpen = false; ov.hidden = true; document.body.classList.remove("sbm-ov");
    try{ fr.src = "about:blank"; }catch(e){}
    updateMini();
  }
  function openOverlay(url){
    overlayOpen = true; document.body.classList.add("sbm-ov"); ov.hidden = false; fr.src = url; updateMini();
  }
  function toWatch(u){
    var v = u.searchParams.get("v");
    closeOverlay();
    if(v){ queueMode = u.searchParams.get("q") === "1"; if(v !== videoId) loadVideoById(v, true); }
    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
  }
  document.getElementById("miniExpand").onclick = function(){
    if(overlayOpen){ closeOverlay(); window.scrollTo(0, 0); }
    else slot.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" });
  };
  document.getElementById("miniClose").onclick = function(){ miniDismissed = true; stopPlayback(); updateMini(); };
  fr.addEventListener("load", function(){
    try{
      var w = fr.contentWindow;
      if(!w || w.location.href === "about:blank") return;
      if(w.location.pathname === "/music/watch.html"){ toWatch(new URL(w.location.href)); return; }
      if(w.navigation && w.navigation.addEventListener){
        w.navigation.addEventListener("navigate", function(e){
          try{
            var u = new URL(e.destination.url);
            if(u.origin === location.origin && u.pathname === "/music/watch.html" && e.cancelable && e.navigationType !== "traverse"){ e.preventDefault(); toWatch(u); }
          }catch(err){}
        });
      }
    }catch(err){}
  });
  /* Chrome / Edge: going to another page keeps this page (and the video) alive and shows the new page on top */
  if(window.navigation && window.navigation.addEventListener){
    var syncing = false;
    window.navigation.addEventListener("navigate", function(e){
      try{
        if(syncing || !e.canIntercept || e.hashChange || e.downloadRequest !== null || e.formData || e.navigationType === "reload") return;
        var u = new URL(e.destination.url);
        if(u.origin !== location.origin) return;
        if(e.navigationType === "traverse"){
          if(overlayOpen && u.pathname === "/music/watch.html"){ e.intercept({ handler: function(){ closeOverlay(); return Promise.resolve(); } }); }
          return;
        }
        if(u.pathname === location.pathname) return;
        if(!sbActive()) return;
        var host = location.href;
        e.intercept({ handler: function(){
          syncing = true; try{ history.replaceState(history.state, "", host); }catch(err){} syncing = false;
          if(u.pathname === "/music/watch.html"){ toWatch(u); } else { openOverlay(u.href); }
          return Promise.resolve();
        } });
      }catch(err){}
    });
  }
})();

function loadVideo(){
  if(!videoId){
    document.getElementById("videoTitle").innerText = "No video specified.";
    return;
  }
  loadVideoById(videoId, false);
}

function upNextThumb(v){
  var inner;
  if(v.thumbnailUrl) inner = "<img class='un-thumb' src='" + v.thumbnailUrl + "'>";
  else if(v.youtubeId) inner = "<img class='un-thumb' src='https://img.youtube.com/vi/" + v.youtubeId + "/hqdefault.jpg'>";
  else inner = "<div class='un-thumb-fallback'></div>";
  return "<div class='un-wrap'>" + inner + "</div>";
}

async function loadSide(data){

  const all = await SBM.getAll();
  const list = document.getElementById("upNextList");
  const heading = document.getElementById("sideHeading");
  const q = SBM.getQueue();
  const inQueue = queueMode && q && q.ids.indexOf(data.id) > -1;
  const m = SBM.byId(all);

  let shown, order;

  if(inQueue){
    order = q.ids.filter(i => m[i]).map(i => m[i]);
    shown = order;
    heading.innerText = "Playing: " + q.title;
  }else{
    queueMode = false;
    const sim = SBM.similar(data, all, 12);
    order = [{ id: data.id }].concat(sim);
    shown = sim;
    heading.innerText = "More like this";
  }

  upNextQueue = order;

  if(!shown.length){
    list.innerHTML = "<div class='empty-note'>No other videos yet.</div>";
    return;
  }

  list.innerHTML = "";

  shown.forEach((v,i) => {
    const row = document.createElement("div");
    row.className = "up-next-row" + (v.id === data.id ? " now-playing" : "");
    if(v.id === data.id) row.style.cssText = "background:rgba(212,175,106,.14);border-radius:10px;";
    row.onclick = () => { if(v.id !== data.id) loadVideoById(v.id, true); };
    row.innerHTML =
      upNextThumb(v) +
      "<div><div class='un-title'>" + SBM.esc(v.title) + "</div><div class='un-sub'>" + SBM.esc(v.artist||"SayBon Music") + " · " + (v.views||0) + " views</div></div>";
    attachHoverPreview(row, v);
    list.appendChild(row);
  });

}


function attachHoverPreview(row, v){
  var wrap = row.querySelector(".un-wrap");
  if(!wrap || (!v.fileUrl && !v.youtubeId)) return;
  var timer = null, prev = null;
  function stop(){
    clearTimeout(timer);
    if(prev){ try{ if(prev.pause) prev.pause(); }catch(e){} prev.remove(); prev = null; }
  }
  row.addEventListener("mouseenter", function(){
    if(row.classList.contains("now-playing")) return;
    timer = setTimeout(function(){
      if(v.fileUrl){
        prev = document.createElement("video");
        prev.className = "un-prev";
        prev.muted = true; prev.defaultMuted = true; prev.loop = true; prev.playsInline = true;
        prev.setAttribute("muted",""); prev.preload = "auto";
        prev.src = v.fileUrl;
        wrap.appendChild(prev);
        var pr = prev.play(); if(pr && pr.catch) pr.catch(function(){});
      }else{
        prev = document.createElement("iframe");
        prev.className = "un-prev";
        prev.allow = "autoplay";
        prev.src = "https://www.youtube.com/embed/" + v.youtubeId + "?autoplay=1&mute=1&controls=0&modestbranding=1&rel=0&playsinline=1&loop=1&playlist=" + v.youtubeId;
        wrap.appendChild(prev);
      }
    }, 300);
  });
  row.addEventListener("mouseleave", stop);
  row.addEventListener("click", stop);
}

window.loadVideoById = loadVideoById;

document.getElementById("likeBtn").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  const realUser = auth.currentUser;
  if(!realUser){
    alert("Please sign in to react to videos.");
    return;
  }
  const btn = document.getElementById("likeBtn");
  const countEl = document.getElementById("likeCount");
  if(btn.dataset.busy) return;
  btn.dataset.busy = "1";
  try{
    const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/musicToggleReaction", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ videoId: currentVideo.id, userId: realUser.uid })
    });
    const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
    if(!res.ok || typeof data.liked !== "boolean") throw new Error(data.error || "not saved");
    const before = Number(countEl.innerText) || 0;
    SBM.setLiked(currentVideo.id, data.liked);
    btn.classList.toggle("liked", data.liked);
    countEl.innerText = (typeof data.likeCount === "number") ? data.likeCount : Math.max(0, before + (data.liked ? 1 : -1));
  }catch(err){
    alert("Could not save your like. Please try again.");
  }finally{
    delete btn.dataset.busy;
  }
});
async function loadComments(id){

  const idToUse = id || videoId;
  if(!idToUse) return;

  const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/musicComments?videoId=" + encodeURIComponent(idToUse));
  const comments = await res.json();

  const list = document.getElementById("commentsList");

  if(!comments.length){
    list.innerHTML = "<div class='empty-note'>No comments yet. Be the first to say something.</div>";
    return;
  }

  list.innerHTML = "";

  comments.forEach((c,i) => {
    const div = document.createElement("div");
    div.className = "comment cascade-card";
    div.style.animationDelay = (i * 0.05) + "s";
    div.innerHTML =
      (c.userPhoto ? "<img class='comment-avatar' src='" + c.userPhoto + "'>" : "<div class='comment-avatar'></div>") +
      "<div class='comment-body'>" +
        "<div class='comment-name'>" + c.userName + "</div>" +
        "<div class='comment-text'>" + c.text.replace(/</g,"&lt;") + "</div>" +
      "</div>";
    list.appendChild(div);
  });

}

window.postComment = async function(){

  const errorEl = document.getElementById("commentError");
  errorEl.style.display = "none";

  const realUser = auth.currentUser || currentUser;

  if(!realUser){
    errorEl.innerText = "Please sign in to comment.";
    errorEl.style.display = "block";
    return;
  }

  if(!currentVideo || !currentVideo.id){
    errorEl.innerText = "Video not loaded yet - please wait a moment and try again.";
    errorEl.style.display = "block";
    return;
  }

  const text = document.getElementById("commentInput").value.trim();
  if(!text) return;

  const btn = document.getElementById("postCommentBtn");
  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.innerText = "Posting...";

  try{

    const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/musicAddComment", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        videoId: currentVideo.id,
        userId: realUser.uid,
        userName: realUser.displayName || "SayBon User",
        userPhoto: realUser.photoURL || "",
        text
      })
    });

    if(res.ok){
      document.getElementById("commentInput").value = "";
      loadComments(currentVideo.id);
    }else{
      const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      errorEl.innerText = data.error || "Could not post your comment. Please try again.";
      errorEl.style.display = "block";
    }

  }catch(err){
    errorEl.innerText = "Could not reach the server. Please try again.";
    errorEl.style.display = "block";
  }finally{
    btn.disabled = false;
    btn.innerText = "Post";
  }

}

window.openPlaylistModal = async function(){

  const realUser = auth.currentUser || currentUser;

  if(!realUser){
    alert("Please sign in to use playlists.");
    return;
  }

  const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/musicPlaylists?userId=" + encodeURIComponent(realUser.uid));
  const playlists = await res.json();

  const list = document.getElementById("playlistList");

  if(!playlists.length){
    list.innerHTML = "<div class='empty-note'>You don't have any playlists yet.</div>";
  }else{
    list.innerHTML = "";
    playlists.forEach(p => {
      const item = document.createElement("div");
      item.className = "playlist-item";
      item.innerText = p.name + " (" + p.videoIds.length + ")";
      item.onclick = () => addToPlaylist(p.id);
      list.appendChild(item);
    });
  }

  document.getElementById("playlistModal").style.display = "flex";

}

document.getElementById("playlistBtn").addEventListener("click", () => window.openPlaylistModal());

async function addToPlaylist(playlistId){
  const realUser = auth.currentUser || currentUser;
  try{
    const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/musicAddToPlaylist", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ playlistId, videoId: currentVideo.id, userId: realUser ? realUser.uid : undefined })
    });
    const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
    if(!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || ("server said " + res.status));
    document.getElementById("playlistModal").style.display = "none";
    alert("Added to playlist.");
    return true;
  }catch(err){
    alert("Could not add to the playlist: " + err.message);
    return false;
  }
}

window.createAndAdd = async function(){
  const realUser = auth.currentUser || currentUser;
  if(!realUser){ alert("Please sign in to use playlists."); return; }
  const input = document.getElementById("newPlaylistName");
  const name = input.value.trim();
  if(!name){ alert("Type a name for the playlist first."); return; }
  try{
    const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/musicCreatePlaylist", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ userId: realUser.uid, name })
    });
    const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
    if(!res.ok || !data.id) throw new Error(data.error || ("server said " + res.status));
    input.value = "";
    await addToPlaylist(data.id);
  }catch(err){
    alert("Could not create the playlist: " + err.message);
  }
};

</script>

=== \public\placement\placement.js ===
console.log("placement.js loaded");

/* ==================================================
   QUESTION BANK - grouped by CEFR level
   The test now runs as ONE continuous sequence through
   all 30 questions - no visible pass/fail, no stopping.
   The test-taker just answers question after question
   with real-time right/wrong feedback and a running score.

   The actual confirmed level is calculated BACKSTAGE once
   the test ends (or is stopped early): it is the TOP of
   the longest unbroken run of consecutively PASSED levels
   (3/4-ish correct on that level's full question block).
   This is deliberately stricter than passing any single
   level - randomly guessing 3/4 on one level is roughly a
   5% chance, but doing it on three levels in a row by pure
   luck is closer to 1 in 7,700.
================================================== */

  { id: 106, level: "C1", type: "oral", prompt: "Say: Il faut que tu sois à  l'heure", expectedText: "Il faut que tu sois à  l'heure" }

function shuffleOptions(q){
  const correctText = q.options[q.correct];
  for(let i = q.options.length - 1; i > 0; i--){
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    const tmp = q.options[i];
    q.options[i] = q.options[j];
    q.options[j] = tmp;
  }
  q.correct = q.options.indexOf(correctText);
}

questions.forEach(q => {
  if (q.type === "mc" && !q.image) shuffleOptions(q);
});

const scoreDisplay = document.createElement("div");
scoreDisplay.id = "scoreDisplay";
scoreDisplay.className = "score-pill";
progressLabel.insertAdjacentElement("afterend", scoreDisplay);

function updateScoreDisplay(){
  scoreDisplay.textContent = "Score: " + correctSoFar + " / " + (currentIndex + 1);
}

function typePrompt(text, onDone){
  promptEl.textContent = "";
  const cursor = document.createElement("span");
  cursor.className = "prompt-cursor";
  promptEl.appendChild(cursor);

  let i = 0;
  const speed = 28;

  function step(){
    if(i < text.length){
      cursor.insertAdjacentText("beforebegin", text.charAt(i));
      i++;
      setTimeout(step, speed);
    } else {
      setTimeout(() => {
        cursor.remove();
        if(typeof onDone === "function") onDone();
      }, 400);
    }
  }
  step();
}

function updateProgress(){
  const pct = ((currentIndex + 1) / questions.length) * 100;
  progressBar.style.width = pct + "%";
  progressLabel.textContent = "Question " + (currentIndex + 1) + " of " + questions.length;
}

function normalizeAnswer(str){
  return (str || "").trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[.!?]+$/, "");
}

function buildAccentKeyboard(targetInput){
  const wrap = document.createElement("div");
  wrap.style.marginTop = "10px";
  wrap.style.display = "flex";
  wrap.style.flexWrap = "wrap";
  wrap.style.gap = "6px";

  accentChars.forEach(ch => {
    const key = document.createElement("span");
    key.textContent = ch;
    key.style.display = "inline-block";
    key.style.padding = "6px 11px";
    key.style.borderRadius = "7px";
    key.style.cursor = "pointer";
    key.style.background = "rgba(0,0,0,.06)";
    key.style.fontSize = "15px";
    key.onclick = () => {
      const start = targetInput.selectionStart;
      const end = targetInput.selectionEnd;
      const val = targetInput.value;
      targetInput.value = val.slice(0, start) + ch + val.slice(end);
      targetInput.selectionStart = targetInput.selectionEnd = start + ch.length;
      targetInput.focus();
    };
    wrap.appendChild(key);
  });

  return wrap;
}

    ".sb-meta{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:rgba(255,255,255,.8);letter-spacing:.02em;}" +
    ".sb-replay{flex:0 0 auto;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:#fff;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0;}" +

function buildAudioPlayer(src){
  ensurePlayerStyles();
  const wrap = document.createElement("div");
  wrap.className = "sb-player sb-loading";
  wrap.innerHTML =
    '<button type="button" class="sb-play" aria-label="Play audio">' +
      '<svg class="sb-ico-play" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M8 5.5v13a1 1 0 0 0 1.5.86l10.5-6.5a1 1 0 0 0 0-1.72L9.5 4.64A1 1 0 0 0 8 5.5z"/></svg>' +
      '<svg class="sb-ico-pause" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="6" y="5" width="4.5" height="14" rx="1.2"/><rect x="13.5" y="5" width="4.5" height="14" rx="1.2"/></svg>' +
    '</button>' +
    '<div class="sb-mid"><div class="sb-track" role="slider" aria-label="Audio position"><div class="sb-fill"></div><div class="sb-knob"></div></div>' +
    '<div class="sb-meta"><span class="sb-time">0:00</span><span class="sb-status"></span><span class="sb-dur">0:00</span></div></div>' +
    '<button type="button" class="sb-replay" aria-label="Replay from the start"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3.5 12a8.5 8.5 0 1 0 2.6-6.1"/><path d="M3.5 4v5h5"/></svg></button>';

  const audio = new Audio();
  audio.preload = "auto";
  audio.src = src;
  const playBtn = wrap.querySelector(".sb-play");
  const replayBtn = wrap.querySelector(".sb-replay");
  const track = wrap.querySelector(".sb-track");
  const fill = wrap.querySelector(".sb-fill");
  const knob = wrap.querySelector(".sb-knob");
  const timeEl = wrap.querySelector(".sb-time");
  const durEl = wrap.querySelector(".sb-dur");
  const fmt = (s) => { s = Math.max(0, Math.floor(s || 0)); return Math.floor(s / 60) + ":" + String(s % 60).padStart(2, "0"); };

  function paint(){
    const d = audio.duration;
    const f = (d && isFinite(d)) ? Math.min(1, audio.currentTime / d) : 0;
    fill.style.width = (f * 100) + "%";
    knob.style.left = (f * 100) + "%";
    timeEl.textContent = fmt(audio.currentTime);
    if (d && isFinite(d)) durEl.textContent = fmt(d);
  }
  function start(){
    if (activeClipAudio && activeClipAudio !== audio) { try { activeClipAudio.pause(); } catch(e){} }
    activeClipAudio = audio;
    if (wrap.classList.contains("sb-error")) { wrap.classList.remove("sb-error"); wrap.classList.add("sb-loading"); audio.load(); }
    const p = audio.play();
    if (p && p.catch) p.catch(() => {});
  }
  playBtn.addEventListener("click", () => { if (audio.paused) start(); else audio.pause(); });
  replayBtn.addEventListener("click", () => { try { audio.currentTime = 0; } catch(e){} start(); });
  function seekTo(clientX){
    const d = audio.duration;
    if (!d || !isFinite(d)) return;
    const r = track.getBoundingClientRect();
    const f = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (clientX - r.left) / r.width));
    audio.currentTime = f * d;
    paint();
  }
  let dragging = false;
  track.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => { dragging = true; try { track.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch(_){} seekTo(e.clientX); });
  track.addEventListener("pointermove", (e) => { if (dragging) seekTo(e.clientX); });
  track.addEventListener("pointerup", () => { dragging = false; });
  track.addEventListener("pointercancel", () => { dragging = false; });

  audio.addEventListener("loadedmetadata", paint);
  audio.addEventListener("canplay", () => { wrap.classList.remove("sb-loading"); paint(); });
  audio.addEventListener("timeupdate", paint);
  audio.addEventListener("play", () => { wrap.classList.add("sb-playing"); playBtn.setAttribute("aria-label", "Pause audio"); });
  audio.addEventListener("pause", () => { wrap.classList.remove("sb-playing"); playBtn.setAttribute("aria-label", "Play audio"); });
  audio.addEventListener("ended", () => { wrap.classList.remove("sb-playing"); playBtn.setAttribute("aria-label", "Play audio"); try { audio.currentTime = 0; } catch(e){} paint(); });
  audio.addEventListener("error", () => { wrap.classList.remove("sb-loading", "sb-playing"); wrap.classList.add("sb-error"); });
  return wrap;
}

function loadQuestion() {
  const q = questions[currentIndex];
  if (activeClipAudio) { try { activeClipAudio.pause(); } catch(e){} }

  optionsEl.innerHTML = "";
  optionsEl.classList.remove("options-ready");
  mediaArea.innerHTML = "";

  updateProgress();
  updateScoreDisplay();

  typePrompt(q.prompt, () => {

    if (q.clip || q.audio) {
      mediaArea.appendChild(buildAudioPlayer(q.clip ? CLIP_BASE + q.clip : q.audio));
    }

    if (q.image) {
      const img = document.createElement("img");
      img.src = q.image;
      img.className = "question-image";
      mediaArea.appendChild(img);
    }

    if (q.type === "oral") {

      const oralWrap = document.createElement("div");
      oralWrap.innerHTML =
        '<canvas id="oralWaveCanvas" class="oral-wave-canvas" width="280" height="56" style="display:none;"></canvas>' +
        '<div class="oral-record-row">' +
        '<button class="option oral-record-btn" id="oralRecordBtn">● Record</button>' +
        '<span class="oral-record-status" id="oralRecordStatus">Not recorded yet</span>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="oral-playback-row" id="oralPlaybackRow" style="display:none;">' +
        '<button class="option oral-secondary-btn" id="oralPlayBtn">&#9658; Play My Recording</button>' +
        '<button class="option oral-secondary-btn" id="oralRerecordBtn">&#8635; Re-record</button>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<audio id="oralPlaybackAudio" style="display:none;"></audio>' +
        '<div id="oralFeedback" class="oral-feedback" style="display:none;"></div>' +
        '<div class="oral-btn-row"><button class="option" id="oralSubmitBtn" disabled>Submit</button></div>';
      optionsEl.appendChild(oralWrap);

      setupOralRecording();

      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        optionsEl.classList.add("options-ready");
      });

      return;
    }

    if (q.type === "typed") {

      const input = document.createElement("input");
      input.type = "text";
      input.placeholder = "Type your answer";
      input.style.width = "100%";
      input.style.padding = "12px 14px";
      input.style.fontSize = "15px";
      input.style.borderRadius = "10px";
      input.style.border = "1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.2)";
      input.style.boxSizing = "border-box";
      optionsEl.appendChild(input);

      optionsEl.appendChild(buildAccentKeyboard(input));

      const feedbackMsg = document.createElement("div");
      feedbackMsg.id = "typedFeedbackMsg";
      feedbackMsg.style.cssText = "margin-top:8px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;min-height:18px;";
      optionsEl.appendChild(feedbackMsg);

      const submitBtn = document.createElement("button");
      submitBtn.className = "option";
      submitBtn.id = "typedSubmitBtn";
      submitBtn.textContent = "Submit Answer";
      submitBtn.style.marginTop = "14px";
      submitBtn.onclick = () => answerTyped(input.value);
      optionsEl.appendChild(submitBtn);

      input.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
        if (e.key === "Enter") answerTyped(input.value);
      });

      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        optionsEl.classList.add("options-ready");
        input.focus();
      });

      return;

    }

    q.options.forEach((opt, i) => {
      const btn = document.createElement("button");
      btn.className = "option";
      btn.style.animationDelay = (i * 0.12) + "s";
      btn.textContent = opt;
      btn.onclick = () => answer(i, btn);
      optionsEl.appendChild(btn);
    });

    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      optionsEl.classList.add("options-ready");
    });

  });
}

/* ==================================================
   REAL-TIME FEEDBACK + RESULT HANDLING
================================================== */

function recordLevelResult(level, isCorrect){
  if(!levelResults[level]) levelResults[level] = { correct: 0, total: 0 };
  levelResults[level].total++;
  if(isCorrect) levelResults[level].correct++;
}

function registerResult(isCorrect){

  const q = questions[currentIndex];
  recordLevelResult(q.level, isCorrect);

  if(isCorrect){
    correctSoFar++;
    consecutiveWrong = 0;
  }else{
    consecutiveWrong++;
    cumulativeWrong++;
  }

  updateScoreDisplay();

  const disableInputs = () => {
    optionsEl.querySelectorAll("button, input").forEach(el => el.disabled = true);
  };
  disableInputs();

  setTimeout(() => {

    if(consecutiveWrong >= CONSECUTIVE_WRONG_THRESHOLD || cumulativeWrong >= CUMULATIVE_WRONG_THRESHOLD){
      triggerIntervention();
      return;
    }

    advance();

  }, FEEDBACK_PAUSE_MS);

}

function celebrateAnswer(isCorrect, originEl){
  scoreDisplay.classList.remove("score-flash-correct", "score-flash-wrong");
  void scoreDisplay.offsetWidth;
  scoreDisplay.classList.add(isCorrect ? "score-flash-correct" : "score-flash-wrong");

  if(isCorrect && originEl){
    const originRect = originEl.getBoundingClientRect();
    const targetRect = scoreDisplay.getBoundingClientRect();

    const flyEl = document.createElement("div");
    flyEl.className = "score-fly-plus-one";
    flyEl.textContent = "+1";
    flyEl.style.left = (originRect.left + originRect.width / 2) + "px";
    flyEl.style.top = (originRect.top + originRect.height / 2) + "px";
    document.body.appendChild(flyEl);

    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      flyEl.style.left = (targetRect.left + targetRect.width / 2) + "px";
      flyEl.style.top = (targetRect.top + targetRect.height / 2) + "px";
      flyEl.style.transform = "translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.6)";
      flyEl.style.opacity = "0";
    });

    setTimeout(() => flyEl.remove(), 850);
  }
}

function answer(choice, clickedBtn) {
  const q = questions[currentIndex];
  const isCorrect = choice === q.correct;

  const allButtons = optionsEl.querySelectorAll("button.option");
  if(isCorrect){
    clickedBtn.classList.add("option-correct");
  }else{
    clickedBtn.classList.add("option-wrong");
    allButtons.forEach((b, i) => {
      if(i === q.correct){
        b.classList.add("option-correct");
      }
    });
  }

  celebrateAnswer(isCorrect, clickedBtn);
  registerResult(isCorrect);
}

function answerTyped(userInput) {
  const q = questions[currentIndex];
  const normalized = normalizeAnswer(userInput);
  const isCorrect = q.acceptableAnswers.some(a => normalizeAnswer(a) === normalized);

  const msg = document.getElementById("typedFeedbackMsg");
  if(msg){
    if(isCorrect){
      msg.textContent = "Correct!";
      msg.style.color = "#22c55e";
    }else{
      msg.textContent = "Not quite - accepted answer: " + q.acceptableAnswers[0];
      msg.style.color = "#ef4444";
    }
  }

  const submitBtn = document.getElementById("typedSubmitBtn");
  if(submitBtn){
    submitBtn.classList.add(isCorrect ? "option-correct" : "option-wrong");
  }
  celebrateAnswer(isCorrect, submitBtn);

  registerResult(isCorrect);
}
