var oralEncourageMessages = ["Good effort - keep going!", "Nice try - onward!", "That's alright, you're making progress!"];

// ===== WAV encoding (proven pattern already working in Talkletics) =====
function encodeWAV(samples, sampleRate){
  var buffer = new ArrayBuffer(44 + samples.length * 2);
  var view = new DataView(buffer);
  function writeString(offset, str){
    for(var i=0;i<str.length;i++) view.setUint8(offset+i, str.charCodeAt(i));
  }
  writeString(0,"RIFF");
  view.setUint32(4, 36 + samples.length*2, true);
  writeString(8,"WAVE");
  writeString(12,"fmt ");
  view.setUint32(16,16,true);
  view.setUint16(20,1,true);
  view.setUint16(22,1,true);
  view.setUint32(24,sampleRate,true);
  view.setUint32(28,sampleRate*2,true);
  view.setUint16(32,2,true);
  view.setUint16(34,16,true);
  writeString(36,"data");
  view.setUint32(40, samples.length*2, true);
  var offset = 44;
  for(var i=0;i<samples.length;i++, offset+=2){
    var s = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, samples[i]));
    view.setInt16(offset, s<0 ? s*0x8000 : s*0x7FFF, true);
  }
  return buffer;
}

async function convertOralBlobToWav(blob){
  var arrayBuffer = await blob.arrayBuffer();
  var audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
  var decoded = await audioCtx.decodeAudioData(arrayBuffer);
  var offlineCtx = new OfflineAudioContext(1, Math.ceil(decoded.duration * 16000), 16000);
  var source = offlineCtx.createBufferSource();
  source.buffer = decoded;
  source.connect(offlineCtx.destination);
  source.start(0);
  var rendered = await offlineCtx.startRendering();
  var wavBuffer = encodeWAV(rendered.getChannelData(0), 16000);
  audioCtx.close();
  var ch = rendered.getChannelData(0), peak = 0;
  for(var pi = 0; pi < ch.length; pi += 8){ var av = Math.abs(ch[pi]); if(av > peak) peak = av; }
  var outBlob = new Blob([wavBuffer], { type: "audio/wav" });
  outBlob._peak = peak;
  outBlob._dur = decoded.duration;
  return outBlob;
}

function oralRecordingTooQuiet(blob){
  if(!blob || blob.size < 6000) return true;
  if(typeof blob._peak === "number" && blob._peak < 0.012) return true;
  return false;
}

function oralRetryUi(message){
  var btn = document.getElementById("oralRecordBtn");
  var status = document.getElementById("oralRecordStatus");
  oralRecordedBlob = null;
  if(btn){ btn.style.display = "inline-block"; btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = "\u25CF  Record"; }
  document.getElementById("oralPlaybackRow").style.display = "none";
  document.getElementById("oralSubmitBtn").disabled = true;
  if(status) status.textContent = message;
}

function startOralWave(streamOrElement, isElement){
  var canvas = document.getElementById("oralWaveCanvas");
  var ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  canvas.style.display = "block";
  if(!oralAudioCtx){
    oralAudioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
  }
  var analyser = oralAudioCtx.createAnalyser();
  analyser.fftSize = 64;

  if(isElement){
    if(!streamOrElement._oralWaveSource){
      streamOrElement._oralWaveSource = oralAudioCtx.createMediaElementSource(streamOrElement);
      streamOrElement._oralWaveSource.connect(oralAudioCtx.destination);
    }
    streamOrElement._oralWaveSource.connect(analyser);
  } else {
    var source = oralAudioCtx.createMediaStreamSource(streamOrElement);
    source.connect(analyser);
  }

  var bufferLength = analyser.frequencyBinCount;
  var dataArray = new Uint8Array(bufferLength);

  function draw(){
    oralWaveAnimId = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    var barWidth = (canvas.width / bufferLength) * 1.8;
    var x = 0;
    for(var i = 0; i < bufferLength; i++){
      var barHeight = (dataArray[i] / 255) * canvas.height;
      ctx.fillStyle = "#5fbf5f";
      ctx.fillRect(x, canvas.height - barHeight, barWidth, barHeight);
      x += barWidth + 2;
    }
  }
  draw();
}

function stopOralWave(){
  if(oralWaveAnimId){
    cancelAnimationFrame(oralWaveAnimId);
    oralWaveAnimId = null;
  }
  var canvas = document.getElementById("oralWaveCanvas");
  if(canvas){
    canvas.getContext("2d").clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    canvas.style.display = "none";
  }
}

function toggleOralRecording(){
  var btn = document.getElementById("oralRecordBtn");
  var status = document.getElementById("oralRecordStatus");

  if(!oralMediaRecorder || oralMediaRecorder.state === "inactive"){
    navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true }).then(function(stream){
      oralCurrentStream = stream;
      oralRecordedChunks = [];
      oralMediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream);
      oralMediaRecorder.ondataavailable = function(e){ oralRecordedChunks.push(e.data); };
      oralMediaRecorder.onstop = function(){ if(window.resumeAppBgMusicAfterRecording){ window.resumeAppBgMusicAfterRecording(); }
        var rawType = (oralMediaRecorder.mimeType) || "audio/webm";
        var rawBlob = new Blob(oralRecordedChunks, { type: rawType });
        stopOralWave();

        var submitBtn = document.getElementById("oralSubmitBtn");
        var status = document.getElementById("oralRecordStatus");
        status.textContent = "Processing recording...";

        convertOralBlobToWav(rawBlob).then(function(wavBlob){
          if(oralRecordingTooQuiet(wavBlob)){
            oralRetryUi("We could not hear anything. Check your microphone, speak a little closer, and record again.");
            return;
          }
          oralRecordedBlob = wavBlob;
          var rBtn = document.getElementById("oralRecordBtn");
          rBtn.style.display = "none";
          rBtn.disabled = false;
          document.getElementById("oralPlaybackRow").style.display = "flex";
          submitBtn.disabled = false;
          status.textContent = "Recording captured";
        }).catch(function(err){
          console.error("WAV conversion failed:", err);
          if(rawBlob.size < 2000){ oralRetryUi("We could not hear anything. Check your microphone and record again."); return; }
          oralRecordedBlob = rawBlob;
          var rBtn2 = document.getElementById("oralRecordBtn");
          rBtn2.style.display = "none";
          rBtn2.disabled = false;
          document.getElementById("oralPlaybackRow").style.display = "flex";
          submitBtn.disabled = false;
          status.textContent = "Recording captured";
        });

        oralCurrentStream.getTracks().forEach(function(t){ t.stop(); });
      };
      if(window.pauseAppBgMusicForRecording){ window.pauseAppBgMusicForRecording(); } oralMediaRecorder.start();
      startOralWave(stream, false);
      btn.textContent = "■  Stop";
      status.textContent = "Recording...";
    }).catch(function(err){
      status.textContent = "Microphone access denied";
      console.error(err);
    });
  } else {
    btn.textContent = "Processing...";
    btn.disabled = true;
    oralMediaRecorder.stop();
  }
}

function playOralRecording(){
  var playBtn = document.getElementById("oralPlayBtn");
  var audioEl = document.getElementById("oralPlaybackAudio");
  var originalLabel = playBtn.innerHTML;
  playBtn.innerHTML = "Loading...";
  playBtn.disabled = true;

  var settled = false;
  var fallbackTimer = setTimeout(function(){
    if(settled) return;
    settled = true;
    playBtn.innerHTML = originalLabel;
    playBtn.disabled = false;
    console.warn("Playback canplay event never fired - fallback triggered");
  }, 3000);

  audioEl.src = URL.createObjectURL(oralRecordedBlob);
  audioEl.load();

  var onReady = function(){
    if(settled) return;
    settled = true;
    clearTimeout(fallbackTimer);
    playBtn.innerHTML = originalLabel;
    playBtn.disabled = false;
    startOralWave(audioEl, true);
    audioEl.currentTime = 0;
    audioEl.play().catch(function(err){ console.error("Playback failed:", err); });
  };

  audioEl.addEventListener("canplay", onReady, { once: true });
  audioEl.addEventListener("loadeddata", onReady, { once: true });
  audioEl.addEventListener("ended", stopOralWave, { once: true });
}

function reRecordOral(){
  oralRecordedBlob = null;
  document.getElementById("oralPlaybackRow").style.display = "none";
  var btn = document.getElementById("oralRecordBtn");
  btn.style.display = "inline-block";
  btn.textContent = "● Record";
  btn.disabled = false;
  document.getElementById("oralRecordStatus").textContent = "Not recorded yet";
  document.getElementById("oralSubmitBtn").disabled = true;
}

function submitOralRecording(){
  var q = questions[currentIndex];
  var submitBtn = document.getElementById("oralSubmitBtn");
  var feedbackEl = document.getElementById("oralFeedback");

  submitBtn.disabled = true;
  submitBtn.textContent = "Scoring...";

  function failUi(reason){
    feedbackEl.style.display = "block";
    feedbackEl.innerHTML =
      '<div style="font-size:.95rem;margin-bottom:10px;">' + reason + '</div>' +
      '<div class="oral-btn-row"><button class="option" id="oralTryAgainBtn">Try again</button> <button class="option" id="oralSkipBtn">Skip this one</button></div>';
    submitBtn.textContent = "Submit";
    document.getElementById("oralTryAgainBtn").onclick = function(){ feedbackEl.style.display = "none"; reRecordOral(); };
    document.getElementById("oralSkipBtn").onclick = function(){ feedbackEl.style.display = "none"; advance(); };
  }

  fetch("https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com/api/assessPronunciation?referenceText=" + encodeURIComponent(q.expectedText || ""), {
    method: "POST",
    body: oralRecordedBlob
  }).then(function(res){
    return res.json().catch(function(){ return {}; }).then(function(data){ return { ok: res.ok, data: data }; });
  }).then(function(r){
    var data = r.data || {};
    var raw = data.finalScore != null ? data.finalScore : (data.score != null ? data.score : (data.AccuracyScore != null ? data.AccuracyScore : data.accuracyScore));
    if(!r.ok || raw == null){
      failUi(data.error ? String(data.error) : "We could not score that recording. Please try again.");
      return;
    }
    var score = Math.round(Number(raw) || 0);
    var passed = score >= 60;
    var msg = passed
      ? oralPassMessages[Math.floor(Math.random() * oralPassMessages.length)]
      : oralEncourageMessages[Math.floor(Math.random() * oralEncourageMessages.length)];

    if(passed) correctSoFar++;
    updateScoreDisplay();
    celebrateAnswer(passed, submitBtn);

    document.querySelectorAll("#options button").forEach(function(b){ b.disabled = true; });

    feedbackEl.style.display = "block";
    feedbackEl.innerHTML =
      '<div style="font-size:1.6rem;font-weight:800;">' + score + '%</div>' +
      '<div style="font-size:.9rem;margin-top:4px;">' + msg + '</div>';

    setTimeout(function(){
      advance();
    }, 2500);
  }).catch(function(err){
    console.error(err);
    failUi("We could not reach the scoring service. Check your connection and try again.");
  });
}

function advance(){
  currentIndex++;

  if (currentIndex >= questions.length) {
    finish();
    return;
  }

  loadQuestion();
}

/* ==================================================
   BACKSTAGE LEVEL CALCULATION
   The confirmed level is the TOP of the longest unbroken
   run of consecutively passed levels, based on whatever
   has actually been completed - works identically whether
   someone finishes all 30 questions or stops early via
   the intervention screen's Reveal option.
================================================== */

function computeConfirmedLevel(){

  // A level counts as passed when at least 60% of the questions the learner
  // actually answered at that level are correct (and at least 3 were answered,
  // or the whole level if it is shorter). The placement is the highest passed
  // level, as long as every level below it scored at least 50%, so one unlucky
  // slip on an easy level cannot drag a learner down, and a lucky guess at a
  // hard level cannot lift them up.
  let best = -1;

  for(let i = 0; i < levelOrder.length; i++){

    const lvl = levelOrder[i];
    const r = levelResults[lvl];
    const need = Math.min(levelTotalQuestions[lvl], 3);
    const passed = r && r.total >= need && (r.correct / r.total) >= 0.6;
    if(!passed) continue;

    let supported = true;
    for(let j = 0; j < i; j++){
      const lower = levelResults[levelOrder[j]];
      if(!lower || !lower.total || (lower.correct / lower.total) < 0.5){ supported = false; break; }
    }
    if(supported) best = i;

  }

  if(best === -1) return "A0";
  return levelOrder[best];

}

/* ==================================================
   INTERVENTION (encouragement screen)
   Purely a supportive pause - has ZERO effect on the
   confirmed level either way. Continue resets only the
   consecutive-wrong counter (cumulative keeps counting)
   and resumes exactly where the test left off. Reveal
   ends the test early and runs the same backstage
   calculation on whatever was actually completed.
================================================== */

function triggerIntervention() {
  overlay.classList.remove("hidden");

  teacherBox.style.display = "flex";
  actions.style.display = "none";

  continueBtn.classList.remove("slide-in-left", "shimmer");
  revealBtn.classList.remove("slide-in-right", "shimmer");
  continueBtn.style.opacity = "0";
  revealBtn.style.opacity = "0";

  teacherBox.classList.add("slow-bounce");

  setTimeout(() => {
    interventionAudio.currentTime = 0;
    interventionAudio.play().catch(()=>{});
  }, 200);

  interventionAudio.onended = () => {
    teacherBox.classList.remove("slow-bounce");

    actions.style.display = "flex";

    setTimeout(() => {
      continueBtn.classList.add("slide-in-left", "shimmer");
    }, 200);

    setTimeout(() => {
      revealBtn.classList.add("slide-in-right", "shimmer");
    }, 900);
  };
}

continueBtn.onclick = () => {
  overlay.classList.add("hidden");
  consecutiveWrong = 0;
  advance();
};

revealBtn.onclick = () => {
  overlay.classList.add("hidden");
  finish();
};

function finish() {
  const level = computeConfirmedLevel();

  sessionStorage.setItem("saybon_level", level);
  sessionStorage.setItem("saybon_next", "/reveal/");
  window.location.href = "/loader.html";
}

loadQuestion();

function audUrl(it){return "/assets/audio/placement/"+it.id+".mp3"}
function usable(it){
  if(it.speak&&(speechOff||!canRecord()))return Promise.resolve(false);
  var p=[];
  if(it.img)p.push(check(imgUrl(it),"image"));
  if(it.say)p.push(check(audUrl(it),"audio"));
  return Promise.all(p).then(function(a){return a.every(Boolean)});
}
function shuffle(a){a=a.slice();for(var i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){var j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1)),t=a[i];a[i]=a[j];a[j]=t}return a}

/* ---- pick the next question: nearest level with an unseen, usable item ---- */
// Opening staircase, same for everyone, never skipping a level: questions 1-5 are A0, 6-9 are A1, 10-11 are A2.
// After that the test adapts. If a learner got fewer than half of a stage right, they stay at the lower level instead of moving up.
var STAIR=[5,9,11];
function stageLevel(n){
  var lv=n<STAIR[0]?0:n<STAIR[1]?1:n<STAIR[2]?2:-1;
  // strong learners move on early: three correct answers in a row at the current stage end that stage (never skipping a level)
  while(lv>=0&&lv<2){
    var tail=st.log.slice(-3);
    if(tail.length===3&&tail.every(function(l){return l.ok&&l.lv>=lv&&!l.idk})&&st.log.filter(function(l){return l.lv===lv}).length>=3)lv++; else break;
  }
  while(lv>0){
    var prev=st.log.filter(function(l){return l.lv===lv-1&&l.kind!=="speak"||l.lv===lv-1&&l.kind==="speak"});
    if(prev.length&&prev.filter(function(l){return l.ok}).length/prev.length<0.5)lv--; else break;
  }
  return lv;
}
async function nextItem(){
  // rhythm: one special question (oral first, then photo, reading, listening in turn), then two regular ones, and so on
  var noOral=(speechOff||!canRecord())&&!(st.log.length&&st.log[0].kind==="speak"), n=st.log.length+(noOral?3:0), want;
  // special questions: every third at the start (oral, photo), then every second one, so photos and listening come round often
  var SPEC=["speak","picture","listen","picture","listen","speak","picture","read","listen","picture","listen"];
  var special=n===0||(n<6?n%3===0:n%2===0);
  if(special){var idx=st.log.filter(function(l){return l.kind!=="text"}).length+(noOral?1:0);want=SPEC[idx%SPEC.length];if(want==="speak"&&n>0&&st.lv>2)want="picture"}
  else want="text";
  var sl=stageLevel(st.log.length), lv=null;
  if(sl>=0){lv=[sl];if(sl>0)lv.push(sl-1);lv.push(sl+1);if(want==="speak")lv=[0]}
  var f=await pick(false,[want],lv);
  if(f)return f;
  if(want!=="text"){f=await pick(false,["text"],lv);if(f)return f}
  if(lv){f=await pick(false,null,lv);if(f)return f}
  return (await pick(true))||(await pick(false));
}
async function pick(strict,only,lvls){
  var order=[0,-1,1,-2,2,-3,3];
  for(var k=0;k<(lvls?lvls.length:order.length);k++){
    var L=lvls?lvls[k]:st.lv+order[k];
    if(L<0||L>6)continue;
    if(st.n<FRENCH_AFTER&&L>2)continue;   // French-only questions wait until after question 7
    var lk=st.log.length?st.log[st.log.length-1].kind:null;
    var pool=shuffle(ITEMS.filter(function(x){return x.lv===L&&!st.seen[x.id]&&!(strict&&kind(x)===lk)&&(!only||only.indexOf(kind(x))>-1)}));
    // keep a mix: prefer a kind (picture / listening / text) not used in the last two questions
    var last=st.log.slice(-2).map(function(l){return l.kind});
    // variety: favour the kinds used least so far (photo, listening, reading), plain grammar last
    var cnt={};st.log.forEach(function(l){cnt[l.kind]=(cnt[l.kind]||0)+1});
    var lastShapes=st.log.filter(function(l){return l.kind==="text"}).slice(-2).map(function(l){return l.shape});
    var sc=function(x){var k=kind(x);if(k==="text"){var sh=shape(x);return (lastShapes.indexOf(sh)>-1?8:0)+(sh==="fill"?4:0)}return (last.indexOf(k)>-1?10:0)+(cnt[k]||0)};
    pool.sort(function(a,b){return sc(a)-sc(b)});
    for(var i=0;i<pool.length;i++){ if(await usable(pool[i]))return pool[i]; st.seen[pool[i].id]=1; }
  }
  return null;
}
function shape(it){return it.s||(/^Compl/.test(it.q)?"fill":"reply")}
function kind(it){return it.speak?"speak":it.say?"listen":it.img?"picture":it.p?"read":"text"}

/* ---- placement estimate: Bayesian over the seven levels ---- */
function mapLevel(){var m=0;for(var i=1;i<7;i++)if(st.post[i]>st.post[m])m=i;return m}
function conf(){return Math.max.apply(null,st.post)}
function estimate(){return mapLevel()}
function update(L,res){
  var p=st.post.map(function(v,th){return v*lik(th,L,res)}),s=p.reduce(function(a,b){return a+b},0);
  st.post=p.map(function(v){return v/s});
}

/* ---- speaking: hear a line, answer out loud, scored kindly by the server (Azure) ---- */
var SPEAK_API="https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com/api/assessPronunciation", SPEAK_PASS=50, speechOff=false;
function canRecord(){return !!(navigator.mediaDevices&&navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia&&window.MediaRecorder&&(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext))}
function recStart(){
  return navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({audio:{echoCancellation:true,noiseSuppression:true,autoGainControl:true}}).then(function(stream){
    var mr=new MediaRecorder(stream),chunks=[],h={mr:mr,stream:stream};
    mr.ondataavailable=function(ev){if(ev.data&&ev.data.size)chunks.push(ev.data)};
    h.done=new Promise(function(res){mr.onstop=function(){stream.getTracks().forEach(function(t){t.stop()});res(new Blob(chunks,{type:mr.mimeType||"audio/mp4"}))}});
    mr.start();return h;
  });
}
function toWav16(blob){
  return blob.arrayBuffer().then(function(ab){
    var AC=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext,ac=new AC();
    return new Promise(function(res,rej){ac.decodeAudioData(ab,res,rej)}).then(function(buf){
      try{ac.close()}catch(e){}
      var len=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(buf.duration*16000)),oc=new (window.OfflineAudioContext||window.webkitOfflineAudioContext)(1,len,16000);
      var src=oc.createBufferSource();src.buffer=buf;src.connect(oc.destination);src.start(0);
      return new Promise(function(res,rej){var r=oc.startRendering();if(r&&r.then)r.then(res,rej);oc.oncomplete=function(ev){res(ev.renderedBuffer)}});
    });
  }).then(function(out){
    var d=out.getChannelData(0),n=d.length,b=new ArrayBuffer(44+n*2),v=new DataView(b);var pk=0;for(var j=0;j<n;j++){var q=Math.abs(d[j]);if(q>pk)pk=q}var G=(pk>0.004&&pk<0.7)?Math.min(40,0.85/pk):1;
    function s(o,t){for(var i=0;i<t.length;i++)v.setUint8(o+i,t.charCodeAt(i))}
    s(0,"RIFF");v.setUint32(4,36+n*2,true);s(8,"WAVEfmt ");v.setUint32(16,16,true);v.setUint16(20,1,true);v.setUint16(22,1,true);
    v.setUint32(24,16000,true);v.setUint32(28,32000,true);v.setUint16(32,2,true);v.setUint16(34,16,true);s(36,"data");v.setUint32(40,n*2,true);
    for(var i=0;i<n;i++){var x=Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,d[i]*G));v.setInt16(44+i*2,x<0?x*0x8000:x*0x7FFF,true)}
    return new Blob([b],{type:"audio/wav"});
  });
}
/* the same marking curve the lessons use: kind at A0, stricter as the levels climb; a word that sounds like the right word is about 50 */
var LENP={0:{g:.66,f:38},1:{g:.77,f:28},2:{g:.86,f:17},3:{g:.93,f:5},4:{g:.98,f:0},5:{g:1,f:0},6:{g:1,f:0}};
function curveP(raw,lv){var L=LENP[lv]||LENP[1];raw=+raw||0;if(raw<8)return{v:0,heard:false};var v=Math.round(100*Math.pow(Math.min(100,raw)/100,L.g));v=Math.max(v,L.f);return{v:Math.min(100,v),heard:true}}
function askSpeak(it){
  st.cur.shown=[];
  var h='<div class="kick">Question '+(st.n+1)+'</div><div class="body"><h1>'+esc(it.q)+'</h1>'+
   '<div class="avatar" id="av"><img alt="" src="/assets/images/placement/teacher_head.png"></div>'+
   '<p class="hint spk" id="spk">&nbsp;</p>'+
   '<button class="snd" id="snd" style="display:none"><i>▶</i> Tap to hear me</button>'+'<button class="snd" id="slow2" type="button"><i>▶</i> Listen slower</button>'+
   '<div class="opts"><button class="opt idk" data-i="-1">I can\'t speak now</button></div></div>';
  $("card").innerHTML=h; $("card").classList.remove("wide");
  var a=$("qAud"),av=$("av"),msg=$("spk"),snd=$("snd"),tries=0,gone=false,stopRec=null;
  function say(t){msg.textContent=t}
  function skip(){gone=true;speechOff=true;st.seen[it.id]=1;ask()}
  function listen(rate){
    rate=(typeof rate==="number")?rate:1;try{a.pause()}catch(e){}
    snd.style.display="none";av.classList.remove("rec");av.classList.add("talk");say("Listen…");
    a.onended=function(){a.onended=null;av.classList.remove("talk");if(!gone)respond()};
    a.onerror=function(){a.onerror=null;av.classList.remove("talk");skip()};
    a.defaultPlaybackRate=rate;a.src=audUrl(it);a.playbackRate=rate;try{a.preservesPitch=true;a.webkitPreservesPitch=true}catch(e){}a.currentTime=0;
    var pr=a.play();
    if(pr&&pr.catch)pr.catch(function(){av.classList.remove("talk");say("Tap to hear me");snd.style.display="";});
  }
  function score(blob){
    return toWav16(blob).then(function(wav){
      var ctl=new AbortController(),to=setTimeout(function(){ctl.abort()},45000);
      return fetch(SPEAK_API+"?referenceText="+encodeURIComponent(it.speak),{method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"audio/wav"},body:wav,signal:ctl.signal}).then(function(r){clearTimeout(to);return r.json().then(function(j){return{ok:r.ok,status:r.status,j:j}})});
    });
  }
  function respond(){
    if(gone)return;
    av.classList.add("rec");say("Your turn. Take your time, I'm listening.");
    var rec=null,ctx=null,timer=null,iv=null,done=false;
    function cleanup(){clearInterval(iv);clearTimeout(timer);try{ctx&&ctx.close()}catch(e){}}
    function stop(){ if(done||!rec)return; done=true;cleanup();av.classList.remove("rec");say("Checking…");
      try{rec.mr.stop()}catch(e){}
      rec.done.then(score).then(function(x){
        if(gone)return;
        if(x.status===400){tries++;if(tries<2){say("I didn't catch that. Say it again.");return setTimeout(respond,900)}
          say("I couldn't hear you. Tap me to try again, or skip.");av.onclick=function(){av.onclick=null;tries=0;listen()};return}
        if(!x.ok||typeof x.j.finalScore!=="number"){tries++;if(tries<2){say("One more time.");return setTimeout(respond,900)}return skip()}
        var cv=curveP(x.j.finalScore,it.lv),pass=cv.heard&&cv.v>=SPEAK_PASS;
        av.classList.add(pass?"good":"soft");say(pass?"Très bien !":"Good try, let's keep going");
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll(".opt"),function(b){b.disabled=true;b.classList.add("dim")});
        gone=true;answer(0,av,pass?"ok":"bad");
      }).catch(function(){if(gone)return;tries++;if(tries<2){say("One more time.");return setTimeout(respond,900)}skip()});
    }
    stopRec=stop;
    recStart().then(function(r){
      if(gone){r.mr.stop();return}
      rec=r;
      var t0=Date.now(),spoke=false,last=0,calib=[],floor=null;
      try{
        var AC=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;ctx=new AC();
        var src=ctx.createMediaStreamSource(r.stream),an=ctx.createAnalyser();an.fftSize=1024;src.connect(an);
        var buf=new Uint8Array(an.fftSize);
        iv=setInterval(function(){
          an.getByteTimeDomainData(buf);var s=0;for(var i=0;i<buf.length;i++){var v=(buf[i]-128)/128;s+=v*v}
          var rms=Math.sqrt(s/buf.length),now=Date.now();
          if(now-t0<400){calib.push(rms);return}if(floor===null){var c2=calib.slice().sort(function(a,b){return a-b});floor=c2.length?c2[Math.floor(c2.length*0.3)]:0}var thr=Math.min(0.05,Math.max(0.012,floor*2.4));if(rms>thr){spoke=true;last=now}
          if(spoke&&now-last>1400)stop();
          else if(!spoke&&now-t0>25000)stop();
        },60);
      }catch(e){}
      timer=setTimeout(stop,45000);
    }).catch(function(){skip()});
  }
  snd.onclick=function(){listen(1)};var sl2=$("slow2");if(sl2)sl2.onclick=function(){tries=0;listen(0.7)};
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll(".opt"),function(b){b.onclick=function(){gone=true;try{a.pause()}catch(e){}if(stopRec)try{stopRec()}catch(e){}answer(-1,b)}});
  if(document.activeElement&&document.activeElement.blur)document.activeElement.blur();
  setTimeout(function(){listen(1)},500);
}
function esc(s){return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return{"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c]})}

function flyPlus(from){
  var to=$("score").getBoundingClientRect(),f=from.getBoundingClientRect();
  var p=document.createElement("div");p.className="plus";p.textContent="+1";
  p.style.left=(f.left+f.width/2-14)+"px";p.style.top=(f.top+f.height/2-14)+"px";document.body.appendChild(p);
  requestAnimationFrame(function(){requestAnimationFrame(function(){
    p.style.transform="translate("+(to.left+to.width/2-f.left-f.width/2)+"px,"+(to.top+to.height/2-f.top-f.height/2)+"px) scale(.8)";
  })});
  setTimeout(function(){p.style.opacity="0"},650);
  setTimeout(function(){
    if(p.parentNode)p.parentNode.removeChild(p);
    var s=$("score"),n=$("scoreN");n.textContent=(+n.textContent||0)+1;
    s.classList.remove("bump");void s.offsetWidth;s.classList.add("bump");
  },780);

function answer(i,btn,force){
  var it=st.cur, idk=(i<0), ok=!idk&&(force?force==="ok":st.cur.shown[i].ok);
  var all=document.querySelectorAll(".opt");
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(all,function(b){b.disabled=true});
  // colour: your pick turns red if wrong, the right answer turns green
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(all,function(b){
    var bi=+b.dataset.i;
    if(bi>=0&&st.cur.shown[bi].ok)b.classList.add("good");
    else if(b===btn&&!idk)b.classList.add("bad");
    else b.classList.add("dim");
  });
  if(ok)flyPlus(btn);
  try{$("qAud").pause()}catch(e){}
  var r=st.res[it.lv]; r.t++; if(ok)r.c++;
  update(it.lv,ok?"ok":(idk?"idk":"bad"));
  st.n++; st.hist.push(it.lv);
  st.log.push({id:it.id,lv:it.lv,ok:ok,idk:idk,kind:kind(it),shape:shape(it)});
  st.wrong=ok?0:st.wrong+1;
  var want=Math.round(st.post.reduce(function(a,p,i){return a+p*i},0));
  st.lv=Math.max(0,Math.min(6,Math.max(it.lv-1,Math.min(it.lv+1,want)))); // at most one step from the question just asked
  setFill();
  setTimeout(function(){
    if(st.wrong>=3 && st.teacherShown<2 ){return teacher()}
    if(st.wrong>=3 && st.n>=3 && st.teacherShown>=2){return finish()}
    var top3=st.log.slice(-3).length===3&&st.log.slice(-3).every(function(l){return l.ok&&l.lv===6});
    if(top3||st.n>=MAXQ||(st.n>=MINQ&&conf()>=CONF&&(st.n>=FRENCH_AFTER||mapLevel()<=1)))return finish();
    ask();
  },FEEDBACK_MS);
}

/* ---- the teacher: five stills that cross-fade while she speaks ---- */
var tFrames=null;
async function loadFrames(){
  if(tFrames)return tFrames;
  var list=[];

async function teacher(){
  st.teacherShown++;
  var T=$("teacher"),txt=$("tTxt"),act=$("tAct"),aud=$("tAud"),stage=$("tStage");
  var frames=await loadFrames();
  stage.innerHTML=frames.map(function(u,i){return '<img alt="" src="'+u+'" class="'+(i===0?'on':'')+'">'}).join("");
  var imgs=stage.querySelectorAll("img");
  txt.textContent=""; act.classList.remove("on"); T.classList.add("on");
  var words=TEACHER_TEXT.split(" "),k=0,textTimer=null,frameTimer=null,shown=false,fi=0;
  function showFrame(n){Array.prototype.forEach.call(imgs,function(im,i){im.classList.toggle("on",i===n)})}/*twalk*/function walk(total){var W=Math.max(5,Math.min(10,total*0.85/1000)),n=imgs.length,t0=null,raf=0,ended=false,last=0;var dist=(window.innerWidth/2)+(stage.offsetWidth||200)/2+20,bounces=Math.max(3,Math.round(W/1.4));stage.style.transform="translateX("+(-dist)+"px)";function rest(){ended=true;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);stage.style.transform="none"}function step(ts){if(ended)return;if(shown)return rest();if(t0===null)t0=ts;var t=Math.min(1,(ts-t0)/(W*1000)),e=1-Math.pow(1-t,2);var x=-dist*(1-e),s=Math.sin(Math.PI*bounces*t),y=-12*s*s*(1-t*t);stage.style.transform="translate("+x.toFixed(1)+"px,"+y.toFixed(1)+"px)";var f=Math.min(n-1,Math.floor(t*(n-1)+0.0001));if(t>=1)f=n-1;if(f!==last){last=f;fi=f;showFrame(f)}if(t>=1)return rest();raf=requestAnimationFrame(step)}raf=requestAnimationFrame(step)}/*endwalk*/
  function reveal(){ if(shown)return; shown=true; clearInterval(textTimer); clearInterval(frameTimer); txt.textContent=TEACHER_TEXT; showFrame(imgs.length-1); act.classList.add("on") }
  var take=window.PT_TEACHER||"a";
  aud.src="/assets/audio/placement/teacher_"+take+".mp3";
  aud.onended=reveal; aud.onerror=function(){txt.textContent=TEACHER_TEXT;setTimeout(reveal,2500)};
  function startShow(dur){
    var total=(dur&&isFinite(dur)?dur:words.length*0.33)*1000;
    var perWord=total/words.length;
    textTimer=setInterval(function(){k++;txt.textContent=words.slice(0,k).join(" ");if(k>=words.length)clearInterval(textTimer)},perWord);
    var nf=imgs.length;if(nf>1){var per=Math.max(2200,total/nf);frameTimer=setInterval(function(){fi=Math.min(nf-1,fi+1);showFrame(fi);if(fi>=nf-1)clearInterval(frameTimer)},per)}
  }
  var p=aud.play();
  if(p&&p.then){p.then(function(){ if(aud.readyState>=1)startShow(aud.duration); else aud.onloadedmetadata=function(){startShow(aud.duration)} }).catch(function(){startShow(0);setTimeout(reveal,words.length*330+2500)})}
  else startShow(0);
  setTimeout(reveal,45000); // safety
  $("tShow").onclick=function(){T.classList.remove("on");aud.pause();finish()};
  $("tKeep").onclick=function(){T.classList.remove("on");aud.pause();clearInterval(textTimer);clearInterval(frameTimer);st.wrong=0;ask()};
}

/* ==========================================
   EXACT ORB COLOR CONTROL
========================================== */

function applyOrbBackground(level) {
  let color = "#95C2BD"; // default fallback

  if (level === "A0") color = "#DE5969";
  if (level === "A1") color = "#DDA280";
  if (level === "A2") color = "#D6B9A4";
  if (level === "B1") color = "#3A837D";
  if (level === "B2") color = "#95C2BD";

  document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--orb-color", color);
}

let index = 0;
let score = 0;

// DOM
const questionText = document.getElementById("questionText");
const answersEl = document.getElementById("answers");
const imageEl = document.getElementById("questionImage");
const audioBtn = document.getElementById("audioBtn");
const progressBar = document.getElementById("progressBar");

function loadQuestion() {
  const q = questions[index];

  questionText.textContent = q.text;
  answersEl.innerHTML = "";

  // progress
  progressBar.style.width =
    ((index + 1) / questions.length) * 100 + "%";

  // image
  if (q.image) {
    imageEl.src = q.image;
    imageEl.classList.remove("hidden");
  } else {
    imageEl.classList.add("hidden");
  }

  // audio (IMPORTANT FIX)
  if (q.audio) {
    audioBtn.classList.remove("hidden");

    audioBtn.onclick = () => {
      const audio = new Audio(q.audio);
      audio.load();
      audio.play();
    };

  } else {
    audioBtn.classList.add("hidden");
    audioBtn.onclick = null;
  }

  q.options.forEach((opt, i) => {
    const btn = document.createElement("button");
    btn.className = "answer-btn";
    btn.textContent = opt;

    btn.onclick = () => {
      if (i === q.correct) score++;
      index++;

      if (index < questions.length) {
        loadQuestion();
      } else {
        finishTest();
      }
    };

    answersEl.appendChild(btn);
  });
}

function finishTest() {
  let level;

  if (score <= 2) level = "Absolute Beginner";
  else if (score <= 4) level = "Beginner";
  else if (score <= 6) level = "Intermediate";
  else if (score === 7) level = "Semi-Advanced";
  else level = "Advanced";

  localStorage.setItem("saybon_level", level);

  // placement test → loader → dashboard
  sessionStorage.setItem("saybon_next", "../dashboard/index.html");
  window.location.href = "../loader.html";
}

loadQuestion();

}

}

/* Shared by the lesson page and the build script: turns one scene into a lesson for a pace. */
(function(root,f){if(typeof module==="object"&&module.exports)module.exports=f();else root.ScenEngine=f()})(this,function(){
var CUES={scene:"Voici la scène. Écoutez bien.",again:"Encore une fois.",phrases:"Maintenant, les phrases importantes.",listen:"Écoutez.",repeat:"Répétez.",yours:"À vous.",model:"Voici le modèle.",drills:"Maintenant, les échanges.",swap:"Changeons un détail.",twist:"Attention, une surprise !",final:"Maintenant, vous jouez la scène en entier.",end:"Bravo ! La leçon est terminée. À bientôt."};
/* The three paces only change how often a learner studies, never how the lesson itself runs. */
var PACES={relaxed:{phr:6,mult:1.5},steady:{phr:6,mult:1.5},intensive:{phr:6,mult:1.5}};
var EN={
 promise:"[chuckles] That was the conversation. And here's the plan: by the end of this lesson, you'll be able to take part in it yourself, fluently. Let's get you there!",
 drills:"Now the drills. Short exchanges, one at a time. [chuckles] You'll be surprised how quickly they stick.",
 c12:"Lovely. Now let's put drill one and drill two together, as a little conversation.",
 c34:"Great. Now drills three and four, together, as a conversation.",
 c1234:"Now all four together. This is a real conversation, so take your time.",
 whole:"Now the whole conversation, from the start. This time, you play your part. Ready? [chuckles] Let's go!",
 done:"[chuckles] And that's the lesson! Wow, great job today. [sighs] Ahh, I'm proud of you. See you in the next one.",
 first:"Here is your first line. [chuckles] Listen, then say it.",next:"Here is your next line. Listen, then say it.",practice:"Now some quick practice. I speak, then you answer. [chuckles] Same sentence, small changes.",join:"Now let's join your lines together, as a little conversation.",
 praise:["[chuckles] Great job!","Wow, you're doing so well! [chuckles]","[chuckles] Brilliant! Keep going.","[chuckles] Lovely. That sounded really good.","[chuckles] Yes! Exactly like that.","[sighs] Ahh, perfect. [chuckles] You've got this."]};
function strip(t){return String(t).replace(/<<([^>]*)>>/g,"$1").replace(/\[[^\]]*\]/g,"").replace(/\s{2,}/g," ").trim()}
function hash(s){var h1=0xdeadbeef,h2=0x41c6ce57;for(var i=0;i<s.length;i++){var c=s.charCodeAt(i);h1=Math.imul(h1^c,2654435761);h2=Math.imul(h2^c,1597334677)}h1=Math.imul(h1^(h1>>>16),2246822507)^Math.imul(h2^(h2>>>13),3266489909);h2=Math.imul(h2^(h2>>>16),2246822507)^Math.imul(h1^(h1>>>13),3266489909);return (4294967296*(2097151&h2)+(h1>>>0)).toString(36)}
function lineId(role,text){return role+"-"+hash(text)}
function win(text,pace){var n=text.split(/\s+/).length;return Math.min(14,Math.max(3.5,Math.round((2+n*0.55)*PACES[pace].mult*10)/10))}
function say(role,text,lang){var o={k:"say",a:lineId(role,text),who:role,fr:strip(text),raw:text};if(lang)o.lang=lang;return o}
function en(text){return say("t",text,"en")}
function cue(name){return say("t",CUES[name])}
function uniq(a){var s={},o=[];a.forEach(function(x){if(!s[x]){s[x]=1;o.push(x)}});return o}
function buildLadder(L,pace){
 var S=[],pi=0;
 function praise(){S.push(en(EN.praise[pi++%EN.praise.length]))}
 function turn(t,h){S.push({k:"turn",fr:t,w:win(t,pace),hint:h===undefined?2:h})}
 function listenSay(t){S.push(cue("listen"));S.push(say("p",t));S.push(cue("repeat"));turn(t)}
 if(L.goal&&(L.lv==="a0"||L.lv==="a1"))S.push({k:"goal",text:L.goal});
 S.push({k:"sec",t:"La scène"});
 S.push(en(L.setup||"For this lesson, you will play a short conversation. First, just listen."));
 S.push(cue("scene"));
 L.scene.forEach(function(x){S.push(say(x[0],x[1]))});
 S.push(en(EN.promise));
 var pIdx=[];L.scene.forEach(function(x,i){if(x[0]==="p")pIdx.push(i)});
 L.ladder.forEach(function(g,k){
  var full=L.scene[pIdx[k]][1];
  S.push({k:"sec",t:"Phrase "+(k+1)});
  S.push(en(k===0?EN.first:EN.next));
  var pcs=(g.build||[]).slice();if(!pcs.length||pcs[pcs.length-1]!==full)pcs.push(full);
  pcs.forEach(function(t){listenSay(t)});
  praise();
  S.push(en(EN.practice));
  g.drills.forEach(function(d,j){
   S.push(say("c",d.c));
   if(j===0){S.push(cue("model"));S.push(say("p",d.p));S.push(cue("yours"))}
   turn(d.p,j===0?2:1);
   if(j===2||j===4)praise()});
  if(k>0){S.push(en(EN.join));
   for(var i=0;i<=pIdx[k];i++){var x=L.scene[i];if(x[0]==="c")S.push(say("c",x[1]));else turn(x[1],1)}
   praise()}
 });
 S.push({k:"sec",t:"Une surprise"});S.push(cue("twist"));S.push(say("c",L.twist.c));turn(L.twist.p,1);
 if(L.extra&&L.extra.length){S.push({k:"sec",t:"Les phrases"});S.push(cue("phrases"));L.extra.forEach(function(t){listenSay(t)})}
 S.push({k:"sec",t:"À vous"});S.push(en(EN.whole));
 L.scene.forEach(function(x){if(x[0]==="c")S.push(say("c",x[1]));else turn(x[1],1)});
 S.push(en(EN.done));
 return S}
function build(L,pace){
 if(L.ladder)return buildLadder(L,pace);
 var P=PACES[pace]||PACES.steady,S=[],pi=0;
 function praise(){S.push(en(EN.praise[pi++%EN.praise.length]))}
 function turn(t,h){S.push({k:"turn",fr:t,w:win(t,pace),hint:h===undefined?2:h})}
 function drill(d){S.push(say("c",d.c));S.push(cue("model"));S.push(say("p",d.p));S.push(cue("yours"));turn(d.p)}
 function mini(ds){ds.forEach(function(d){S.push(say("c",d.c));turn(d.p,1)})}
 if(L.goal&&(L.lv==="a0"||L.lv==="a1"))S.push({k:"goal",text:L.goal});
 /* 1. where you are, who is talking, then the whole conversation once */
 S.push({k:"sec",t:"La scène"});
 S.push(en(L.setup||"For this lesson, you will play a short conversation. First, just listen."));
 S.push(cue("scene"));
 L.scene.forEach(function(x){S.push(say(x[0],x[1]))});
 S.push(en(EN.promise));
 /* 2. the key phrases */
 var pool=[];L.scene.forEach(function(x){if(x[0]==="p")pool.push(x[1])});
 L.drills.forEach(function(d){pool.push(d.p)});L.swaps.forEach(function(d){pool.push(d.p)});
 (L.extra||[]).forEach(function(x){pool.push(x)});
 var ph=uniq(pool).slice(0,P.phr);
 S.push({k:"sec",t:"Les phrases"});S.push(cue("phrases"));
 ph.forEach(function(t,i){S.push(cue("listen"));S.push(say("p",t));S.push(cue("repeat"));turn(t);S.push(say("p",t));if(i===2)praise()});
 /* 3. the drills, joined up into a conversation step by step */
 var D=[L.drills[0],L.drills[1],L.drills[2],L.swaps[0]];
 S.push({k:"sec",t:"Les échanges"});S.push(en(EN.drills));
 drill(D[0]);drill(D[1]);praise();S.push(en(EN.c12));mini([D[0],D[1]]);praise();
 drill(D[2]);drill(D[3]);S.push(en(EN.c34));mini([D[2],D[3]]);praise();
 S.push(en(EN.c1234));mini(D);praise();
 /* 4. the whole conversation, with the learner playing their part */
 S.push({k:"sec",t:"À vous"});S.push(en(EN.whole));
 L.scene.forEach(function(x){if(x[0]==="c")S.push(say("c",x[1]));else turn(x[1],1)});
 S.push(en(EN.done));
 return S}
function needs(L,pace){var o={},a=[];build(L,pace).forEach(function(s){if(s.k==="say"&&!o[s.a]){o[s.a]=1;a.push({id:s.a,role:s.who,text:s.raw,lang:s.lang||"fr"})}});return a}
return{CUES:CUES,EN:EN,strip:strip,PACES:PACES,hash:hash,lineId:lineId,build:build,needs:needs,win:win}});

/* The browser's own voice, used for any line that has no recorded audio yet.
   It speaks clause by clause so that commas, full stops and question marks give real pauses and a lift in the voice. */
(function(){
var synth=window.speechSynthesis,voices=[],cache={};
function load(){try{voices=synth.getVoices()||[]}catch(e){voices=[]}cache={}}
if(synth){load();if(synth.addEventListener)synth.addEventListener("voiceschanged",load)}
function frVoices(){return voices.filter(function(v){return /^fr/i.test(v.lang)})}
function score(v){var n=v.name||"",s=0;if(/google|neural|natural|online|premium|enhanced/i.test(n))s+=3;if(/fr[-_]FR/i.test(v.lang))s+=2;if(v.localService)s+=0;return s}
function pick(male){
 var k=male?"m":"f";if(cache[k])return cache[k];
 var L=frVoices().sort(function(a,b){return score(b)-score(a)}),F=/denise|am[eé]lie|audrey|julie|hortense|marie|eloise|vivienne|brigitte|female|femme/i,M=/henri|thomas|paul|claude|antoine|male|homme|mathieu/i;
 var m=L.filter(function(v){return(male?M:F).test(v.name)})[0]||(male?L[1]:L[0])||L[0]||null;cache[k]=m;return m;
}
function pickEn(){
 if(cache.en)return cache.en;
 var L=voices.filter(function(v){return /^en/i.test(v.lang)}).sort(function(a,b){return score(b)-score(a)}),F=/female|samantha|serena|karen|moira|tessa|aria|jenny|libby|sonia|zira|hazel|susan/i;
 return cache.en=L.filter(function(v){return F.test(v.name)})[0]||L[0]||null;
}
function chunks(t){
 t=String(t).replace(/\s+/g," ").trim();
 var out=[],re=/[^,;:.!?…]+[,;:.!?…]*/g,m;
 while((m=re.exec(t))){var s=m[0].trim();if(s)out.push(s)}
 return out.length?out:[t];
}
var token=0;
function speak(text,role,pace,lang){
 return new Promise(function(res){
  if(!synth){res("err");return}
  api.spoke=false;var my=++token,parts=chunks(text),i=0,male=role==="c",v=lang==="en"?pickEn():pick(male);
  var base=lang==="en"?0.82:(api.base||0.65);
  function next(){
   if(my!==token){res("ok");return}
   if(i>=parts.length){res("ok");return}
   var p=parts[i++],u=new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(p),end=p.slice(-1);
   u.lang=lang==="en"?"en-GB":"fr-FR";if(v){u.voice=v;if(lang==="en"&&v.lang)u.lang=v.lang}
   u.rate=base*(end==="!"?1.05:1);
   u.pitch=(male?0.82:1.04)+(end==="?"?0.14:end==="!"?0.06:0);
   u.volume=1;
   var adv=false,guard=null;
   function after(){if(adv)return;adv=true;clearTimeout(guard);var gap=Math.round((/[.!?\u2026]$/.test(p)?380:/[,;:]$/.test(p)?170:60)*(api.gapx||1));setTimeout(next,gap)}
   u.onstart=function(){api.spoke=true};u.onend=after;u.onerror=function(){if(adv)return;adv=true;clearTimeout(guard);res("err")};
   guard=setTimeout(after,Math.round(p.length*95/u.rate)+2500); /* if the browser never reports the end, move on anyway */
   try{synth.speak(u)}catch(e){res("err")}
  }
  try{synth.cancel()}catch(e){}
  setTimeout(next,60);
 });
}
function stop(){token++;try{synth.cancel()}catch(e){}}
function pause(){try{synth.pause()}catch(e){}}
function resume(){try{synth.resume()}catch(e){}}
function unlock(){try{var u=new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(" ");u.volume=0;synth.speak(u)}catch(e){}}
var api=window.SBTTS={spoke:false,speak:speak,stop:stop,pause:pause,resume:resume,unlock:unlock,ok:!!synth};
})();

=== \public\reveal\reveal.js ===
const level =
  sessionStorage.getItem("saybon_level") || "Absolute Beginner";

const levelText = document.getElementById("levelText");
levelText.textContent = level;

const levelFriendlyLabels = {
  "A0": "Absolute Beginner",
  "A1": "Beginner",
  "A2": "Elementary",
  "B1": "Intermediate",
  "B2": "Upper Intermediate",
  "C1": "Advanced"
};

const friendlyLabelEl = document.getElementById("levelFriendlyLabel");
if(friendlyLabelEl && levelFriendlyLabels[level]){
  friendlyLabelEl.textContent = levelFriendlyLabels[level];
}


document.getElementById("startJourney").onclick = () => {
  sessionStorage.setItem("saybon_next", "/auth/login.html");
  window.location.href = "/loader.html";
};

document.getElementById("backHome").onclick = () => {
  if(window.stopAppBgMusic){ window.stopAppBgMusic(); } window.location.href = "/";
};

<script type="module">
import { schoolsReady } from "/schools/schools-guard.js";
const API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";
const LEVEL = "schools-a0";

function applyUnlocks(max){
  document.querySelectorAll(".sc-lesson").forEach(function(btn){
    var num = parseInt(btn.querySelector(".sc-num").textContent);
    if (num <= max){
      btn.classList.remove("locked"); btn.classList.add("unlocked");
      var lock = btn.querySelector(".sc-lock"); if (lock) lock.style.display = "none";
      btn.onclick = function(){ window.location.href = "lesson" + num + ".html"; };
    }
  });
}

schoolsReady.then(function(s){
  if (s.admin){ applyUnlocks(25); return; }
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/levelProgress?uid=" + s.user.uid + "&level=" + LEVEL)
    .then(function(r){ return r.json(); })
    .then(function(d){ var c = d.completedLessons || []; applyUnlocks((c.length ? Math.max.apply(null, c) : 0) + 1); })
    .catch(function(){ applyUnlocks(1); });
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

      <button class="sc-lesson locked"><svg class="sc-lock" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="5" y="11" width="14" height="10" rx="2"></rect><path d="M8 11V7a4 4 0 0 1 8 0v4"></path></svg><span class="sc-num">23</span></button>
      <button class="sc-lesson locked"><svg class="sc-lock" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="5" y="11" width="14" height="10" rx="2"></rect><path d="M8 11V7a4 4 0 0 1 8 0v4"></path></svg><span class="sc-num">24</span></button>
      <button class="sc-lesson locked"><svg class="sc-lock" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="5" y="11" width="14" height="10" rx="2"></rect><path d="M8 11V7a4 4 0 0 1 8 0v4"></path></svg><span class="sc-num">25</span></button>
    </main>
  </div>
<script type="module">
import { schoolsReady } from "/schools/schools-guard.js";
const API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";
const LEVEL = "schools-a1";

function applyUnlocks(max){
  document.querySelectorAll(".sc-lesson").forEach(function(btn){
    var num = parseInt(btn.querySelector(".sc-num").textContent);
    if (num <= max){
      btn.classList.remove("locked"); btn.classList.add("unlocked");
      var lock = btn.querySelector(".sc-lock"); if (lock) lock.style.display = "none";
      btn.onclick = function(){ window.location.href = "lesson" + num + ".html"; };
    }
  });
}

schoolsReady.then(function(s){
  if (s.admin){ applyUnlocks(25); return; }
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/levelProgress?uid=" + s.user.uid + "&level=" + LEVEL)
    .then(function(r){ return r.json(); })
    .then(function(d){ var c = d.completedLessons || []; applyUnlocks((c.length ? Math.max.apply(null, c) : 0) + 1); })
    .catch(function(){ applyUnlocks(1); });
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

      <button class="sc-lesson locked"><svg class="sc-lock" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="5" y="11" width="14" height="10" rx="2"></rect><path d="M8 11V7a4 4 0 0 1 8 0v4"></path></svg><span class="sc-num">23</span></button>

      <button class="sc-lesson locked"><svg class="sc-lock" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="5" y="11" width="14" height="10" rx="2"></rect><path d="M8 11V7a4 4 0 0 1 8 0v4"></path></svg><span class="sc-num">25</span></button>

  </div>
<script type="module">
import { schoolsReady } from "/schools/schools-guard.js";
const API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";
const LEVEL = "schools-a2";

function applyUnlocks(max){
  document.querySelectorAll(".sc-lesson").forEach(function(btn){
    var num = parseInt(btn.querySelector(".sc-num").textContent);
    if (num <= max){
      btn.classList.remove("locked"); btn.classList.add("unlocked");
      var lock = btn.querySelector(".sc-lock"); if (lock) lock.style.display = "none";
      btn.onclick = function(){ window.location.href = "lesson" + num + ".html"; };
    }
  });
}

schoolsReady.then(function(s){
  if (s.admin){ applyUnlocks(25); return; }
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/levelProgress?uid=" + s.user.uid + "&level=" + LEVEL)
    .then(function(r){ return r.json(); })
    .then(function(d){ var c = d.completedLessons || []; applyUnlocks((c.length ? Math.max.apply(null, c) : 0) + 1); })
    .catch(function(){ applyUnlocks(1); });
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

<script type="module">
import { schoolsReady } from "/schools/schools-guard.js";
const API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";
const LEVEL = "schools-b1";

function applyUnlocks(max){
  document.querySelectorAll(".sc-lesson").forEach(function(btn){
    var num = parseInt(btn.querySelector(".sc-num").textContent);
    if (num <= max){
      btn.classList.remove("locked"); btn.classList.add("unlocked");
      var lock = btn.querySelector(".sc-lock"); if (lock) lock.style.display = "none";
      btn.onclick = function(){ window.location.href = "lesson" + num + ".html"; };
    }
  });
}

schoolsReady.then(function(s){
  if (s.admin){ applyUnlocks(25); return; }
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/levelProgress?uid=" + s.user.uid + "&level=" + LEVEL)
    .then(function(r){ return r.json(); })
    .then(function(d){ var c = d.completedLessons || []; applyUnlocks((c.length ? Math.max.apply(null, c) : 0) + 1); })
    .catch(function(){ applyUnlocks(1); });
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

<script type="module">
import { schoolsReady } from "/schools/schools-guard.js";
const API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";
const LEVEL = "schools-b2";

function applyUnlocks(max){
  document.querySelectorAll(".sc-lesson").forEach(function(btn){
    var num = parseInt(btn.querySelector(".sc-num").textContent);
    if (num <= max){
      btn.classList.remove("locked"); btn.classList.add("unlocked");
      var lock = btn.querySelector(".sc-lock"); if (lock) lock.style.display = "none";
      btn.onclick = function(){ window.location.href = "lesson" + num + ".html"; };
    }
  });
}

schoolsReady.then(function(s){
  if (s.admin){ applyUnlocks(25); return; }
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/levelProgress?uid=" + s.user.uid + "&level=" + LEVEL)
    .then(function(r){ return r.json(); })
    .then(function(d){ var c = d.completedLessons || []; applyUnlocks((c.length ? Math.max.apply(null, c) : 0) + 1); })
    .catch(function(){ applyUnlocks(1); });
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

async function setupTeacherAudioAnimation(imgId, audioId, btnId){
  injectTeacherAudioStyles();
  var img = document.getElementById(imgId);
  var audioEl = document.getElementById(audioId);
  var playBtn = btnId ? document.getElementById(btnId) : null;
  if(!img || !audioEl) return;
  img.style.opacity = "0";
  img.style.transition = "opacity .5s ease-in";
  if(img.complete){
    img.style.opacity = "1";
  } else {
    img.addEventListener("load", function(){ img.style.opacity = "1"; });
  }
  function showPlayButton(){
    if(playBtn){ playBtn.style.display = "inline-block"; }
  }
  if(playBtn){
    playBtn.addEventListener("click", function(){
      audioEl.play().then(function(){
        playBtn.style.display = "none";
      }).catch(function(err){
        console.error("TEACHER AUDIO MANUAL PLAY FAILED:", err);
      });
    });
  }
  try{
    var audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    if(audioCtx.state === "suspended"){
      await audioCtx.resume();
    }
    var source = audioCtx.createMediaElementSource(audioEl);
    var analyser = audioCtx.createAnalyser();
    analyser.fftSize = 256;
    source.connect(analyser);
    analyser.connect(audioCtx.destination);
    try{
      await audioEl.play();
      setTimeout(function(){
        if(audioEl.paused){ showPlayButton(); }
      }, 400);
    }catch(playErr){
      console.error("TEACHER AUDIO PLAY BLOCKED:", playErr);
      showPlayButton();
    }
    var dataArray = new Uint8Array(analyser.frequencyBinCount);
    function animate(){
      if(!img.isConnected || !audioEl.isConnected){ return; }
      if(audioEl.paused || audioEl.ended){
        img.style.transform = "scale(1)";
        img.style.filter = "none";
        return;
      }
      analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);
      var avg = dataArray.reduce(function(a,b){ return a+b; }, 0) / dataArray.length;
      var intensity = Math.min(avg / 80, 1);
      var scale = 1 + (intensity * 0.06);
      var bounce = intensity * 8;
      var glow = 10 + (intensity * 30);
      img.style.transform = "scale(" + scale.toFixed(3) + ") translateY(-" + bounce.toFixed(2) + "px)";
      img.style.filter = "drop-shadow(0 0 " + glow.toFixed(0) + "px rgba(212,175,106," + (0.3 + intensity * 0.5).toFixed(2) + "))";
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }
    audioEl.addEventListener("play", function(){ requestAnimationFrame(animate); });
    audioEl.addEventListener("playing", function(){ requestAnimationFrame(animate); });
    animate();
  }catch(err){
    console.error("TEACHER AUDIO ANIMATION ERROR:", err);
  }
}
function renderBlock(block){
  var sizeClass = block.size ? "ls-size-" + block.size : "ls-size-large";
  if(block.type === "text") return '<div class="ls-block ls-block-text">' + block.content + '</div>';
  if(block.type === "image") return '<div class="ls-block ' + sizeClass + '"><img src="' + block.url + '"></div>';
  if(block.type === "audio") return '<div class="ls-block"><audio controls controlsList="nodownload" oncontextmenu="return false;" src="' + block.url + '"></audio></div>';
  if(block.type === "video") return '<div class="ls-block ' + sizeClass + '"><video controls controlsList="nodownload" oncontextmenu="return false;" src="' + block.url + '"></video></div>';
  if(block.type === "teacher-audio"){
    injectTeacherAudioStyles();
    return '<div class="ls-block" style="text-align:center;">' +
      '<div style="position:relative;display:inline-block;min-width:220px;min-height:280px;">' +
      '<img class="ls-teacher-audio-img" src="' + block.imageUrl + '">' +
      '<div class="ls-teacher-tap-overlay ls-teacher-tap-hidden">Tap to hear the teacher</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<audio class="ls-teacher-audio-el" controlsList="nodownload" oncontextmenu="return false;" style="display:none;" autoplay src="' + block.url + '"></audio>' +
      '</div>';
  }
  return "";
}

function getPartAssets(partNum){
  return allAssets.filter(function(a){ return a.part === partNum; });
}
function getMaxPart(){ var max = 1; allAssets.forEach(function(a){ if(a.part > max) max = a.part; }); return max; }
function getPartLabel(partNum){ var match = allAssets.find(function(a){ return a.part === partNum; }); return (match && match.partTitle) ? ("Part " + partNum + " - " + match.partTitle) : ("Part " + partNum); }
function getPartTransitionMode(partNum){ var match = allAssets.find(function(a){ return a.part === partNum; }); return (match && match.transitionMode) ? match.transitionMode : "button"; }

function renderPart(partNum, label){if(window.psRender&&window.psRender(partNum,getPartAssets(partNum),{root:root,api:API_BASE})){return;}
  var blocks = getPartAssets(partNum);
  var promptBlock = blocks.find(function(b){ return b.recordPrompt; });
  var needsRecording = !!promptBlock;
  var transitionMode = getPartTransitionMode(partNum);

  var blocksHtml = blocks.map(renderBlock).join("");

  var recordSection = "";
  if(needsRecording){
    var promptText = promptBlock ? promptBlock.recordPrompt : "Record your answer";
    recordSection =
      '<div class="ls-prompt-bubble">' + promptText + '</div>' +
      '<canvas id="lsWaveCanvas" class="ls-wave-canvas" width="280" height="56" style="display:none;"></canvas>' +
      '<div class="ls-record-row">' +
      '<button class="ls-record-btn" id="lsRecordBtn">● Record</button>' +
      '<span class="ls-record-status" id="lsRecordStatus">' + (recordedBlob ? "Recorded" : "Not recorded yet") + '</span>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="ls-playback-row" id="lsPlaybackRow" style="display:none;">' +
      '<button class="ls-btn ls-btn-secondary" id="lsPlayBtn">&#9658; Play My Recording</button>' +
      '<button class="ls-btn ls-btn-secondary" id="lsRerecordBtn">&#8635; Re-record</button>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<audio id="lsPlaybackAudio" controlsList="nodownload" style="display:none;"></audio>' +
      '<div id="lsScoreDisplay"></div>' +
      '<div class="ls-btn-row"><button class="ls-btn ls-btn-primary" id="lsSubmitBtn" disabled>Submit</button></div>';
  }

  var continueBtn = (needsRecording || transitionMode === "auto") ? "" :
    '<div class="ls-btn-row"><button class="ls-btn ls-btn-primary" onclick="window.lsGoNext()">Continue</button></div>';

  var back1Btn = partNum > 1 ?
    '<div style="text-align:center;margin-top:10px;"><button class="ls-btn ls-btn-secondary" onclick="window.lsGoToPart1()">&#8634; Back to Part 1</button></div>' : '';

  render(
    '<p class="ls-part-label">' + label + '</p>' +
    '<div class="ls-card">' + blocksHtml + recordSection + '</div>' +
    continueBtn + back1Btn
  );

  root.querySelectorAll(".ls-teacher-audio-el").forEach(function(audioEl){
    setTimeout(function(){
      if(audioEl.paused){
        var wrapper = audioEl.previousElementSibling;
        var overlay = wrapper ? wrapper.querySelector(".ls-teacher-tap-overlay") : null;
        if(overlay){ overlay.classList.remove("ls-teacher-tap-hidden"); }
      }
    }, 500);
  });

  if(!needsRecording && transitionMode === "auto"){
    var autoMedia = root.querySelector("video, audio");
    if(autoMedia){
      autoMedia.addEventListener("ended", function(){ window.lsGoNext(); });
    } else {
      setTimeout(function(){ window.lsGoNext(); }, 2500);
    }
  }

  if(needsRecording){
    document.getElementById("lsRecordBtn").addEventListener("click", toggleRecording);
    document.getElementById("lsPlayBtn").addEventListener("click", playRecording);
    document.getElementById("lsRerecordBtn").addEventListener("click", reRecord);
    var expectedText = promptBlock ? promptBlock.expectedText : "";
    document.getElementById("lsSubmitBtn").addEventListener("click", function(){ submitRecording(expectedText, partNum); });
  }
}

function startWave(streamOrElement, isElement){
  var canvas = document.getElementById("lsWaveCanvas");
  var ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  canvas.style.display = "block";
  if(!lsAudioCtx){
    lsAudioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
  }
  var analyser = lsAudioCtx.createAnalyser();
  analyser.fftSize = 64;

  if(isElement){
    if(!streamOrElement._lsWaveSource){
      streamOrElement._lsWaveSource = lsAudioCtx.createMediaElementSource(streamOrElement);
      streamOrElement._lsWaveSource.connect(lsAudioCtx.destination);
    }
    streamOrElement._lsWaveSource.connect(analyser);
  } else {
    var source = lsAudioCtx.createMediaStreamSource(streamOrElement);
    source.connect(analyser);
  }

  var bufferLength = analyser.frequencyBinCount;
  var dataArray = new Uint8Array(bufferLength);

  function draw(){
    lsWaveAnimId = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    var barWidth = (canvas.width / bufferLength) * 1.8;
    var x = 0;
    for(var i = 0; i < bufferLength; i++){
      var barHeight = (dataArray[i] / 255) * canvas.height;
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd93d";
      ctx.fillRect(x, canvas.height - barHeight, barWidth, barHeight);
      x += barWidth + 2;
    }
  }
  draw();
}

function stopWave(){
  if(lsWaveAnimId){
    cancelAnimationFrame(lsWaveAnimId);
    lsWaveAnimId = null;
  }
  var canvas = document.getElementById("lsWaveCanvas");
  if(canvas){
    canvas.getContext("2d").clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    canvas.style.display = "none";
  }
}

function toggleRecording(){
  var btn = document.getElementById("lsRecordBtn");
  var status = document.getElementById("lsRecordStatus");

  if(!mediaRecorder || mediaRecorder.state === "inactive"){
    navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true }).then(function(stream){
      currentStream = stream;
      recordedChunks = [];
      mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream);
      mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = function(e){ recordedChunks.push(e.data); };
      mediaRecorder.onstop = function(){ if(window.resumeAppBgMusicAfterRecording){ window.resumeAppBgMusicAfterRecording(); }
        recordedBlob = new Blob(recordedChunks, { type: "audio/webm" });
        stopWave();
        document.getElementById("lsRecordBtn").style.display = "none";
        document.getElementById("lsPlaybackRow").style.display = "flex";
        document.getElementById("lsSubmitBtn").disabled = false;
        currentStream.getTracks().forEach(function(t){ t.stop(); });
      };
      if(window.pauseAppBgMusicForRecording){ window.pauseAppBgMusicForRecording(); } mediaRecorder.start();
      startWave(stream, false);
      btn.textContent = "■ Stop";
      btn.classList.add("ls-recording");
      status.textContent = "Recording...";
    }).catch(function(err){
      status.textContent = "Microphone access denied";
      console.error(err);
    });
  } else {
    mediaRecorder.stop();
  }
}

function playRecording(){
  var playBtn = document.getElementById("lsPlayBtn");
  var audioEl = document.getElementById("lsPlaybackAudio");
  var originalLabel = playBtn.innerHTML;
  playBtn.innerHTML = '<span class="ls-loading-pulse"></span>Loading...';
  playBtn.disabled = true;

  audioEl.src = URL.createObjectURL(recordedBlob);

  var onReady = function(){
    playBtn.innerHTML = originalLabel;
    playBtn.disabled = false;
    startWave(audioEl, true);
    audioEl.currentTime = 0;
    audioEl.play();
  };

  audioEl.addEventListener("canplay", onReady, { once: true });
  audioEl.addEventListener("ended", stopWave, { once: true });
}

function reRecord(){
  recordedBlob = null;
  document.getElementById("lsPlaybackRow").style.display = "none";
  var btn = document.getElementById("lsRecordBtn");
  btn.style.display = "inline-block";
  btn.textContent = "● Record";
  btn.classList.remove("ls-recording");
  document.getElementById("lsRecordStatus").textContent = "Not recorded yet";
  document.getElementById("lsSubmitBtn").disabled = true;
  document.getElementById("lsScoreDisplay").innerHTML = "";
}

function submitRecording(expectedText, partNum){
  var scoreDisplay = document.getElementById("lsScoreDisplay");
  scoreDisplay.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);">Scoring...</p>';

  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/assessPronunciation?referenceText=" + encodeURIComponent(expectedText || ""), {
    method: "POST",
    body: recordedBlob
  }).then(function(res){ return res.json(); }).then(function(data){
    var score = data.finalScore ?? data.score ?? data.AccuracyScore ?? data.accuracyScore ?? 0;
    score = Math.round(score);
    scoreDisplay.innerHTML =
      '<div class="ls-score">' + score + '%</div>' +
      '<div class="ls-btn-row">' +
      '<button class="ls-btn ls-btn-secondary" onclick="window.lsRetryRecording()">Try Again</button>' +
      '<button class="ls-btn ls-btn-primary" onclick="window.lsGoNext()">Continue</button>' +
      '</div>';
  }).catch(function(err){
    console.error(err);
    scoreDisplay.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#ff8a8a;">Could not score - please try again.</p>' +
      '<div class="ls-btn-row"><button class="ls-btn ls-btn-secondary" onclick="window.lsRetryRecording()">Try Again</button></div>';
  });
}

// C'est bon for Schools: who may open it.
// For now only the SayBon admin. To admit a partner school later, add its login email to SCHOOLS_ALLOWED_EMAILS.
export const SCHOOLS_ADMIN_EMAIL = "saybon.fr@gmail.com";
export const SCHOOLS_ALLOWED_EMAILS = [SCHOOLS_ADMIN_EMAIL];

export const SCHOOLS_LEVELS = [
  { id: "a0", label: "A0", sub: "Absolute Beginner" },
  { id: "a1", label: "A1", sub: "Beginner" },
  { id: "a2", label: "A2", sub: "Elementary" },
  { id: "b1", label: "B1", sub: "Intermediate" },
  { id: "b2", label: "B2", sub: "Upper Intermediate" }
];
export const SCHOOLS_LESSONS = 25;

function norm(u){ return String((u && u.email) || "").trim().toLowerCase(); }
export function isSchoolsAdmin(user){ return norm(user) === SCHOOLS_ADMIN_EMAIL; }
export function isSchoolsAllowed(user){ return SCHOOLS_ALLOWED_EMAILS.indexOf(norm(user)) !== -1; }


=== \public\schools\schools-guard.js ===
// Every page in /schools/ imports this. Not signed in -> login. Signed in but not invited -> dashboard.
import "/js/usage-track.js";
import { auth } from "/js/firebase-init.js";
import { onAuthStateChanged } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-auth.js";
import { isSchoolsAdmin, isSchoolsAllowed } from "/schools/schools-config.js";

document.documentElement.style.visibility = "hidden";

export const schoolsReady = new Promise(function(resolve){
  onAuthStateChanged(auth, function(user){
    if (!user) { window.location.replace("/auth/login.html"); return; }
    if (!isSchoolsAllowed(user)) { window.location.replace("/dashboard/"); return; }
    document.documentElement.style.visibility = "visible";
    resolve({ user: user, admin: isSchoolsAdmin(user) });
  });
});

=== \public\support\donate.js ===
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {

  const payBtn = document.getElementById("payBtn");
  const form = document.getElementById("donationForm");

  if (!payBtn || !form) return;

  payBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {

    const firstName = form.firstName.value.trim();
    const lastName = form.lastName.value.trim();
    const email = form.email.value.trim();
    const amount = Number(form.amount.value);
    const currency = form.currency.value;
    const message = form.message.value.trim();

    if (!email || !amount || amount <= 0) {
      alert("Please enter a valid donation amount.");
      return;
    }

    if (currency === "USD") {
      payWithStripe(firstName, lastName, email, amount, message);
    } else {
      payWithPaystack(firstName, lastName, email, amount, currency);
    }

  });

  function payWithPaystack(firstName, lastName, email, amount, currency) {

    const handler = PaystackPop.setup({
      key: "pk_live_adbd997a6cb7382da7c9e3e77c0ca487b93d73ab",

      email: email,
      amount: amount * 100,
      currency: currency,

      ref: "SAYBON_" + Date.now(),

      metadata: {
        custom_fields: [
          {
            display_name: "Donor Name",
            variable_name: "donor_name",
            value: firstName + " " + lastName
          }
        ]
      },

      callback: function (response) {
        sessionStorage.setItem("donorName", firstName || "friend");
        sessionStorage.setItem("donationRef", response.reference);

        window.location.href = "thank-you.html";
      },

      onClose: function () {
        alert("Donation cancelled.");
      }
    });

    handler.openIframe();
  }

  async function payWithStripe(firstName, lastName, email, amount, message) {

    payBtn.disabled = true;
    payBtn.textContent = "Redirecting to payment...";

    try {

      const res = await fetch("https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com/api/createDonationCheckout", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ firstName, lastName, email, amount, message })
      });

      const data = await res.json();

      if (!res.ok || !data.url) {
        alert("Could not start payment. Please try again.");
        payBtn.disabled = false;
        payBtn.textContent = "Continue to Payment";
        return;
      }

      sessionStorage.setItem("donorName", firstName || "friend");
      window.location.href = data.url;

    } catch (err) {
      alert("Could not start payment. Please try again.");
      payBtn.disabled = false;
      payBtn.textContent = "Continue to Payment";
    }

  }

});

// Verify and log the real payment - Stripe via session_id in URL,
// Paystack via the reference already stored during checkout.
(function verifyDonationPayment(){
  const API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";
  const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  const sessionId = params.get("session_id");
  const paystackRef = sessionStorage.getItem("donationRef");

  if(sessionId){
    fetch(API_BASE + "/api/verifyDonationSession?session_id=" + encodeURIComponent(sessionId))
      .catch(function(err){ console.error("Stripe donation verification failed:", err); });
  } else if(paystackRef){
    fetch(API_BASE + "/api/verifyPaystackDonation", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ reference: paystackRef })
    }).catch(function(err){ console.error("Paystack donation verification failed:", err); });
  }
})();

  window.location.href = "/dashboard/";

// ===== LOCATIONS =====

async function loadLocations(){

  const table = document.getElementById("locationsTable");
  table.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='5' class='empty-note'>Loading…</td></tr>";

  const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/locations");
  const locations = await res.json();

  if(!locations.length){
    table.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='5' class='empty-note'>No locations yet. Add your first one above.</td></tr>";
    return;
  }

  table.innerHTML = "";

  locations.forEach((loc, i) => {
    const row = document.createElement("tr");
    row.innerHTML =
      "<td><img class='thumb-sm' src='" + loc.imageUrl + "'></td>" +
      "<td>" + loc.name + "</td>" +
      "<td>" + loc.order + "</td>" +
      "<td>" + (loc.unlocked ? "<span class='badge-unlocked'>Unlocked</span>" : "<span class='badge-locked'>Locked</span>") + "</td>" +
      "<td>" +
      "<button class='btn-move' " + (i===0 ? "disabled" : "") + " onclick=\"moveLocation('" + loc.id + "','up')\">&#9650;</button> " +
      "<button class='btn-move' " + (i===locations.length-1 ? "disabled" : "") + " onclick=\"moveLocation('" + loc.id + "','down')\">&#9660;</button> " +
      "<button class='btn-delete' onclick=\"deleteLocation('" + loc.id + "')\">Delete</button>" +
      "</td>";
    table.appendChild(row);
  });

}

window.addLocation = async function(){

  const name = document.getElementById("addName").value.trim();
  const imageFile = document.getElementById("addImage").files[0];
  const btn = document.getElementById("addLocationBtn");
  const progressEl = document.getElementById("uploadProgress");

  if(!name){ alert("Please provide a location name."); return; }
  if(!imageFile){ alert("Please choose an image."); return; }

  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.innerText = "Uploading...";

  try{

    if(!auth.currentUser){ await signInAnonymously(auth); }

    const imgSrc = await window.compressImageFile(imageFile);
    const imgRef = ref(storage, "talkleticsLocations/" + Date.now() + "_" + imgSrc.name);
    const uploadTask = uploadBytesResumable(imgRef, imgSrc);

    const imageUrl = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      uploadTask.on("state_changed",
        (snapshot) => {
          const pct = Math.round((snapshot.bytesTransferred / snapshot.totalBytes) * 100);
          progressEl.innerText = "Uploading: " + pct + "%";
        },
        (err) => reject(err),
        async () => resolve(await getDownloadURL(uploadTask.snapshot.ref))
      );
    });

    const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminAddLocation", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ name, imageUrl })
    });

    if(res.ok){
      document.getElementById("addName").value = "";
      document.getElementById("addImage").value = "";
      progressEl.innerText = "Location added.";
      loadLocations();
    } else {
      alert("Could not add location.");
    }

  }catch(err){
    console.error(err);
    alert("Upload failed. Please try again.");
  }

  btn.disabled = false;
  btn.innerText = "Add Location";

};

window.moveLocation = async function(locationId, direction){
  await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminMoveLocation", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ locationId, direction })
  });
  loadLocations();
};

window.deleteLocation = async function(locationId){
  if(!confirm("Delete this location? This cannot be undone.")) return;
  await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminDeleteLocation", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ locationId })
  });
  loadLocations();
};

async function loadAssets(){

  const table = document.getElementById("assetsTable");
  table.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='4' class='empty-note'>Loading…</td></tr>";

  const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/assets");
  const assets = await res.json();

  if(!assets.length){
    table.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='4' class='empty-note'>No assets yet. Add your first one above.</td></tr>";
    return;
  }

  table.innerHTML = "";

  assets.forEach(a => {
    const row = document.createElement("tr");
    row.innerHTML =
      "<td>" + a.name + "</td>" +
      "<td>" + a.type + "</td>" +
      "<td><a class='asset-link' href='" + a.url + "' target='_blank'>" + a.url.slice(0,50) + "…</a></td>" +
      "<td>" +
      "<button onclick=\"renameAsset('" + a.id + "','" + a.name.replace(/'/g, "\\'") + "')\">Rename</button> " +
      "<button class='btn-delete' onclick=\"deleteAsset('" + a.id + "')\">Delete</button>" +
      "</td>";
    table.appendChild(row);
  });

}

window.addAsset = async function(){

  const name = document.getElementById("assetName").value.trim();
  const type = document.getElementById("assetType").value;
  const file = document.getElementById("assetFile").files[0];
  const btn = document.getElementById("addAssetBtn");
  const progressEl = document.getElementById("assetUploadProgress");

  if(!name){ alert("Please provide an asset name."); return; }
  if(!file){ alert("Please choose a file."); return; }

  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.innerText = "Uploading...";

  try{

    if(!auth.currentUser){ await signInAnonymously(auth); }

    const fileSrc = await window.compressImageFile(file);
    const fileRef = ref(storage, "talkleticsAssets/" + Date.now() + "_" + fileSrc.name);
    const uploadTask = uploadBytesResumable(fileRef, fileSrc);

    const url = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      uploadTask.on("state_changed",
        (snapshot) => {
          const pct = Math.round((snapshot.bytesTransferred / snapshot.totalBytes) * 100);
          progressEl.innerText = "Uploading: " + pct + "%";
        },
        (err) => reject(err),
        async () => resolve(await getDownloadURL(uploadTask.snapshot.ref))
      );
    });

    const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminAddAsset", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ name, type, url })
    });

    if(res.ok){
      document.getElementById("assetName").value = "";
      document.getElementById("assetFile").value = "";
      progressEl.innerText = "Asset added.";
      loadAssets();
    } else {
      alert("Could not add asset.");
    }

  }catch(err){
    console.error(err);
    alert("Upload failed. Please try again.");
  }

  btn.disabled = false;
  btn.innerText = "Add Asset";

};

window.renameAsset = async function(assetId, currentName){
  var newName = prompt("Rename asset:", currentName);
  if(!newName || newName === currentName) return;
  await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminRenameAsset", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ assetId, newName })
  });
  loadAssets();
};

window.deleteAsset = async function(assetId){
  if(!confirm("Delete this asset?")) return;
  await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminDeleteAsset", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ assetId })
  });
  loadAssets();
};

=== \public\talkletics\admin-open.js ===
/* Talkletics: the SayBon admin account opens every place, the same way the lessons are opened for it.
   Reads the signed-in Firebase user that the browser already holds; nothing is sent anywhere. */
(function(){
  var ADMIN="saybon.fr@gmail.com";
  function fromLocal(){
    try{for(var i=0;i<localStorage.length;i++){var k=localStorage.key(i);
      if(k&&k.indexOf("firebase:authUser:")===0){var u=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(k)||"null");if(u&&u.email)return String(u.email).toLowerCase();}}}catch(e){}
    return "";
  }
  function fromIDB(){
    return new Promise(function(res){
      try{
        var rq=indexedDB.open("firebaseLocalStorageDb");
        rq.onerror=function(){res("");};
        rq.onsuccess=function(){
          try{
            var db=rq.result;if(!db.objectStoreNames.contains("firebaseLocalStorage")){db.close();return res("");}
            var g=db.transaction("firebaseLocalStorage","readonly").objectStore("firebaseLocalStorage").getAll();
            g.onsuccess=function(){var out="";(g.result||[]).forEach(function(r){var v=r&&r.value;if(r&&String(r.fbase_key).indexOf("firebase:authUser:")===0&&v&&v.email)out=String(v.email).toLowerCase();});db.close();res(out);};
            g.onerror=function(){db.close();res("");};
          }catch(e){res("");}
        };
      }catch(e){res("");}
    });
  }
  window.tkIsAdmin=function(){
    var l=fromLocal();if(l)return Promise.resolve(l===ADMIN);
    return fromIDB().then(function(e){return e===ADMIN;});
  };
})();
