/* Talkletics curriculum - single source of truth for the journey hub, the game player and the curriculum document.
   Every media item is a PLACEHOLDER until a real file named by its `key` exists in Talkletics assets:
     audio  = transcript only        (the voice will say this)
     video  = icon + transcript      (a video where this is said; scene in `description`)
     image  = icon + description     (an image to generate; this is what it shows)
   Real files are looked up by `key` in /api/assets (asset name === key). */
(function (root) {
  var TK = { levels: [], version: 1 };

  var KINDS = {
    echo:     ["Répétez", "Repeat after me"],
    see:      ["Dites ce que vous voyez", "Say what you see"],
    answer:   ["Répondez", "Answer the question"],
    role:     ["Jeu de rôle", "Role-play"],
    describe: ["Décrivez", "Describe"],
    opinion:  ["Donnez votre avis", "Give your opinion"],
    story:    ["Racontez", "Tell a story"],
    debate:   ["Débattez", "Debate"],
    summary:  ["Résumez", "Summarise"],
    present:  ["Présentez", "Present"],
    mediate:  ["Négociez", "Negotiate"]
  };
  TK.kinds = KINDS;

  // ---- item builders ------------------------------------------------------
  // ref items: graded by pronunciation assessment against the expected text
  function E(fr, en, key) {                       // echo: hear it, say it
    return { mode: "ref", expected: fr, en: en, showText: true, key: key || null,
             media: { type: "audio", transcript: fr } };
  }
  function S(icon, desc, fr, en, key) {           // see: say what the picture shows
    return { mode: "ref", expected: fr, en: en, showText: false, key: key || null,
             voice: "Qu'est-ce que c'est ?",
             media: { type: "image", icon: icon, description: desc } };
  }
  // free items: graded on transcript (content + language) + fluency + clarity
  function free(media, voice, en, task, must, sample, min, max, key) {
    return { mode: "free", voice: voice, en: en, task: task, must: must, sample: sample,
             min: min || null, max: max || null, key: key || null, media: media, showText: false };
  }
  function A(say, en, task, must, sample, min, max) {        // audio question
    return free({ type: "audio", transcript: say }, say, en, task, must, sample, min, max);
  }
  function V(scene, say, en, task, must, sample, min, max) { // video line
    return free({ type: "video", icon: "🎬", transcript: say, description: scene }, say, en, task, must, sample, min, max);
  }
  function I(icon, desc, voice, en, task, must, sample, min, max) { // image + guide question
    return free({ type: "image", icon: icon, description: desc }, voice, en, task, must, sample, min, max);
  }
  root.TK_BUILD = { E: E, S: S, A: A, V: V, I: I };

  // ---- level registration -------------------------------------------------
  function LEVEL(d) {
    d.order = TK.levels.length + 1;
    var n = 0;
    function prep(g, gid, isGrad) {
      g.id = gid; g.level = d.id; g.isGraduation = !!isGrad;
      g.kindLabel = KINDS[g.kind] || KINDS.answer;
      g.items.forEach(function (it, i) {
        it.id = gid + "-" + (i + 1);
        it.key = it.key || it.id;
        it.media.key = it.key;
        if (it.mode === "free") {
          it.min = it.min || d.defMin;
          it.max = Math.min(it.max || d.defMax, 55);   // Azure short-audio limit is 60 s
        }
      });
      g.passMark = isGrad ? d.gradPass : d.pass;
    }
    d.games.forEach(function (g, i) { prep(g, d.id.toLowerCase() + "g" + (i + 1), false); g.index = i + 1; });
    prep(d.graduation, d.id.toLowerCase() + "grad", true);
    d.graduation.index = d.games.length + 1;
    TK.levels.push(d);
  }
  root.TK_LEVEL = LEVEL;

  // ---- lookups ------------------------------------------------------------
  TK.allGames = function () {
    var out = [];
    TK.levels.forEach(function (l) { l.games.forEach(function (g) { out.push(g); }); out.push(l.graduation); });
    return out;
  };
  TK.game = function (id) { return TK.allGames().filter(function (g) { return g.id === id; })[0] || null; };
  TK.level = function (id) { return TK.levels.filter(function (l) { return l.id === id; })[0] || null; };
  root.TK_CURRICULUM = TK;
})(typeof window !== "undefined" ? window : globalThis);

=== \public\talkletics\journey.js ===
import { whenUser, loadProgress, status, esc, CUR } from "./tk-common.js";

var main = document.getElementById("jyMain");
var params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
var unlockAll = params.get("preview") === "1";

(async function () {
  var user = await whenUser();
  if (!user) { main.innerHTML = '<p class="jy-loading">Please sign in to play.</p>'; return; }
  var scores = await loadProgress();
  var html = "";
  var firstOpen = null;

  CUR.levels.forEach(function (lv) {
    var gradSt = status(lv, lv.graduation, scores, unlockAll);
    var levelDone = gradSt.done;
    var firstSt = status(lv, lv.games[0], scores, unlockAll);
    var doneCount = lv.games.filter(function (g) { return status(lv, g, scores, unlockAll).done; }).length;
    html += '<section class="jy-level' + (firstSt.unlocked ? "" : " is-locked") + '" id="lv-' + lv.id + '">' +
      '<div class="jy-level-head"><span class="jy-cefr">' + esc(lv.cefr) + '</span><div><h2>' + esc(lv.place) +
      '</h2><p>' + esc(lv.placeEn) + ' · ' + esc(lv.tagline) + '</p></div><span class="jy-count">' +
      (levelDone ? "✓" : doneCount + "/" + lv.games.length) + '</span></div>' +
      '<div class="jy-scene">' + esc(lv.sceneImage.icon) + ' <small>' + esc(lv.sceneImage.description) + '</small></div>' +
      '<div class="jy-games">';
    lv.games.concat([lv.graduation]).forEach(function (g) {
      var st = status(lv, g, scores, unlockAll);
      if (st.unlocked && !st.done && !firstOpen) firstOpen = g.id;
      var tag = st.unlocked ? "a" : "div";
      var href = st.unlocked ? ' href="play.html?game=' + g.id + (unlockAll ? "&preview=1" : "") + '"' : "";
      html += "<" + tag + ' class="jy-game' + (g.isGraduation ? " is-grad" : "") + (st.done ? " is-done" : "") +
        (st.unlocked ? "" : " is-locked") + '" id="g-' + g.id + '"' + href + ">" +
        '<span class="jy-num">' + (g.isGraduation ? "🎓" : g.index) + "</span>" +
        '<span class="jy-gt"><b>' + esc(g.title) + "</b><i>" + esc(g.titleEn) + " · " + esc(g.kindLabel[1]) + "</i></span>" +
        '<span class="jy-stars">' + (st.unlocked ? (st.done ? "★".repeat(st.stars) + "☆".repeat(3 - st.stars) : (st.avg ? st.avg + "%" : "")) : "🔒") + "</span></" + tag + ">";
    });
    html += "</div>" +
      '<p class="jy-grad-note">🎓 <b>' + esc(lv.graduation.title) + '</b> - ' + esc(lv.graduationMeans) + '</p></section>';
  });

  main.innerHTML = html;
  if (firstOpen) {
    var el = document.getElementById("g-" + firstOpen);
    if (el) { el.classList.add("is-next"); el.scrollIntoView({ block: "center" }); }
  }
})();

function buildChain(){

  world.style.width=LAY.W+"px";world.style.height=LAY.H+"px";house.style.width=LAY.W+"px";house.style.height=LAY.H+"px";
}
function camTarget(t){
  var cover=Math.max(vw/LAY.W,(vh*1.0)/LAY.H);
  var z=cover*Math.max(1,LAY.zoom*(PORTRAIT?1:Math.min(1.15,vw/1300+0.3)));
  var breathe=1+Math.sin(t/5200)*0.018;var s=Math.max(cover,z*breathe);
  var fx=charX+Math.sin(t/4300)*26,fy=charY-LAY.ch*0.45+Math.cos(t/3700)*18;
  var tx=vw/2-fx*s,ty=vh*LAY.anchor-fy*s;
  tx=clamp(tx,vw-LAY.W*s,0);ty=clamp(ty,vh-LAY.H*s-vh*0.24,0); // the picture may slide up a little so the card never hides the child at the gate
  return {x:tx,y:ty,s:s};
}
var lastT=performance.now();
function loop(t){
  var dt=Math.min(80,t-lastT);lastT=t;if(CHAIN.length)updateActor(t);var g=camTarget(t);
  if(!cam.ready){cam.x=g.x;cam.y=g.y;cam.s=g.s;cam.ready=true;}
  var k=1-Math.pow(0.0008,dt/1000);cam.x+=(g.x-cam.x)*k;cam.y+=(g.y-cam.y)*k;cam.s+=(g.s-cam.s)*k;
  world.style.transform="translate("+cam.x.toFixed(1)+"px,"+cam.y.toFixed(1)+"px) scale("+cam.s.toFixed(4)+")";
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

async function encourage(score,idx){
  if(!XT||score<62)return;
  var pool=null;
  if(idx+1===Math.floor(N/2))pool=[5];
  else if(N>14&&idx+1===N-3)pool=[11];
  else if(sinceEnc>=encGap)pool=streak>=5?[1,3,4,6,7,8,9,12,14,15,16]:[1,2,4,10,13,15,16];
  if(!pool)return;
  pool=pool.filter(function(n){return n!==lastEnc;});var n=pool[Math.floor(Math.random()*pool.length)];
  lastEnc=n;sinceEnc=0;encGap=8+Math.floor(Math.random()*5);
  setPhase("","Well done");setDir(XT.enc[n-1]);await say("enc"+n);await sleep(300);
}


/* ---------- microphone: opens by itself, no record button ---------- */
var stream=null,actx=null,analyser=null,srcNode=null;
function wavOf(blob){
  return blob.arrayBuffer().then(function(buf){
    var Ctx=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext,c=new Ctx();
    return new Promise(function(res,rej){c.decodeAudioData(buf,res,rej);}).then(function(dec){
      try{c.close();}catch(e){}
      var rate=16000,len=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(Math.min(dec.duration,60)*rate)),off=new OfflineAudioContext(1,len,rate),s=off.createBufferSource();
      s.buffer=dec;s.connect(off.destination);s.start(0);return off.startRendering();});
  }).then(function(r){
    var d=r.getChannelData(0),n=d.length,v=new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(44+n*2));
    function str(o,t){for(var i=0;i<t.length;i++)v.setUint8(o+i,t.charCodeAt(i));}
    str(0,"RIFF");v.setUint32(4,36+n*2,true);str(8,"WAVE");str(12,"fmt ");v.setUint32(16,16,true);v.setUint16(20,1,true);v.setUint16(22,1,true);
    v.setUint32(24,16000,true);v.setUint32(28,32000,true);v.setUint16(32,2,true);v.setUint16(34,16,true);str(36,"data");v.setUint32(40,n*2,true);
    var pk=0;for(var j=0;j<n;j++){var q=Math.abs(d[j]);if(q>pk)pk=q;}var G=(pk>0.004&&pk<0.7)?Math.min(40,0.85/pk):1;for(var i=0;i<n;i++){var s=Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,d[i]*G));v.setInt16(44+i*2,s<0?s*0x8000:s*0x7FFF,true);}
    return new Blob([v],{type:"audio/wav"});
  });
}
function openMic(){
  if(stream)return Promise.resolve();
  if(!navigator.mediaDevices||!navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia)return Promise.reject(new Error("nomic"));
  return navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({audio:{echoCancellation:true,noiseSuppression:true,autoGainControl:true}}).then(function(s){
    stream=s;var C=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;actx=new C();
    srcNode=actx.createMediaStreamSource(s);analyser=actx.createAnalyser();analyser.fftSize=1024;srcNode.connect(analyser);
  });
}
var wave=$("wave"),wctx=wave.getContext("2d"),levels=[];
function drawWave(){
  var w=wave.width,h=wave.height;wctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);var n=48,bw=w/n;
  for(var i=0;i<n;i++){var v=levels[levels.length-n+i]||0,bh=Math.max(4,Math.min(h,v*h*5));
    wctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,215,106,"+(0.45+Math.min(.55,v*4))+")";var x=i*bw+bw*0.2;
    wctx.beginPath();if(wctx.roundRect)wctx.roundRect(x,(h-bh)/2,bw*0.6,bh,3);else wctx.rect(x,(h-bh)/2,bw*0.6,bh);wctx.fill();}
}
// listens until the learner has spoken and then stopped; resolves {blob} or {none:true}
function closeMic(){try{if(stream)stream.getTracks().forEach(function(t){t.stop();});}catch(e){}try{if(actx)actx.close();}catch(e){}stream=null;actx=null;analyser=null;srcNode=null;}/*volfix*/
function capture(){return openMic().then(capture0).then(function(r){closeMic();return r;},function(e){closeMic();throw e;});}
function capture0(){
  return new Promise(function(resolve){
    if(actx&&actx.state==="suspended")actx.resume();
    stream.getAudioTracks().forEach(function(t){t.enabled=true;});
    var mime=window.MediaRecorder&&MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported&&MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported("audio/webm;codecs=opus")?"audio/webm;codecs=opus":"";
    var rec=mime?new MediaRecorder(stream,{mimeType:mime}):new MediaRecorder(stream),chunks=[];
    rec.ondataavailable=function(e){if(e.data&&e.data.size)chunks.push(e.data);};
    var buf=new Uint8Array(analyser.fftSize),start=performance.now(),spoke=false,voiceAt=0,quietAt=0,floor=null,calib=[],ended=false,maxR=0;
    levels=[];wave.classList.add("show");
    function fin(none){
      if(ended)return;ended=true;wave.classList.remove("show");
      stream.getAudioTracks().forEach(function(t){t.enabled=false;});
      if(none){try{rec.stop();}catch(e){}resolve({none:true});return;}
      rec.onstop=function(){resolve({blob:new Blob(chunks,{type:rec.mimeType||"audio/webm"})});};try{rec.stop();}catch(e){resolve({none:true});}
    }
    rec.start(100);
    (function tick(){
      if(ended)return;if(paused)return fin(true);
      analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(buf);var sum=0;for(var i=0;i<buf.length;i++){var x=(buf[i]-128)/128;sum+=x*x;}
      var rms=Math.sqrt(sum/buf.length);levels.push(rms);if(rms>maxR)maxR=rms;drawWave();
      var now=performance.now(),el=now-start;
      if(el<450){calib.push(rms);}else if(floor===null){var cs=calib.slice().sort(function(a,b){return a-b;});floor=cs.length?cs[Math.floor(cs.length*0.3)]:0;}
      if(floor!==null){
        var thr=Math.min(0.05,Math.max(0.012,floor*2.4));
        if(rms>thr){if(!voiceAt)voiceAt=now;if(now-voiceAt>140)spoke=true;quietAt=0;}
        else{voiceAt=0;if(spoke){if(!quietAt)quietAt=now;if(now-quietAt>1250)return fin(false);}}
      }
      if(!spoke&&el>11000)return fin(!(maxR>Math.max(0.014,(floor||0)*1.8)));
      if(el>14000)return fin(false);
      requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    })();
  });
}

/* ---------- scoring: every word is graded on how accurately it was said, and the worst words pull the phrase down ---------- */
// Azure's word accuracy -> our word grade: sounds like the word = 50 (the pass mark), said exactly right = up to 100,
// nothing like it = 20 or less. The leniency lives here, in the word, not in a bonus on the whole phrase.
function wordGrade(w){
  if(w.errorType==="Omission")return 0;
  var a=clamp(w.accuracyScore||0,0,100);
  if(a>=80)return 85+(a-80)*0.75;
  if(a>=60)return 50+(a-60)*1.75;
  return a*(50/60);
}
function grade(out){
  if(!out||!out.recognizedText)return 0;
  var ws=(out.words||[]).filter(function(w){return w.errorType!=="Insertion";});
  if(!ws.length)ws=[{accuracyScore:out.accuracyScore||0}];
  var g=ws.map(wordGrade),mean=g.reduce(function(x,y){return x+y;},0)/g.length,worst=Math.min.apply(null,g);
  var s=0.4*mean+0.6*worst; // one badly said word cannot hide behind the good ones
  s*=0.92+0.08*clamp((out.fluencyScore||0)/100,0,1);
  return clamp(Math.round(s),0,100);
}
function assess(blob,ref){
  return wavOf(blob).then(function(wav){
    return fetch(API+"/api/assessPronunciation?referenceText="+encodeURIComponent(ref),{method:"POST",body:wav});
  }).then(function(r){return r.json().then(function(j){if(!r.ok)throw new Error(j&&j.error||"fail");return j;});});
}

var C=null,flat=[],N=0,st={idx:0,gain:0,sum:0,done:0,who:null,finished:false};
function load(){try{var s=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SAVE));if(s&&typeof s.idx==="number")st=Object.assign(st,s);}catch(e){}}

function unlockNext(){try{var c=parseInt(localStorage.getItem("tkMapUnlocked"),10)||1;if(c<2)localStorage.setItem("tkMapUnlocked","2");}catch(e){}}
function setBar(){$("barFill").style.width=Math.min(100,st.gain/N*100).toFixed(1)+"%";}
function setPhase(cls,txt){var p=document.querySelector(".mz-phase");p.className="mz-phase "+cls;$("phaseTxt").textContent=txt;}
function dots(n,state){var d=$("listenDots").children;for(var i=0;i<3;i++)d[i].className=i<n?"done":(i===n&&state==="on"?"on":"");}
function chips(words,ref){
  var el=$("frWords");el.innerHTML="";
  var list=words&&words.length?words:ref.split(/\s+/).map(function(w){return {word:w,accuracyScore:null,errorType:null};});
  list.forEach(function(w){var e=document.createElement("em"),a=w.accuracyScore;
    e.textContent=w.word;e.className=(w.errorType==="Omission"||(a!=null&&a<55))?"r":(a!=null&&a<80)?"a":(a!=null?"g":"");el.appendChild(e);});
}
function label(s){return s>=88?"Parfait !":s>=75?"Très bien !":s>=62?"Bien !":s>=50?"On avance !":"Presque !";}
function hintFor(words){
  if(!words||!words.length)return "";
  var bad=words.filter(function(w){return w.errorType==="Omission"||(w.accuracyScore!=null&&w.accuracyScore<55);}).map(function(w){return w.word.replace(/[.,!?;:]/g,"");}).filter(Boolean);
  if(!bad.length)return "";
  return (bad.length===1?"Work on this word: ":"Work on these words: ")+bad.slice(0,3).join(", ")+".";
}
function sectionOf(i){var n=0;for(var s=0;s<C.sections.length;s++){var L=C.sections[s].items.length;if(i<n+L)return {sec:C.sections[s],k:i-n,L:L};n+=L;}return null;}

var lastSec=null;
function setDir(txt,go){var d=$("dir");d.innerHTML=go?'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="9" y="3" width="6" height="11" rx="3"/><path d="M5 11a7 7 0 0 0 14 0M12 18v3"/></svg><span></span>':"<span></span>";d.lastChild.textContent=txt;d.className="mz-dir"+(go?" go":"");$("card").classList.toggle("speaking",!!go);}
function chime(){ // a short two-note signal so nobody misses that it is their turn
  try{if(!actx)return;var t=actx.currentTime;[[660,0],[990,0.16]].forEach(function(n){var o=actx.createOscillator(),g=actx.createGain();o.type="sine";o.frequency.value=n[0];
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001,t+n[1]);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.22,t+n[1]+0.02);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,t+n[1]+0.2);o.connect(g);g.connect(actx.destination);o.start(t+n[1]);o.stop(t+n[1]+0.22);});}catch(e){}
}
async function runItem(){
  var info=sectionOf(st.idx),item=info.sec.items[info.k],arcs=SECARC[info.sec.id],a0=arcs[0],a1=arcs[arcs.length-1];
  $("result").hidden=true;$("againBtn").hidden=true;$("skipBtn").hidden=true;$("introSkip").hidden=true;
  $("en").innerHTML="&nbsp;";dots(0);
  if(lastSec!==info.sec.id){
    lastSec=info.sec.id;
    $("secFr").textContent=info.sec.fr;$("secEn").textContent=info.sec.title;
    var b=$("banner");$("banFr").textContent=info.sec.fr;$("banEn").textContent=info.sec.title;b.hidden=false;b.style.animation="none";void b.offsetWidth;b.style.animation="";
    setTimeout(function(){b.hidden=true;},2700);
    setPhase("","Next place");setDir("");$("en").textContent=info.sec.intro;
    var walk=Math.abs(arc-a0)>2?glide(a0,LAY.ch*1.7):Promise.resolve();
    await Promise.all([say("sec-"+info.sec.id),walk]);
    await sleep(250);
  }
  $("en").textContent=item.en;
  var fails=0,noHear=0,first=true;
  for(;;){
    await waitResume();    var reps=3;first=false;
    $("result").hidden=true;
    for(var k=0;k<reps;k++){
      setPhase("","Listen · "+(k+1)+"/"+reps);dots(k,"on");
      setDir(k===0?"Stay quiet and listen. The teacher will say this "+reps+" times.":"Keep listening, without speaking.");
      var played=await say(item.id);
      if(!played&&!skipThis){$("en").textContent="Teacher audio is still being prepared for this phrase.";await sleep(1400);}
      await sleep(850);dots(k+1);
      if(skipThis)break;
    }
    if(skipThis){skipThis=false;st.done++;break;}
    setPhase("","Get ready");setDir("Get ready…");await sleep(700);
    chime();await sleep(480);
    setPhase("speak","Speak now");setDir("Speak now! Say it as accurately as you heard it.",true);
    var cap;try{cap=await capture();}catch(e){cap={none:true};}
    $("card").classList.remove("speaking");
    if(skipThis){skipThis=false;st.done++;break;}
    if(cap.none&&pauseHit){pauseHit=false;await waitResume();continue;}
    if(cap.none){
      noHear++;setPhase("","I didn't hear you");setDir("I didn't hear you. Listen once more, then speak a little louder.");await say("nohear");await sleep(300);
      if(noHear>=2){$("hint").textContent="Check your microphone is allowed, and speak right after the signal.";$("result").hidden=false;$("scoreNum").textContent="–";$("scoreLbl").textContent="";chips([],item.fr);}
      continue;
    }
    setPhase("eval","Evaluating…");setDir("Evaluating…");
    var out;
    try{out=await assess(cap.blob,item.fr.replace(/[«»]/g,""));}catch(e){
      noHear++;setPhase("","Couldn't evaluate");setDir("The scoring service didn't answer. Let's try again.");$("result").hidden=false;$("scoreNum").textContent="–";$("scoreLbl").textContent="";chips([],item.fr);
      await sleep(1800);continue;
    }
    var score=grade(out),pass=score>=50;
    $("scoreNum").textContent=score;$("scoreLbl").textContent=label(score);chips(out.words,item.fr);
    $("hint").textContent=hintFor(out.words);$("result").hidden=false;
    if(pass){
      var q=clamp((score-50)/45,0,1);st.lastQ=q;st.gain+=0.45+0.55*q;st.sum+=score;st.done++;setBar();
      setPhase("","Well done");setDir("Well done! Moving on…");
      // every passing score propels the child along the route: a better score, a longer step
      var target=a0+(a1-a0)*(info.k+1)/info.L,step=arc+(target-arc)*(0.55+0.45*q);
      await Promise.all([glide(Math.max(arc,step),LAY.ch*1.05),say("ok"+(1+Math.floor(Math.random()*6))),sleep(2400)]);
      streak++;sinceEnc++;await encourage(score,st.idx);
      break;
    }
    fails++;streak=0;setPhase("","Almost");setDir("Not quite yet. Press the replay button, listen again and match it as closely as you can.");
    // the replay button stays until they get across, however many tries it takes
    var tapped=new Promise(function(res){$("againBtn").onclick=function(){stopVoice();res();};});
    $("againBtn").hidden=false;$("skipBtn").hidden=true;
    say("retry"+(1+Math.floor(Math.random()*4)));
    await tapped;
    $("againBtn").hidden=true;
  }
  skipThis=false;
  st.idx++;save();
}
var skipThis=false;
$("skipBtn").onclick=function(){skipThis=true;stopVoice();$("skipBtn").hidden=true;};

async function game(){
  $("top").hidden=false;$("card").hidden=false;
  $("pauseBtn").hidden=false;await introGate();
  while(st.idx<N){await runItem();}
  $("pauseBtn").hidden=true;
  st.finished=true;save();unlockNext();
  $("card").hidden=true;$("top").hidden=true;
  var dist=Math.round(st.gain/N*100),avg=st.done?Math.round(st.sum/st.done):0;
  $("fDist").textContent=dist+"%";$("fAvg").textContent=avg;
  $("finalTxt").textContent=dist>=90?"You spoke it beautifully, all the way round.":"You made it round the whole house. Play again to go even further.";
  $("final").hidden=false;say("final");
}

/* ---------- start screen ---------- */
function reset(){st={idx:0,gain:0,sum:0,done:0,who:st.who,finished:false,introDone:false};save();}

(function(){
  var BASE="/assets/talkletics/map/";
  var mapEl=document.getElementById("tkmMap");
  try{history.scrollRestoration="manual";}catch(e){}
  var L=null,P=null,state=null;

  var ADMIN=false,BUILT={"arret-de-bus":1,banque:1,maison:1,cuisine:1,salon:1,chambre:1,"salle-de-bains":1,"la-maison":1,boulangerie:1,supermarche:1,marche:1,patisserie:1,cafe:1,restaurant:1,"salon-de-coiffure":1,laverie:1,pharmacie:1,poste:1,"salle-de-sport":1,"station-taxis":1,parc:1,ecole:1};
  function unlockedCount(){
    if(ADMIN)return P.length;
    var q=new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("unlocked");
    if(q&&/^\d+$/.test(q))return Math.min(P.length,Math.max(1,+q));
    try{var v=parseInt(localStorage.getItem("tkMapUnlocked"),10);if(v>0)return Math.min(P.length,v);}catch(e){}
    return 1;
  }
  function dev(){return window.matchMedia("(max-width:768px)").matches?"mobile":"desktop";}

  // Lay all 50 places along the road. Open places are big (fill the road), locked ones small;
  // each place takes the room it needs, so everything after an open place shifts to make space.
  function layout(c,un){
    var res=[],tile=0,cursor=c.s0,i=0,k;
    function pathOf(t){return t===0?c.start:c.cont;}
    function lenOf(t){return t===0?c.startLen:c.contLen;}
    function pt(t,s){ // s = arc length from the bottom of tile t
      var a=pathOf(t),l=lenOf(t),f=Math.min(a.length-1,Math.max(0,s/l*(a.length-1))),i0=Math.floor(f),t1=f-i0,p0=a[i0],p1=a[Math.min(a.length-1,i0+1)];
      return [p0[0]+(p1[0]-p0[0])*t1,p0[1]+(p1[1]-p0[1])*t1];
    }
    for(k=0;k<P.length;k++){
      var w=(k<un?c.big:c.small)*c.w,half=w*0.54;
      if(cursor+2*half>lenOf(tile)-c.tail){tile++;cursor=c.cstart;}
      var center=cursor+half,p=pt(tile,center);
      res.push({x:p[0]/c.w,yb:tile*c.h+(c.h-p[1]),tile:tile,w:w});
      cursor=center+half+c.small*c.w*0.3;
    }
    return res;
  }
  function visibleTiles(pts,un,c){
    var t=pts[un-1].tile,vt=t+1;
    if(un<pts.length&&pts[un].tile>t)vt=t+2;
    return vt;
  }
  // positions are percentages of the road stack itself, so they never depend on measured pixel sizes
  function style(b,pt,c,vt){
    b.style.left=(pt.x*100)+"%";b.style.bottom=(pt.yb/(vt*c.h)*100)+"%";b.style.width=(pt.w/c.w*100)+"%";
  }
  function build(b,p,open){
    b.className="tkm-node "+(open?"tkm-node-unlocked":"tkm-node-locked");
    b.setAttribute("aria-label",p.name+(open?"":" (locked)"));
    b.tabIndex=open?0:-1;
    var lk=b.querySelector(".tkm-lock");
    if(!open&&!lk){lk=document.createElement("span");lk.className="tkm-lock";lk.innerHTML='<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round"><rect x="5" y="11" width="14" height="9" rx="2"/><path d="M8 11V8a4 4 0 0 1 8 0v3"/></svg>';b.appendChild(lk);}
    if(open&&lk)lk.remove();
    b.onclick=open?function(){if(BUILT[p.slug])location.href=p.slug+".html";else toast(p.name+" is being built.");}:null;
  }

  function toast(t){var e=document.getElementById("tkmToast");if(!e){e=document.createElement("div");e.id="tkmToast";e.style.cssText="position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:92px;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:50;padding:10px 18px;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(20,20,30,.82);color:#fff;font:600 14px Poppins,sans-serif;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);transition:opacity .3s";document.body.appendChild(e);}
    e.textContent=t;e.style.opacity=1;clearTimeout(e._t);e._t=setTimeout(function(){e.style.opacity=0;},2200);}
  function lock(un){document.documentElement.classList.toggle("tkm-locked",un<25);if(un<25)window.scrollTo(0,0);}
  function render(animate){
    var d=dev(),c=L[d],un=unlockedCount(),pts=layout(c,un),vt=Math.min(visibleTiles(pts,un,c),99);lock(un);
    mapEl.innerHTML="";
    var stack=document.createElement("div");stack.className="tkm-stack";mapEl.appendChild(stack);
    for(var i=vt-1;i>=0;i--){var im=new Image();im.className="bg";im.alt="";im.draggable=false;im.src=BASE+"bg/"+d+"-"+(i===0?"start":"cont")+".webp";stack.appendChild(im);}
    var nodes=[];
    for(var k=0;k<P.length;k++){
      if(pts[k].tile>=vt)break;
      var p=P[k],b=document.createElement("button");
      var img=new Image();img.className="tkm-node-img";img.alt=p.name;img.src=BASE+"places/"+p.img;
      var bd=new Image();bd.className="tkm-node-badge";bd.alt="";bd.src=BASE+"badges/"+p.badge;
      b.appendChild(img);b.appendChild(bd);
      build(b,p,k<un);style(b,pts[k],c,vt);
      stack.appendChild(b);nodes.push(b);
    }
    state={d:d,un:un,vt:vt,nodes:nodes,c:c};
    var bgs=[].slice.call(mapEl.querySelectorAll("img.bg")),left=bgs.length;
    function ready(){
      if(--left>0)return;
      window.scrollTo(0,document.documentElement.scrollHeight);
      nodes.forEach(function(n,i){
        if(animate===false){n.classList.add("tkm-node-visible");return;}
        setTimeout(function(){n.classList.add("tkm-node-visible");},500+i*320);
      });
    }
    bgs.forEach(function(g){if(g.complete)ready();else{g.onload=g.onerror=ready;}});
  }

  // When a place unlocks: it grows and everything after it makes room, smoothly, in place.
  function refresh(){
    var un=unlockedCount();
    if(!state||un===state.un)return;
    var c=state.c,pts=layout(c,un),vt=visibleTiles(pts,un,c);
    if(vt!==state.vt||dev()!==state.d){render(false);return;}
    state.nodes.forEach(function(b,k){build(b,P[k],k<un);style(b,pts[k],c,vt);});
    state.un=un;lock(un);
  }
  window.tkMapSetUnlocked=function(n){try{localStorage.setItem("tkMapUnlocked",String(n));}catch(e){}refresh();};
  window.addEventListener("storage",function(e){if(e.key==="tkMapUnlocked")refresh();});

  Promise.all([fetch(BASE+"layout.json?v=9").then(function(r){return r.json();}),fetch(BASE+"places.json?v=9").then(function(r){return r.json();})])
    .then(function(a){

      var rt,lw=window.innerWidth;window.addEventListener("resize",function(){if(window.innerWidth===lw)return;lw=window.innerWidth;clearTimeout(rt);rt=setTimeout(function(){render(false);},200);});
    }).catch(function(e){console.error(e);mapEl.innerHTML="<p style='text-align:center;color:#fff;font-weight:700;padding:80px 20px;'>Could not load the map. Please try again.</p>";});
})();

(function(){
"use strict";
var API="https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";
var SLUG=document.body.getAttribute("data-place"),SH="/assets/talkletics/maison/",BASE="/assets/talkletics/places/"+SLUG+"/";
var SAVE="tkPlace-"+SLUG;
var $=function(id){return document.getElementById(id);};
var sleep=function(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms);});};
var clamp=function(x,a,b){return Math.max(a,Math.min(b,x));};

fetch(BASE+"config.json?v=1").then(function(r){return r.json();}).then(function(CFG){
var PORTRAIT=window.innerWidth/window.innerHeight<0.9;
var LAY=CFG.layouts[PORTRAIT?"m":"d"];LAY.lamps=[];var SPOTS=LAY.spots||CFG.spots;
document.title="Talkletics - "+CFG.name;
$("pickTitle").textContent=CFG.name;$("pickKicker").textContent="Talkletics · Place "+CFG.order;
var ADJ={};LAY.e.split(" ").forEach(function(p){var a=p.split("-");(ADJ[a[0]]=ADJ[a[0]]||[]).push(a[1]);(ADJ[a[1]]=ADJ[a[1]]||[]).push(a[0]);});
function dist(a,b){return Math.hypot(a[0]-b[0],a[1]-b[1]);}
function route(from,to){ // Dijkstra over the walkable points
  var D={},P={},Q=Object.keys(LAY.n);Q.forEach(function(k){D[k]=1e9;});D[from]=0;
  while(Q.length){var u=Q.reduce(function(a,b){return D[a]<=D[b]?a:b;});Q.splice(Q.indexOf(u),1);if(u===to)break;
    (ADJ[u]||[]).forEach(function(v){var d=D[u]+dist(LAY.n[u],LAY.n[v]);if(d<D[v]){D[v]=d;P[v]=u;}});}
  var r=[to];while(P[r[0]])r.unshift(P[r[0]]);return r;
}

/* ---------- the kids: one steady picture per direction, smooth gliding, bopping while they wait ---------- */
var SETS={
  girl:{right:4,left:7,up:2,upR:3,upL:5,front:18,back:2,tiltR:3,tiltL:5},
  boy:{right:14,left:11,up:8,upR:12,upL:9,front:17,back:8,tiltR:12,tiltL:9}
};
function spr(n){return SH+"chars/c"+(n<10?"0":"")+n+".webp";}
var who="girl",actor=$("actor"),layerA=$("actorImg"),layerB=$("actorImg2"),bop=$("bopper");
actor.style.height=LAY.ch+"px";
var front=layerA,backL=layerB,curPose=null;
function setPose(key){ // crossfades to the new picture, never snaps
  var n=SETS[who][key];if(n==null||curPose===who+key)return;curPose=who+key;
  var u=spr(n);backL.src=u;backL.classList.add("on");front.classList.remove("on");var t=front;front=backL;backL=t;
}
var charX=0,charY=0;
function pos(x,y){actor.style.left=x+"px";actor.style.top=y+"px";}

// the whole walk through the house as one long line, so every score can move the child a little further along it
var CHAIN=[],ARCS=[],OCC={},SECARC={};
var JUMPS=[],DOORA=1,DOORB=2; // closed gate and closed front door: the child vanishes at them and appears on the other side
function buildChain(){
  var nodes=[],occ=[];
  C.sections.forEach(function(sec){
    SPOTS[sec.id].forEach(function(sp,i){
      if(!nodes.length){nodes.push(sp);}
      else if(nodes[nodes.length-1]!==sp){var r=route(nodes[nodes.length-1],sp);for(var j=1;j<r.length;j++)nodes.push(r[j]);}
      occ.push({sec:sec.id,i:i,at:nodes.length-1});
    });
  });
  CHAIN=nodes.map(function(n){return LAY.n[n];});
  ARCS=[0];JUMPS=[];
  for(var i=1;i<CHAIN.length;i++){
    var jump=false;
    ARCS.push(ARCS[i-1]+(jump?130:dist(CHAIN[i-1],CHAIN[i])));
    if(jump)JUMPS.push([ARCS[i-1],ARCS[i]]);
  }
  JUMPS.forEach(function(j,n){if(n===1){DOORA=j[0];DOORB=j[1];}});
  occ.forEach(function(o){(SECARC[o.sec]=SECARC[o.sec]||[]).push(ARCS[o.at]);});
}
function settle(a){ // a child never comes to rest inside a gate or door: the step carries them through
  for(var i=0;i<JUMPS.length;i++)if(a>JUMPS[i][0]+4&&a<JUMPS[i][1])return JUMPS[i][1];
  return a;
}
function hiddenAt(a){for(var i=0;i<JUMPS.length;i++)if(a>JUMPS[i][0]+14&&a<JUMPS[i][1]-14)return true;return false;}
function scaleAt(a){
  if(!JUMPS.length)return 1; // walking away from the viewer: smaller and smaller until small enough for the door
  var end=Math.max(0.34,LAY.doorH*0.92/LAY.ch);
  if(a<(DOORA+DOORB)/2)return 1-(1-end)*ease(clamp(a/DOORA,0,1));
  return 0.82+0.13*clamp((a-DOORB)/120,0,1); // stepping out from behind the door at nearly full size
}
function pointAt(a){
  a=clamp(a,0,ARCS[ARCS.length-1]);var i=1;while(i<ARCS.length-1&&ARCS[i]<a)i++;
  var seg=ARCS[i]-ARCS[i-1]||1,t=(a-ARCS[i-1])/seg,p=CHAIN[i-1],q=CHAIN[i];
  return [p[0]+(q[0]-p[0])*t,p[1]+(q[1]-p[1])*t];
}
var arc=0,glideA=null,idleSince=performance.now(),want=null,wantSince=0;
function ease(t){return t<0.5?4*t*t*t:1-Math.pow(-2*t+2,3)/2;}
function glide(to,speed){ // smooth, no bobbing, no picture swapping
  return new Promise(function(done){
    to=settle(to);var from=arc,d=Math.abs(to-from);if(d<1){arc=to;done();return;}
    var dur=clamp(d/speed*1000,1100,9500);
    if(glideA&&glideA.done)glideA.done();
    glideA={from:from,to:to,t0:performance.now(),dur:dur,done:done};
  });
}
function faceOf(dx,dy){
  var ax=Math.abs(dx),ay=Math.abs(dy);
  if(ax>=ay*1.15)return dx>0?"right":"left";
  if(dy<0)return dx>ay*0.3?"upR":dx<-ay*0.3?"upL":"up";
  return "front";
}
var TURNS=[["back",3300],["tiltR",1100],["tiltL",1100],["back",2700],["tiltR",1000],["tiltL",1000],["back",2300]],TURN_TOTAL=TURNS.reduce(function(a,t){return a+t[1];},0);
var lastVis=1;
function dress(){var h=hiddenAt(arc)?0:1,sc=scaleAt(arc);actor.style.transform="translate(-50%,-100%) scale("+sc.toFixed(3)+")";if(h!==lastVis){lastVis=h;actor.style.opacity=h;}}
function updateActor(t){
  var bobY=0;
  if(glideA){
    var k=clamp((t-glideA.t0)/glideA.dur,0,1);arc=glideA.from+(glideA.to-glideA.from)*ease(k);
    var p=pointAt(arc),p2=pointAt(arc+(glideA.to>glideA.from?24:-24));charX=p[0];charY=p[1];
    var f=faceOf(p2[0]-p[0],p2[1]-p[1]);
    if(f!==want){want=f;wantSince=t;}
    if(t-wantSince>220)setPose(want);
    pos(charX,charY);bop.style.transform="none";dress();
    if(k>=1){var d=glideA.done;glideA=null;idleSince=t;want=null;d();}
  }else{
    var p3=pointAt(arc);charX=p3[0];charY=p3[1];
    var e=(t-idleSince)%TURN_TOTAL,acc=0,key="back";
    for(var i=0;i<TURNS.length;i++){acc+=TURNS[i][1];if(e<acc){key=TURNS[i][0];break;}}
    setPose(key);
    bobY=-Math.abs(Math.sin((t-idleSince)/720*Math.PI))*7; // bopping on the spot
    pos(charX,charY);bop.style.transform="translateY("+bobY.toFixed(1)+"px)";dress();
  }
}

/* ---------- microphone: opens by itself, no record button ---------- */
var stream=null,actx=null,analyser=null,srcNode=null;
function wavOf(blob){
  return blob.arrayBuffer().then(function(buf){
    var Ctx=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext,c=new Ctx();
    return new Promise(function(res,rej){c.decodeAudioData(buf,res,rej);}).then(function(dec){
      try{c.close();}catch(e){}
      var rate=16000,len=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(Math.min(dec.duration,60)*rate)),off=new OfflineAudioContext(1,len,rate),s=off.createBufferSource();
      s.buffer=dec;s.connect(off.destination);s.start(0);return off.startRendering();});
  }).then(function(r){
    var d=r.getChannelData(0),n=d.length,v=new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(44+n*2));
    function str(o,t){for(var i=0;i<t.length;i++)v.setUint8(o+i,t.charCodeAt(i));}
    str(0,"RIFF");v.setUint32(4,36+n*2,true);str(8,"WAVE");str(12,"fmt ");v.setUint32(16,16,true);v.setUint16(20,1,true);v.setUint16(22,1,true);
    v.setUint32(24,16000,true);v.setUint32(28,32000,true);v.setUint16(32,2,true);v.setUint16(34,16,true);str(36,"data");v.setUint32(40,n*2,true);
    var pk=0;for(var j=0;j<n;j++){var q=Math.abs(d[j]);if(q>pk)pk=q;}var G=(pk>0.004&&pk<0.7)?Math.min(40,0.85/pk):1;for(var i=0;i<n;i++){var s=Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,d[i]*G));v.setInt16(44+i*2,s<0?s*0x8000:s*0x7FFF,true);}
    return new Blob([v],{type:"audio/wav"});
  });
}
function openMic(){
  if(stream)return Promise.resolve();
  if(!navigator.mediaDevices||!navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia)return Promise.reject(new Error("nomic"));
  return navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({audio:{echoCancellation:true,noiseSuppression:true,autoGainControl:true}}).then(function(s){
    stream=s;var C=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;actx=new C();
    srcNode=actx.createMediaStreamSource(s);analyser=actx.createAnalyser();analyser.fftSize=1024;srcNode.connect(analyser);
  });
}
var wave=$("wave"),wctx=wave.getContext("2d"),levels=[];
function drawWave(){
  var w=wave.width,h=wave.height;wctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);var n=48,bw=w/n;
  for(var i=0;i<n;i++){var v=levels[levels.length-n+i]||0,bh=Math.max(4,Math.min(h,v*h*5));
    wctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,215,106,"+(0.45+Math.min(.55,v*4))+")";var x=i*bw+bw*0.2;
    wctx.beginPath();if(wctx.roundRect)wctx.roundRect(x,(h-bh)/2,bw*0.6,bh,3);else wctx.rect(x,(h-bh)/2,bw*0.6,bh);wctx.fill();}
}

function closeMic(){try{if(stream)stream.getTracks().forEach(function(t){t.stop();});}catch(e){}try{if(actx)actx.close();}catch(e){}stream=null;actx=null;analyser=null;srcNode=null;}/*volfix*/
function capture(){return openMic().then(capture0).then(function(r){closeMic();return r;},function(e){closeMic();throw e;});}
function capture0(){
  return new Promise(function(resolve){
    if(actx&&actx.state==="suspended")actx.resume();
    stream.getAudioTracks().forEach(function(t){t.enabled=true;});
    var mime=window.MediaRecorder&&MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported&&MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported("audio/webm;codecs=opus")?"audio/webm;codecs=opus":"";
    var rec=mime?new MediaRecorder(stream,{mimeType:mime}):new MediaRecorder(stream),chunks=[];
    rec.ondataavailable=function(e){if(e.data&&e.data.size)chunks.push(e.data);};
    var buf=new Uint8Array(analyser.fftSize),start=performance.now(),spoke=false,voiceAt=0,quietAt=0,floor=null,calib=[],ended=false,maxR=0;
    levels=[];wave.classList.add("show");
    function fin(none){
      if(ended)return;ended=true;wave.classList.remove("show");
      stream.getAudioTracks().forEach(function(t){t.enabled=false;});
      if(none){try{rec.stop();}catch(e){}resolve({none:true});return;}
      rec.onstop=function(){resolve({blob:new Blob(chunks,{type:rec.mimeType||"audio/webm"})});};try{rec.stop();}catch(e){resolve({none:true});}
    }
    rec.start(100);
    (function tick(){
      if(ended)return;if(paused)return fin(true);
      analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(buf);var sum=0;for(var i=0;i<buf.length;i++){var x=(buf[i]-128)/128;sum+=x*x;}
      var rms=Math.sqrt(sum/buf.length);levels.push(rms);if(rms>maxR)maxR=rms;drawWave();
      var now=performance.now(),el=now-start;
      if(el<450){calib.push(rms);}else if(floor===null){var cs=calib.slice().sort(function(a,b){return a-b;});floor=cs.length?cs[Math.floor(cs.length*0.3)]:0;}
      if(floor!==null){
        var thr=Math.min(0.05,Math.max(0.012,floor*2.4));
        if(rms>thr){if(!voiceAt)voiceAt=now;if(now-voiceAt>140)spoke=true;quietAt=0;}
        else{voiceAt=0;if(spoke){if(!quietAt)quietAt=now;if(now-quietAt>1250)return fin(false);}}
      }
      if(!spoke&&el>11000)return fin(!(maxR>Math.max(0.014,(floor||0)*1.8)));
      if(el>14000)return fin(false);
      requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    })();
  });
}

/* ---------- scoring: every word is graded on how accurately it was said, and the worst words pull the phrase down ---------- */
// Azure's word accuracy -> our word grade: sounds like the word = 50 (the pass mark), said exactly right = up to 100,
// nothing like it = 20 or less. The leniency lives here, in the word, not in a bonus on the whole phrase.
function wordGrade(w){
  if(w.errorType==="Omission")return 0;
  var a=clamp(w.accuracyScore||0,0,100);
  if(a>=80)return 85+(a-80)*0.75;
  if(a>=60)return 50+(a-60)*1.75;
  return a*(50/60);
}
function grade(out){
  if(!out||!out.recognizedText)return 0;
  var ws=(out.words||[]).filter(function(w){return w.errorType!=="Insertion";});
  if(!ws.length)ws=[{accuracyScore:out.accuracyScore||0}];
  var g=ws.map(wordGrade),mean=g.reduce(function(x,y){return x+y;},0)/g.length,worst=Math.min.apply(null,g);
  var s=0.4*mean+0.6*worst; // one badly said word cannot hide behind the good ones
  s*=0.92+0.08*clamp((out.fluencyScore||0)/100,0,1);
  return clamp(Math.round(s),0,100);
}
function assess(blob,ref){
  return wavOf(blob).then(function(wav){
    return fetch(API+"/api/assessPronunciation?referenceText="+encodeURIComponent(ref),{method:"POST",body:wav});
  }).then(function(r){return r.json().then(function(j){if(!r.ok)throw new Error(j&&j.error||"fail");return j;});});
}

    if(pass){
      var q=clamp((score-50)/45,0,1);st.lastQ=q;st.gain+=0.45+0.55*q;st.sum+=score;st.done++;setBar();
      setPhase("","Well done");setDir("Well done! Moving on…");
      // every passing score propels the child along the route: a better score, a longer step
      var target=a0+(a1-a0)*(info.k+1)/info.L,step=arc+(target-arc)*(0.55+0.45*q);
      await Promise.all([glide(Math.max(arc,step),LAY.ch*1.05),say("ok"+(1+Math.floor(Math.random()*6))),sleep(2400)]);
      streak++;sinceEnc++;await encourage(score,st.idx);
      break;
    }
    fails++;streak=0;setPhase("","Almost");setDir("Not quite yet. Press the replay button, listen again and match it as closely as you can.");
    // the replay button stays until they get across, however many tries it takes
    var tapped=new Promise(function(res){$("againBtn").onclick=function(){stopVoice();res();};});
    $("againBtn").hidden=false;$("skipBtn").hidden=true;
    say("retry"+(1+Math.floor(Math.random()*4)));
    await tapped;
    $("againBtn").hidden=true;
  }
  skipThis=false;
  st.idx++;save();
}
var skipThis=false;
$("skipBtn").onclick=function(){skipThis=true;stopVoice();$("skipBtn").hidden=true;};

  while(st.idx<N){await runItem();}
  $("pauseBtn").hidden=true;
  st.finished=true;save();unlockNext();

  $("finalTxt").textContent=dist>=90?"You spoke it beautifully, all the way round.":"You made it all the way round. Play again to go even further.";
  $("final").hidden=false;say(CFG.finalId);
}

// ---------- audio helpers ----------
function encodeWAV(samples, rate) {
  var b = new ArrayBuffer(44 + samples.length * 2), v = new DataView(b);
  function w(o, s) { for (var i = 0; i < s.length; i++) v.setUint8(o + i, s.charCodeAt(i)); }
  w(0, "RIFF"); v.setUint32(4, 36 + samples.length * 2, true); w(8, "WAVE"); w(12, "fmt ");
  v.setUint32(16, 16, true); v.setUint16(20, 1, true); v.setUint16(22, 1, true);
  v.setUint32(24, rate, true); v.setUint32(28, rate * 2, true); v.setUint16(32, 2, true); v.setUint16(34, 16, true);
  w(36, "data"); v.setUint32(40, samples.length * 2, true);
  for (var i = 0, o = 44; i < samples.length; i++, o += 2) {
    var s = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, samples[i])); v.setInt16(o, s < 0 ? s * 0x8000 : s * 0x7fff, true);
  }
  return b;
}
async function toWav(blob) {
  var ctx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
  var dec = await ctx.decodeAudioData(await blob.arrayBuffer());
  var off = new OfflineAudioContext(1, Math.ceil(dec.duration * 16000), 16000);
  var src = off.createBufferSource(); src.buffer = dec; src.connect(off.destination); src.start(0);
  var out = await off.startRendering(); ctx.close();
  return encodeWAV(out.getChannelData(0), 16000);
}
function speak(text) {
  if (!window.speechSynthesis) return;
  speechSynthesis.cancel();
  var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text); u.lang = "fr-FR"; u.rate = 0.9; speechSynthesis.speak(u);
}

// ---------- media ----------
function mediaHTML(item) {
  var m = item.media; if (!m) return "";
  var a = assets[m.key];
  var url = a && a.url;
  if (m.type === "audio") {
    return '<div class="pl-media"><button class="pl-play" data-say="' + esc(m.transcript) + '"' + (url ? ' data-url="' + esc(url) + '"' : "") + '>🔊 Écouter</button></div>';
  }
  if (m.type === "image") {
    if (url) return '<div class="pl-media"><img src="' + esc(url) + '" alt=""></div>';
    return '<div class="pl-media"><div class="pl-ph"><span class="ic">' + esc(m.icon || "🖼️") + '</span><small>' + esc(m.description) + '</small></div></div>';
  }
  if (m.type === "video") {
    var inner = url ? '<video src="' + esc(url) + '" controls playsinline></video>'
      : '<div class="pl-ph"><span class="ic">' + esc(m.icon || "🎬") + '</span><small>' + esc(m.description || "") + '</small></div>';
    return '<div class="pl-media">' + inner + (m.transcript ? '<button class="pl-play" data-say="' + esc(m.transcript) + '">🔊 Écouter</button>' : "") + "</div>";
  }
  return "";
}
function wirePlay(root) {
  root.querySelectorAll(".pl-play").forEach(function (b) {
    b.onclick = function () {
      if (b.dataset.url) { var au = new Audio(b.dataset.url); au.play().catch(function () { speak(b.dataset.say); }); }
      else speak(b.dataset.say);
    };
  });
}

function render() {
  var item = game.items[idx];
  document.getElementById("plCount").textContent = (idx + 1) + "/" + game.items.length;
  document.getElementById("plBarFill").style.width = (idx / game.items.length * 100) + "%";
  lastScore = null;
  var h = '<div class="pl-card">' + mediaHTML(item);
  if (item.mode === "ref") {
    h += '<p class="pl-fr">' + (item.showText !== false ? esc(item.expected) : "🎧") + '</p><p class="pl-en">' + esc(item.en) + "</p>";
    if (item.media && item.media.type === "image") h += '<p class="pl-task">Dites ce que vous voyez. <small>(' + esc(item.en) + ")</small></p>";
  } else {
    h += '<p class="pl-task">' + esc(item.task) + "</p>";
    if (item.en && item.media && item.media.type !== "image") h += '<p class="pl-en">' + esc(item.en) + "</p>";
    if (item.must && item.must.length) h += '<div class="pl-must">' + item.must.map(function (m) { return "<span>" + esc(m) + "</span>"; }).join("") + "</div>";
    h += '<p class="pl-en" style="margin-top:8px"><small>' + item.min + "–" + item.max + " s</small></p>";
  }
  h += '</div><div class="pl-rec"><button class="pl-mic" id="plMic" aria-label="Record">🎤</button><div class="pl-status" id="plStatus">Appuyez pour parler</div></div><div id="plResult"></div>';
  main.innerHTML = h;
  wirePlay(main);
  document.getElementById("plMic").onclick = toggleRec;
  if (item.media && item.media.type === "audio" && !assets[item.media.key]) setTimeout(function () { speak(item.media.transcript); }, 400);
  else if (item.media && item.media.type === "video" && item.media.transcript) setTimeout(function () { speak(item.media.transcript); }, 400);
  else if (item.voice) setTimeout(function () { speak(item.voice); }, 400);
}

async function toggleRec() {
  if (busy) return;
  var mic = document.getElementById("plMic"), st = document.getElementById("plStatus");
  if (rec && rec.state === "recording") { stopRec(); return; }
  try {
    speechSynthesis && speechSynthesis.cancel();
    stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
  } catch (e) { st.textContent = "Microphone bloqué - autorisez-le dans le navigateur."; return; }
  chunks = []; rec = new MediaRecorder(stream);
  rec.ondataavailable = function (e) { if (e.data.size) chunks.push(e.data); };
  rec.onstop = onStopped;
  rec.start(); startedAt = Date.now();
  mic.classList.add("rec"); mic.textContent = "⏹";
  var max = game.items[idx].mode === "free" ? game.items[idx].max : 15;
  var tick = function () {
    var s = Math.round((Date.now() - startedAt) / 1000);
    st.textContent = "Enregistrement… " + s + " s";
    if (s >= max) stopRec();
  };
  tick(); timer = setInterval(tick, 500);
}
function stopRec() {
  clearInterval(timer);
  if (rec && rec.state === "recording") rec.stop();
}
async function onStopped() {
  stream && stream.getTracks().forEach(function (t) { t.stop(); });
  var mic = document.getElementById("plMic"), st = document.getElementById("plStatus");
  mic.classList.remove("rec"); mic.textContent = "🎤";
  if (Date.now() - startedAt < 600) { st.textContent = "Trop court. Réessayez."; return; }
  busy = true; st.textContent = "Analyse en cours…";
  try {
    var wav = await toWav(new Blob(chunks));
    var item = game.items[idx];
    var r = await fetch(API + "/api/talkleticsGradeSpeaking?gameId=" + encodeURIComponent(game.id) + "&itemId=" + encodeURIComponent(item.id), {
      method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "audio/wav", Authorization: "Bearer " + await token() }, body: wav
    });
    var d = await r.json();
    if (!r.ok) { st.textContent = d.error || "Erreur. Réessayez."; busy = false; return; }
    best[item.id] = Math.max(best[item.id] || 0, d.best != null ? d.best : d.score);
    lastScore = d; st.textContent = ""; showResult(d);
  } catch (e) { console.error(e); st.textContent = "Quelque chose a mal tourné. Réessayez."; }
  busy = false;
}

function showResult(d) {
  var pass = d.score >= game.passMark, last = idx === game.items.length - 1;
  var h = '<div class="pl-card"><div class="pl-score ' + (pass ? "pass" : "fail") + '">' + d.score + "%</div>" +
    '<p class="pl-said">« ' + esc(d.recognizedText) + " »</p>";
  if (d.tip) h += '<p class="pl-fb">💡 ' + esc(d.tip) + "</p>";
  if (d.missing && d.missing.length) h += '<p class="pl-fb">À ajouter : ' + d.missing.map(esc).join(" · ") + "</p>";
  if (d.note) h += '<p class="pl-fb">' + esc(d.note) + "</p>";
  h += '<div class="pl-actions"><button class="pl-btn sec" id="plRetry">Réessayer</button><button class="pl-btn" id="plNext">' +
    (last ? "Terminer" : "Suivant") + "</button></div></div>";
  document.getElementById("plResult").innerHTML = h;
  document.getElementById("plRetry").onclick = function () { document.getElementById("plResult").innerHTML = ""; document.getElementById("plStatus").textContent = "Appuyez pour parler"; };
  document.getElementById("plNext").onclick = function () { if (last) summary(); else { idx++; render(); } };
}

async function summary() {
  var scores = {}; scores[game.id] = best;
  var avg = gameAvg(game, scores), done = gameDone(game, scores), st = stars(game, scores);
  document.getElementById("plBarFill").style.width = "100%";
  var nx = nextGame(game);

    (done ? (game.isGraduation ? "🎓 Bravo ! Niveau validé !" : "Bravo ! Jeu réussi.") : "Il faut " + game.passMark + "% pour réussir. Refaites les réponses les plus faibles.") +
    '</p><ul class="pl-sum" style="list-style:none;padding:0">' +
    game.items.map(function (it, i) { return "<li><span>" + (i + 1) + ". " + esc((it.expected || it.task || "").slice(0, 38)) + "</span><b>" + (best[it.id] || 0) + "%</b></li>"; }).join("") +
    '</ul><div class="pl-actions"><button class="pl-btn sec" id="plAgain">Rejouer</button>' +
    (done && nx ? '<button class="pl-btn" id="plGo">Jeu suivant</button>' : '<button class="pl-btn" id="plMap">Le voyage</button>') + "</div></div>";

  var mp = document.getElementById("plMap");
  if (mp) mp.onclick = function () { location.href = "journey.html" + (q.get("preview") ? "?preview=1" : ""); };
}

=== \public\talkletics\talkletics.js ===
(function(){
  var bubble = document.getElementById("tkSpeechBubble");
  var greetingEl = document.getElementById("tkGreetText");
  var ctaEl = document.getElementById("tkTypeText");
  var startBtn = document.getElementById("tkStartBtn");

  startBtn.addEventListener("click", function(){
    window.location.href = "map.html";
  });

  var pairs = [
    { greeting: "Bonjour !", cta: "Click on START and Let's go." },
    { greeting: "Salut !", cta: "Let's begin this adventure together! Ready?" },
    { greeting: "Bonjour !", cta: "Fun and French Awaits ya! Allons-y." },
    { greeting: "Coucou !", cta: "What a way to pick up French! Go on..." },
    { greeting: "Bonjour !", cta: "The Adventure is here! Let's begin." },
    { greeting: "Allo !", cta: "Time to play, or learn, or both." },
    { greeting: "Bonjour !", cta: "Off we go. Dive in." },
    { greeting: "Tchao !", cta: "Are we beginning or what?" }
  ];
  var pairIndex = 0;

  var holdAfterReveal = 10000;
  var rollAwayDuration = 500;
  var pauseBeforeNext = 3000;

  function rollAway(){
    bubble.classList.remove("tk-bubble-unroll");
    bubble.classList.add("tk-bubble-rollaway");
    setTimeout(function(){
      bubble.classList.remove("tk-bubble-rollaway");
      pairIndex = (pairIndex + 1) % pairs.length;
      setTimeout(cycle, pauseBeforeNext);
    }, rollAwayDuration);
  }

  function cycle(){
    greetingEl.textContent = pairs[pairIndex].greeting;
    ctaEl.textContent = pairs[pairIndex].cta;
    bubble.classList.add("tk-bubble-unroll");
    setTimeout(rollAway, holdAfterReveal);
  }

  setTimeout(cycle, 1000);
})();

(function(){

  var API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";
  var TIME_KEY = "tkAudioTime";
  var MUTED_KEY = "tkAudioMuted";
  var UNLOCKED_KEY = "tkAudioUnlocked";

  var audio = document.createElement("audio");
  audio.loop = true;
  audio.style.display = "none";
  document.body.appendChild(audio);

  var muteBtn = document.createElement("button");
  muteBtn.setAttribute("aria-label", "Toggle music");
  muteBtn.style.cssText = "position:fixed;bottom:14px;right:14px;width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(20,30,50,.55);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;z-index:999;font-size:18px;";

  function updateMuteIcon(){
    muteBtn.textContent = audio.muted ? "\uD83D\uDD07" : "\uD83D\uDD0A";
  }

  function findBackgroundMusic(){
    return fetch(API_BASE + "/api/assets")
      .then(function(res){ return res.json(); })
      .then(function(assets){
        return assets.find(function(a){
          return a.type === "audio" && a.name.toLowerCase() === "background-music";
        });
      })
      .catch(function(){ return null; });
  }

  function attemptPlay(){
    var playPromise = audio.play();
    if(playPromise !== undefined){
      playPromise.catch(function(){
        // autoplay blocked - wait for the mute button tap to unlock
      });
    }
  }

  findBackgroundMusic().then(function(asset){

    if(!asset) return;

    audio.src = asset.url;

    var savedTime = parseFloat(sessionStorage.getItem(TIME_KEY) || "0");
    var savedMuted = sessionStorage.getItem(MUTED_KEY) === "true";
    var unlocked = sessionStorage.getItem(UNLOCKED_KEY) === "true";

    audio.muted = savedMuted;
    updateMuteIcon();

    audio.addEventListener("loadedmetadata", function(){
      if(savedTime > 0 && savedTime < audio.duration){
        audio.currentTime = savedTime;
      }
      if(unlocked){
        attemptPlay();
      }
    });

    setInterval(function(){
      if(!audio.paused){
        sessionStorage.setItem(TIME_KEY, String(audio.currentTime));
      }
    }, 2000);

    window.addEventListener("pagehide", function(){
      sessionStorage.setItem(TIME_KEY, String(audio.currentTime));
    });

    muteBtn.addEventListener("click", function(){
      sessionStorage.setItem(UNLOCKED_KEY, "true");
      if(audio.paused){
        attemptPlay();
      }
      audio.muted = !audio.muted;
      sessionStorage.setItem(MUTED_KEY, String(audio.muted));
      updateMuteIcon();
    });

    document.body.appendChild(muteBtn);

  });

})();

// Shared helpers for the Talkletics journey. Loaded as an ES module.
import { auth } from "/js/firebase-init.js";
import { onAuthStateChanged } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-auth.js";

export const API = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";
export const CUR = window.TK_CURRICULUM;

export function whenUser() {
  return new Promise(function (resolve) {
    var off = onAuthStateChanged(auth, function (u) { off(); resolve(u); });
  });
}
export async function token() { return auth.currentUser ? auth.currentUser.getIdToken() : null; }

export async function loadProgress() {
  try {
    var t = await token();
    var r = await fetch(API + "/api/talkleticsProgress", { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer " + t } });
    if (!r.ok) return {};
    return (await r.json()).scores || {};
  } catch (e) { return {}; }
}

export async function loadAssets() {
  var map = {};
  try {
    var r = await fetch(API + "/api/assets");
    (await r.json()).forEach(function (a) { map[a.name] = a; });
  } catch (e) {}
  return map;
}

// avg of best item scores (missing item = 0)
export function gameAvg(game, scores) {
  var s = scores[game.id] || {};
  var sum = 0;
  game.items.forEach(function (it) { sum += s[it.id] || 0; });
  return Math.round(sum / game.items.length);
}
export function gameDone(game, scores) {
  var s = scores[game.id] || {};
  var all = game.items.every(function (it) { return s[it.id] != null; });
  return all && gameAvg(game, scores) >= game.passMark;
}
export function stars(game, scores) {
  if (!gameDone(game, scores)) return 0;
  var a = gameAvg(game, scores), span = 100 - game.passMark;
  return a >= game.passMark + span * 0.75 ? 3 : a >= game.passMark + span * 0.4 ? 2 : 1;
}
// returns {unlocked, done, avg, stars}
export function status(level, game, scores, unlockAll) {
  var li = CUR.levels.indexOf(level);
  var levelOpen = unlockAll || li === 0 || gameDone(CUR.levels[li - 1].graduation, scores);
  var open = false;
  if (levelOpen) {
    if (game.isGraduation) open = level.games.every(function (g) { return gameDone(g, scores); });
    else open = game.index === 1 || gameDone(level.games[game.index - 2], scores);
  }
  if (unlockAll) open = true;
  return { unlocked: open, done: gameDone(game, scores), avg: gameAvg(game, scores), stars: stars(game, scores) };
}
export function nextGame(game) {
  var all = CUR.allGames();
  var i = all.findIndex(function (g) { return g.id === game.id; });
  return all[i + 1] || null;
}
export function esc(s) {
  return String(s == null ? "" : s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, function (c) { return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" }[c]; });
}

/* ===== SUBMISSIONS TAB ===== */

async function loadSubmissions(){

const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminSubmissions");
const submissions = await res.json();

const table = document.getElementById("submissions");
table.innerHTML = "";

if(!submissions.length){
  table.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='7' class='empty-note'>No submissions yet.</td></tr>";
  return;
}

submissions.forEach(s=>{

const row = document.createElement("tr");

const statusBadge = s.reviewed
  ? "<span class='badge badge-reviewed'>Reviewed - Rank " + s.rank + (s.passed ? " (Passed)" : " (Failed)") + "</span>"
  : "<span class='badge badge-unreviewed'>Awaiting Review</span>";

const flags = [];

if(s.keystrokeCount === 0){
  flags.push("<span style='color:#e08585;font-weight:600;'>⚠ No keystrokes detected</span>");
}

if(s.timeTakenSeconds > 0 && s.jobWordCount > 0 && s.timeTakenSeconds < (s.jobWordCount * 0.3)){
  flags.push("<span style='color:#F0C77E;font-weight:600;'>⚠ Completed unusually fast (" + s.timeTakenSeconds + "s for " + s.jobWordCount + " words)</span>");
}

if(s.pasteAttempts > 0){
  flags.push("<span style='color:#F0C77E;font-weight:600;'>⚠ " + s.pasteAttempts + " blocked paste attempt(s)</span>");
}

if(s.tabSwitches > 2){
  flags.push("<span style='color:#8FA8A3;'>Switched tabs " + s.tabSwitches + "x</span>");
}

const flagsHtml = flags.length ? flags.join("<br>") : "<span style='color:#8FA8A3;'>No flags</span>";

row.innerHTML =
  "<td>" + (s.jobFile || s.jobId) + "<br><span style='color:#8FA8A3;font-size:10.5px;'>" + s.jobId + "</span></td>" +
  "<td>" + s.translator + "</td>" +
  "<td>" + (s.submitted ? new Date(s.submitted._seconds ? s.submitted._seconds*1000 : s.submitted).toLocaleString() : "-") + "</td>" +
  "<td><div class='translation-preview'>" + (s.translation || "").replace(/</g,"&lt;") + "</div></td>" +
  "<td style='font-size:11px;line-height:1.6;'>" + flagsHtml + "</td>" +
  "<td>" + statusBadge + "</td>" +
  "<td>" +
    "<select class='rank-select' id='rank-" + s.id + "'>" +
      "<option value='1'" + (s.rank===1?" selected":"") + ">1st</option>" +
      "<option value='2'" + (s.rank===2?" selected":"") + ">2nd</option>" +
      "<option value='3'" + (s.rank===3?" selected":"") + ">3rd</option>" +
    "</select>" +
    "<button class='btn-pass' onclick=\"reviewSubmission('" + s.id + "', true)\">Pass</button>" +
    "<button class='btn-fail' onclick=\"reviewSubmission('" + s.id + "', false)\">Fail</button>" +
  "</td>";

table.appendChild(row);

});

}

async function reviewSubmission(submissionId, passed){

const rank = Number(document.getElementById("rank-" + submissionId).value);

const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/reviewSubmission", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  body: JSON.stringify({ submissionId, rank, passed })
});

const data = await res.json();

if(!res.ok){
  alert(data.error || "Could not review this submission.");
  return;
}

alert(passed ? ("Marked passed at rank " + rank + ". Payout: $" + data.amountOwed.toFixed(2)) : "Marked failed. No payout owed.");

loadSubmissions();
loadPayouts();
loadOverview();

}

async function loadTranslators(){

const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminTranslators");
const translators = await res.json();

const table = document.getElementById("translators");
table.innerHTML = "";

if(!translators.length){
  table.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='6' class='empty-note'>No applications yet.</td></tr>";
  return;
}

translators.forEach(t=>{

const row = document.createElement("tr");

const statusBadge = t.passed
  ? "<span class='badge badge-passed'>Approved</span>"
  : "<span class='badge badge-failed'>Not Approved</span>";

const scoreText = t.finalScore !== undefined ? t.finalScore + "%" : "-";

let docsHtml = "<span style='color:#8FA8A3;font-size:11px;'>None on file</span>";

if(t.documents){
  const links = [];
  if(t.documents.id) links.push("<a class='doc-link' href='" + t.documents.id + "' target='_blank'>National ID</a>");
  if(t.documents.cv && t.documents.cv.length) links.push("<a class='doc-link' href='" + t.documents.cv[0] + "' target='_blank'>CV</a>");
  if(t.documents.certifications && t.documents.certifications.length) links.push("<a class='doc-link' href='" + t.documents.certifications[0] + "' target='_blank'>Certification</a>");
  if(links.length) docsHtml = links.join("");
}

row.innerHTML =
  "<td>" + (t.photoUrl ? "<img class='avatar-thumb' src='" + t.photoUrl + "'>" : "") + " " + (t.name || "(no name)") + "</td>" +
  "<td>" + t.email + "<br><span style='color:#8FA8A3;font-size:10.5px;'>" + (t.phone||"-") + " - " + (t.country||"-") + "</span></td>" +
  "<td>" + scoreText + "</td>" +
  "<td>" + statusBadge + "</td>" +
  "<td>" + (t.passkey || "<span style='color:#8FA8A3;'>-</span>") + "</td>" +
  "<td>" + docsHtml + "</td>";

table.appendChild(row);

});

}


/* ===== PAYOUTS TAB ===== */

async function loadPayouts(){

const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminPayouts");
const payouts = await res.json();

const table = document.getElementById("payouts");
table.innerHTML = "";

if(!payouts.length){
  table.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='7' class='empty-note'>No payouts yet.</td></tr>";
  return;
}

payouts.forEach(p=>{

const row = document.createElement("tr");

let pmHtml = "<span class='pm-missing'>No payment method on file</span>";

if(p.paymentMethod){
  const pm = p.paymentMethod;
  if(pm.method === "bank"){
    let lines = ["Bank: " + pm.bankName];
    if(pm.bankRegion === "us"){
      lines.push("Acct: " + pm.accountNumber);
      lines.push("Routing: " + pm.routingNumber);
    }else if(pm.bankRegion === "uk"){
      lines.push("Acct: " + pm.accountNumber);
      lines.push("Sort Code: " + pm.sortCode);
    }else if(pm.bankRegion === "international"){
      lines.push("IBAN: " + pm.iban);
    }else{
      lines.push("Acct: " + pm.accountNumber);
    }
    if(pm.swiftBic){
      lines.push("SWIFT: " + pm.swiftBic);
    }
    lines.push("Name: " + pm.accountName);
    pmHtml = "<div class='pm-details'>" + lines.join("<br>") + "</div>";
  } else {
    pmHtml = "<div class='pm-details'>" + pm.momoNetwork + "<br>" + pm.momoNumber + "</div>";
  }
}

const statusBadge = p.status === "paid"
  ? "<span class='badge badge-paid'>Paid</span>"
  : "<span class='badge badge-pending'>Pending</span>";

row.innerHTML =
  "<td>" + p.jobId + "</td>" +
  "<td>" + p.translatorPasskey + "</td>" +
  "<td>" + p.rank + (p.passed ? "" : " (Failed)") + "</td>" +
  "<td>$" + Number(p.amountOwed||0).toFixed(2) + "</td>" +
  "<td>" + pmHtml + "</td>" +
  "<td>" + statusBadge + "</td>" +
  "<td>" + (p.status === "paid" ? "-" : "<button class='btn-paid' onclick=\"markPaid('" + p.id + "')\">Mark as Paid</button>") + "</td>";

table.appendChild(row);

});

}

async function markPaid(payoutId){

const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/markPayoutPaid", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  body: JSON.stringify({ payoutId })
});

if(!res.ok){
  alert("Could not mark this payout as paid.");
  return;
}

loadPayouts();
loadOverview();

}

<script type="module">

import { db, auth } from "/js/firebase-init.js";
import { doc, getDoc, collection, getDocs } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-firestore.js";
import { onAuthStateChanged } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-auth.js";

const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
const jobId = params.get("job");
const adminKey = params.get("admin");

const STATUS_BADGE = {
  awaiting_payment: { label: "Awaiting Payment", color: "#9a8b7d" },
  open: { label: "Open", color: "#2f6f68" },
  claimed: { label: "Claimed", color: "#c9714f" },
  completed: { label: "Completed", color: "#3f8f5f" }
};

async function loadAllJobs(){

  document.getElementById("deskGrid").style.display = "none";
  document.getElementById("jobListPanel").style.display = "block";

  const listEl = document.getElementById("jobList");
  listEl.innerHTML = "";

  try{

    const snapshot = await getDocs(collection(db, "translationJobs"));

    if(snapshot.empty){
      listEl.innerHTML = "<div class=\"job-list-empty\">No jobs found.</div>";
      return;
    }

    const jobs = [];
    snapshot.forEach(docSnap => jobs.push({ id: docSnap.id, data: docSnap.data() }));

    jobs.sort((a, b) => {
      const aTime = a.data.createdAt && a.data.createdAt.toMillis ? a.data.createdAt.toMillis() : 0;
      const bTime = b.data.createdAt && b.data.createdAt.toMillis ? b.data.createdAt.toMillis() : 0;
      return bTime - aTime;
    });

    jobs.forEach(({ id, data }) => {

      const badge = STATUS_BADGE[data.status] || { label: data.status || "Unknown", color: "#9a8b7d" };

      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.className = "job-list-item";
      row.onclick = () => { window.location.href = "/translation/desk.html?job=" + encodeURIComponent(id); };

      row.innerHTML =
        "<div class=\"job-list-left\">" +
          "<div class=\"job-list-code\">" + (data.jobId || id) + "</div>" +
          "<div class=\"job-list-meta\">" + (data.email || "-") + " · " + (data.wordCount ?? "-") + " words · $" + Number(data.price || 0).toFixed(2) + "</div>" +
        "</div>" +
        "<span class=\"job-list-badge\" style=\"background:" + badge.color + "\">" + badge.label + "</span>";

      listEl.appendChild(row);

    });

  }catch(err){
    console.error("ALL JOBS LOAD ERROR:", err);
    listEl.innerHTML = "<div class=\"job-list-empty\">There was a problem loading jobs.</div>";
  }

}


async function loadOtherJobs(email, currentJobId){
  try{
    const res = await fetch("https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com/api/jobsByEmail?email=" + encodeURIComponent(email) + "&excludeJobId=" + encodeURIComponent(currentJobId));
    const jobs = await res.json();
    if(!jobs || jobs.length === 0) return;

    const panel = document.getElementById("otherJobsPanel");
    const listEl = document.getElementById("otherJobsList");
    listEl.innerHTML = "";

    jobs.forEach(function(job){
      const badge = STATUS_BADGE[job.status] || { label: job.status || "Unknown", color: "#9a8b7d" };
      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.className = "job-list-item";
      row.onclick = function(){ window.location.href = "/translation/desk.html?job=" + encodeURIComponent(job.jobId); };
      row.innerHTML =
        "<div class=\"job-list-left\">" +
          "<div class=\"job-list-code\">" + job.jobId + "</div>" +
          "<div class=\"job-list-meta\">" + job.plan + " · " + job.wordCount + " words · $" + Number(job.price).toFixed(2) + "</div>" +
        "</div>" +
        "<span class=\"job-list-badge\" style=\"background:" + badge.color + "\">" + badge.label + "</span>";
      listEl.appendChild(row);
    });

    panel.style.display = "block";
  }catch(err){
    console.error("OTHER JOBS LOAD ERROR:", err);
  }
}

function setStep(dotId, done){
  const el = document.getElementById(dotId);
  el.className = "step-dot " + (done ? "step-done" : "step-pending");
  el.innerHTML = done
    ? '<svg width="11" height="11" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"/></svg>'
    : "";
}

async function loadJob(){

  if(!jobId){
    document.getElementById("message").innerText = "No job code was provided.";
    return;
  }

  try{

    const jobSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, "translationJobs", jobId));

    if(!jobSnap.exists()){
      document.getElementById("message").innerText = "No job found for this code.";
      return;
    }

    const data = jobSnap.data();

    document.getElementById("job").innerText = data.jobId || jobId;
    document.getElementById("email").innerText = data.email || "-";
    document.getElementById("words").innerText = data.wordCount ?? "-";
    document.getElementById("language").innerText = data.targetLanguage || "-";
    document.getElementById("plan").innerText = data.plan || "-";
    document.getElementById("price").innerText = "$" + Number(data.price || 0).toFixed(2);

    const paid = data.paid === true;
    const status = data.status || "";

    setStep("dot1", paid);
    setStep("dot2", status === "open" || status === "claimed" || status === "completed");
    setStep("dot3", status === "claimed" || status === "completed");
    setStep("dot4", status === "completed");

    if(status === "completed"){
      document.getElementById("message").innerText = "Your translation is complete.";
    }else if(status === "claimed"){
      document.getElementById("message").innerText = "A translator is working on your document.";
    }else if(status === "open"){
      document.getElementById("message").innerText = "Your document is posted and waiting for a translator.";
    }else if(paid){
      document.getElementById("message").innerText = "Payment confirmed. Your job is being prepared.";
    }else{
      document.getElementById("message").innerText = "Awaiting payment confirmation.";
    }

    if(data.email){ loadOtherJobs(data.email, jobId); }

  }catch(err){
    console.error("DESK LOAD ERROR:", err);
    document.getElementById("message").innerText = "There was a problem loading this job.";
  }

}

if(adminKey === "true"){
  onAuthStateChanged(auth, async function(user){
    if(!user){ loadJob(); return; }
    try{
      const res = await fetch("https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com/api/accessControlCheck?email=" + encodeURIComponent(user.email || ""));
      const data = await res.json();
      if(data.authorized){ loadAllJobs(); } else { loadJob(); }
    }catch(err){ loadJob(); }
  });
}else{
  loadJob();
}

</script>

</body>
</html>
