// Builds ALL new audio in order of importance, stops cleanly the moment credits run out, and never makes a half-finished lesson go live.
// Run again after a top-up: it carries on where it stopped. Needs ELEVENLABS_API_KEY (set in PowerShell by you, never stored).
import { spawnSync } from "child_process"; import fs from "fs"; import os from "os"; import path from "path"; import { fileURLToPath } from "url";
const here = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), aud = path.resolve(here, "..", "..", "public", "assets", "audio");
if (!process.env.ELEVENLABS_API_KEY) { console.log("\nNo ELEVENLABS_API_KEY set: skipping audio. The pages stay as they are. Set the key in PowerShell and run this block again."); process.exit(0); }
const tmp = path.join(os.tmpdir(), "saybon-audio-tmp"); fs.mkdirSync(tmp, { recursive: true });
const steps = [
  ["Les Petits lessons 13-25", ["build-lp.mjs", path.join(aud, "lp")]],
  ["Les Petits reading lessons 13, 19, 25", ["build-lp-read.mjs", path.join(aud, "lp")]],
  ["Reading lessons 12, 18, 24", ["build-reading-extra.mjs", path.join(aud, "lessons")]],
  ["Lessons 21, 22, 23, 25 (A1-C2)", ["build-scenes.mjs", path.join(aud, "lessons"), tmp, "--rounds=21,22,23,25"]],
  ["Tout Public lessons 4-25", ["build-tp.mjs", path.join(aud, "lessons"), tmp]],
];
let stopped = false;
for (const [label, args] of steps) {
  console.log("\n==================== " + label + " ====================");
  const r = spawnSync("node", args, { cwd: here, stdio: "inherit" });
  if (r.status === 42) { stopped = true; break; }
  if (r.status) console.log("\n(" + label + " hit an error. Carrying on with the rest. Send me the lines above if it repeats.)");
}
console.log(stopped ? "\n*** CREDITS RAN OUT. Everything finished so far is kept and will go live. Top up and run the same block again to continue. ***" : "\nAll audio is built.");
process.exit(0);

// Builds the Les Petits lessons 2-6 audio (Mira). Skips files that already exist. Stops cleanly if credits run low.
// Usage: node build-lp.mjs <outDir>   (needs ELEVENLABS_API_KEY)
import fs from "fs"; import path from "path"; import { spawnSync } from "child_process"; import { fileURLToPath } from "url";
const here = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const out = path.resolve(process.argv[2] || "../../public/assets/audio/lp"); fs.mkdirSync(out, { recursive: true });
const { man } = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(here, "lp-manifest.json"), "utf8"));
let made = 0, kept = 0;
for (const m of man) {
  if (fs.existsSync(path.join(out, m.name + ".mp3"))) { kept++; continue; }
  console.log("\n=== " + m.name);
  const r = spawnSync("node", [path.join(here, "make-audio.mjs"), "--level", "a0-les-petits", "--lesson", String(m.lesson), "--name", m.name, "--script", path.join(here, "scripts", m.script), "--outdir", out], { stdio: "inherit" });
  if (r.status === 42) { console.log("\nOut of credits: stopped cleanly. Top up and run the same block again, it continues where it stopped."); process.exit(42); }
  if (r.status) { console.log("\nFAILED on " + m.name + ". Send me the lines above."); process.exit(1); }
  made++;
}
console.log(`\nAll done. Made ${made}, already there ${kept}.`);

  const m = /^R(\d+)_(a1|a2|b1|b2|c1|c2)_/.exec(name); let r;
  for (let k = 1; k <= 6; k++) {
    r = spawnSync("node", ["make-audio.mjs", "--level", m[2], "--lesson", m[1], "--name", name, "--script", `scripts/${name}.txt`, "--outdir", d], { cwd: here, stdio: "inherit" });
    if (r.status === 0 || r.status === 42) break; console.log(`\nStep error, retry ${k}/6 in 10s...`); sleep(10);
  }
  if (r.status === 42) { console.log("\nREADING: out of credits, stopped cleanly."); process.exit(42); }
  if (r.status) { console.log("\nREADING: failed on " + name); process.exit(1); }
  made++;
}
console.log(`\nREADING clips complete. Made ${made}, already there ${kept}.`);

=== \tools\audio\concat-audio.mjs ===
// Joins audio files with a gap. Usage: node concat-audio.mjs <gapSeconds> <out.mp3> <in1.mp3> <in2.mp3> ...
import { spawnSync } from "child_process";
let ffmpeg = "ffmpeg"; try { ffmpeg = (await import("ffmpeg-static")).default || "ffmpeg"; } catch {}
const [gap, out, ...ins] = process.argv.slice(2), a = ["-y", "-loglevel", "error"];
ins.forEach(f => a.push("-i", f));
const parts = ins.map((_, i) => `[${i}:a]aresample=44100,aformat=channel_layouts=mono[a${i}]`), sil = `anullsrc=r=44100:cl=mono,atrim=0:${gap}[g]`;
let chain = [], lab = "";
ins.forEach((_, i) => { lab += `[a${i}]` + (i < ins.length - 1 ? "[g" + i + "]" : ""); });
const split = `[g]asplit=${Math.max(1, ins.length - 1)}` + Array.from({ length: Math.max(1, ins.length - 1) }, (_, i) => `[g${i}]`).join("");
a.push("-filter_complex", parts.join(";") + ";" + sil + ";" + (ins.length > 1 ? split + ";" : "") + lab + `concat=n=${ins.length * 2 - 1}:v=0:a=1[o]`, "-map", "[o]", "-codec:a", "libmp3lame", "-q:a", "3", out);
const r = spawnSync(ffmpeg, a); if (r.status) { console.log(String(r.stderr)); process.exit(1); }

=== \tools\audio\make-audio.mjs ===
// SayBon teacher audio. Usage:
//   node make-audio.mjs --level a0-les-petits --lesson 1 --script lesson1.txt [--dry]
// Key: environment variable ELEVENLABS_API_KEY (never stored in the project).
import fs from "fs"; import path from "path"; import crypto from "crypto";
import { spawnSync } from "child_process";
let ffmpeg = "ffmpeg"; try { ffmpeg = (await import("ffmpeg-static")).default || "ffmpeg"; } catch {}
import { fileURLToPath } from "url";
const here = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const cfg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(here, "config.json"), "utf8"));
const a = {}; for (let i = 2; i < process.argv.length; i++) { const k = process.argv[i]; if (k.startsWith("--")) { const n = process.argv[i + 1]; if (!n || n.startsWith("--")) a[k.slice(2)] = true; else { a[k.slice(2)] = n; i++; } } }
if (!a.script) { console.log("Need --script <file.txt>"); process.exit(1); }
const level = a.level || "default";
const voiceName = a.voice || cfg.voices[level] || cfg.voices.default;
const outName = a.name || `${level}-lesson${a.lesson || "x"}`;
const outDir = a.outdir ? path.resolve(a.outdir) : path.join(here, "out"), cache = path.join(here, "cache"), tmp = path.join(here, "cache", "tmp-" + outName);
for (const d of [outDir, cache, tmp]) fs.mkdirSync(d, { recursive: true });
const run = (args) => { const r = spawnSync(ffmpeg, ["-y", "-loglevel", "error", ...args]); if (r.status) throw new Error("ffmpeg: " + r.stderr); };

// ---- parse: split on pause tags; everything else (emotion tags) goes to ElevenLabs untouched
export function parse(text) {
  const items = []; let buf = "", sil = 0;
  const flush = () => {
    const t = buf.trim(); buf = "";
    if (/\p{L}/u.test(t.replace(/\[[^\]]*\]/g, ""))) { if (sil) items.push({ sil }); sil = 0; items.push({ say: t.replace(/[ \t]*\n[ \t]*/g, " ").replace(/\s{2,}/g, " ") }); }
  };
  for (const part of text.split(/(\[(?:short pause|long pause|pause|your turn|long turn|repeat|turn:[^\]]*)\])/gi)) {
    const m = part.match(/^\[(short pause|long pause|pause|your turn|long turn|repeat)\]$/i), tm = part.match(/^\[turn:([^\]]*)\]$/i);
    if (tm) { flush(); const w = tm[1].trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length; items.push({ sil: sil + Math.min(8, Math.max(2.5, 0.9 + 0.4 * w)), child: true }); sil = 0; continue; }
    if (m && /^repeat$/i.test(m[1])) { flush(); const prev = items.length ? items[items.length - 1] : null; const words = prev && prev.say ? prev.say.replace(/\[[^\]]*\]/g, "").split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length : 3; items.push({ sil: Math.min(5, Math.max(2.0, 0.8 + 0.4 * words)) }); sil = 0; }
    else if (m && /turn$/i.test(m[1])) { flush(); items.push({ sil: sil + (/long/i.test(m[1]) ? (cfg.longTurnSeconds || 10) : (cfg.childGapSeconds || 2)), child: true }); sil = 0; }
    else if (m) { flush(); sil += cfg.pauseSeconds[m[1].toLowerCase()]; } else buf += part;
  }
  flush(); return items;
}
if (level !== "a0-les-petits" && cfg.upperChildGapSeconds) cfg.childGapSeconds = cfg.upperChildGapSeconds;
if (a.gap) cfg.childGapSeconds = +a.gap;
const items = parse(fs.readFileSync(a.script, "utf8"));
for (const it of items) if (it.say && cfg.alwaysTag && level === "a0-les-petits" && !it.say.toLowerCase().includes(cfg.alwaysTag)) it.say = cfg.alwaysTag + " " + it.say;
// a silence right after the child's cue (a drilled word, or "you will say...") is the child's turn: make sure it is long enough
const CUE = /(bonjour|salut|au revoir)[\s?!.\u2026,]*$/i, CUE2 = /you will say[\s?!.\u2026,]*$/i;
for (let i = 1; i < items.length; i++) if (items[i].sil && items[i - 1].say) { const bare = items[i - 1].say.replace(/\[[^\]]*\]/g, "").trim(); if (CUE.test(bare) || CUE2.test(bare)) { items[i].child = true; items[i].sil = Math.max(items[i].sil, cfg.childGapSeconds || 2); } }
console.log(`${items.filter(i => i.say).length} spoken pieces, voice: ${a.dry ? "(dry run)" : voiceName}`);

const key = process.env.ELEVENLABS_API_KEY;
const vids = {};
async function getVoice(voiceName = globalThis.__vn) {
  const idf = path.join(cache, `voice-${voiceName}.txt`);
  if (fs.existsSync(idf)) return fs.readFileSync(idf, "utf8");
  const r = await fetch(`https://api.elevenlabs.io/v2/voices?search=${encodeURIComponent(voiceName)}&page_size=100`, { headers: { "xi-api-key": key } });
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`Voice lookup failed (${r.status}): ${await r.text()}`);
  const v = (await r.json()).voices.filter(x => x.name.toLowerCase().startsWith(voiceName.toLowerCase()));
  if (!v.length) throw new Error(`No voice named "${voiceName}" in your account. Add it to My Voices first.`);
  const id = (v.find(x => x.name.toLowerCase() === voiceName.toLowerCase()) || v[0]).voice_id; fs.writeFileSync(idf, id); return id;
}

let _left = null, _calls = 0;
async function creditGuard(text) {
  const need = text.replace(/\[[^\]]*\]/g, "").length;
  if (_left === null || _calls++ % 15 === 0) {
    try { const r = await fetch("https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/user/subscription", { headers: { "xi-api-key": key } }); if (r.ok) { const j = await r.json(); _left = j.character_limit - j.character_count; } else _left = Infinity; } catch { _left = Infinity; }
  }
  _left -= need;
  if (_left < 150) { console.log(`\nOUT OF CREDITS (about ${Math.max(0, Math.round(_left + need))} left) - stopped cleanly. Everything made so far is saved. Top up, then run the same command again.`); process.exit(42); }
}
async function speak(text, vn = voiceName) {
  const h = crypto.createHash("sha1").update([vn, cfg.model, cfg.stability, cfg.similarity, text].join("|")).digest("hex").slice(0, 16);
  const f = path.join(cache, h + (a.dry ? ".dry.mp3" : ".mp3"));
  if (fs.existsSync(f)) return f;
  if (a.dry) { const words = text.replace(/\[[^\]]*\]/g, "").split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length; run(["-f", "lavfi", "-i", `sine=frequency=440:duration=${Math.max(.4, words * .35)}`, "-ar", "44100", "-ac", "1", f]); return f; }
  vids[vn] ||= await getVoice(vn);
  await creditGuard(text);
  const r = await fetch(`https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/${vids[vn]}?output_format=mp3_44100_128`, { method: "POST", headers: { "xi-api-key": key, "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ text, model_id: cfg.model, voice_settings: { stability: cfg.stability, similarity_boost: cfg.similarity } }) });
  if (r.status===401||r.status===402||r.status===429){const b=await r.text(); if(/quota|credit|limit/i.test(b)){ console.log("\nOUT OF CREDITS - stopped cleanly. Everything made so far is saved. Top up, then run the same command again."); process.exit(42);} throw new Error(`ElevenLabs error (${r.status}): ${b}`);}
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`ElevenLabs error (${r.status}): ${await r.text()}`);
  fs.writeFileSync(f, Buffer.from(await r.arrayBuffer())); return f;
}
if (!a.dry && !key) { console.log("Set ELEVENLABS_API_KEY first (see instructions)."); process.exit(1); }

const dur = (f) => { const r = spawnSync(ffmpeg, ["-i", f]); const m = /Duration: (\d+):(\d+):([\d.]+)/.exec(String(r.stderr)); return m ? (+m[1]) * 3600 + (+m[2]) * 60 + (+m[3]) : 0; };
const parts = []; const gaps = []; let n = 0, cur = 0;
for (const it of items) {
  const w = path.join(tmp, String(n++).padStart(3, "0") + ".wav");
  if (it.say) { let vn = voiceName; const am = /^\[as:([^\]]+)\]\s*/.exec(it.say); if (am) { vn = am[1].trim(); it.say = it.say.slice(am[0].length); } const f = await speak(it.say, vn); run(["-i", f, "-ar", "44100", "-ac", "1", w]); cur += dur(w); process.stdout.write("."); }
  else { run(["-f", "lavfi", "-i", "anullsrc=r=44100:cl=mono", "-t", String(it.sil), w]); if (it.child) gaps.push([+(cur + 0.25).toFixed(2), +(cur + it.sil - 0.1).toFixed(2)]); cur += it.sil; }
  parts.push(w);
}
const list = path.join(tmp, "list.txt"); fs.writeFileSync(list, parts.map(p => `file '${p.replace(/\\/g, "/")}'`).join("\n"));
const out = path.join(outDir, outName + ".mp3");
run(["-f", "concat", "-safe", "0", "-i", list, "-codec:a", "libmp3lame", "-q:a", "3", out]);
fs.rmSync(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true });
if (gaps.length) { fs.writeFileSync(path.join(outDir, outName + ".json"), JSON.stringify({ dur: +cur.toFixed(2), gaps })); console.log(`\n${gaps.length} child turns marked`); }
console.log(`\nDone: ${out}`);


=== \tools\audio\mix-intro.mjs ===
// Fits the background music to a recording: loud opening -> quiet bed stretched to the speech -> loud ending.
//  Intro:    node mix-intro.mjs --body body.mp3 --end end.mp3 --out intro.mp3
//  Dialogue: node mix-intro.mjs --body voice.mp3 --json voice.json --out dlg.mp3   (the song's own closing line ends it; the teacher does not say it)
import { spawnSync } from "child_process"; import fs from "fs"; import path from "path"; import { fileURLToPath } from "url";
let ffmpeg = "ffmpeg", ffprobe = "ffprobe";
try { const m = await import("ffmpeg-static"); if (m.default) ffmpeg = m.default; } catch {}
const a = {}; for (let i = 2; i < process.argv.length; i += 2) a[process.argv[i].slice(2)] = process.argv[i + 1];
const here = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const music = a.music || path.join(here, "bg_music.mp3");
if (!a.body || !a.out) { console.log("Need --body and --out"); process.exit(1); }
const dur = f => { const r = spawnSync(ffprobe, ["-v", "error", "-show_entries", "format=duration", "-of", "csv=p=0", f]); if (r.status === 0 && r.stdout.toString().trim()) return parseFloat(r.stdout.toString()); const q = spawnSync(ffmpeg, ["-i", f, "-f", "null", "-"]); const m = /time=(\d+):(\d+):([\d.]+)/g; let t, x; while ((x = m.exec(q.stderr.toString()))) t = +x[1] * 3600 + +x[2] * 60 + +x[3]; return t; };
const f = n => n.toFixed(2), V0 = 2.4, KEEP = 7.6;
const hasEnd = !!a.end, B = dur(a.body), GAP = 0.35, F = hasEnd ? dur(a.end) : 0;
const Te = hasEnd ? V0 + B + GAP : V0 + B + 0.8;
const Tt = hasEnd ? Math.max(4, Te - 0.5) : Math.max(4, V0 + B - 0.3), TOTAL = Tt + KEEP;
const run = args => { const r = spawnSync(ffmpeg, ["-y", "-loglevel", "error", ...args]); if (r.status) throw new Error("ffmpeg: " + r.stderr.toString()); };
let voiceIn = [], voiceFilter;
if (hasEnd) {
  const pad = a.out + ".body.tmp.mp3"; run(["-i", a.body, "-af", `apad=pad_dur=${GAP}`, "-ar", "44100", "-ac", "1", pad]);
  voiceIn = ["-i", pad, "-i", a.end]; voiceFilter = `[0:a][1:a]concat=n=2:v=0:a=1[v0]`;
} else { voiceIn = ["-i", a.body]; voiceFilter = `[0:a]anull[v0]`; }
const mi = hasEnd ? 2 : 1;
const filt = [
  `[${mi}:a]atrim=0:3.2,afade=t=out:st=2.1:d=1.1,asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS[head]`,
  `[${mi}:a]atrim=3.2:29,asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS,aloop=loop=-1:size=2000000000,atrim=0:${f(Tt + 1.2)},afade=t=in:st=0:d=0.9,afade=t=out:st=${f(Tt + 0.4)}:d=0.8,adelay=2300|2300[bed]`,
  `[${mi}:a]atrim=29.4:37.0,asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS,afade=t=in:st=0:d=0.5,afade=t=out:st=6.4:d=1.2,adelay=${Math.round(Tt * 1000)}|${Math.round(Tt * 1000)}[tail]`,
  voiceFilter, `[v0]adelay=${Math.round(V0 * 1000)}|${Math.round(V0 * 1000)}[voice]`,
  `[head][bed][tail][voice]amix=inputs=4:normalize=0:duration=longest,atrim=0:${f(TOTAL)}[out]`,
].join(";");
run([...voiceIn, "-i", music, "-filter_complex", filt, "-map", "[out]", "-ar", "44100", "-ac", "2", "-b:a", "128k", a.out]);
if (hasEnd) fs.unlinkSync(a.out + ".body.tmp.mp3");
if (a.json && fs.existsSync(a.json)) {
  const j = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(a.json, "utf8"));
  fs.writeFileSync(a.out.replace(/\.mp3$/i, ".json"), JSON.stringify({ dur: +f(TOTAL), gaps: (j.gaps || []).map(g => [+f(g[0] + V0), +f(g[1] + V0)]) }));
}
console.log(`${hasEnd ? "Intro" : "Dialogue"} made: ${a.out}  (speech ${f(B)}s, music fitted to ${f(TOTAL)}s)`);

[warmly] Welcome back. Today you learn two tiny words that unlock a lot of French. Je suis, which means I am. And tu es, which means you are.

[short pause]

[warmly] Listen first. Je suis content. I am happy.

[pause]

[calmly] Je suis content.

[pause]

[warmly] Now you. Say it with me. Je suis content.

[short pause]

[calmly] Je suis content.

[your turn]

[warmly] Very good.

[short pause]

[warmly] Now the other one. Tu es content. You are happy.

[short pause]

[calmly] Tu es content.

[your turn]

[warmly] Very good.

[short pause]

[warmly] Here is the nice part. A question is just the same words said with a rising voice. Tu es content ?

[short pause]

[calmly] Tu es content ?

[your turn]

[warmly] And you answer. Oui, je suis content.

[short pause]

[calmly] Oui, je suis content.

[your turn]

[warmly] Very good.

[short pause]

[warmly] Now a little conversation. I will ask. You answer, and give your own name after je suis. Ready? Bonjour !

[short pause]

[calmly] Bonjour !

[your turn]

[warmly] Tu es content ?

[short pause]

[calmly] Tu es content ?

[your turn]

[warmly] Lovely. Je suis content aussi. That means, I am happy too.

[short pause]

[warmly] Well done. You can now say who you are, and ask someone how they are. Next time, we'll use these words with more people.

[warmly] Très bien. C'est la fin de la leçon. Bravo.

=== \tools\audio\scripts\L22_a0_intro.txt ===
[warmly] Hello!

[short pause]

[calmly] Today you share your opinions in the simplest way: what you like and what you do not like.

[short pause]

[warmly] It makes conversations come alive.

[short pause]

[calmly] The key words are j'aime, I like, je n'aime pas, I do not like, and je déteste, I hate.

[short pause]

[warmly] We use them with food, colours, jobs, anything we have seen.

[pause]

[warmly] Ready? Let's begin.

// SayBon audit: every audio file a lesson uses must exist, and every recorder must be wired. Writes audit-report.txt
import fs from "fs"; import path from "path";
const root = process.argv[2] || "C:/SayBon", pub = path.join(root, "public"), lv = path.join(pub, "levels");
const SERVER = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com", SITE = "https://saybonapp.com";
const ui0 = fs.existsSync(path.join(lv, "scene-paris", "scene-ui.js")) ? fs.readFileSync(path.join(lv, "scene-paris", "scene-ui.js"), "utf8") : "";
const out = []; const P = s => { out.push(s); console.log(s); }; let PROBLEMS = 0; const F = s => { PROBLEMS++; P("  !! " + s); };
const tf = async (u, o = {}, tries = 3) => { for (let i = 0; i < tries; i++) { try { const r = await fetch(u, { ...o, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(60000) }); if (r.ok || i === tries - 1) return r; } catch (e) { if (i === tries - 1) return null; } await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 4000)); } return null; };
const exists = u => { const f = path.join(pub, decodeURIComponent(u.split("?")[0]).replace(/^\//, "")); return fs.existsSync(f) && fs.statSync(f).size > 1000 ? "ok" : (fs.existsSync(f) ? "TOO SMALL" : "MISSING"); };
P("== 1. Lesson pages and engines");
const dirs = fs.readdirSync(lv).filter(d => fs.statSync(path.join(lv, d)).isDirectory());
for (const d of dirs) { const fl = fs.readdirSync(path.join(lv, d)).filter(f => /\.html$/.test(f)); const eng = new Set();
  for (const f of fl) { const s = fs.readFileSync(path.join(lv, d, f), "utf8"); const m = s.match(/src="([^"]*lesson-engine[^"]*)"/); eng.add(m ? m[1] : "NO ENGINE"); }
  const noEng = fl.filter(f => !/lesson-engine/.test(fs.readFileSync(path.join(lv, d, f), "utf8")));
  if (noEng.length) P(`  ${d}: pages WITHOUT the lesson engine: ${noEng.join(" ")}`);
  P(`${d}: ${fl.length} pages (${fl.filter(f => /^lesson\d+/.test(f)).join(" ") || "-"}) engine: ${[...eng].join(" , ")}`); }
P("\n== 2. Recorder wiring in the scripts");
for (const f of fs.readdirSync(lv).filter(f => /\.js$/.test(f)).concat(["scene-paris/scene-ui.js"].filter(f => fs.existsSync(path.join(lv, f))))) {
  const s = fs.readFileSync(path.join(lv, f), "utf8");
  P(`${f}: getUserMedia=${/getUserMedia/.test(s)} MediaRecorder=${/MediaRecorder/.test(s)} assessPronunciation=${/assessPronunciation/.test(s)} stops tracks=${/getTracks\(\)\.forEach/.test(s)}`); }
P("\n== 3. Audio files named in the scripts (static)");
const seen = new Set(); let miss = 0;
for (const f of fs.readdirSync(lv).filter(f => /\.js$/.test(f)).concat(["scene-paris/scene-ui.js"])) { const p = path.join(lv, f); if (!fs.existsSync(p)) continue;
  for (const m of fs.readFileSync(p, "utf8").matchAll(/\/assets\/audio\/[A-Za-z0-9_\-\/.]+\.mp3/g)) { if (seen.has(m[0])) continue; seen.add(m[0]); const r = exists(m[0]); if (r !== "ok") { miss++; F(`${r}: ${m[0]}  (${f})`); } } }
P(`  ${seen.size} fixed audio paths, ${miss} problems`);
P("\n== 3b. Tout Public lessons 1-3 and Les Petits audio (built from names)");
{ const A = "/assets/audio/"; const chk = (u, why) => { const r = exists(u); if (r !== "ok") F(`${r}: ${u}  (${why})`); return r === "ok"; }; let t = 0, ok = 0;
  const TP = { 1: 5, 2: 4, 3: 2 }; for (const l in TP) for (let i = 1; i <= TP[l]; i++) { t++; ok += chk(`${A}A0_TP_L${l}_phrase${i}.mp3`, "Tout Public phrase") ? 1 : 0; }
  const km = (n) => { const m = ui0.match(new RegExp("var " + n + "=\\{([^}]*)\\}")); return m ? [...m[1].matchAll(/'(\d+)-(\d+)'/g)].map(x => [x[1], x[2]]) : []; };
  for (const [l, p] of km("KAUD")) { t++; ok += chk(`${A}lp/lesson${l}_part${p}.mp3`, "Les Petits part audio") ? 1 : 0; }
  for (const [l, p] of km("KINTRO")) { t++; ok += chk(`${A}lp/lesson${l}_part${p}.mp3`, "Les Petits intro") ? 1 : 0; }
  P(`  ${ok} of ${t} present`); }
P("\n== 4. Built lessons (A1-C2 and Tout Public): intro, steps, dialogue and its answer windows");
const ui = fs.readFileSync(path.join(lv, "scene-paris", "scene-ui.js"), "utf8"); const mm = ui.match(/var UCFG=(\{.*?\});\nfunction U\(\)/s);
if (!mm) P("  no UCFG found (apply-upper3 not applied)"); else { const cfg = JSON.parse(mm[1]); const A = "/assets/audio/lessons/";
  for (const k in cfg) { const c = cfg[k], bad = [];
    for (const n of [c.intro, ...c.steps.map(s => s.a), c.dlg]) { const r = exists(A + n + ".mp3"); if (r !== "ok") bad.push(`${n}.mp3 ${r}`); }
    const jf = path.join(pub, "assets/audio/lessons", c.dlg + ".json");
    if (!fs.existsSync(jf)) bad.push(c.dlg + ".json MISSING"); else { const g = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(jf, "utf8")).gaps || []; if (g.length !== c.dd.length) bad.push(`windows ${g.length} but expected-answers ${c.dd.length}`); }
    if (bad.length) F(`${k}: ` + bad.join("; ")); else P(`  ${k}: all ${c.steps.length + 2} audio files + windows ok`); } }
P("\n== 5. Live lessons from the server (assets per lesson) and their audio");
const ids = ["a0-les-petits", "a0-tout-public", "a1", "a2", "b1", "b2", "c1", "c2"];
try { const h = await tf(SERVER + "/api/levelAssets?level=a1&lesson=1"); if (!h || !h.ok) F("server did not answer the lessons request"); else P("server answers: " + h.status); } catch {}
for (const id of ids) for (let n = 1; n <= 5; n++) {
  try { const r = await tf(`${SERVER}/api/levelAssets?level=${id}&lesson=${n}`); if (!r || !r.ok) throw new Error("no answer"); const j = await r.json(); const a = Array.isArray(j) ? j : (j.assets || []);
    const urls = []; const walk = o => { if (typeof o === "string") { if (/\.(mp3|wav|m4a|webm|ogg)(\?|$)/i.test(o)) urls.push(o); } else if (o && typeof o === "object") for (const v of Object.values(o)) walk(v); }; walk(a);
    if (id === "a1" && n === 1 && a[0]) P("  (shape of one asset: " + Object.keys(a[0]).join(", ") + "; types: " + [...new Set(a.map(x => x.type))].join(", ") + ")");
    const bad = [];
    for (const u of urls) { const full = u.startsWith("http") ? u : SITE + (u.startsWith("/") ? "" : "/") + u; const h = await tf(full, { method: "HEAD" }); if (!h || !h.ok) bad.push(u + " -> " + (h ? h.status : "no reply")); }
    if (bad.length) F(`${id} lesson ${n}: broken audio ${bad.join("; ")}`); else P(`  ${id} lesson ${n}: ${a.length} assets, ${urls.length} audio links ok`);
  } catch (e) { F(`${id} lesson ${n}: could not read the lesson (${e.message})`); } }
P("\n== 6. Live site: pages and every built audio file");
for (const u of ["/", "/levels/", "/levels/A1/", "/levels/A1/lesson1.html", "/levels/A1/lesson2.html", "/levels/A2/lesson1.html", "/levels/B1/lesson1.html", "/levels/B2/lesson1.html", "/levels/C1/lesson1.html", "/levels/C2/lesson1.html", "/levels/lesson-engine-tp.js", "/levels/scene-paris/scene-ui.js"]) { const h = await tf(SITE + u, { method: "HEAD" }); if (!h || !h.ok) F(`page ${u} -> ${h ? h.status : "no reply"}`); else P(`  ${u}: ${h.status}`); }
for (const k of ["A0_TP_L1_intro", "A0_TP_L1_dialogue", "A0_TP_L2_dialogue", "A0_TP_L3_dialogue", "A0_TP_L3_intro", "A0_TP_L3_dialogue_intro"]) { const h = await tf(`${SITE}/assets/audio/${k}.mp3`, { method: "HEAD" }); if (!h || !h.ok) F(`live audio ${k}.mp3 -> ${h ? h.status : "no reply"}`); }
if (mm) { const cfg = JSON.parse(mm[1]); let ok = 0, tot = 0; for (const k in cfg) { const c = cfg[k]; for (const n of [c.intro + ".mp3", ...c.steps.map(s => s.a + ".mp3"), c.dlg + ".mp3", c.dlg + ".json"]) { tot++; const h = await tf(`${SITE}/assets/audio/lessons/${n}`, { method: "HEAD" }); if (h && h.ok) ok++; else F(`live ${k}: ${n} -> ${h ? h.status : "no reply"}`); } } P(`  built lesson audio live: ${ok} of ${tot}`); }
P(PROBLEMS ? `\nRESULT: ${PROBLEMS} PROBLEM(S)` : "\nRESULT: all good");
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root, "audit-report.txt"), out.join("\n"));
P("\nSaved: " + path.join(root, "audit-report.txt"));
process.exit(PROBLEMS ? 1 : 0);

// SayBon full-project audit. Usage: node tools\audit-full.mjs C:\SayBon [other project folders...] [--no-live]
import fs from "fs"; import path from "path"; import { spawnSync } from "child_process";
const args = process.argv.slice(2), NOLIVE = args.includes("--no-live"), roots = args.filter(a => !a.startsWith("--")).map(r => path.resolve(r));
if (!roots.length) roots.push(path.resolve("."));

function resolveRef(page, ref) {
  if (/^(https?:)?\/\//i.test(ref)) return { ext: true };
  if (/^(mailto:|tel:|javascript:|data:|blob:|#|sms:|whatsapp:)/i.test(ref)) return { skip: true };

  p = slash(path.normalize(p));
  const cands = [p]; if (p.endsWith("/")) cands.push(p + "index.html"); else if (!path.extname(p)) { cands.push(p + ".html", p + "/index.html"); }
  for (const c of cands) { const s = ex(c); if (s && s.isFile()) return { file: c, size: s.size }; }
  const rw = rewrites.some((w) => { try { return new RegExp("^" + (w.source || "").replace(/\*\*/g, ".*").replace(/\*/g, "[^/]*") + "$").test(r); } catch (e) { return false; } });
  return rw ? { rewrite: true } : { missing: p };
}

=== \tools\Make-FeedbackVoices.ps1 ===
# Records the teacher's spoken reactions to a score (Eryn, eleven_v4). About 700 characters in total. Run it from C:\SayBon:
#   .\tools\Make-FeedbackVoices.ps1
# It asks for your ElevenLabs key (typed hidden, never saved). Files that already exist are skipped, so it is safe to run twice.
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$root = Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent
$out = Join-Path $root "public\audio\feedback"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $out | Out-Null
Write-Host "Paste your ElevenLabs API key and press Enter (nothing will show):" -ForegroundColor Yellow
$sec = Read-Host -AsSecureString
$key = [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::PtrToStringAuto([Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::SecureStringToBSTR($sec))
if (-not $key) { Write-Host "No key, nothing done." -ForegroundColor Red; return }
$h = @{ "xi-api-key" = $key.Trim() }
try { $sub = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/user/subscription" -Headers $h; Write-Host ("Key accepted. Credits left: " + ([int]$sub.character_limit - [int]$sub.character_count)) -ForegroundColor Green } catch { Write-Host ("ElevenLabs refused this key: " + $_.Exception.Message) -ForegroundColor Red; return }
$teacher = (Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://api.elevenlabs.io/v2/voices?search=Eryn&page_size=50" -Headers $h).voices | Where-Object { $_.name -like "Eryn*" } | Select-Object -First 1
if (-not $teacher) { Write-Host "No voice named Eryn in this ElevenLabs account." -ForegroundColor Red; return }
$C = [ordered]@{
 "en-wow-1" = "Wow! Très bien!"; "en-wow-2" = "Super! Well done!"; "en-wow-3" = "Excellent! Bravo!"; "en-wow-4" = "Wow, that was lovely!"
 "en-good-1" = "Pas mal! Not bad at all."; "en-good-2" = "Not too bad! Pas mal!"; "en-good-3" = "Good! Très bien, keep going."; "en-good-4" = "Nice one, you're getting there."
 "en-try-1" = "Good try! Encore une fois."; "en-try-2" = "Almost! Let's go again."; "en-try-3" = "Don't worry. Encore une fois!"; "en-try-4" = "Nearly there. Try once more."
 "en-none-1" = "I didn't hear you. Try again."; "en-none-2" = "Sorry, I missed that. Once more?"
 "mix-wow-1" = "Wow! Très bien!"; "mix-wow-2" = "Excellent! Well done!"; "mix-wow-3" = "Parfait! Bravo!"; "mix-wow-4" = "Super! C'était très bien."
 "mix-good-1" = "Pas mal du tout!"; "mix-good-2" = "Not bad! Continuez."; "mix-good-3" = "C'est bien! Keep going."; "mix-good-4" = "Pas mal! You're nearly there."
 "mix-try-1" = "Encore une fois!"; "mix-try-2" = "Presque! Let's try again."; "mix-try-3" = "Courage! Encore un effort."; "mix-try-4" = "Not yet, mais ça vient."
 "mix-none-1" = "Je n'ai rien entendu. Try again."; "mix-none-2" = "I didn't hear you. Encore une fois."
 "fr-wow-1" = "Wow! Très bien!"; "fr-wow-2" = "Excellent! Bravo!"; "fr-wow-3" = "Parfait! Magnifique!"; "fr-wow-4" = "Superbe, vraiment!"
 "fr-good-1" = "Pas mal du tout!"; "fr-good-2" = "Pas mal! Continuez."; "fr-good-3" = "C'est bien, ça vient!"; "fr-good-4" = "Bien. On y est presque."
 "fr-try-1" = "Encore une fois!"; "fr-try-2" = "Presque! Reprenons."; "fr-try-3" = "Courage, encore un effort!"; "fr-try-4" = "Pas encore, mais ça vient."
 "fr-none-1" = "Je n'ai rien entendu. Réessayez."; "fr-none-2" = "Je n'ai pas bien entendu. Encore une fois."
}
$n = 0; $chars = 0
foreach ($id in $C.Keys) {
  $f = Join-Path $out ($id + ".mp3")
  if (Test-Path $f) { continue }
  $b = @{ text = $C[$id]; model_id = "eleven_v4"; voice_settings = @{ stability = 0.5; similarity_boost = 0.75 } } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
  try {
    Invoke-WebRequest -Method Post -Uri ("https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/" + $teacher.voice_id + "?output_format=mp3_44100_128") -Headers ($h + @{ "Content-Type" = "application/json; charset=utf-8" }) -Body ([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($b)) -OutFile $f | Out-Null
    if ((Get-Item $f).Length -lt 1000) { Remove-Item $f -Force; throw "empty audio" }
    $n++; $chars += $C[$id].Length; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 150
  } catch { if (Test-Path $f) { Remove-Item $f -Force }; Write-Host ("STOPPED at " + $id + ": " + $_.Exception.Message) -ForegroundColor Red; break }
}
$have = @(Get-ChildItem $out -Filter *.mp3).Count
Write-Host ("Recorded " + $n + " new clips (" + $chars + " credits). Folder now holds " + $have + " of " + $C.Count + ".") -ForegroundColor Green
explorer.exe /select,$out


=== \tools\Make-KidsVoices.ps1 ===
# Records the big celebration reactions for Les Petits with the voice you name (default: Mira). About 500 characters. Run from C:\SayBon:
#   .\tools\Make-KidsVoices.ps1            (or  -Voice "Letici")
# It asks for your ElevenLabs key (typed hidden, never saved). Existing files are skipped.
param([string]$Voice = "Mira")
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$root = Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent
$out = Join-Path $root "public\audio\feedback"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $out | Out-Null
Write-Host "Paste your ElevenLabs API key and press Enter (nothing will show):" -ForegroundColor Yellow
$sec = Read-Host -AsSecureString
$key = [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::PtrToStringAuto([Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::SecureStringToBSTR($sec))
if (-not $key) { Write-Host "No key, nothing done." -ForegroundColor Red; return }
$h = @{ "xi-api-key" = $key.Trim() }
try { $sub = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/user/subscription" -Headers $h; Write-Host ("Key accepted. Credits left: " + ([int]$sub.character_limit - [int]$sub.character_count)) -ForegroundColor Green } catch { Write-Host ("ElevenLabs refused this key: " + $_.Exception.Message) -ForegroundColor Red; return }
$all = (Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://api.elevenlabs.io/v2/voices?page_size=100" -Headers $h).voices
$v = $all | Where-Object { $_.name -like ($Voice + "*") } | Select-Object -First 1
if (-not $v) {
  Write-Host ("No voice starting with '" + $Voice + "' in this ElevenLabs account. Nothing recorded. The voices you have are:") -ForegroundColor Red
  $all | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ("  " + $_.name) }
  Write-Host "Run again with the exact name, e.g.  .\tools\Make-KidsVoices.ps1 -Voice ""Name""" -ForegroundColor Yellow
  return
}
Write-Host ("Using voice: " + $v.name) -ForegroundColor Green
$C = [ordered]@{
 "kids-k3-1" = "Wow! Amazing! Bravo, bravo, bravo!"; "kids-k3-2" = "Superrr! You did it! Tu es génial!"; "kids-k3-3" = "Yaaay! Fantastic! Trop bien!"; "kids-k3-4" = "Oh là là! Incredible! Bravo!"
 "kids-k2-1" = "Très bien! Well done, great job!"; "kids-k2-2" = "Yay! Super! Almost perfect!"; "kids-k2-3" = "Great! Bravo! Let's keep going!"; "kids-k2-4" = "Ooh, so good! Très bien!"
 "kids-k1-1" = "Good try! Bon effort! You can do it!"; "kids-k1-2" = "Nice! Let's try again, ça va aller!"; "kids-k1-3" = "Almost! Courage, you're doing great!"; "kids-k1-4" = "Ooh, so close! Encore une fois, you can do it!"
 "kids-kn-1" = "Hmm, I couldn't hear you. A little louder, please!"; "kids-kn-2" = "Oops! Say it again, a little louder!"
}
$n = 0; $chars = 0
foreach ($id in $C.Keys) {
  $f = Join-Path $out ($id + ".mp3")
  if (Test-Path $f) { continue }
  $b = @{ text = $C[$id]; model_id = "eleven_v4"; voice_settings = @{ stability = 0.4; similarity_boost = 0.75; style = 0.6 } } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
  try {
    Invoke-WebRequest -Method Post -Uri ("https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/" + $v.voice_id + "?output_format=mp3_44100_128") -Headers ($h + @{ "Content-Type" = "application/json; charset=utf-8" }) -Body ([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($b)) -OutFile $f | Out-Null
    if ((Get-Item $f).Length -lt 1000) { Remove-Item $f -Force; throw "empty audio" }
    $n++; $chars += $C[$id].Length; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 150
  } catch { if (Test-Path $f) { Remove-Item $f -Force }; Write-Host ("STOPPED at " + $id + ": " + $_.Exception.Message) -ForegroundColor Red; break }
}
Write-Host ("Recorded " + $n + " new clips (" + $chars + " credits) of " + $C.Count + ".") -ForegroundColor Green
explorer.exe /select,$out


=== \tools\Make-MaisonAudio.ps1 ===
# Makes the teacher voice (Eryn) for the Chez moi drill game with ElevenLabs.
# Needs $env:ELEVENLABS_API_KEY in this PowerShell window. Safe to run again: it only makes missing clips,
# and it stops by itself if your credits run out (run it again after a top-up and it carries on).
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$root = Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent
$key = $env:ELEVENLABS_API_KEY
if (-not $key) { Write-Host "ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is not set in this window." -ForegroundColor Yellow; return $false }

$free = [math]::Round((Get-PSDrive C).Free / 1GB, 1)
Write-Host "Free space on C: $free GB"
if ($free -lt 1) { Write-Host "Less than 1 GB free. Free some space first." -ForegroundColor Yellow; return $false }

$contentPath = Join-Path $root "public\assets\talkletics\maison\maison-content.json"
$outDir = Join-Path $root "public\assets\talkletics\maison\audio"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $outDir | Out-Null
$content = Get-Content $contentPath -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json
$h = @{ "xi-api-key" = $key }

# find the voice called Eryn in your account
$voice = $null
try {
  $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ("https://api.elevenlabs.io/v2/voices?search=" + [uri]::EscapeDataString($content.voice) + "&page_size=50") -Headers $h
  $voice = $r.voices | Where-Object { $_.name -like ($content.voice + "*") } | Select-Object -First 1
} catch {
  Write-Host ("Could not read your voices: " + $_.Exception.Message) -ForegroundColor Yellow; return $false
}
if (-not $voice) { Write-Host ("No voice named " + $content.voice + " in your ElevenLabs account.") -ForegroundColor Yellow; return $false }
Write-Host ("Voice: " + $voice.name)

# clip list: [id, text]
$clips = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
foreach ($x in $content.extras) { [void]$clips.Add(@($x.id, $x.text)) }
foreach ($s in $content.sections) {
  [void]$clips.Add(@($s.introId, $s.intro))
  foreach ($i in $s.items) { [void]$clips.Add(@($i.id, $i.fr)) }
}

$models = @("eleven_v4", "eleven_v3", "eleven_multilingual_v2")
$mi = 0
$made = 0; $skipped = 0

function Get-ErrBody($ex) {
  try { $sr = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($ex.Response.GetResponseStream()); return $sr.ReadToEnd() } catch { return "" }
}

foreach ($c in $clips) {
  $id = $c[0]; $text = $c[1]
  $file = Join-Path $outDir ($id + ".mp3")
  if ((Test-Path $file) -and ((Get-Item $file).Length -gt 1000)) { $skipped++; continue }
  $ok = $false
  for ($try = 0; $try -lt 6 -and -not $ok; $try++) {
    $body = @{ text = $text; model_id = $models[$mi]; voice_settings = @{ stability = 0.5; similarity_boost = 0.75 } } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4
    $bytes = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($body)
    try {
      Invoke-WebRequest -Method Post -Uri ("https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/" + $voice.voice_id + "?output_format=mp3_44100_128") `
        -Headers $h -ContentType "application/json; charset=utf-8" -Body $bytes -OutFile $file -UseBasicParsing | Out-Null
      $ok = $true; $made++
      if ($made % 10 -eq 0) { Write-Host ("  made " + $made + " clips...") }
    } catch {
      $code = 0; try { $code = [int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode } catch {}
      $eb = Get-ErrBody $_.Exception
      if (Test-Path $file) { Remove-Item $file -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
      if ($code -eq 401 -and $eb -match "quota") { Write-Host "Your ElevenLabs credits ran out. Top up and run this again: it carries on where it stopped." -ForegroundColor Yellow; return $false }
      if ($code -eq 401) { Write-Host "ElevenLabs refused the key. Set it again in this window." -ForegroundColor Yellow; return $false }
      if ($code -eq 402 -or $eb -match "quota_exceeded") { Write-Host "Your ElevenLabs credits ran out. Top up and run this again: it carries on where it stopped." -ForegroundColor Yellow; return $false }
      if ($code -eq 429) { Start-Sleep -Seconds (4 + 3 * $try); continue }
      if (($code -eq 400 -or $code -eq 404 -or $code -eq 422) -and $mi -lt ($models.Count - 1) -and $made -eq 0) { $mi++; Write-Host ("Switching model to " + $models[$mi]); continue }
      Write-Host ("Clip " + $id + " failed (" + $code + "): " + $eb) -ForegroundColor Yellow; return $false
    }
  }
  if (-not $ok) { Write-Host ("Clip " + $id + " did not work after several tries.") -ForegroundColor Yellow; return $false }
}
Write-Host ("Done. Model " + $models[$mi] + ". Made " + $made + ", already there " + $skipped + ", total " + $clips.Count + ".") -ForegroundColor Green
return $true


=== \tools\Make-MusicIntro.ps1 ===

# It asks for your ElevenLabs key (typed hidden, never saved). Files that already exist are skipped, so it is safe to run twice.

$C = [ordered]@{
 "intro-eryn" = "Welcome to the music room. This is a language bath. We don't show English subtitles on purpose. If you stop to work out what every line means, your attention leaves the French. So just listen, hum along, and let the sounds settle in. Understanding grows by itself, with time. Now, enjoy."
}
$n = 0; $chars = 0
foreach ($id in $C.Keys) {
  $f = Join-Path $out ($id + ".mp3")
  if (Test-Path $f) { continue }
  $b = @{ text = $C[$id]; model_id = "eleven_v4"; voice_settings = @{ stability = 0.5; similarity_boost = 0.75 } } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
  try {
    Invoke-WebRequest -Method Post -Uri ("https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/" + $teacher.voice_id + "?output_format=mp3_44100_128") -Headers ($h + @{ "Content-Type" = "application/json; charset=utf-8" }) -Body ([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($b)) -OutFile $f | Out-Null
    if ((Get-Item $f).Length -lt 1000) { Remove-Item $f -Force; throw "empty audio" }
    $n++; $chars += $C[$id].Length; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 150
  } catch { if (Test-Path $f) { Remove-Item $f -Force }; Write-Host ("STOPPED at " + $id + ": " + $_.Exception.Message) -ForegroundColor Red; break }
}
$have = @(Get-ChildItem $out -Filter *.mp3).Count
Write-Host ("Recorded " + $n + " new clips (" + $chars + " credits). Folder now holds " + $have + " of " + $C.Count + ".") -ForegroundColor Green
explorer.exe /select,$out

=== \tools\Make-PlacesAudio.ps1 ===
# Makes the teacher voice (Eryn) for the Talkletics places (kitchen, living room, bedroom, bathroom, house street, bakery) with ElevenLabs.
# Needs $env:ELEVENLABS_API_KEY in this PowerShell window. Safe to run again: it only makes missing clips,
# and it stops by itself if your credits run out (run it again after a top-up and it carries on).
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$root = Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent
$key = $env:ELEVENLABS_API_KEY
if (-not $key) { Write-Host "ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is not set in this window." -ForegroundColor Yellow; return $false }

$free = [math]::Round((Get-PSDrive C).Free / 1GB, 1)
Write-Host "Free space on C: $free GB"
if ($free -lt 1) { Write-Host "Less than 1 GB free. Free some space first." -ForegroundColor Yellow; return $false }

$h = @{ "xi-api-key" = $key }
$placesDir = Join-Path $root "public\assets\talkletics\places"
$configs = Get-ChildItem $placesDir -Directory | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $_.FullName "config.json" } | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ }

$configs = @($configs) + (Join-Path $root "public\assets\talkletics\maison\extras.json")
$first = Get-Content $configs[0] -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json
$voice = $null
try {
  $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ("https://api.elevenlabs.io/v2/voices?search=" + [uri]::EscapeDataString($first.voice) + "&page_size=50") -Headers $h
  $voice = $r.voices | Where-Object { $_.name -like ($first.voice + "*") } | Select-Object -First 1
} catch {
  Write-Host ("Could not read your voices: " + $_.Exception.Message) -ForegroundColor Yellow; return $false
}
if (-not $voice) { Write-Host ("No voice named " + $first.voice + " in your ElevenLabs account.") -ForegroundColor Yellow; return $false }
Write-Host ("Voice: " + $voice.name)

$models = @("eleven_v4", "eleven_v3", "eleven_multilingual_v2")
$mi = 0
$made = 0; $skipped = 0; $total = 0

function Get-ErrBody($ex) {
  try { $sr = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($ex.Response.GetResponseStream()); return $sr.ReadToEnd() } catch { return "" }
}

foreach ($cfgPath in $configs) {
  $content = Get-Content $cfgPath -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json
  $outDir = Join-Path (Split-Path $cfgPath -Parent) "audio"
  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $outDir | Out-Null
  Write-Host ("Place: " + $content.slug)
  $clips = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
  if ($cfgPath -like "*extras.json") {
    Write-Host "Shared: welcome intros and encouragements"
    for ($n = 0; $n -lt $content.intro_new.Count; $n++) { [void]$clips.Add(@(("intro_new" + ($n + 1)), $content.intro_new[$n])) }
    for ($n = 0; $n -lt $content.intro_back.Count; $n++) { [void]$clips.Add(@(("intro_back" + ($n + 1)), $content.intro_back[$n])) }
    for ($n = 0; $n -lt $content.enc.Count; $n++) { [void]$clips.Add(@(("enc" + ($n + 1)), $content.enc[$n])) }
  } else {
  foreach ($x in $content.extras) { [void]$clips.Add(@($x.id, $x.text)) }
  foreach ($s in $content.sections) {
    [void]$clips.Add(@($s.introId, $s.intro))
    foreach ($i in $s.items) { [void]$clips.Add(@($i.id, $i.fr)) }
  }
  }
  foreach ($c in $clips) {
    $total++
    $id = $c[0]; $text = $c[1]
    $file = Join-Path $outDir ($id + ".mp3")
    if ((Test-Path $file) -and ((Get-Item $file).Length -gt 1000)) { $skipped++; continue }
    $ok = $false
    for ($try = 0; $try -lt 6 -and -not $ok; $try++) {
      $body = @{ text = $text; model_id = $models[$mi]; voice_settings = @{ stability = $(if ($id -like "enc*") { 0.3 } else { 0.5 }); similarity_boost = 0.75 } } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4
      $bytes = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($body)
      try {
        Invoke-WebRequest -Method Post -Uri ("https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/" + $voice.voice_id + "?output_format=mp3_44100_128") `
          -Headers $h -ContentType "application/json; charset=utf-8" -Body $bytes -OutFile $file -UseBasicParsing | Out-Null
        $ok = $true; $made++
        if ($made % 10 -eq 0) { Write-Host ("  made " + $made + " clips...") }
      } catch {
        $code = 0; try { $code = [int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode } catch {}
        $eb = Get-ErrBody $_.Exception
        if (Test-Path $file) { Remove-Item $file -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
        if ($code -eq 401 -and $eb -match "quota") { Write-Host "Your ElevenLabs credits ran out. Top up and run this again: it carries on where it stopped." -ForegroundColor Yellow; return $false }
        if ($code -eq 401) { Write-Host "ElevenLabs refused the key. Set it again in this window." -ForegroundColor Yellow; return $false }
        if ($code -eq 402 -or $eb -match "quota_exceeded") { Write-Host "Your ElevenLabs credits ran out. Top up and run this again: it carries on where it stopped." -ForegroundColor Yellow; return $false }
        if ($code -eq 429) { Start-Sleep -Seconds (4 + 3 * $try); continue }
        if (($code -eq 400 -or $code -eq 404 -or $code -eq 422) -and $mi -lt ($models.Count - 1) -and $made -eq 0) { $mi++; Write-Host ("Switching model to " + $models[$mi]); continue }
        Write-Host ("Clip " + $id + " failed (" + $code + "): " + $eb) -ForegroundColor Yellow; return $false
      }
    }
    if (-not $ok) { Write-Host ("Clip " + $id + " did not work after several tries.") -ForegroundColor Yellow; return $false }
  }
}
Write-Host ("Done. Model " + $models[$mi] + ". Made " + $made + ", already there " + $skipped + ", total " + $total + ".") -ForegroundColor Green
return $true


=== \tools\Make-ProAudio.ps1 ===
# Makes ALL the audio for French for Professionals with ElevenLabs: the teacher intros and every scenario line.
# Run it from the project folder:  .\tools\Make-ProAudio.ps1
# It makes the lessons level by level, A0 first. If your credits run out it stops, tells you, and writes down
# which lessons are complete. Add credits, run it again, and it carries on where it stopped (it never remakes a file).
# Option: -UpTo A2 records only up to that level (A0 A1 A2 B1 B2 C1 C2).
param([string]$UpTo = "C2")
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$root = Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent
$pro = Join-Path $root "public\professional"
$scn = Join-Path $pro "scenario"
$key = $env:ELEVENLABS_API_KEY
if (-not $key) {
  Write-Host "Paste your ElevenLabs key here (it stays on this computer, nothing is shown):" -ForegroundColor Yellow
  $sec = Read-Host -AsSecureString
  $key = [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::PtrToStringAuto([Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::SecureStringToBSTR($sec))
}
if (-not $key) { Write-Host "No key, nothing done." -ForegroundColor Red; return }
$h = @{ "xi-api-key" = $key }
$manifest = Get-Content (Join-Path $scn "manifest.json") -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json
$lessons = Get-Content (Join-Path $scn "lessons.json") -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json
$order = @("00 cues", "a0", "a1", "a2", "b1", "b2", "c1", "c2")
$limit = [array]::IndexOf($order, $UpTo.ToLower()); if ($limit -lt 0) { $limit = 7 }
function Find-Voice($name) {
  $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ("https://api.elevenlabs.io/v2/voices?search=" + [uri]::EscapeDataString($name) + "&page_size=50") -Headers $h
  return ($r.voices | Where-Object { $_.name -like ($name + "*") } | Select-Object -First 1)
}
try { $voice = Find-Voice "Eryn" } catch { Write-Host ("ElevenLabs refused the voice lookup: " + $_.Exception.Message) -ForegroundColor Red; return }
if (-not $voice) { Write-Host "No voice named Eryn in this ElevenLabs account." -ForegroundColor Yellow; return }
$cvoice = $voice
if ($env:ELEVENLABS_CLIENT_VOICE) { try { $cv = Find-Voice $env:ELEVENLABS_CLIENT_VOICE; if ($cv) { $cvoice = $cv } } catch {} }
Write-Host ("Teacher voice: " + $voice.name + "   Other-person voice: " + $cvoice.name)
$audioDir = Join-Path $scn "audio"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $audioDir | Out-Null
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Join-Path $pro "audio") | Out-Null
$models = @("eleven_v3", "eleven_multilingual_v2"); $mi = 0; $made = 0; $had = 0; $stopped = $false; $chars = 0
foreach ($ln in $manifest.lines) {
  if ($stopped) { break }
  $ti = [array]::IndexOf($order, [string]$ln.tier); if ($ti -gt $limit) { continue }
  if ($ln.file) { $file = Join-Path $pro ($ln.file -replace "/", "\") } else { $file = Join-Path $audioDir ($ln.id + ".mp3") }
  if ((Test-Path $file) -and ((Get-Item $file).Length -gt 1000)) { $had++; continue }
  $vid = if ($ln.role -eq "c") { $cvoice.voice_id } else { $voice.voice_id }
  $tries = 0
  while ($true) {
    try {
      $body = @{ text = $ln.text; model_id = $models[$mi]; voice_settings = @{ stability = 0.5; similarity_boost = 0.75 } } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4
      Invoke-WebRequest -Method Post -Uri ("https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/" + $vid + "?output_format=mp3_44100_128") -Headers ($h + @{ "Content-Type" = "application/json; charset=utf-8" }) -Body ([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($body)) -OutFile $file | Out-Null
      $made++; $chars += $ln.text.Length
      if ($made % 25 -eq 0) { Write-Host ("Made " + $made + " files so far (level " + $ln.tier + ")") }
      Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 120
      break
    } catch {
      $code = 0; $msg = ""
      try { $code = [int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode; $sr = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($_.Exception.Response.GetResponseStream()); $msg = $sr.ReadToEnd() } catch {}
      if (Test-Path $file) { Remove-Item $file -Force }
      if (($code -eq 400 -or $code -eq 404 -or $code -eq 422) -and $mi -lt ($models.Count - 1) -and $made -eq 0 -and $msg -notmatch "quota|credit") { $mi++; Write-Host ("Switching model to " + $models[$mi]); continue }
      if ($code -ge 500 -and $tries -lt 2) { $tries++; Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; continue }
      if ($code -eq 401 -or $code -eq 402 -or $code -eq 429 -or $msg -match "quota|credit|limit") {
        Write-Host ("STOPPED: ElevenLabs says your credits are finished (or the key is refused). Error " + $code + ". Add credits, then run this again.") -ForegroundColor Red
      } else { Write-Host ("STOPPED at level " + $ln.tier + ": error " + $code + " " + $msg) -ForegroundColor Red }
      $stopped = $true; break
    }
  }
}
# write down which lessons are now complete, so the app only opens lessons that really have all their audio
$ready = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
foreach ($p in $lessons.PSObject.Properties) {
  $ok = $true
  foreach ($id in $p.Value) {
    $f = Join-Path $audioDir ($id + ".mp3")
    if (-not ((Test-Path $f) -and ((Get-Item $f).Length -gt 1000))) { $ok = $false; break }
  }
  if ($ok) { [void]$ready.Add($p.Name) }
}
$json = (@{ lessons = $ready } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)
[IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $scn "ready.json"), $json, (New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
Write-Host ""
Write-Host ("Made " + $made + " new files (" + $chars + " characters), already there " + $had + ".") -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host ("Lessons complete and ready to open: " + $ready.Count + " of " + @($lessons.PSObject.Properties).Count) -ForegroundColor Green
if ($stopped) { Write-Host "Not finished. Add credits and run it again. Then deploy to publish what is ready." -ForegroundColor Yellow }
explorer.exe /select,$scn

# Makes the teacher intros for French for Professionals (every level x relaxed / steady / intensive) with ElevenLabs, voice Eryn.
# Needs $env:ELEVENLABS_API_KEY in this PowerShell window. Safe to run again: it only makes missing files.
# If your credits run out it stops cleanly and tells you. Top up, then run it again and it carries on.

if (-not $key) { Write-Host "ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is not set in this window." -ForegroundColor Yellow; return $false }

$dir = Join-Path $root "public\professional"
$out = Join-Path $dir "audio"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $out | Out-Null

  $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://api.elevenlabs.io/v2/voices?search=Eryn&page_size=50" -Headers $h
  $voice = $r.voices | Where-Object { $_.name -like "Eryn*" } | Select-Object -First 1

  foreach ($k in @("relaxed", "steady", "intensive")) {
    if ($stopped) { break }
    $file = Join-Path $out ("intro-" + $lv + "-" + $k + ".mp3")

        $made++; Write-Host ("Made: " + $lv + " " + $k); break
      } catch {
        $code = 0; $msg = ""
        try { $code = [int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode; $sr = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($_.Exception.Response.GetResponseStream()); $msg = $sr.ReadToEnd() } catch {}
        if (Test-Path $file) { Remove-Item $file -Force }
        if (($code -eq 400 -or $code -eq 404 -or $code -eq 422) -and $mi -lt ($models.Count - 1) -and $made -eq 0) { $mi++; Write-Host ("Switching model to " + $models[$mi]); continue }
        if ($code -eq 401 -or $code -eq 402 -or $code -eq 429 -or $msg -match "quota|credit|limit") {
          Write-Host ("STOPPED: ElevenLabs says your credits are finished (or the key is refused). Error " + $code + ". Top up, then run this again.") -ForegroundColor Red
        } else { Write-Host ("STOPPED at " + $lv + " " + $k + ": error " + $code + " " + $msg) -ForegroundColor Red }
        $stopped = $true; break
      }
    }
  }
}
Write-Host ("Made " + $made + " new, already there " + $had + ", of 18.") -ForegroundColor Green

=== \tools\Make-ProIntros.ps1 ===
# Records ONLY the 70 teacher intros (one per profession and level) with ElevenLabs, voice Eryn.
# Run from the project folder:  .\tools\Make-ProIntros.ps1
# It asks for your ElevenLabs key (typed hidden, kept only in this window, never saved).
# It records A0 for all ten professions first, then A1, and so on. It never remakes a file that exists.
# When your credits run out it stops cleanly. Run it again later and it carries on.
param([int]$MaxChars = 0,      # optional cap, e.g. -MaxChars 10000 stops before spending more than that
      [string]$Only = "",     # record just one intro to test it, e.g. -Only business-A0
      [switch]$Redo)           # record again even if the file exists (use with -Only first, listen, then run without -Only)
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$root = Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent
$pro = Join-Path $root "public\professional"
$scn = Join-Path $pro "scenario"
Write-Host "Paste your ElevenLabs API key and press Enter (nothing will show):" -ForegroundColor Yellow
$sec = Read-Host -AsSecureString
$key = [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::PtrToStringAuto([Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::SecureStringToBSTR($sec))
if (-not $key) { Write-Host "No key, nothing done." -ForegroundColor Red; return }
$h = @{ "xi-api-key" = $key.Trim() }
try {
  $sub = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/user/subscription" -Headers $h
  $left = [int]$sub.character_limit - [int]$sub.character_count
  Write-Host ("Key accepted. Credits left: " + $left) -ForegroundColor Green
} catch { Write-Host ("ElevenLabs refused this key: " + $_.Exception.Message) -ForegroundColor Red; return }
$manifest = Get-Content (Join-Path $scn "manifest.json") -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json
$intros = @($manifest.lines | Where-Object { $_.id -like "intro-*" })
$order = @("a0","a1","a2","b1","b2","c1","c2")
if ($Only) { $intros = @($intros | Where-Object { $_.id -eq ("intro-" + $Only) }); if (-not $intros.Count) { Write-Host ("No intro called " + $Only) -ForegroundColor Red; return } }
$intros = $intros | Sort-Object { [array]::IndexOf($order, [string]$_.tier) }
Write-Host ("Intros in total: " + $intros.Count)
$r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://api.elevenlabs.io/v2/voices?search=Eryn&page_size=50" -Headers $h
$voice = $r.voices | Where-Object { $_.name -like "Eryn*" } | Select-Object -First 1
if (-not $voice) { Write-Host "No voice named Eryn in this ElevenLabs account." -ForegroundColor Yellow; return }
$audioDir = Join-Path $pro "audio"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $audioDir | Out-Null
$made = 0; $had = 0; $chars = 0; $stopped = $false
foreach ($ln in $intros) {
  $file = Join-Path $pro ($ln.file -replace "/", "\")
  if ((-not $Redo) -and (Test-Path $file) -and ((Get-Item $file).Length -gt 1000)) { $had++; continue }
  if ($MaxChars -gt 0 -and ($chars + $ln.text.Length) -gt $MaxChars) { Write-Host ("Reached your cap of " + $MaxChars + " characters.") -ForegroundColor Yellow; $stopped = $true; break }
  $tries = 0
  while ($true) {
    try {
      $body = @{ text = $ln.text; model_id = "eleven_v3"; voice_settings = @{ stability = 0.5; similarity_boost = 0.75 } } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4
      Invoke-WebRequest -Method Post -Uri ("https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/" + $voice.voice_id + "?output_format=mp3_44100_128") -Headers ($h + @{ "Content-Type" = "application/json; charset=utf-8" }) -Body ([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($body)) -OutFile $file | Out-Null
      if ((Get-Item $file).Length -lt 1000) { Remove-Item $file -Force; throw "empty audio" }
      $made++; $chars += $ln.text.Length
      Write-Host ("Done " + $ln.id + "  (" + $made + " made, " + $chars + " characters used)")
      Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 150
      break
    } catch {
      $code = 0; $msg = ""
      try { $code = [int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode; $sr = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($_.Exception.Response.GetResponseStream()); $msg = $sr.ReadToEnd() } catch {}
      if (Test-Path $file) { Remove-Item $file -Force }
      if (($code -ge 500 -or $code -eq 0) -and $tries -lt 2) { $tries++; Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; continue }
      if ($code -eq 401 -or $code -eq 402 -or $code -eq 429 -or $msg -match "quota|credit|limit") {
        Write-Host ("STOPPED: credits finished (or key refused). Error " + $code + ". Run this again when you have credits.") -ForegroundColor Red
      } else { Write-Host ("STOPPED at " + $ln.id + ": error " + $code + " " + $msg) -ForegroundColor Red }
      $stopped = $true; break
    }
  }
  if ($stopped) { break }
}
$have = @($intros | Where-Object { $f = Join-Path $pro ($_.file -replace "/", "\"); (Test-Path $f) -and ((Get-Item $f).Length -gt 1000) }).Count
Write-Host ""
Write-Host ("New this run: " + $made + " (" + $chars + " characters). Intros recorded in total: " + $have + " of " + $intros.Count) -ForegroundColor Green
if ($stopped) { Write-Host "Not finished. Run it again when credits are added. Deploy to publish what is recorded." -ForegroundColor Yellow }
explorer.exe /select,$audioDir


=== \tools\Make-ProLessons.ps1 ===
# Records lesson one for every field and level with ElevenLabs: the scene-setting, the conversation, the drills (intros only with -WithIntros).
#   .\tools\Make-ProLessons.ps1 -Test        records ONE intro and a short lesson sample in a test folder, so you can listen first
#   .\tools\Make-ProLessons.ps1              records everything: A0 for all ten fields first, then A1, and so on
# It asks for your ElevenLabs key (typed hidden, never saved). It stops cleanly when credits run out; run it again later and it carries on.
param([switch]$Test, [string]$OtherVoice = "", [int]$MaxChars = 0, [string]$UpTo = "c2", [string]$Model = "eleven_v4", [string]$FrenchModel = "eleven_v4", [switch]$WithIntros)
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$root = Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent
$pro = Join-Path $root "public\professional"
$scn = Join-Path $pro "scenario"
$doneFile = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "ProAudio2.done.txt"
Write-Host "Paste your ElevenLabs API key and press Enter (nothing will show):" -ForegroundColor Yellow
$sec = Read-Host -AsSecureString
$key = [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::PtrToStringAuto([Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::SecureStringToBSTR($sec))
if (-not $key) { Write-Host "No key, nothing done." -ForegroundColor Red; return }
$h = @{ "xi-api-key" = $key.Trim() }
try {
  $sub = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/user/subscription" -Headers $h
  Write-Host ("Key accepted. Credits left: " + ([int]$sub.character_limit - [int]$sub.character_count)) -ForegroundColor Green
} catch { Write-Host ("ElevenLabs refused this key: " + $_.Exception.Message) -ForegroundColor Red; return }
$credits = [int]$sub.character_limit - [int]$sub.character_count
$raw = Get-Content (Join-Path $scn "units.json") -Raw -Encoding UTF8
if ($raw -match "undefined") { Write-Host "units.json contains the word undefined. Stopping so no credits are wasted. Send the file to Claude." -ForegroundColor Red; return }
$data = $raw | ConvertFrom-Json
# voices
$all = (Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://api.elevenlabs.io/v2/voices?page_size=100" -Headers $h).voices
$teacher = (Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://api.elevenlabs.io/v2/voices?search=Eryn&page_size=50" -Headers $h).voices | Where-Object { $_.name -like "Eryn*" } | Select-Object -First 1
if (-not $teacher) { Write-Host "No voice named Eryn in this ElevenLabs account." -ForegroundColor Red; return }
if ($OtherVoice) { $other = $all | Where-Object { $_.name -like ($OtherVoice + "*") } | Select-Object -First 1 }
else { $other = $all | Where-Object { $_.name -notlike "Eryn*" -and $_.labels.gender -eq "male" } | Select-Object -First 1
       if (-not $other) { $other = $all | Where-Object { $_.name -notlike "Eryn*" } | Select-Object -First 1 } }
if (-not $other) { Write-Host "No second voice found. Add one in ElevenLabs, then run again." -ForegroundColor Red; return }
Write-Host ("Teacher English model: " + $Model + "    French lines model: " + $FrenchModel)
Write-Host ("Teacher: " + $teacher.name + "    Other person: " + $other.name + "   (to use another voice: -OtherVoice ""Name"")")
$script:noLang = $false; $script:stop = $false; $script:chars = 0
function Speak($text, $voiceId, $model, $speed, $lang, $outFile) {
  for ($try = 0; $try -lt 3; $try++) {
    $vs = @{ stability = 0.5; similarity_boost = 0.75 }
    if ($model -eq "eleven_multilingual_v2" -and $speed) { $vs.speed = [double]$speed }
    $b = @{ text = $text; model_id = $model; voice_settings = $vs }
    if ($model -ne "eleven_multilingual_v2" -and $lang -and -not $script:noLang) { $b.language_code = $lang }
    $json = $b | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
    try {
      Invoke-WebRequest -Method Post -Uri ("https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/" + $voiceId + "?output_format=mp3_44100_128") -Headers ($h + @{ "Content-Type" = "application/json; charset=utf-8" }) -Body ([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($json)) -OutFile $outFile | Out-Null
      if ((Get-Item $outFile).Length -lt 1000) { Remove-Item $outFile -Force; throw "empty audio" }
      $script:chars += $text.Length
      Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 150
      return $true
    } catch {
      $code = 0; $msg = ""
      try { $code = [int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode; $sr = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($_.Exception.Response.GetResponseStream()); $msg = $sr.ReadToEnd() } catch {}
      if (Test-Path $outFile) { Remove-Item $outFile -Force }
      if (($code -eq 400 -or $code -eq 422) -and $msg -match "language_code" -and -not $script:noLang) { $script:noLang = $true; Write-Host "(this model ignores language_code, continuing without it)"; continue }
      if ($code -eq 401 -or $code -eq 402 -or $code -eq 429 -or $msg -match "quota|credit|limit") { Write-Host ("STOPPED: credits finished (or key refused), error " + $code + ". Run again when you have credits.") -ForegroundColor Red; $script:stop = $true; return $false }
      if (($code -ge 500 -or $code -eq 0) -and $try -lt 2) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; continue }
      Write-Host ("STOPPED: error " + $code + " " + $msg) -ForegroundColor Red; $script:stop = $true; return $false
    }
  }
  return $false
}
function Speak-Intro($u, $outFile) {
  $parts = @(); $i = 0
  foreach ($sg in $u.intro.segments) {
    $tmp = $outFile + ".part" + $i; $i++
    $lang = if ($sg.fr) { "fr" } else { "en" }
    if (-not (Speak $sg.t $teacher.voice_id $Model $null $lang $tmp)) { foreach ($p in $parts) { Remove-Item $p -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; return $false }
    $parts += $tmp
  }
  $ms = New-Object IO.MemoryStream
  foreach ($p in $parts) { $by = [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($p); $ms.Write($by, 0, $by.Length); Remove-Item $p -Force }
  [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($outFile, $ms.ToArray()); return $true
}
function Speak-Line($ln, $outFile, $frModel = $FrenchModel) {
  if ($ln.lang -eq "en") { return (Speak $ln.text $teacher.voice_id $Model $null "en" $outFile) }
  $vid = if ($ln.role -eq "c") { $other.voice_id } else { $teacher.voice_id }
  if ($frModel -eq "eleven_multilingual_v2") { return (Speak $ln.text $vid $frModel $ln.speed "fr" $outFile) }
  # newer models have no speed setting, so the teaching pace is asked for with a delivery tag
  $tag = ""; if ($ln.speed -and $ln.speed -le 0.75) { $tag = "[speaking very slowly and clearly] " } elseif ($ln.speed -and $ln.speed -le 0.82) { $tag = "[speaking slowly and clearly] " } elseif ($ln.speed -and $ln.speed -le 0.9) { $tag = "[speaking a little slowly] " }
  return (Speak ($tag + $ln.text) $vid $frModel $null "fr" $outFile)
}
# ---------- test mode ----------
if ($Test) {
  $dir = Join-Path $pro "audio-test"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dir | Out-Null
  Get-ChildItem $dir -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Force
  $u = $data.units | Where-Object { $_.key -eq "medical-A0" } | Select-Object -First 1
  $pick = @($u.lines | Where-Object { $_.lang -ne "en" } | Select-Object -First 4)
  $est = @($data.units | ForEach-Object { $_.lines } | Where-Object { $_.lang -ne "en" -and $_.text -match "\best\b" } | Select-Object -First 2)
  Write-Host "Recording the test: the same French lines with two models, so you can hear which is right (about 600 credits)..."
  $n = 1
  foreach ($ln in ($pick + $est)) {
    if ($script:stop) { break }
    foreach ($m in @("eleven_multilingual_v2", "eleven_v4")) { $tag = if ($m -eq "eleven_v4") { "v4" } else { "v2" }
      [void](Speak-Line $ln (Join-Path $dir ($n.ToString() + "-" + $ln.role + "-" + $tag + ".mp3")) $m) }
    $n++
  }
  Write-Host ("Test done (" + $script:chars + " credits). Files go in pairs: number-voice-v2 then the same line as v4. 1 to 4 are the opening lines (c = the other person, p = you); 5 and 6 contain the word est.") -ForegroundColor Green
  Write-Host "Tell me which sounds right, v2 or v4. Nothing on the site was changed."
  explorer.exe /select,(Join-Path $dir "1-c-v2.mp3"); return
}
# ---------- full recording ----------
$done = @{}; if (Test-Path $doneFile) { Get-Content $doneFile | ForEach-Object { if ($_) { $done[$_] = 1 } } }
$audioDir = Join-Path $scn "audio"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $audioDir | Out-Null
$order = @("a0","a1","a2","b1","b2","c1","c2"); $limit = [array]::IndexOf($order, $UpTo.ToLower()); if ($limit -lt 0) { $limit = 6 }
$made = 0
function Mark($id) { Add-Content -Path $doneFile -Value $id; $done[$id] = 1 }
Write-Host "Shared lines (cues, praise, short phrases)..."
foreach ($ln in $data.shared) {
  if ($script:stop) { break }
  if ($done.ContainsKey($ln.id)) { continue }
  if ($MaxChars -gt 0 -and ($script:chars + $ln.text.Length) -gt $MaxChars) { $script:stop = $true; Write-Host "Reached your cap." -ForegroundColor Yellow; break }
  if (Speak-Line $ln (Join-Path $audioDir ($ln.id + ".mp3"))) { Mark $ln.id; $made++ }
}
foreach ($u in $data.units) {
  if ($script:stop) { break }
  if ([array]::IndexOf($order, $u.lv) -gt $limit) { continue }
  $todo = @($u.lines | Where-Object { -not $done.ContainsKey($_.id) })
  $needIntro = ($WithIntros -and $u.intro -and -not $done.ContainsKey($u.intro.id))
  if (-not $needIntro -and $todo.Count -eq 0) { continue }
  $cost = ($todo | ForEach-Object { $_.text.Length } | Measure-Object -Sum).Sum + $(if ($needIntro) { $u.intro.text.Length } else { 0 })
  if ($MaxChars -gt 0 -and ($script:chars + $cost) -gt $MaxChars) { Write-Host ("Reached your cap before " + $u.key) -ForegroundColor Yellow; break }
  if ($cost -gt ($credits - $script:chars - 200)) { Write-Host ("CREDITS ARE OUT: not enough left to record " + $u.key + " completely, so it was skipped to keep every published lesson in one voice.") -ForegroundColor Yellow; $script:stop = $true; break }
  Write-Host ("== " + $u.key + "  (" + $cost + " characters)")
  if ($needIntro) { if (Speak-Intro $u (Join-Path $pro ($u.intro.file -replace "/", "\"))) { Mark $u.intro.id; $made++ } else { break } }
  foreach ($ln in $todo) {
    if ($script:stop) { break }
    if (Speak-Line $ln (Join-Path $audioDir ($ln.id + ".mp3"))) { Mark $ln.id; $made++ }
  }
}
$left = ($data.units | Where-Object { [array]::IndexOf($order, $_.lv) -le $limit } | Where-Object { ($WithIntros -and $_.intro -and -not $done.ContainsKey($_.intro.id)) -or (@($_.lines | Where-Object { -not $done.ContainsKey($_.id) }).Count -gt 0) }).Count
Write-Host ""
Write-Host ("Recorded " + $made + " files this run (" + $script:chars + " characters). Lessons still to record: " + $left + " of " + @($data.units).Count + ".") -ForegroundColor Green
if ($left -gt 0) { Write-Host "Not finished. Run it again when credits are added. Deploy to publish what is recorded." -ForegroundColor Yellow }
explorer.exe /select,$audioDir

=== \tools\patch-server-feedback.mjs ===
// Makes the pronunciation server return sound-by-sound detail (phonemes + word timings) for specific feedback.
// Finds the server file that holds /api/assessPronunciation under C:\SayBon and patches it. Safe to run twice.
import fs from "fs"; import path from "path";
const root = process.argv[2] || "C:\\SayBon";
function find(dir, depth) {
  if (depth > 3) return null;
  for (const n of fs.readdirSync(dir)) {
    if (/^(node_modules|\.git|_QUARANTINE|_ARCHIVE|public|dumps)/.test(n)) continue;
    const f = path.join(dir, n), st = fs.statSync(f);
    if (st.isDirectory()) { const r = find(f, depth + 1); if (r) return r; }
    else if (/\.js$/.test(n) && st.size < 3e6) { const t = fs.readFileSync(f, "utf8"); if (t.includes("/api/assessPronunciation") && t.includes("Pronunciation-Assessment")) return f; }
  }
  return null;
}
const f = find(root, 0);
if (!f) { console.log("STOP: could not find the server file with /api/assessPronunciation under " + root); process.exit(1); }
let s = fs.readFileSync(f, "utf8");
if (s.includes("/*detail-v1*/")) { console.log("Already patched: " + f); process.exit(0); }
fs.writeFileSync(f + ".bakDetail", s);
const g = /Granularity:\s*"Word"/;
if (!g.test(s)) { console.log("STOP: Granularity line not found in " + f); process.exit(1); }
s = s.replace(g, 'Granularity: "Phoneme",\nPhonemeAlphabet: "IPA"');
const m = /res\.json\(\{\s*\n?\s*recognizedText:/;
if (!m.test(s)) { console.log("STOP: response block not found in " + f); process.exit(1); }
s = s.replace(m, (x) => x.replace("recognizedText:", "detail: (best.Words || []), /*detail-v1*/\nrecognizedText:"));
fs.writeFileSync(f, s);
console.log("Patched: " + f + "  (backup: " + path.basename(f) + ".bakDetail)");

function pcmToWav(d) { var n = d.length, pk = 0, i; for (i = 0; i < n; i++) { var a = Math.abs(d[i]); if (a > pk) pk = a; } var gain = (pk > 0.005 && pk < 0.7) ? 0.85 / pk : 1; var bf = new ArrayBuffer(44 + n * 2), v = new DataView(bf); function w(o, t) { for (var k = 0; k < t.length; k++) v.setUint8(o + k, t.charCodeAt(k)); } w(0, "RIFF"); v.setUint32(4, 36 + n * 2, true); w(8, "WAVE"); w(12, "fmt "); v.setUint32(16, 16, true); v.setUint16(20, 1, true); v.setUint16(22, 1, true); v.setUint32(24, 16000, true); v.setUint32(28, 32000, true); v.setUint16(32, 2, true); v.setUint16(34, 16, true); w(36, "data"); v.setUint32(40, n * 2, true); for (i = 0; i < n; i++) { var x = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, d[i] * gain)); v.setInt16(44 + i * 2, x < 0 ? x * 0x8000 : x * 0x7FFF, true); } var wb = new Blob([bf], { type: "audio/wav" }); wb.pk = pk; return wb; }

/* records automatically: starts at once, ends after a pause once the learner has spoken. Resolves a Blob, "quiet" (nobody spoke), or null (skipped). */
function autoRecord(ui, o) {
  return new Promise(function(resolve) {
    var done = false, mr = null, chunks = [], ac = null, raf = 0, spoke = false, lastVoice = 0, t0 = Date.now(), floor = 0, nf = 0;
    ui.orb.classList.remove("idle"); ui.stt.textContent = T.listening;
    ui.btns.innerHTML = '<button class="lnk" id="rdSk">' + T.skip + "</button>";
    function fin(v) { if (done) return; done = true; cancelAnimationFrame(raf); try { ac && ac.close(); } catch (e) {} ui.orb.classList.add("idle"); ui.orb.style.transform = ""; ui.btns.innerHTML = ""; resolve(v); }
    ui.btns.querySelector("#rdSk").onclick = function() { try { if (mr && mr.state === "recording") { mr.onstop = null; mr.stop(); } } catch (e) {} fin(null); };
    getStream().then(function(s) {
      var AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext; ac = new AC(); var an = ac.createAnalyser(); an.fftSize = 1024; ac.createMediaStreamSource(s).connect(an);
      var buf = new Float32Array(an.fftSize);
      mr = new MediaRecorder(s); mr.ondataavailable = function(e) { if (e.data && e.data.size) chunks.push(e.data); };
      mr.onstop = function() { fin(spoke ? new Blob(chunks, { type: mr.mimeType || "audio/webm" }) : "quiet"); };
      mr.start(); t0 = Date.now();
      (function tick() {
        if (done) return; an.getFloatTimeDomainData(buf); var sum = 0, i; for (i = 0; i < buf.length; i++) sum += buf[i] * buf[i]; var rms = Math.sqrt(sum / buf.length), now = Date.now(), el = now - t0;
        if (el < 600) { floor = nf ? Math.min(floor, rms) : rms; nf++; } else { var th = Math.min(0.045, Math.max(0.015, floor * 3));
          if (rms > th) { spoke = true; lastVoice = now; }
          ui.orb.style.transform = "scale(" + (1 + Math.min(1.6, rms * 14)).toFixed(2) + ")";
          if (spoke && now - lastVoice > o.sil && el > 1200) { try { mr.stop(); } catch (e) {} return; }
          if (!spoke && el > o.wait) { try { mr.stop(); } catch (e) {} return; }
          if (el > o.cap) { try { mr.stop(); } catch (e) {} return; } }
        raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      })();
    }).catch(function() { ui.stt.textContent = T.mic; });
  });
}
/* grade -> {v, det:[per reference word {w,s,e,ph,st,en}] or null, ws (compat), quiet, err} */
function azWords(j) {
  var raw = j && (j.detail || (j._debugRawAzureResponse && j._debugRawAzureResponse.NBest && j._debugRawAzureResponse.NBest[0] && j._debugRawAzureResponse.NBest[0].Words));
  return (raw && raw.length) ? raw : null;
